import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../data/models/models.dart';  // ✅ Utiliser models.dart

/// État global de l'application
class AppState {
  // ============================================
  // AUTHENTIFICATION
  // ============================================
  final AppUser? currentUser;
  final bool isAuthenticated;
  final bool isLoading;
  final String? error;

  // ============================================
  // ONBOARDING
  // ============================================
  final bool onboardingCompleted;

  // ============================================
  // PIN
  // ============================================
  final bool hasPin;
  final bool isPinLocked;
  final int pinAttempts;

  // ============================================
  // ACCÈS
  // ============================================
  final bool hasAccessVie;
  final bool isRoot;
  final bool essaiExpire;

  // ============================================
  // THEME
  // ============================================
  final bool isDarkMode;

  // ============================================
  // NOTIFICATIONS
  // ============================================
  final bool notificationsEnabled;

  const AppState({
    this.currentUser,
    this.isAuthenticated = false,
    this.isLoading = false,
    this.error,
    this.onboardingCompleted = false,
    this.hasPin = false,
    this.isPinLocked = false,
    this.pinAttempts = 0,
    this.hasAccessVie = false,
    this.isRoot = false,
    this.essaiExpire = false,
    this.isDarkMode = false,
    this.notificationsEnabled = true,
  });

  // ============================================
  // COPIE
  // ============================================

  AppState copyWith({
    AppUser? currentUser,
    bool? isAuthenticated,
    bool? isLoading,
    String? error,
    bool? onboardingCompleted,
    bool? hasPin,
    bool? isPinLocked,
    int? pinAttempts,
    bool? hasAccessVie,
    bool? isRoot,
    bool? essaiExpire,
    bool? isDarkMode,
    bool? notificationsEnabled,
  }) {
    return AppState(
      currentUser: currentUser ?? this.currentUser,
      isAuthenticated: isAuthenticated ?? this.isAuthenticated,
      isLoading: isLoading ?? this.isLoading,
      error: error ?? this.error,
      onboardingCompleted: onboardingCompleted ?? this.onboardingCompleted,
      hasPin: hasPin ?? this.hasPin,
      isPinLocked: isPinLocked ?? this.isPinLocked,
      pinAttempts: pinAttempts ?? this.pinAttempts,
      hasAccessVie: hasAccessVie ?? this.hasAccessVie,
      isRoot: isRoot ?? this.isRoot,
      essaiExpire: essaiExpire ?? this.essaiExpire,
      isDarkMode: isDarkMode ?? this.isDarkMode,
      notificationsEnabled: notificationsEnabled ?? this.notificationsEnabled,
    );
  }

  // ============================================
  // MÉTHODES UTILITAIRES
  // ============================================

  /// Vérifie si l'utilisateur est complètement authentifié
  bool get isFullyAuthenticated {
    return isAuthenticated && currentUser != null;
  }

  /// Vérifie si l'utilisateur est root
  bool get isRootUser => isRoot;

  /// Vérifie si l'utilisateur a accès à l'application
  bool get canAccessApp {
    return isRoot || hasAccessVie || !essaiExpire;
  }

  /// Récupère le nom d'affichage de l'utilisateur
  String get displayName {
    if (currentUser != null) {
      return currentUser!.prenom;
    }
    return 'Utilisateur';
  }

  /// Récupère la monnaie de l'utilisateur
  String get monnaie {
    return currentUser?.monnaie ?? 'FCFA';
  }

  /// Vérifie si l'utilisateur doit faire l'onboarding
  bool get needsOnboarding {
    return isAuthenticated && !onboardingCompleted;
  }

  /// Vérifie si l'utilisateur doit créer un PIN
  bool get needsPin {
    return isAuthenticated && !hasPin;
  }

  /// Vérifie si l'utilisateur doit aller à l'activation
  bool get needsActivation {
    return isAuthenticated && !canAccessApp;
  }

  /// État initial
  static const AppState initial = AppState();

  /// État chargement
  static const AppState loading = AppState(isLoading: true);

  /// État authentifié
  factory AppState.authenticated(AppUser user) {
    return AppState(
      currentUser: user,
      isAuthenticated: true,
      onboardingCompleted: user.onboardingVu,
    );
  }

  /// État avec erreur
  factory AppState.error(String error) {
    return AppState(
      error: error,
      isLoading: false,
    );
  }
}

  // ============================================
  // AUTHENTIFICATION
  // ============================================

  /// Définit l'utilisateur authentifié
  void setAuthenticatedUser(AppUser user) {
    state = state.copyWith(
      currentUser: user,
      isAuthenticated: true,
      isLoading: false,
      onboardingCompleted: user.onboardingVu,
    );
  }

  /// Définit l'utilisateur non authentifié
  void setUnauthenticated() {
    state = AppState.initial;
  }

  /// Définit l'état de chargement
  void setLoading(bool loading) {
    state = state.copyWith(isLoading: loading);
  }

  /// Définit une erreur
  void setError(String? error) {
    state = state.copyWith(error: error, isLoading: false);
  }

  /// Efface l'erreur
  void clearError() {
    state = state.copyWith(error: null);
  }

  // ============================================
  // ONBOARDING
  // ============================================

  /// Marque l'onboarding comme terminé
  void completeOnboarding() {
    state = state.copyWith(onboardingCompleted: true);
  }

  // ============================================
  // PIN
  // ============================================

  /// Définit le PIN comme existant
  void setPinExists(bool exists) {
    state = state.copyWith(hasPin: exists);
  }

  /// Définit l'état du PIN
  void setPinState({
    bool? hasPin,
    bool? isPinLocked,
    int? pinAttempts,
  }) {
    state = state.copyWith(
      hasPin: hasPin ?? state.hasPin,
      isPinLocked: isPinLocked ?? state.isPinLocked,
      pinAttempts: pinAttempts ?? state.pinAttempts,
    );
  }

  // ============================================
  // ACCÈS
  // ============================================

  /// Définit l'accès à vie
  void setAccessVie(bool hasAccess) {
    state = state.copyWith(hasAccessVie: hasAccess);
  }

  /// Définit le statut root
  void setRootUser(bool isRoot) {
    state = state.copyWith(isRoot: isRoot);
  }

  /// Définit l'expiration de l'essai
  void setEssaiExpire(bool expired) {
    state = state.copyWith(essaiExpire: expired);
  }

  // ============================================
  // THEME
  // ============================================

  /// Bascule le thème sombre
  void toggleDarkMode() {
    state = state.copyWith(isDarkMode: !state.isDarkMode);
  }

  /// Définit le thème sombre
  void setDarkMode(bool darkMode) {
    state = state.copyWith(isDarkMode: darkMode);
  }

  // ============================================
  // NOTIFICATIONS
  // ============================================

  /// Définit les notifications
  void setNotificationsEnabled(bool enabled) {
    state = state.copyWith(notificationsEnabled: enabled);
  }

  // ============================================
  // UTILITAIRES
  // ============================================

  /// Réinitialise l'état
  void reset() {
    state = AppState.initial;
  }

  /// Met à jour le profil utilisateur
  void updateUser(AppUser user) {
    state = state.copyWith(currentUser: user);
  }
}

  final walletRepo = ref.watch(walletRepositoryProvider);
  return DeleteTransactionUseCase(
    transactionRepository: transactionRepo,
    walletRepository: walletRepo,
  );
});

/// Provider du Use Case pour mettre à jour une transaction
final updateTransactionUseCaseProvider = Provider<UpdateTransactionUseCase>((ref) {
  return UpdateTransactionUseCase(ref.watch(transactionRepositoryProvider));
});

/// Liste des transactions en temps réel
final transactionListProvider = StreamProvider.family<List<TransactionModel>, String>((ref, uid) {

  return useCase.execute(uid, limit: 50);
});

/// Liste des transactions avec limite personnalisée
final transactionListWithLimitProvider = StreamProvider.family<List<TransactionModel>, TransactionListParams>(
  (ref, params) {
    final useCase = ref.watch(watchTransactionsUseCaseProvider);
    return useCase.execute(params.uid, limit: params.limit);
  },
);

// ============================================
// FUTURE PROVIDERS (Actions)
// ============================================

/// Provider pour ajouter une transaction
final addTransactionProvider = FutureProvider.family<AddTransactionResult, AddTransactionParams>(
  (ref, params) async {
    final useCase = ref.watch(addTransactionUseCaseProvider);
    final result = await useCase.execute(params);
    
    if (result.success) {
      Logger.success('✅ Transaction ajoutée: ${result.transaction?.id}');
      ref.read(transactionStateProvider.notifier).addTransactionLocally(result.transaction!);
    } else {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur ajout transaction: ${result.message}');
    }
    
    return result;
  },
);

/// Provider pour récupérer les transactions (une seule fois)
final getTransactionsProvider = FutureProvider.family<GetTransactionsResult, GetTransactionsParams>(
  (ref, params) async {
    final useCase = ref.watch(getTransactionsUseCaseProvider);
    return await useCase.execute(
      uid: params.uid,
      limit: params.limit,
      filters: params.filters,
    );
  },
);

/// Provider pour supprimer une transaction
final deleteTransactionProvider = FutureProvider.family<DeleteTransactionResult, String>(
  (ref, transactionId) async {
    final useCase = ref.watch(deleteTransactionUseCaseProvider);
    final result = await useCase.execute(transactionId);
    
    if (result.success) {
      Logger.success('🗑️ Transaction supprimée: $transactionId');
      ref.read(transactionStateProvider.notifier).deleteTransactionLocally(transactionId);
    } else {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur suppression transaction: ${result.message}');
    }
    
    return result;
  },
);

/// Provider pour mettre à jour une transaction
final updateTransactionProvider = FutureProvider.family<UpdateTransactionResult, UpdateTransactionParams>(
  (ref, params) async {
    final useCase = ref.watch(updateTransactionUseCaseProvider);
    final result = await useCase.execute(params);
    
    if (result.success) {
      Logger.success('📝 Transaction mise à jour: ${result.transaction?.id}');
      ref.read(transactionStateProvider.notifier).updateTransactionLocally(result.transaction!);
    } else {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur mise à jour transaction: ${result.message}');
    }
    
    return result;
  },
);

/// Provider pour l'état des transactions
final transactionStateProvider = StateNotifierProvider<TransactionNotifier, TransactionState>((ref) {
  return TransactionNotifier(ref);

/// État des transactions
class TransactionState {
  final List<TransactionModel> transactions;
  final bool isLoading;
  final String? error;
  final double totalRevenus;
  final double totalDepenses;
  final double solde;

  const TransactionState({
    this.transactions = const [],
    this.isLoading = false,
    this.error,
    this.totalRevenus = 0,
    this.totalDepenses = 0,
    this.solde = 0,
  });

  TransactionState copyWith({
    List<TransactionModel>? transactions,
    bool? isLoading,
    String? error,
    double? totalRevenus,
    double? totalDepenses,
    double? solde,
  }) {
    return TransactionState(
      transactions: transactions ?? this.transactions,
      isLoading: isLoading ?? this.isLoading,
      error: error ?? this.error,
      totalRevenus: totalRevenus ?? this.totalRevenus,
      totalDepenses: totalDepenses ?? this.totalDepenses,
      solde: solde ?? this.solde,
    );
  }

  /// Calcule les totaux à partir de la liste
  factory TransactionState.calculate(List<TransactionModel> transactions) {
    double revenus = 0;
    double depenses = 0;

    for (final tx in transactions) {
      if (tx.isRevenu) {
        revenus += tx.montant;
      } else if (tx.isDepense) {
        depenses += tx.montant;
      }
    }

    return TransactionState(
      transactions: transactions,
      totalRevenus: revenus,
      totalDepenses: depenses,
      solde: revenus - depenses,
    );
  }
}

/// Notifier pour l'état des transactions
class TransactionNotifier extends StateNotifier<TransactionState> {
  final Ref _ref;

  TransactionNotifier(this._ref) : super(const TransactionState());

  /// Charge les transactions
  Future<void> loadTransactions(String uid, {int limit = 50, TransactionFilters? filters}) async {
    if (uid.isEmpty) return;

    state = state.copyWith(isLoading: true);
    
    try {
      final result = await _ref.read(getTransactionsProvider(
        GetTransactionsParams(uid: uid, limit: limit, filters: filters),
      ).future);
      
      if (result.success) {
        state = TransactionState.calculate(result.transactions);
      } else {
        state = state.copyWith(
          isLoading: false,
          error: result.message,
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      state = state.copyWith(
        isLoading: false,
        error: e.toString(),
      );
    }
  }

  /// Ajoute une transaction localement (optimiste)
  void addTransactionLocally(TransactionModel transaction) {
    final updatedTransactions = [transaction, ...state.transactions];
    state = TransactionState.calculate(updatedTransactions);
  }

  /// Met à jour une transaction localement
  void updateTransactionLocally(TransactionModel updatedTransaction) {
    final updatedTransactions = state.transactions.map((tx) {
      return tx.id == updatedTransaction.id ? updatedTransaction : tx;
    }).toList();
    
    state = TransactionState.calculate(updatedTransactions);
  }

  /// Supprime une transaction localement
  void deleteTransactionLocally(String transactionId) {
    final updatedTransactions = state.transactions.where((tx) => tx.id != transactionId).toList();
    state = TransactionState.calculate(updatedTransactions);
  }

  /// Filtre les transactions
  List<TransactionModel> filterTransactions({
    String? categorieId,
    TransactionType? type,
    String? walletId,
    DateTime? dateDebut,
    DateTime? dateFin,
  }) {
    return state.transactions.where((tx) {
      if (categorieId != null && tx.categorieId != categorieId) return false;
      if (type != null && tx.type != type) return false;
      if (walletId != null && tx.walletId != walletId) return false;
      if (dateDebut != null && tx.dateTransaction.isBefore(dateDebut)) return false;
      if (dateFin != null && tx.dateTransaction.isAfter(dateFin)) return false;
      return true;
    }).toList();
  }

  /// Efface l'erreur
  void clearError() {
    state = state.copyWith(error: null);
  }

  /// Réinitialise l'état
  void reset() {
    state = const TransactionState();
  }
}

// ============================================
// PARAMÈTRES
// ============================================

/// Paramètres pour la récupération des transactions
class GetTransactionsParams {
  final String uid;
  final int limit;
  final TransactionFilters? filters;

  const GetTransactionsParams({
    required this.uid,
    this.limit = 50,
    this.filters,
  });
}

/// Paramètres pour l'écoute des transactions
class TransactionListParams {
  final String uid;
  final int limit;

  const TransactionListParams({
    required this.uid,
    this.limit = 50,
  });
}

class EcheancesState {
  final List<EcheanceModel> echeances;
  final bool isLoading;
  final String? error;
  final int totalEnRetard;
  final double montantTotal;
  final double montantEnRetard;

  const EcheancesState({
    this.echeances = const [],
    this.isLoading = false,
    this.error,
    this.totalEnRetard = 0,
    this.montantTotal = 0,
    this.montantEnRetard = 0,
  });

  EcheancesState copyWith({
    List<EcheanceModel>? echeances,
    bool? isLoading,
    String? error,
    int? totalEnRetard,
    double? montantTotal,
    double? montantEnRetard,
  }) {
    return EcheancesState(
      echeances: echeances ?? this.echeances,
      isLoading: isLoading ?? this.isLoading,
      error: error ?? this.error,
      totalEnRetard: totalEnRetard ?? this.totalEnRetard,
      montantTotal: montantTotal ?? this.montantTotal,
      montantEnRetard: montantEnRetard ?? this.montantEnRetard,
    );
  }

  List<EcheanceModel> get enAttente =>
      echeances.where((e) => e.statut == 'en_attente').toList();

  List<EcheanceModel> get payees =>
      echeances.where((e) => e.statut == 'payee').toList();

  List<EcheanceModel> get enRetard =>
      echeances.where((e) => e.estEnRetard).toList();

  List<EcheanceModel> get cetteSemaine {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final dans7Jours = now.add(const Duration(days: 7));
    return echeances.where((e) =>
        e.statut != 'payee' &&
        e.dateEcheance.isAfter(now) &&
        e.dateEcheance.isBefore(dans7Jours)).toList();
  }
}

class EcheancesNotifier extends StateNotifier<EcheancesState> {
  final Ref _ref;

  EcheancesNotifier(this._ref) : super(const EcheancesState());

  Future<void> loadEcheances(String uid) async {
    if (uid.isEmpty) return;

    state = state.copyWith(isLoading: true);

    try {
      final result = await _ref.read(getEcheancesProvider(uid).future);

      if (result.success) {
        state = EcheancesState(
          echeances: result.echeances,
          totalEnRetard: result.totalEnRetard,
          montantTotal: result.montantTotal,
          montantEnRetard: result.montantEnRetard,
          isLoading: false,
          error: null,
        );
      } else {
        state = state.copyWith(
          isLoading: false,
          error: result.message,
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      state = state.copyWith(
        isLoading: false,
        error: e.toString(),
      );
    }
  }

  void addEcheanceLocally(EcheanceModel echeance) {
    final updated = [...state.echeances, echeance];
    _recalculerTotaux(updated);
  }

  void updateEcheanceLocally(EcheanceModel updatedEcheance) {
    final updated = state.echeances.map((e) {
      return e.id == updatedEcheance.id ? updatedEcheance : e;
    }).toList();
    _recalculerTotaux(updated);
  }

  void deleteEcheanceLocally(String echeanceId) {
    final updated = state.echeances.where((e) => e.id != echeanceId).toList();
    _recalculerTotaux(updated);
  }

  void _recalculerTotaux(List<EcheanceModel> echeances) {
    int totalEnRetard = 0;
    double montantTotal = 0;
    double montantEnRetard = 0;

    for (final e in echeances) {
      montantTotal += e.montant;
      if (e.estEnRetard) {
        totalEnRetard++;
        montantEnRetard += e.montant;
      }
    }

    state = state.copyWith(
      echeances: echeances,
      totalEnRetard: totalEnRetard,
      montantTotal: montantTotal,
      montantEnRetard: montantEnRetard,
    );
  }

  void clearError() {
    state = state.copyWith(error: null);
  }

  void reset() {
    state = const EcheancesState();
  }
}

final echeancesEnRetardCountProvider = Provider<int>((ref) {
  return ref.watch(echeancesStateProvider).totalEnRetard;
});

final echeancesCetteSemaineProvider = Provider<List<EcheanceModel>>((ref) {
  return ref.watch(echeancesStateProvider).cetteSemaine;
});

final echeanceByIdProvider = Provider.family<EcheanceModel?, String>((ref, id) {
  final state = ref.watch(echeancesStateProvider);
  try {
    return state.echeances.firstWhere((e) => e.id == id);
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
});

// lib/presentation/providers/auth/auth_provider.dart

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

import '../../../data/models/models.dart';

    ref.watch(authRepositoryProvider),
    ref.watch(appStateProvider.notifier),

// ============================================
// NOTIFIER

class AuthNotifier extends StateNotifier<AuthState> {
  final IAuthRepository _authRepository;
  final AppStateNotifier _appStateNotifier;

  AuthNotifier(this._authRepository, this._appStateNotifier)
      : super(AuthState.initial) {
    Future.microtask(_checkAuthStatus);
  }

  // ============================================
  // VÉRIFICATION DE L'AUTHENTIFICATION
  // ============================================

  Future<void> _checkAuthStatus() async {
    try {
      state = AuthState.loading;
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(true);

      final isAuthenticated = await _authRepository.isAuthenticated();

      if (isAuthenticated) {
        final user = await _authRepository.getCurrentUser();
        if (user != null) {
          state = AuthState.authenticated(user);
          _appStateNotifier.setAuthenticatedUser(user);
          Logger.info('👤 Utilisateur authentifié: ${user.prenom}');
        } else {
          state = AuthState.initial;
          _appStateNotifier.setUnauthenticated();
        }
      } else {
        state = AuthState.initial;
        _appStateNotifier.setUnauthenticated();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      state = AuthState.error(e.toString());
      _appStateNotifier.setError(e.toString());
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur vérification auth: $e');
    } finally {
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // ENVOI DU CODE DE VÉRIFICATION SMS
  // ============================================

  Future<void> sendVerificationCode(String phoneNumber) async {
    try {
      state = AuthState.verifying();
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(true);

      await _authRepository.sendVerificationCode(phoneNumber);

      state = AuthState.codeSent('pending');
      Logger.info('📱 Code envoyé à $phoneNumber');
    } catch (e) {
      state = AuthState.error(e.toString());
      _appStateNotifier.setError(e.toString());
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur envoi code: $e');
    } finally {
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // VÉRIFICATION DU CODE SMS
  // ============================================

  Future<AppUser?> verifyCode(String verificationId, String smsCode) async {
    try {
      state = AuthState.verifying();
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(true);

      final user = await _authRepository.verifyPhoneNumber(
        verificationId,
        smsCode,
      );

      state = AuthState.authenticated(user);
      _appStateNotifier.setAuthenticatedUser(user);

      Logger.success('✅ Code vérifié: ${user.prenom}');
      return user;
    } catch (e) {
      state = AuthState.error(e.toString());
      _appStateNotifier.setError(e.toString());
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur vérification: $e');
      return null;
    } finally {
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  Future<bool> verifyCodeSingle(String smsCode) async {
    try {
      state = AuthState.verifying();
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(true);

      final verificationId = state.verificationId ?? '';
      final user = await _authRepository.verifyPhoneNumber(
        verificationId,
        smsCode,
      );

      state = AuthState.authenticated(user);
      _appStateNotifier.setAuthenticatedUser(user);

      Logger.success('✅ Code vérifié: ${user.prenom}');
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      state = AuthState.error(e.toString());
      _appStateNotifier.setError(e.toString());
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur vérification: $e');
      return false;
    } finally {
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // VÉRIFICATION EMAIL (Brevo + Cloudflare Worker)
  // ============================================

  static const String _brevoWorkerUrl =
      'https://brevo-proxy.tapa-budget.workers.dev';

  Future<void> envoyerCodeVerificationEmail(String email) async {
    try {
      state = state.copyWith(isLoading: true);
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(true);

      final code = (100000 + Random().nextInt(900000)).toString();

      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('email_verifications')
          .doc(email)
          .set({
        'code': code,
        'email': email,
        'expiresAt': Timestamp.fromDate(
          DateTime.now().add(const Duration(minutes: 15)),
        ),
      });

      final response = await http.post(
        Uri.parse(_brevoWorkerUrl),
        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
        body: jsonEncode({'email': email, 'code': code}),
      );

      if (response.statusCode != 200 && response.statusCode != 201) {
        throw Exception('Erreur envoi email: ${response.body}');
      }

      Logger.success('✅ Code de vérification envoyé à $email');
    } catch (e) {
      state = AuthState.error(e.toString());
      _appStateNotifier.setError(e.toString());
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur envoi code email: $e');
      rethrow;
    } finally {
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  Future<bool> verifierCodeEmail(String email, String codeEntre) async {
    try {
      state = state.copyWith(isLoading: true);
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(true);

      final doc = await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('email_verifications')
          .doc(email)
          .get();

      if (!doc.exists) {
        Logger.warning('⚠️ Aucune demande de vérification trouvée');
        return false;
      }

      final data = doc.data()!;
      final expiresAt = (data['expiresAt'] as Timestamp).toDate();

      if (DateTime.now().isAfter(expiresAt)) {
        Logger.warning('⚠️ Code expiré');
        return false;
      }

      if (data['code'] != codeEntre) {
        Logger.warning('⚠️ Code incorrect');
        return false;
      }

      final currentUser = state.user;
      if (currentUser != null) {
        final updatedUser = currentUser.copyWith(
          dernierActive: DateTime.now(),
          email: email,
          emailVerifie: true,
        );

        await _authRepository.updateUser(updatedUser);

        state = AuthState.authenticated(updatedUser);
        _appStateNotifier.updateUser(updatedUser);
      }

      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('email_verifications')
          .doc(email)
          .delete();

      Logger.success('✅ Email vérifié avec succès');
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur vérification code email: $e');
      return false;
    } finally {
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // INSCRIPTION / CRÉATION DE COMPTE
  // ============================================

  Future<AppUser?> createUser({
    required String prenom,
    required String email,
    required String codePays,
    required String monnaie,
  }) async {
    try {
      state = AuthState.loading;
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(true);

      final user = await _authRepository.createUser(
        prenom: prenom,
        email: email,
        codePays: codePays,
        monnaie: monnaie,
      );

      state = AuthState.authenticated(user);
      _appStateNotifier.setAuthenticatedUser(user);

      Logger.success('Compte cree: ${user.prenom}');
      return user;
    } catch (e) {
      state = AuthState.error(e.toString());
      _appStateNotifier.setError(e.toString());
      Logger.error('Erreur creation compte: $e');
      return null;
    } finally {
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> createUserProfile({
    required String prenom,
    required String email,
    required String codePays,
    required String monnaie,
  }) async {
    final user = await createUser(
      prenom: prenom,
      email: email,
      codePays: codePays,
      monnaie: monnaie,
    );
    if (user == null) {
      throw Exception(state.error ?? 'Erreur lors de la creation du compte.');
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // GESTION DU PIN
  // ============================================

  Future<void> savePin(String pin) async {
    try {
      state = state.copyWith(isLoading: true);
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(true);

      final userId = firebase_auth.FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.uid;
      if (userId == null) {
        throw Exception('Aucun utilisateur connecté');
      }

      await PinSecurity.savePin(userId, pin);

      _appStateNotifier.setPinExists(true);

      Logger.success('✅ PIN sauvegardé pour $userId');
    } catch (e) {
      state = AuthState.error(e.toString());
      _appStateNotifier.setError(e.toString());
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur sauvegarde PIN: $e');
      rethrow;
    } finally {
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  Future<bool> verifyPin(String pin) async {
    try {
      state = state.copyWith(isLoading: true);
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(true);

      final userId = firebase_auth.FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.uid;
      if (userId == null) {
        Logger.warning('⚠️ Aucun utilisateur connecté pour vérifier le PIN');
        return false;
      }

      final result = await PinSecurity.verifyPin(userId, pin);

      if (result.success) {
        Logger.success('✅ PIN vérifié');
      } else {
        Logger.warning('⚠️ PIN incorrect: ${result.message}');
      }

      return result.success;
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur vérification PIN: $e');
      return false;
    } finally {
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // ONBOARDING
  // ============================================

  Future<void> markOnboardingAsSeen() async {
    try {
      state = state.copyWith(isLoading: true);
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(true);

      final currentUser = state.user;
      if (currentUser != null) {
        final updatedUser = currentUser.copyWith(
          onboardingVu: true,
          dernierActive: DateTime.now(),
        );

        await _authRepository.updateUser(updatedUser);

        state = AuthState.authenticated(updatedUser);
        _appStateNotifier.updateUser(updatedUser);

        Logger.success('✅ Onboarding marqué comme vu');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      state = AuthState.error(e.toString());
      _appStateNotifier.setError(e.toString());
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur markOnboardingAsSeen: $e');
    } finally {
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // WALLET
  // ============================================

  void updateWalletParams(Map<String, dynamic> params) {
    try {
      Logger.info('📊 Mise à jour wallet params: $params');
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur updateWalletParams: $e');
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // MISE À JOUR DU PROFIL
  // ============================================

  Future<void> updateUserProfile({
    String? prenom,
    String? monnaie,
    String? codePays,
    bool? notificationsActivees,
  }) async {
    try {
      state = state.copyWith(isLoading: true);
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(true);

      final currentUser = state.user;
      if (currentUser != null) {
        final updatedUser = currentUser.copyWith(
          prenom: prenom ?? currentUser.prenom,
          monnaie: monnaie ?? currentUser.monnaie,
          codePays: codePays ?? currentUser.codePays,
          notificationsActivees: notificationsActivees ??
              currentUser.notificationsActivees,
          dernierActive: DateTime.now(),
        );

        await _authRepository.updateUser(updatedUser);

        state = AuthState.authenticated(updatedUser);
        _appStateNotifier.updateUser(updatedUser);

        Logger.success('✅ Profil mis à jour');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      state = AuthState.error(e.toString());
      _appStateNotifier.setError(e.toString());
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur mise à jour profil: $e');
    } finally {
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> updateUser(AppUser user) async {
    try {
      state = state.copyWith(isLoading: true);
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(true);

      await _authRepository.updateUser(user);

      state = AuthState.authenticated(user);
      _appStateNotifier.updateUser(user);

      Logger.success('✅ Profil mis à jour');
    } catch (e) {
      state = AuthState.error(e.toString());
      _appStateNotifier.setError(e.toString());
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur mise à jour profil: $e');
    } finally {
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // DÉCONNEXION
  // ============================================

  Future<void> logout() async {
    try {
      state = AuthState.loading;
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(true);

      // 1. Deconnecter Firebase Auth
      await _authRepository.signOut();

      // 2. Vider Hive (donnees locales)
      try {
        final hive = HiveService();
        await hive.clearAll();
      } catch (e) {
        Logger.error('Erreur nettoyage Hive: $e');
      }

      // 3. Vider SharedPreferences (sauf PIN)
      try {
        final prefs = SharedPreferencesService();
        await prefs.clearUserData();
      } catch (e) {
        Logger.error('Erreur nettoyage SharedPrefs: $e');
      }

      // 4. Reset AppState
      state = AuthState.initial;
      _appStateNotifier.setUnauthenticated();

      Logger.info('🔓 Deconnecte + cache nettoye');
    } catch (e) {
      state = AuthState.error(e.toString());
      _appStateNotifier.setError(e.toString());
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur deconnexion: $e');
    } finally {
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> deleteAccount() async {
    try {
      state = AuthState.loading;
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(true);

      await _authRepository.deleteAccount();

      state = AuthState.initial;
      _appStateNotifier.setUnauthenticated();

      Logger.info('🗑️ Compte supprimé');
    } catch (e) {
      state = AuthState.error(e.toString());
      _appStateNotifier.setError(e.toString());
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur suppression compte: $e');
    } finally {
      _appStateNotifier.setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  void clearError() {
    state = state.copyWith(error: null);
    _appStateNotifier.clearError();
  }

  void reset() {
    state = AuthState.initial;
    _appStateNotifier.setUnauthenticated();
    Logger.info('🔄 État réinitialisé');
  }
}

// lib/presentation/providers/auth/auth_state.dart

import '../../../data/models/models.dart';  // ✅ Utiliser models.dart

/// État de l'authentification
class AuthState {
  final AppUser? user;
  final bool isLoading;
  final bool isAuthenticated;
  final String? error;
  final bool isPhoneVerificationInProgress;
  final String? verificationId;

  const AuthState({
    this.user,
    this.isLoading = false,
    this.isAuthenticated = false,
    this.error,
    this.isPhoneVerificationInProgress = false,
    this.verificationId,
  });

  AuthState copyWith({
    AppUser? user,
    bool? isLoading,
    bool? isAuthenticated,
    String? error,
    bool? isPhoneVerificationInProgress,
    String? verificationId,
  }) {
    return AuthState(
      user: user ?? this.user,
      isLoading: isLoading ?? this.isLoading,
      isAuthenticated: isAuthenticated ?? this.isAuthenticated,
      error: error ?? this.error,
      isPhoneVerificationInProgress:
          isPhoneVerificationInProgress ?? this.isPhoneVerificationInProgress,
      verificationId: verificationId ?? this.verificationId,
    );
  }

  /// État initial
  static const AuthState initial = AuthState();

  /// État de chargement
  static const AuthState loading = AuthState(isLoading: true);

  /// État authentifié
  factory AuthState.authenticated(AppUser user) {
    return AuthState(
      user: user,
      isAuthenticated: true,
    );
  }

  /// État avec erreur
  factory AuthState.error(String error) {
    return AuthState(
      error: error,
      isLoading: false,
    );
  }

  /// État de vérification en cours
  factory AuthState.verifying() {
    return const AuthState(
      isPhoneVerificationInProgress: true,
      isLoading: true,
    );
  }

  /// État avec code envoyé
  factory AuthState.codeSent(String verificationId) {
    return AuthState(
      verificationId: verificationId,
      isPhoneVerificationInProgress: false,
      isLoading: false,
    );
  }

  /// Vérifie si l'utilisateur a un PIN
  bool get hasPin {
    // Le PIN est vérifié séparément via PinSecurity
    return false;
  }
}

// lib/presentation/providers/tarifs/tarifs_provider.dart

import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../../data/models/models.dart';
import '../../../domain/repositories/i_tarif_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/tarif_repository_impl.dart';
import '../../../domain/usecases/tarifs/get_tarifs_usecase.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/logger.dart';

final tarifRepositoryProvider = Provider<ITarifRepository>((ref) {
  return TarifRepositoryImpl();
});

final getTarifsUseCaseProvider = Provider<GetTarifsUseCase>((ref) {
  return GetTarifsUseCase(ref.watch(tarifRepositoryProvider));
});

final saveTarifsUseCaseProvider = Provider<SaveTarifsUseCase>((ref) {
  return SaveTarifsUseCase(ref.watch(tarifRepositoryProvider));
});

final watchTarifsUseCaseProvider = Provider<WatchTarifsUseCase>((ref) {
  return WatchTarifsUseCase(ref.watch(tarifRepositoryProvider));
});

final tarifsConfigProvider = FutureProvider<TarifConfigModel>((ref) async {
  final useCase = ref.watch(getTarifsUseCaseProvider);
  return await useCase.execute();
});

final tarifsStreamProvider = StreamProvider<TarifConfigModel?>((ref) {
  final useCase = ref.watch(watchTarifsUseCaseProvider);
  return useCase.execute();
});

final tarifsStateProvider =
    StateNotifierProvider<TarifsNotifier, TarifsState>((ref) {
  return TarifsNotifier(ref);
});

class TarifsState {
  final TarifConfigModel config;
  final bool isLoading;
  final bool isSaving;
  final String? error;
  final String? successMessage;

  TarifsState({
    TarifConfigModel? config,
    this.isLoading = false,
    this.isSaving = false,
    this.error,
    this.successMessage,
  }) : config = config ?? TarifConfigModel.defaut();

  TarifsState copyWith({
    TarifConfigModel? config,
    bool? isLoading,
    bool? isSaving,
    String? error,
    String? successMessage,
    bool clearMessages = false,
  }) {
    return TarifsState(
      config: config ?? this.config,
      isLoading: isLoading ?? this.isLoading,
      isSaving: isSaving ?? this.isSaving,
      error: clearMessages ? null : (error ?? this.error),
      successMessage:
          clearMessages ? null : (successMessage ?? this.successMessage),
    );
  }
}

class TarifsNotifier extends StateNotifier<TarifsState> {
  final Ref _ref;

  TarifsNotifier(this._ref) : super(TarifsState());

  Future<void> loadConfig() async {
    state = state.copyWith(isLoading: true, clearMessages: true);
    try {
      final config = await _ref.read(tarifsConfigProvider.future);
      state = state.copyWith(config: config, isLoading: false);
    } catch (e) {
      state = state.copyWith(isLoading: false, error: e.toString());
    }
  }

  Future<bool> saveConfig(TarifConfigModel newConfig, String updatedBy) async {
    state = state.copyWith(isSaving: true, clearMessages: true);
    try {
      final updated = newConfig.copyWith(
        updatedAt: DateTime.now(),
        updatedBy: updatedBy,
      );
      final useCase = _ref.read(saveTarifsUseCaseProvider);
      final success = await useCase.execute(updated);
      if (success) {
        state = state.copyWith(
          config: updated,
          isSaving: false,
          successMessage: 'Tarifs sauvegardes',
        );
        _ref.invalidate(tarifsConfigProvider);
        return true;
      } else {
        state = state.copyWith(isSaving: false, error: 'Erreur sauvegarde');
        return false;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('Erreur sauvegarde tarifs: $e');
      state = state.copyWith(isSaving: false, error: e.toString());
      return false;
    }
  }

  void updateLocalConfig(TarifConfigModel newConfig) {
    state = state.copyWith(config: newConfig, clearMessages: true);
  }

  void reset() {
    state = TarifsState();
  }
}

class SouscriptionsState {
  final List<SouscriptionModel> souscriptions;
  final bool isLoading;
  final String? error;
  final double montantTotal;
  final int totalEnCours;
  final int totalPayees;

  const SouscriptionsState({
    this.souscriptions = const [],
    this.isLoading = false,
    this.error,
    this.montantTotal = 0,
    this.totalEnCours = 0,
    this.totalPayees = 0,
  });

  SouscriptionsState copyWith({
    List<SouscriptionModel>? souscriptions,
    bool? isLoading,
    String? error,
    double? montantTotal,
    int? totalEnCours,
    int? totalPayees,
  }) {
    return SouscriptionsState(
      souscriptions: souscriptions ?? this.souscriptions,
      isLoading: isLoading ?? this.isLoading,
      error: error ?? this.error,
      montantTotal: montantTotal ?? this.montantTotal,
      totalEnCours: totalEnCours ?? this.totalEnCours,
      totalPayees: totalPayees ?? this.totalPayees,
    );
  }

  List<SouscriptionModel> get enCours =>
      souscriptions.where((s) => s.estEnCours).toList();

  List<SouscriptionModel> get payees =>
      souscriptions.where((s) => s.estPayee).toList();

class SouscriptionsNotifier extends StateNotifier<SouscriptionsState> {
  final Ref _ref;

  SouscriptionsNotifier(this._ref) : super(const SouscriptionsState());

  Future<void> loadSouscriptions(String uid) async {
    if (uid.isEmpty) return;

    state = state.copyWith(isLoading: true);

    try {
      final result = await _ref.read(getSouscriptionsProvider(uid).future);

      if (result.success) {
        state = SouscriptionsState(
          souscriptions: result.souscriptions,
          montantTotal: result.montantTotal,
          totalEnCours: result.totalEnCours,
          totalPayees: result.totalPayees,
          isLoading: false,
          error: null,
        );
      } else {
        state = state.copyWith(
          isLoading: false,
          error: result.message,
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      state = state.copyWith(
        isLoading: false,
        error: e.toString(),
      );
    }
  }

  void reset() {
    state = const SouscriptionsState();
  }
}

class AdminSouscriptionsState {
  final List<SouscriptionModel> souscriptions;
  final bool isLoading;
  final String? error;
  final String filtre;
  final double montantTotal;
  final int totalEnCours;
  final int totalPayees;
  final int totalAnnulees;

  const AdminSouscriptionsState({
    this.souscriptions = const [],
    this.isLoading = false,
    this.error,
    this.filtre = 'toutes',
    this.montantTotal = 0,
    this.totalEnCours = 0,
    this.totalPayees = 0,
    this.totalAnnulees = 0,
  });

  AdminSouscriptionsState copyWith({
    List<SouscriptionModel>? souscriptions,
    bool? isLoading,
    String? error,
    String? filtre,
    double? montantTotal,
    int? totalEnCours,
    int? totalPayees,
    int? totalAnnulees,
  }) {
    return AdminSouscriptionsState(
      souscriptions: souscriptions ?? this.souscriptions,
      isLoading: isLoading ?? this.isLoading,
      error: error ?? this.error,
      filtre: filtre ?? this.filtre,
      montantTotal: montantTotal ?? this.montantTotal,
      totalEnCours: totalEnCours ?? this.totalEnCours,
      totalPayees: totalPayees ?? this.totalPayees,
      totalAnnulees: totalAnnulees ?? this.totalAnnulees,
    );
  }

  List<SouscriptionModel> get souscriptionsFiltrees {
    if (filtre == 'toutes') return souscriptions;
    if (filtre == 'en_cours') return souscriptions.where((s) => s.estEnCours).toList();
    if (filtre == 'payee') return souscriptions.where((s) => s.estPayee).toList();
    if (filtre == 'annulee') return souscriptions.where((s) => s.estAnnulee).toList();
    return souscriptions;
  }
}

class AdminSouscriptionsNotifier extends StateNotifier<AdminSouscriptionsState> {
  final Ref _ref;

  AdminSouscriptionsNotifier(this._ref) : super(const AdminSouscriptionsState());

  void setFiltre(String filtre) {
    state = state.copyWith(filtre: filtre);
  }

  Future<void> loadAllSouscriptions() async {
    state = state.copyWith(isLoading: true, error: null);
    try {
      final useCase = _ref.read(getAllSouscriptionsUseCaseProvider);
      final result = await useCase.execute();

      if (result.success) {
        state = AdminSouscriptionsState(
          souscriptions: result.souscriptions,
          montantTotal: result.montantTotal,
          totalEnCours: result.totalEnCours,
          totalPayees: result.totalPayees,
          totalAnnulees: result.totalAnnulees,
          filtre: state.filtre,
          isLoading: false,
        );
      } else {
        state = state.copyWith(isLoading: false, error: result.message);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      state = state.copyWith(isLoading: false, error: e.toString());
    }
  }

  Future<bool> updateStatut(String reference, String statut) async {
    try {
      final useCase = _ref.read(updateSouscriptionStatutUseCaseProvider);
      final result = await useCase.execute(reference, statut);

      if (result.success) {
        await loadAllSouscriptions();
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  void reset() {
    state = const AdminSouscriptionsState();
  }
}

/// Provider pour créer un portefeuille
final createWalletProvider = FutureProvider.family<CreateWalletResult, CreateWalletParams>(
  (ref, params) async {
    final useCase = ref.watch(createWalletUseCaseProvider);
    final result = await useCase.execute(params);
    
    if (result.success) {
      Logger.success('✅ Portefeuille créé: ${result.wallet?.nom}');
      ref.read(walletStateProvider.notifier).addWalletLocally(result.wallet!);
    } else {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur création portefeuille: ${result.message}');
    }
    
    return result;
  },
);

/// Provider pour récupérer les portefeuilles (une seule fois)
final getWalletsProvider = FutureProvider.family<GetWalletsResult, String>((ref, uid) async {
  final useCase = ref.watch(getWalletsUseCaseProvider);
  return await useCase.execute(uid);
});

/// Provider pour mettre à jour un portefeuille
final updateWalletProvider = FutureProvider.family<UpdateWalletResult, UpdateWalletParams>(
  (ref, params) async {
    final useCase = ref.watch(updateWalletUseCaseProvider);
    final result = await useCase.execute(params);
    
    if (result.success) {
      Logger.success('✅ Portefeuille mis à jour: ${result.wallet?.nom}');
      ref.read(walletStateProvider.notifier).updateWalletLocally(result.wallet!);
    } else {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur mise à jour portefeuille: ${result.message}');
    }
    
    return result;
  },
);

/// Provider pour mettre à jour le solde
final updateWalletBalanceProvider = FutureProvider.family<UpdateWalletResult, UpdateBalanceParams>(
  (ref, params) async {
    final useCase = ref.watch(updateWalletBalanceUseCaseProvider);
    final result = await useCase.execute(
      walletId: params.walletId,
      newBalance: params.newBalance,
    );
    
    if (result.success) {

      ref.read(walletStateProvider.notifier).updateWalletLocally(result.wallet!);
    } else {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur mise à jour solde: ${result.message}');
    }
    
    return result;
  },
);

final deleteWalletProvider = FutureProvider.family<DeleteWalletResult, String>((ref, walletId) async {

  if (result.success) {

    ref.read(walletStateProvider.notifier).deleteWalletLocally(walletId);
  } else {
    Logger.error('❌ Erreur suppression portefeuille: ${result.message}');
  }
  
  return result;
});

/// Provider pour l'état des portefeuilles
final walletStateProvider = StateNotifierProvider<WalletNotifier, WalletState>((ref) {
  return WalletNotifier(ref);
});

/// État des portefeuilles
class WalletState {
  final List<WalletModel> wallets;
  final bool isLoading;
  final String? error;
  final double totalBalance;

  const WalletState({
    this.wallets = const [],
    this.isLoading = false,
    this.error,
    this.totalBalance = 0,
  });

  WalletState copyWith({
    List<WalletModel>? wallets,
    bool? isLoading,
    String? error,
    double? totalBalance,
  }) {
    return WalletState(
      wallets: wallets ?? this.wallets,
      isLoading: isLoading ?? this.isLoading,
      error: error ?? this.error,
      totalBalance: totalBalance ?? this.totalBalance,
    );
  }

  double calculateTotalBalance() {
    double total = 0;
    for (final w in wallets) {
      total += w.solde;
    }
    return total;
  }
}

/// Notifier pour l'état des portefeuilles
class WalletNotifier extends StateNotifier<WalletState> {
  final Ref _ref;

  WalletNotifier(this._ref) : super(const WalletState());

  Future<void> loadWallets(String uid) async {
    if (uid.isEmpty) return;

    state = state.copyWith(isLoading: true);
    
    try {
      final result = await _ref.read(getWalletsProvider(uid).future);
      
      if (result.success) {
        state = state.copyWith(
          wallets: result.wallets,
          totalBalance: result.totalBalance,
          isLoading: false,
          error: null,
        );
      } else {
        state = state.copyWith(
          isLoading: false,
          error: result.message,
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      state = state.copyWith(
        isLoading: false,
        error: e.toString(),
      );
    }
  }

  void addWalletLocally(WalletModel wallet) {
    final updatedWallets = [...state.wallets, wallet];
    double newTotal = 0;
    for (final w in updatedWallets) {
      newTotal += w.solde;
    }
    state = state.copyWith(
      wallets: updatedWallets,
      totalBalance: newTotal,
    );
  }

  void updateWalletLocally(WalletModel updatedWallet) {
    final updatedWallets = state.wallets.map((w) {
      return w.id == updatedWallet.id ? updatedWallet : w;
    }).toList();
    
    double newTotal = 0;
    for (final w in updatedWallets) {
      newTotal += w.solde;
    }
    
    state = state.copyWith(
      wallets: updatedWallets,
      totalBalance: newTotal,
    );
  }

  void deleteWalletLocally(String walletId) {
    final updatedWallets = state.wallets.where((w) => w.id != walletId).toList();
    
    double newTotal = 0;
    for (final w in updatedWallets) {
      newTotal += w.solde;
    }
    
    state = state.copyWith(
      wallets: updatedWallets,
      totalBalance: newTotal,
    );
  }

  void clearError() {
    state = state.copyWith(error: null);
  }

  void reset() {
    state = const WalletState();
  }
}

  final String walletId;
  final double newBalance;

  const UpdateBalanceParams({
    required this.walletId,
    required this.newBalance,
  });
}

});

final walletCountProvider = Provider<int>((ref) {
  final state = ref.watch(walletStateProvider);
  return state.wallets.length;
});

final walletsLoadedProvider = Provider<bool>((ref) {

  return !state.isLoading && state.wallets.isNotEmpty;
});

final walletByIdProvider = Provider.family<WalletModel?, String>((ref, walletId) {
  final state = ref.watch(walletStateProvider);
  try {
    return state.wallets.firstWhere((w) => w.id == walletId);
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
});

  },

class DettesState {
  final List<DetteModel> dettes;
  final bool isLoading;
  final String? error;
  final double totalDettes;
  final double totalCreances;
  final double totalRestant;

  const DettesState({
    this.dettes = const [],
    this.isLoading = false,
    this.error,
    this.totalDettes = 0,
    this.totalCreances = 0,
    this.totalRestant = 0,
  });

  DettesState copyWith({
    List<DetteModel>? dettes,
    bool? isLoading,
    String? error,
    double? totalDettes,
    double? totalCreances,
    double? totalRestant,
  }) {
    return DettesState(
      dettes: dettes ?? this.dettes,
      isLoading: isLoading ?? this.isLoading,
      error: error ?? this.error,
      totalDettes: totalDettes ?? this.totalDettes,
      totalCreances: totalCreances ?? this.totalCreances,
      totalRestant: totalRestant ?? this.totalRestant,
    );
  }

  List<DetteModel> get dettesOnly =>
      dettes.where((d) => d.type == 'dette').toList();

  List<DetteModel> get creancesOnly =>
      dettes.where((d) => d.type == 'creance').toList();

  List<DetteModel> get dettesSoldees =>
      dettes.where((d) => d.estSolde).toList();

  List<DetteModel> get dettesEnCours =>
      dettes.where((d) => !d.estSolde).toList();
}

class DettesNotifier extends StateNotifier<DettesState> {
  final Ref _ref;

  DettesNotifier(this._ref) : super(const DettesState());

  Future<void> loadDettes(String uid) async {
    if (uid.isEmpty) return;

    state = state.copyWith(isLoading: true);

    try {
      final result = await _ref.read(getDettesProvider(uid).future);

      if (result.success) {
        state = DettesState(
          dettes: result.dettes,
          totalDettes: result.totalDettes,
          totalCreances: result.totalCreances,
          totalRestant: result.totalRestant,
          isLoading: false,
          error: null,
        );
      } else {
        state = state.copyWith(
          isLoading: false,
          error: result.message,
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      state = state.copyWith(
        isLoading: false,
        error: e.toString(),
      );
    }
  }

  void addDetteLocally(DetteModel dette) {
    final updatedDettes = [...state.dettes, dette];
    _recalculerTotaux(updatedDettes);
  }

  void updateDetteLocally(DetteModel updatedDette) {
    final updatedDettes = state.dettes.map((d) {
      return d.id == updatedDette.id ? updatedDette : d;
    }).toList();
    _recalculerTotaux(updatedDettes);
  }

  void deleteDetteLocally(String detteId) {
    final updatedDettes =
        state.dettes.where((d) => d.id != detteId).toList();
    _recalculerTotaux(updatedDettes);
  }

  void _recalculerTotaux(List<DetteModel> dettes) {
    double totalDettes = 0;
    double totalCreances = 0;
    double totalRestant = 0;

    for (final d in dettes) {
      if (d.type == 'dette') {
        totalDettes += d.montantRestant;
      } else {
        totalCreances += d.montantRestant;
      }
      totalRestant += d.montantRestant;
    }

    state = state.copyWith(
      dettes: dettes,
      totalDettes: totalDettes,
      totalCreances: totalCreances,
      totalRestant: totalRestant,
    );
  }

  void clearError() {
    state = state.copyWith(error: null);
  }

  void reset() {
    state = const DettesState();
  }
}

/// État du budget
class BudgetState {
  final BudgetMensuel? currentBudget;
  final bool isLoading;
  final String? error;
  final bool hasBudget;
  final Map<String, double> depensesReelles;
  final double totalRevenusReels;
  final double totalDepensesReelles;

  const BudgetState({
    this.currentBudget,
    this.isLoading = false,
    this.error,
    this.hasBudget = false,
    this.depensesReelles = const {},
    this.totalRevenusReels = 0,
    this.totalDepensesReelles = 0,
  });

  BudgetState copyWith({
    BudgetMensuel? currentBudget,
    bool? isLoading,
    String? error,
    bool? hasBudget,
    Map<String, double>? depensesReelles,
    double? totalRevenusReels,
    double? totalDepensesReelles,
  }) {
    return BudgetState(
      currentBudget: currentBudget ?? this.currentBudget,
      isLoading: isLoading ?? this.isLoading,
      error: error ?? this.error,
      hasBudget: hasBudget ?? this.hasBudget,
      depensesReelles: depensesReelles ?? this.depensesReelles,
      totalRevenusReels: totalRevenusReels ?? this.totalRevenusReels,
      totalDepensesReelles: totalDepensesReelles ?? this.totalDepensesReelles,
    );
  }

  /// Récupère le total des revenus prévus
  double get totalRevenusPrevus {
    return currentBudget?.totalRevenusPrevu ?? 0;
  }

  /// Récupère le total des dépenses prévues
  double get totalDepensesPrevues {
    return currentBudget?.totalDepensesPrevu ?? 0;
  }

  /// Récupère l'écart des revenus
  double get ecartRevenus {
    return totalRevenusReels - totalRevenusPrevus;
  }

  /// Récupère l'écart des dépenses
  double get ecartDepenses {
    return totalDepensesReelles - totalDepensesPrevues;
  }

  /// Vérifie si le budget est équilibré
  bool get isBalanced {
    return totalRevenusPrevus > 0 && totalDepensesPrevues > 0;
  }

  /// Récupère l'écart pour une catégorie
  double getEcartForCategorie(String categorieId) {
    if (currentBudget == null) return 0;
    
    final ligne = currentBudget!.lignes.firstWhere(
      (l) => l.categorieId == categorieId,
      orElse: () => BudgetLigne(
        id: '',
        categorieId: categorieId,
        categorieLabel: '',
        categorieEmoji: '📌',
        montantPrevu: 0,
        isRevenu: false,
      ),
    );
    
    final reel = depensesReelles[categorieId] ?? 0;
    return ligne.montantPrevu - reel;
  }

  /// Vérifie si une catégorie est en dépassement
  bool isCategorieExceeded(String categorieId) {
    if (currentBudget == null) return false;
    
    final ligne = currentBudget!.lignes.firstWhere(
      (l) => l.categorieId == categorieId,
      orElse: () => BudgetLigne(
        id: '',
        categorieId: categorieId,
        categorieLabel: '',
        categorieEmoji: '📌',
        montantPrevu: 0,
        isRevenu: false,
      ),
    );
    
    if (ligne.montantPrevu <= 0) return false;
    
    final reel = depensesReelles[categorieId] ?? 0;
    return reel > ligne.montantPrevu;
  }
}

/// Notifier pour l'état du budget
class BudgetNotifier extends StateNotifier<BudgetState> {
  final Ref _ref;

  BudgetNotifier(this._ref) : super(const BudgetState());

  /// Définit le budget
  void setBudget(BudgetMensuel? budget) {
    if (budget == null) {
      state = state.copyWith(
        currentBudget: null,
        hasBudget: false,
      );
      return;
    }

    state = state.copyWith(
      currentBudget: budget,
      hasBudget: true,
    );
  }

  /// Sauvegarde (creation ou mise a jour) d'un budget
  Future<bool> saveBudget({
    required String uid,
    required BudgetMensuel budget,
    bool isUpdate = false,
  }) async {
    state = state.copyWith(isLoading: true);

    try {
      final params = CreateBudgetParams(
        uid: uid,
        mois: budget.mois,
        annee: budget.annee,
        lignes: budget.lignes
            .map((l) => CreateBudgetLigneParams(
                  categorieId: l.categorieId,
                  categorieLabel: l.categorieLabel,
                  categorieEmoji: l.categorieEmoji,
                  montantPrevu: l.montantPrevu,
                  isRevenu: l.isRevenu,
                ))
            .toList(),
      );

      final CreateBudgetResult result;
      if (isUpdate) {
        final useCase = _ref.read(updateBudgetUseCaseProvider);
        result = await useCase.execute(params);
      } else {
        final useCase = _ref.read(createBudgetUseCaseProvider);
        result = await useCase.execute(params);
      }

      if (result.success && result.budget != null) {
        state = state.copyWith(
          currentBudget: result.budget,
          hasBudget: true,
          isLoading: false,
          error: null,
        );
        return true;
      } else {
        state = state.copyWith(
          isLoading: false,
          error: result.message,
        );
        return false;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      state = state.copyWith(
        isLoading: false,
        error: e.toString(),
      );
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// Met à jour les données réelles
  void setReelData({
    required Map<String, double> depensesReelles,
    required double totalRevenusReels,
    required double totalDepensesReelles,
  }) {
    state = state.copyWith(
      depensesReelles: depensesReelles,
      totalRevenusReels: totalRevenusReels,
      totalDepensesReelles: totalDepensesReelles,
    );
  }

  /// Charge un budget
  Future<void> loadBudget({
    required String uid,
    required int mois,
    required int annee,
  }) async {
    state = state.copyWith(isLoading: true);

    try {
      final result = await _ref.read(
        getBudgetProvider(GetBudgetParams(uid: uid, mois: mois, annee: annee))
            .future,
      );

      if (result.success && result.hasBudget) {
        state = state.copyWith(
          currentBudget: result.budget,
          hasBudget: true,
          depensesReelles: result.comparison?.depensesReelles ?? {},
          totalRevenusReels: result.comparison?.totalRevenusReels ?? 0,
          totalDepensesReelles: result.comparison?.totalDepensesReelles ?? 0,
          isLoading: false,
          error: null,
        );
      } else {
        state = state.copyWith(
          isLoading: false,
          hasBudget: false,
          currentBudget: null,
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      state = state.copyWith(
        isLoading: false,
        error: e.toString(),
      );
    }
  }

  /// Efface le budget
  void clearBudget() {
    state = const BudgetState();
  }

  /// Efface l'erreur
  void clearError() {
    state = state.copyWith(error: null);
  }

  /// Réinitialise l'état
  void reset() {
    state = const BudgetState();
  }
}

// ============================================
// PARAMÈTRES
// ============================================

/// Paramètres pour la récupération d'un budget
class GetBudgetParams {
  final String uid;
  final int mois;
  final int annee;

  const GetBudgetParams({
    required this.uid,
    required this.mois,
    required this.annee,
  });
}

/// Paramètres pour la récupération des budgets d'une année
class GetBudgetsForYearParams {
  final String uid;
  final int annee;

  const GetBudgetsForYearParams({
    required this.uid,
    required this.annee,
  });
}

/// Paramètres pour la suppression d'un budget
class DeleteBudgetParams {
  final String uid;
  final int mois;
  final int annee;

  const DeleteBudgetParams({
    required this.uid,
    required this.mois,
    required this.annee,
  });
}

// ============================================
// PROVIDERS UTILITAIRES
// ============================================

/// Provider pour savoir si un budget existe
final hasBudgetProvider = Provider<bool>((ref) {
  final state = ref.watch(budgetStateProvider);
  return state.hasBudget;
});

/// Provider pour le mois courant du budget
final currentBudgetMonthProvider = Provider<String>((ref) {
  final state = ref.watch(budgetStateProvider);
  return state.currentBudget?.moisLabel ?? 'Aucun budget';
});

/// Provider pour l'écart des dépenses
final budgetEcartDepensesProvider = Provider<double>((ref) {
  final state = ref.watch(budgetStateProvider);
  return state.ecartDepenses;
});

/// Provider pour l'écart des revenus
final budgetEcartRevenusProvider = Provider<double>((ref) {
  final state = ref.watch(budgetStateProvider);
  return state.ecartRevenus;
});

/// Provider pour les catégories en dépassement
final exceededCategoriesProvider = Provider<List<String>>((ref) {
  final state = ref.watch(budgetStateProvider);
  if (state.currentBudget == null) return [];
  
  return state.currentBudget!.lignes
      .where((l) => state.isCategorieExceeded(l.categorieId))
      .map((l) => l.categorieLabel)
      .toList();
});

/// Provider pour le pourcentage d'utilisation du budget
final budgetUsagePercentageProvider = Provider<double>((ref) {
  final state = ref.watch(budgetStateProvider);
  if (!state.hasBudget || state.totalDepensesPrevues == 0) return 0;
  return (state.totalDepensesReelles / state.totalDepensesPrevues * 100).clamp(0, 100);
});

// lib/presentation/screens/home/home_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import 'package:tapa_budget/presentation/providers/providers.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/formatters.dart';
import '../../../data/models/models.dart';

class HomeScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const HomeScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<HomeScreen> createState() => _HomeScreenState();
}

// ============================================
// MÉTRIQUES RESPONSIVES
// ============================================

class _Metrics {
  final bool isTablet;
  final bool isSmall;
  final double contentMaxWidth;

  _Metrics(BoxConstraints c)
      : isTablet = c.maxWidth >= 600,
        isSmall = c.maxWidth < 360,
        contentMaxWidth = c.maxWidth >= 900
            ? 680
            : (c.maxWidth >= 600 ? 600 : double.infinity);
}

// ============================================
// ÉTAT DE L'ÉCRAN HOME
// ============================================

class _HomeScreenState extends ConsumerState<HomeScreen> {
  bool _soldeVisible = true;
  String _categorieSelectionnee = 'Tous';
  int _selectedIndex = 0;

  static const List<String> _categoriesConnues = [
    'Banque',
    'Cash',
    'MTN',
    'Orange',
    'Wave',
  ];

  static const Color _mtn = Color(0xFFFFCC00);
  static const Color _orange = Color(0xFFFF7900);
  static const Color _wave = Color(0xFF1DC8F2);

  // ============================================
  // NAVIGATION & DONNÉES
  // ============================================

  void _navigateTo(String route, int index) {
    setState(() => _selectedIndex = index);
    context.go(route);
  }

  void _refreshData() {
    final userId = ref.read(currentUserProvider)?.id;
    if (userId != null && userId.isNotEmpty) {
      ref.invalidate(walletListProvider(userId));
      ref.invalidate(transactionListProvider(userId));
    }
  }

  Future<void> _pushAndRefresh(String route) async {
    await context.push(route);
    if (mounted) _refreshData();
  }

  String _categorieDe(WalletModel w) {
    final nom = w.nom.toLowerCase();
    for (final c in _categoriesConnues) {
      if (nom.contains(c.toLowerCase())) return c;
    }
    return 'Autres';
  }

  // ============================================
  // BUILD
  // ============================================

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final user = ref.watch(currentUserProvider);
    final monnaie = ref.watch(userMonnaieProvider);
    final prenom = ref.watch(userPrenomProvider);
    final userId = user?.id ?? '';

    final walletsAsync = ref.watch(walletListProvider(userId));
    final transactionsAsync = ref.watch(transactionListProvider(userId));

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
      body: walletsAsync.when(
        loading: () => const Center(
          child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: TAPAColors.gold),
        ),
        error: (err, stack) => Center(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.error_outline,
                    size: 48, color: TAPAColors.gold),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                const Text(
                  'Impossible de charger vos données',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: TAPAColors.white,
                    fontSize: 16,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                ElevatedButton(
                  style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: TAPAColors.gold,
                    foregroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
                  ),
                  onPressed: _refreshData,
                  child: const Text('Réessayer'),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
        data: (wallets) {
          final transactions = transactionsAsync.when(
            data: (txs) => txs,
            loading: () => <TransactionModel>[],
            error: (_, __) => <TransactionModel>[],
          );

          return LayoutBuilder(
            builder: (context, constraints) {
              final m = _Metrics(constraints);

              // ✅ 1. Solde total = Somme de tous les portefeuilles
              final soldeTotalWallets = wallets.fold(
                0.0,
                    (sum, w) => sum + w.solde,
              );

              // Totaux des transactions pour l'affichage informatif
              final totalRevenus = transactions
                  .where((t) => t.isRevenu)
                  .fold(0.0, (s, t) => s + t.montant);
              final totalDepenses = transactions
                  .where((t) => t.isDepense)
                  .fold(0.0, (s, t) => s + t.montant);

              final categoriesPresentes = _categoriesConnues
                  .where((c) => wallets.any((w) => _categorieDe(w) == c))
                  .toList();
              final aDesAutres =
              wallets.any((w) => _categorieDe(w) == 'Autres');
              final onglets = [
                'Tous',
                ...categoriesPresentes,
                if (aDesAutres) 'Autres',
              ];

              if (!onglets.contains(_categorieSelectionnee)) {
                _categorieSelectionnee = 'Tous';
              }

              final walletsFiltres = _categorieSelectionnee == 'Tous'
                  ? wallets
                  : wallets
                  .where((w) => _categorieDe(w) == _categorieSelectionnee)
                  .toList();

              final comptesParOnglet = <String, int>{
                for (final o in onglets)
                  o: o == 'Tous'
                      ? wallets.length
                      : wallets.where((w) => _categorieDe(w) == o).length,
              };

              final recentes = transactions.take(10).toList();

              return RefreshIndicator(
                onRefresh: () async => _refreshData(),
                color: TAPAColors.gold,
                child: CustomScrollView(
                  physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(
                    parent: BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                  ),
                  slivers: [
                    // Barre du haut épinglée
                    SliverAppBar(
                      pinned: true,
                      elevation: 0,
                      toolbarHeight: 60,
                      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
                      surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
                      automaticallyImplyLeading: false,
                      titleSpacing: 20,
                      title: _logo(),
                      actions: [
                        _buildCoachButton(context),
                        _roundIconButton(
                          Icons.notifications_outlined,
                              () {
                            // TODO: Ouvrir les notifications
                          },
                        ),
                        _avatar(prenom),
                      ],
                    ),

                    // Bandeau solde
                    SliverToBoxAdapter(
                      child: Center(
                        child: ConstrainedBox(
                          constraints:
                          BoxConstraints(maxWidth: m.contentMaxWidth),
                          child: _headerSolde(
                            prenom: prenom,
                            monnaie: monnaie,
                            total: soldeTotalWallets, // ✅ Solde des wallets
                            revenus: totalRevenus,
                            depenses: totalDepenses,
                            isSmall: m.isSmall,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),

                    // Contenu principal
                    SliverToBoxAdapter(
                      child: Container(
                        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                          color: TAPAColors.background,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(
                            top: Radius.circular(28),
                          ),
                        ),
                        child: Center(
                          child: ConstrainedBox(
                            constraints: BoxConstraints(
                              maxWidth: m.contentMaxWidth,
                            ),
                            child: Padding(
                              padding:
                              const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 20, 16, 32),
                              child: Column(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                children: [
                                  _quickActions(), // ✅ Boutons mis à jour
                                  const SizedBox(height: 24),

                                  _sectionTitle('Mes portefeuilles'),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                                  if (onglets.length > 1) ...[
                                    _filtresCategories(
                                        onglets, comptesParOnglet),
                                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                                  ],
                                  _listeWallets(
                                    walletsFiltres,
                                    monnaie,
                                    m.isSmall ? 150 : 176,
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 24),

                                  _graphiqueDepenses(monnaie, transactions),

                                  _sectionTitle(
                                    'Transactions récentes',
                                    actionLabel: 'Voir tout',
                                    onAction: () => context.push('/history'),
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                                  _listeTransactions(recentes, monnaie),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              );
            },
          );
        },
      ),
      bottomNavigationBar: _buildBottomNavigationBar(),
    );
  }

                fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                color: TAPAColors.gold,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _headerSolde({
    required String prenom,
    required String monnaie,
    required double total,
    required double revenus,
    required double depenses,
    required bool isSmall,
  }) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 4, 20, 28),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(
            'Bonjour${prenom.isNotEmpty ? ', $prenom' : ''} 👋',
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 14,
              color: Colors.white60,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      'Solde total · $monnaie',
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: TAPAColors.gold.withOpacity(0.95),
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    FittedBox(
                      fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                      alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                      child: Text(
                        _soldeVisible
                            ? Fmt.montant(total, monnaie: monnaie)
                            : '••••••••',
                        maxLines: 1,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: isSmall ? 28 : 34,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                          color: TAPAColors.white,
                          letterSpacing: -0.5,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => setState(() => _soldeVisible = !_soldeVisible),
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.08),
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  ),
                  child: Icon(
                    _soldeVisible
                        ? Icons.visibility_outlined
                        : Icons.visibility_off_outlined,
                    color: Colors.white70,
                    size: 20,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 18),
          Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: _miniCard(
                  'Revenus',
                  _soldeVisible
                      ? Fmt.montant(revenus, monnaie: monnaie)
                      : '•••',
                  TAPAColors.green,
                  Icons.south_west_rounded,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Expanded(
                child: _miniCard(
                  'Dépenses',
                  _soldeVisible
                      ? Fmt.montant(depenses, monnaie: monnaie)
                      : '•••',
                  TAPAColors.red,
                  Icons.north_east_rounded,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,

                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: TAPAColors.navy.withOpacity(0.05),
              blurRadius: 12,
              offset: const Offset(0, 4),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Container(
              width: 42,
              height: 42,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: highlighted
                    ? TAPAColors.navy
                    : TAPAColors.navy.withOpacity(0.07),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
              ),
              child: Icon(
                icon,
                size: 22,
                color: highlighted ? TAPAColors.gold : TAPAColors.navy,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),

              fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,

                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
