            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showAddMenu(BuildContext context) {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (ctx) {
        return Container(
          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
            color: TAPAColors.surface,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(28)),
          ),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 12, 24, 24),
          child: SafeArea(
            top: false,
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                Container(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 20),
                  width: 40,
                  height: 4,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: TAPAColors.border,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                  ),
                ),
                const Text(
                  'Que souhaitez-vous faire ?',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 18,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                    color: TAPAColors.navy,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 20),
                _addMenuOption(
                  ctx,
                  icon: Icons.edit_note_rounded,
                  title: 'Nouvelle transaction',
                  subtitle: 'Saisir un revenu ou une dépense',
                  onTap: () {
                    Navigator.pop(ctx);
                    _pushAndRefresh('/add-transaction');
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                _addMenuOption(
                  ctx,
                  icon: Icons.document_scanner_outlined,
                  title: 'Scanner un reçu',
                  subtitle: 'Extraction automatique par IA',
                  onTap: () {
                    Navigator.pop(ctx);
                    _pushAndRefresh('/scanner');
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                _addMenuOption(
                  ctx,
                  icon: Icons.mic_none_rounded,
                  title: 'Saisie vocale',
                  subtitle: 'Dicter votre transaction',
                  onTap: () {
                    Navigator.pop(ctx);
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(ctx).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Fonction vocale bientôt disponible')));
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 20),
                TextButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                  child: const Text(
                    'Annuler',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  // ============================================
  // FILTRES PAR CATÉGORIE
  // ============================================

  Widget _filtresCategories(List<String> onglets, Map<String, int> comptes) {
    return SizedBox(
      height: 44,
      child: ListView.builder(
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        itemCount: onglets.length,
        itemBuilder: (ctx, i) => _ongletCategorie(
          onglets[i],
          _categorieSelectionnee == onglets[i],
          comptes[onglets[i]] ?? 0,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  IconData _iconeCategorie(String label) {
    switch (label) {
      case 'Tous':
        return Icons.apps_rounded;
      case 'Banque':
        return Icons.account_balance_rounded;
      case 'Cash':
        return Icons.payments_rounded;
      case 'MTN':
        return Icons.sim_card_rounded;
      case 'Orange':
        return Icons.wifi_tethering_rounded;
      case 'Wave':
        return Icons.waves_rounded;
      default:
        return Icons.more_horiz_rounded;
    }
  }

  Color _couleurCategorie(String label) {
    switch (label) {
      case 'Cash':
        return TAPAColors.green;
      case 'MTN':
        return _mtn;
      case 'Orange':
        return _orange;
      case 'Wave':
        return _wave;
      case 'Autres':
        return TAPAColors.purple;
      default:
        return TAPAColors.navy;
    }
  }

  Widget _ongletCategorie(String label, bool selected, int count) {
    final couleur = _couleurCategorie(label);
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
      child: GestureDetector(
        onTap: () => setState(() => _categorieSelectionnee = label),
        child: AnimatedContainer(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
          curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 6, right: 12),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: selected ? TAPAColors.navy : TAPAColors.surface,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
            border: Border.all(
              color: selected ? TAPAColors.navy : TAPAColors.border,
            ),
            boxShadow: selected
                ? [
              BoxShadow(
                color: TAPAColors.navy.withOpacity(0.25),
                blurRadius: 10,
                offset: const Offset(0, 4),
              ),
            ]
                : null,
          ),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              Container(
                width: 28,
                height: 28,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: selected
                      ? TAPAColors.gold.withOpacity(0.2)
                      : couleur.withOpacity(0.15),
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                ),
                child: Icon(
                  _iconeCategorie(label),
                  size: 14,
                  color: selected ? TAPAColors.gold : couleur,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Text(
                label,
                maxLines: 1,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 12,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                  color: selected ? TAPAColors.gold : TAPAColors.navy,
                ),
              ),
              if (count > 0) ...[
                const SizedBox(width: 6),
                Container(
                  padding:
                  const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: selected
                        ? Colors.white.withOpacity(0.15)
                        : couleur.withOpacity(0.12),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    '$count',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 10,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      color: selected ? Colors.white70 : TAPAColors.navy,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================
  // PORTEFEUILLES
  // ============================================

  Widget _listeWallets(
      List<WalletModel> wallets, String monnaie, double cardWidth) {
    if (wallets.isEmpty) {
      return Container(
        width: double.infinity,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: TAPAColors.surface,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
          border: Border.all(color: TAPAColors.border, width: 0.8),
        ),
        child: const Row(
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.account_balance_wallet_outlined,
                color: TAPAColors.textHint),
            SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                'Aucun portefeuille dans cette catégorie',
                maxLines: 2,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: TextStyle(color: TAPAColors.textSecond, fontSize: 13),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }

    return SizedBox(
      height: 118,
      child: ListView.builder(
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        clipBehavior: Clip.none,
        itemCount: wallets.length,
        itemBuilder: (ctx, i) => _walletCard(wallets[i], monnaie, cardWidth),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _walletCard(WalletModel w, String monnaie, double cardWidth) {
    final nom = w.nom.toLowerCase();
    final isMtn = nom.contains('mtn');
    final isOrange = nom.contains('orange');
    final isWave = nom.contains('wave');
    final Color? brand =
    isMtn ? _mtn : (isOrange ? _orange : (isWave ? _wave : null));
    final hasBrand = brand != null;

    final badgeText =
    isMtn ? 'MTN' : (isOrange ? 'OR' : (isWave ? 'WV' : null));
    final badgeTextColor = isMtn ? const Color(0xFF003366) : Colors.white;

    return GestureDetector(
      onLongPress: () => _modifierSolde(w, monnaie),
      child: Container(
        width: cardWidth,
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 12),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: hasBrand ? brand.withOpacity(0.13) : TAPAColors.surface,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
          border: Border.all(
            color: w.estPresqueVide
                ? TAPAColors.red
                : (hasBrand ? brand.withOpacity(0.55) : TAPAColors.border),
            width: w.estPresqueVide || hasBrand ? 1.5 : 0.8,
          ),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: (hasBrand ? brand : TAPAColors.navy).withOpacity(0.08),
              blurRadius: 12,
              offset: const Offset(0, 5),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Container(
                  width: 36,
                  height: 36,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: hasBrand ? brand : TAPAColors.goldLight,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11),
                  ),
                  child: Center(
                    child: badgeText != null
                        ? Text(
                      badgeText,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 9,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                        color: badgeTextColor,
                      ),
                    )
                        : Text(w.emoji, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18)),
                  ),
                ),
                const Spacer(),
                if (w.estPresqueVide)
                  const Icon(Icons.warning_rounded,
                      size: 16, color: TAPAColors.red),
              ],
            ),
            Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                Text(
                  w.nom,
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11.5,
                    color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                FittedBox(
                  fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                  alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                  child: Text(
                    _soldeVisible
                        ? Fmt.montant(w.solde, monnaie: monnaie)
                        : '•••••',
                    maxLines: 1,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 15,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      color: w.estPresqueVide
                          ? TAPAColors.red
                          : TAPAColors.navy,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _modifierSolde(WalletModel w, String monnaie) {
    final ctrl = TextEditingController(text: w.solde.round().toString());
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) => Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom),
        child: Container(
          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
            color: TAPAColors.surface,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
          ),
          child: SafeArea(
            top: false,
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Container(
                    margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
                    width: 40,
                    height: 4,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: TAPAColors.border,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                    ),
                  ),
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Container(
                        width: 44,
                        height: 44,
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: TAPAColors.goldLight,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        ),
                        child: Center(
                          child: Text(w.emoji,
                              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 22)),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 12),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                          'Modifier ${w.nom}',
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 17,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                            color: TAPAColors.navy,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 20),
                  TextField(
                    controller: ctrl,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                    autofocus: true,
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Nouveau solde',
                      suffixText: monnaie,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  SizedBox(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    height: 52,
                    child: ElevatedButton(
                      style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
                        foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                        ),
                      ),
                      onPressed: () async {
                        // ignore: unused_local_variable
                        final nouveau = double.tryParse(ctrl.text) ?? w.solde;
                        // TODO: Implémenter la mise à jour du solde via provider
                        Navigator.pop(ctx);
                        _refreshData();
                      },
                      child: const Text('Enregistrer'),
                    ),
                  ),
                  TextButton(
                    onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                    child: const Text(
                      'Annuler',
                      style: TextStyle(color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================
  // GRAPHIQUE DES DÉPENSES
  // ============================================

  Widget _graphiqueDepenses(String monnaie, List<TransactionModel> txs) {
    if (txs.isEmpty) return const SizedBox();

    final now = DateTime.now();
    final transactionsMois = txs
        .where((tx) =>
    tx.dateTransaction.month == now.month &&
        tx.dateTransaction.year == now.year &&
        tx.isDepense)
        .toList();

    if (transactionsMois.isEmpty) return const SizedBox();

    final Map<String, double> par = {};
    for (final tx in transactionsMois) {
      par[tx.categorieLabel] = (par[tx.categorieLabel] ?? 0) + tx.montant;
    }
    final total = par.values.fold(0.0, (s, v) => s + v);
    final top = (par.entries.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => b.value.compareTo(a.value)))
        .take(4)
        .toList();
    final List<Color> colors = [
      TAPAColors.red,
      TAPAColors.amber,
      TAPAColors.purple,
      TAPAColors.navy,
    ];

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 24),
      child: Container(
        width: double.infinity,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: TAPAColors.surface,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          border: Border.all(color: TAPAColors.border, width: 0.8),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: TAPAColors.navy.withOpacity(0.05),
              blurRadius: 14,
              offset: const Offset(0, 5),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Container(
                  width: 34,
                  height: 34,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: TAPAColors.amberLight,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                  ),
                  child: const Icon(Icons.pie_chart_rounded,
                      size: 18, color: TAPAColors.amber),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                const Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    'Dépenses du mois',
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 15,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      color: TAPAColors.navy,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Flexible(
                  child: FittedBox(
                    fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                    child: Text(
                      Fmt.montant(total, monnaie: monnaie),
                      maxLines: 1,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 13,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                        color: TAPAColors.red,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            ClipRRect(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
              child: SizedBox(
                height: 10,
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    for (int i = 0; i < top.length; i++)
                      Expanded(
                        flex: ((total > 0 ? top[i].value / total : 0) * 1000)
                            .round()
                            .clamp(1, 1000),
                        child: Container(color: colors[i % colors.length]),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            ...top.asMap().entries.map((e) {
              final pct = total > 0 ? e.value.value / total : 0.0;
              final color = colors[e.key % colors.length];
              return Padding(
                padding:
                EdgeInsets.only(bottom: e.key == top.length - 1 ? 0 : 12),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      width: 10,
                      height: 10,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: color,
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        e.value.key,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 13,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          color: TAPAColors.navy,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Flexible(
                      child: FittedBox(
                        fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                        alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                        child: Text(
                          Fmt.montant(e.value.value, monnaie: monnaie),
                          maxLines: 1,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 12.5,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                            color: TAPAColors.navy,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    SizedBox(
                      width: 38,
                      child: Text(
                        '${(pct * 100).round()}%',
                        textAlign: TextAlign.right,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12,
                          color: color,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              );
            }),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _listeTransactions(List<TransactionModel> txs, String monnaie) {
    if (txs.isEmpty) {
      return Container(

          color: TAPAColors.surface,

        child: Column(
          children: [
            Container(
              width: 64,
              height: 64,

                  size: 30, color: TAPAColors.navy),

            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            const Text(
              'Aucune transaction',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 15,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                color: TAPAColors.navy,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            const Text(
              'Ajoutez votre première dépense ou revenu.',
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }

    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: TAPAColors.surface,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(color: TAPAColors.border, width: 0.8),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: TAPAColors.navy.withOpacity(0.05),
            blurRadius: 14,
            offset: const Offset(0, 5),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          for (int i = 0; i < txs.length; i++)
            _txTile(txs[i], i == txs.length - 1, monnaie),

      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _txTile(TransactionModel tx, bool isLast, String monnaie) {

              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(13),

                tx.categorieEmoji,
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  tx.categorieLabel,
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 13.5,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    color: TAPAColors.navy,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                Text(
                  Fmt.dateRelative(tx.dateTransaction),
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11.5,
                    color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 130),
            child: FittedBox(
              fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
              alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
              child: Text(
                '${tx.isRevenu ? "+" : "-"}${Fmt.montant(tx.montant, monnaie: monnaie)}',
                maxLines: 1,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 13.5,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                  color: couleur,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBottomNavigationBar() {
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.08),
            blurRadius: 16,
            offset: const Offset(0, -4),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(4, 8, 4, 6),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.home_outlined,
                activeIcon: Icons.home,
                label: 'Accueil',
                index: 0,
                route: '/home',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.pie_chart_outline,
                activeIcon: Icons.pie_chart,
                label: 'Budget',
                index: 3,
                route: '/budget',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.credit_card_outlined,
                activeIcon: Icons.credit_card,
                label: 'Dettes',
                index: 4,
                route: '/dettes',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.person_outline,
                activeIcon: Icons.person,
                label: 'Profil',
                index: 5,
                route: '/profile',
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildNavItem({
    required IconData icon,
    required IconData activeIcon,
    required String label,
    required int index,
    required String route,
  }) {
    final isActive = _selectedIndex == index;
    return Expanded(
      child: GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTap: () => _navigateTo(route, index),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            AnimatedContainer(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 260),
              curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
              width: isActive ? 46 : 38,
              height: 32,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: isActive
                    ? const LinearGradient(
                  colors: [Color(0xFF1A237E), Color(0xFF0D1444)],
                  begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                  end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                )
                    : null,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                boxShadow: isActive
                    ? [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: const Color(0xFF1A237E).withOpacity(0.35),
                    blurRadius: 10,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 4),
                  ),
                ]
                    : null,
              ),
              child: Icon(
                isActive ? activeIcon : icon,
                size: 20,
                color: isActive ? Colors.amber : Colors.grey.shade500,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 2),
              child: FittedBox(
                fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                child: Text(
                  label,
                  maxLines: 1,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 10,
                    fontWeight: isActive ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
                    color: isActive
                        ? const Color(0xFF1A237E)
                        : Colors.grey.shade500,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

/// Graphique des dépenses du mois par catégorie
class ExpenseChart extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<TransactionModel> transactions;
  final String monnaie;

  const ExpenseChart({
    super.key,
    required this.transactions,
    required this.monnaie,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final transactionsMois = transactions.where((tx) =>
    tx.dateTransaction.month == now.month &&
        tx.dateTransaction.year == now.year &&
        tx.isDepense).toList();

    if (transactionsMois.isEmpty) return const SizedBox();

    final Map<String, double> par = {};
    for (final tx in transactionsMois) {
      par[tx.categorieLabel] = (par[tx.categorieLabel] ?? 0) + tx.montant;
    }
    final total = par.values.fold(0.0, (s, v) => s + v);
    final top = (par.entries.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => b.value.compareTo(a.value)))
        .take(4)
        .toList();

    final List<Color> colors = [
      TAPAColors.red,
      TAPAColors.amber,
      TAPAColors.purple,
      TAPAColors.navy,
    ];

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: TAPAColors.surface,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),

            color: TAPAColors.navy.withOpacity(0.04),

          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(

          Row(
            children: [
              Container(
                width: 28,
                height: 28,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: TAPAColors.amberLight,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                ),
                child: const Icon(
                  Icons.pie_chart_rounded,
                  size: 14,
                  color: TAPAColors.amber,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              const Text(
                'Dépenses du mois',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 13,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                  color: TAPAColors.navy,
                ),
              ),
              const Spacer(),
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 2),

            final pct = total > 0 ? e.value.value / total : 0.0;
            final Color color = colors[e.key % colors.length];
            return Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        e.value.key,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11,

          }),

// lib/presentation/screens/home/widgets/wallet_list.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../../../../data/models/models.dart';
import '../../../../../core/utils/formatters.dart';
import '../../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';

/// Liste des portefeuilles avec filtres par catégorie
class WalletList extends StatefulWidget {
  final List<WalletModel> wallets;
  final String monnaie;
  final bool soldeVisible;
  final VoidCallback onRefresh;

  const WalletList({
    super.key,
    required this.wallets,
    required this.monnaie,
    required this.soldeVisible,
    required this.onRefresh,
  });

  @override
  State<WalletList> createState() => _WalletListState();
}

class _WalletListState extends State<WalletList> {
  String _categorieSelectionnee = 'Tous';

  static const List<String> _categoriesConnues = [
    'Banque',
    'Cash',
    'MTN',
    'Orange',
    'Wave',
  ];

  String _categorieDe(WalletModel w) {
    final nom = w.nom.toLowerCase();
    for (final c in _categoriesConnues) {
      if (nom.contains(c.toLowerCase())) return c;
    }
    return 'Autres';
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isSmall = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width < 360;
    final cardWidth = isSmall ? 140.0 : 172.0;

    final categoriesPresentes = _categoriesConnues
        .where((c) => widget.wallets.any((w) => _categorieDe(w) == c))
        .toList();
    final aDesAutres = widget.wallets.any((w) => _categorieDe(w) == 'Autres');
    final onglets = ['Tous', ...categoriesPresentes, if (aDesAutres) 'Autres'];

    if (!onglets.contains(_categorieSelectionnee)) {
      _categorieSelectionnee = 'Tous';
    }

    final walletsFiltres = _categorieSelectionnee == 'Tous'
        ? widget.wallets
        : widget.wallets.where((w) => _categorieDe(w) == _categorieSelectionnee).toList();

    final Map<String, int> comptesParOnglet = {
      for (final o in onglets)
        o: o == 'Tous'
            ? widget.wallets.length
            : widget.wallets.where((w) => _categorieDe(w) == o).length,
    };

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        // Titre
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, 10),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              Text(
                'Mes portefeuilles',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: isSmall ? 15.0 : 17.0,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                  color: TAPAColors.navy,
                ),
              ),
              const Spacer(),
              Text(
                '${widget.wallets.length}',
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 12,
                  color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),

        // Filtres
        if (onglets.length > 1)
          SizedBox(
            height: 42,
            child: ListView.builder(
              scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
              itemCount: onglets.length,
              itemBuilder: (ctx, i) => _ongletCategorie(
                onglets[i],
                _categorieSelectionnee == onglets[i],
                comptesParOnglet[onglets[i]] ?? 0,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        if (onglets.length > 1) const SizedBox(height: 10),

        // Liste des portefeuilles
        SizedBox(
          height: 72,
          child: walletsFiltres.isEmpty
              ? const Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
            child: Center(
              child: Align(
                alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                child: Text(
                  'Aucun portefeuille',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                    fontSize: 13,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          )
              : ListView.builder(
            scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
            itemCount: walletsFiltres.length,
            itemBuilder: (ctx, i) => _walletCard(
              walletsFiltres[i],
              widget.monnaie,
              cardWidth,
              isSmall,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _ongletCategorie(String label, bool selected, int count) {
    final Color couleur = _couleurCategorie(label);
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
      child: GestureDetector(
        onTap: () => setState(() => _categorieSelectionnee = label),
        child: AnimatedContainer(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
          curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 6, right: 12, top: 4, bottom: 4),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            gradient: selected
                ? const LinearGradient(
              colors: [TAPAColors.navy, Color(0xFF1A2B4A)],
              begin: Alignment.topLeft,
              end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            )
                : null,
            color: selected ? null : TAPAColors.surface,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
            border: Border.all(
              color: selected ? TAPAColors.navy : TAPAColors.border,
              width: 1,
            ),
            boxShadow: selected
                ? [
              BoxShadow(
                color: TAPAColors.navy.withOpacity(0.28),
                blurRadius: 10,
                offset: const Offset(0, 4),
              ),
            ]
                : [],
          ),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              AnimatedContainer(
                duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
                width: 24,
                height: 24,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: selected
                      ? TAPAColors.gold.withOpacity(0.18)
                      : couleur.withOpacity(0.14),
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                ),
                child: Icon(
                  _iconeCategorie(label),
                  size: 12,
                  color: selected ? TAPAColors.gold : couleur,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              Text(
                label,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 11.5,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                  color: selected ? TAPAColors.gold : TAPAColors.navy,
                ),
              ),
              if (count > 0) ...[
                const SizedBox(width: 6),
                AnimatedContainer(
                  duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 5, vertical: 2),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: selected
                        ? Colors.white.withOpacity(0.14)
                        : couleur.withOpacity(0.12),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    '$count',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 9.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      color: selected ? Colors.white70 : couleur,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  IconData _iconeCategorie(String label) {
    switch (label) {
      case 'Tous':
        return Icons.apps_rounded;
      case 'Banque':
        return Icons.account_balance_rounded;
      case 'Cash':
        return Icons.payments_rounded;
      case 'MTN':
        return Icons.sim_card_rounded;
      case 'Orange':
        return Icons.wifi_tethering_rounded;
      case 'Wave':
        return Icons.waves_rounded;
      default:
        return Icons.more_horiz_rounded;
    }
  }

  Color _couleurCategorie(String label) {
    switch (label) {
      case 'Tous':
        return TAPAColors.navy;
      case 'Banque':
        return TAPAColors.navy;
      case 'Cash':
        return TAPAColors.green;
      case 'MTN':
        return const Color(0xFFFFCC00);
      case 'Orange':
        return const Color(0xFFFF7900);
      case 'Wave':
        return const Color(0xFF1DC8F2);
      default:
        return TAPAColors.purple;
    }
  }

  Widget _walletCard(WalletModel w, String monnaie, double cardWidth, bool isSmall) {
    final bool isMtn = w.nom.toLowerCase().contains('mtn');
    final bool isOrange = w.nom.toLowerCase().contains('orange');

    return GestureDetector(
      onLongPress: () => _modifierSolde(w, monnaie),
      child: Container(
        width: cardWidth,
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 10, left: 4),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 8),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isMtn
              ? const Color(0xFFFFCC00).withOpacity(0.15)
              : isOrange
              ? const Color(0xFFFF7900).withOpacity(0.15)
              : TAPAColors.surface,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          border: Border.all(
            color: w.estPresqueVide
                ? TAPAColors.red
                : isMtn
                ? const Color(0xFFFFCC00).withOpacity(0.5)
                : isOrange
                ? const Color(0xFFFF7900).withOpacity(0.5)
                : TAPAColors.border,
            width: w.estPresqueVide ? 1.5 : (isMtn || isOrange ? 1.5 : 0.5),
          ),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: (isMtn
                  ? const Color(0xFFFFCC00)
                  : isOrange
                  ? const Color(0xFFFF7900)
                  : TAPAColors.navy)
                  .withOpacity(isMtn || isOrange ? 0.12 : 0.04),
              blurRadius: 8,
              offset: const Offset(0, 3),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Container(
              width: 32,
              height: 32,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: isMtn
                    ? const Color(0xFFFFCC00)
                    : isOrange
                    ? const Color(0xFFFF7900)
                    : TAPAColors.goldLight,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
              ),
              child: Center(
                child: isMtn
                    ? const Text(
                  'MTN',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 9,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                    color: Color(0xFF003366),
                  ),
                )
                    : isOrange
                    ? const Text(
                  'OR',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 9,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                    color: Colors.white,
                  ),
                )
                    : Text(
                  w.emoji,
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: isSmall ? 14 : 17),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    w.nom,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 10,
                      color: isMtn || isOrange
                          ? TAPAColors.navy
                          : TAPAColors.textSecond,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    ),
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    maxLines: 1,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 1),
                  Text(
                    widget.soldeVisible
                        ? Fmt.montant(w.solde, monnaie: monnaie)
                        : '•••',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      color: w.estPresqueVide
                          ? TAPAColors.red
                          : isMtn
                          ? const Color(0xFF003366)
                          : isOrange
                          ? const Color(0xFFCC5500)
                          : TAPAColors.navy,
                    ),
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    maxLines: 1,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            if (w.estPresqueVide)
              const Icon(Icons.warning_rounded, size: 12, color: TAPAColors.red)
            else
              const Icon(Icons.edit_outlined, size: 11, color: TAPAColors.textHint),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _modifierSolde(WalletModel w, String monnaie) {
    final ctrl = TextEditingController(text: w.solde.round().toString());
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) => Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom),
        child: Container(
          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
            color: TAPAColors.surface,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
          ),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              Container(
                margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
                width: 40,
                height: 4,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: TAPAColors.border,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                ),
              ),
              Row(
                children: [
                  Container(
                    width: 40,
                    height: 40,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: TAPAColors.goldLight,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    ),
                    child: Center(
                      child: Text(w.emoji, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 20)),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  Text(
                    'Modifier ${w.nom}',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 16,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      color: TAPAColors.navy,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 20),
              TextField(
                controller: ctrl,
                keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                autofocus: true,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Nouveau solde',
                  suffixText: monnaie,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              SizedBox(
                width: double.infinity,
                child: ElevatedButton(
                  onPressed: () {
                    // TODO: Implémenter la mise à jour du solde
                    Navigator.pop(ctx);
                    widget.onRefresh();
                  },
                  child: const Text('Enregistrer'),
                ),
              ),
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                child: const Text(
                  'Annuler',
                  style: TextStyle(color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// lib/presentation/screens/home/widgets/transaction_list.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../../../../data/models/models.dart';
import '../../../../../core/utils/formatters.dart';
import '../../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';

/// Liste des transactions récentes
class TransactionList extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<TransactionModel> transactions;
  final List<WalletModel> wallets;
  final String monnaie;
  final int maxItems;

  const TransactionList({
    super.key,
    required this.transactions,
    required this.wallets,
    required this.monnaie,
    this.maxItems = 10,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isSmall = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width < 360;
    final titleSize = isSmall ? 15.0 : 17.0;
    final displayedTransactions = transactions.take(maxItems).toList();

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        // Titre
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 24, 16, 10),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              Text(
                'Transactions',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: titleSize,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                  color: TAPAColors.navy,
                ),
              ),
              const Spacer(),
              GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => context.go('/history'),
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 10,
                    vertical: 5,
                  ),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: TAPAColors.navy.withOpacity(0.06),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                  ),
                  child: const Text(
                    'Voir tout',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 10,
                      color: TAPAColors.navy,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),

        // Liste
        if (displayedTransactions.isEmpty)
          const Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
            child: Center(
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    Icons.receipt_long_outlined,
                    size: 36,
                    color: TAPAColors.textHint,
                  ),
                  SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                    'Aucune transaction',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                      fontSize: 12,
                    ),
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          )
        else
          Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: TAPAColors.surface,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
              border: Border.all(
                color: TAPAColors.border,
                width: 0.5,
              ),
            ),
            child: Column(
              children: displayedTransactions
                  .asMap()
                  .entries
                  .map(
                    (e) => _transactionTile(
                  e.value,
                  e.key == displayedTransactions.length - 1,
                  wallets,
                  monnaie,
                ),
              )
                  .toList(),
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _transactionTile(
      TransactionModel tx,
      bool isLast,
      List<WalletModel> wallets,
      String monnaie,
      ) {
    final wallet = wallets.isNotEmpty
        ? wallets.first
        : WalletModel(
      id: '',
      uid: '',
      nom: 'Inconnu',
      emoji: '💰',
      type: 'compte',
      solde: 0,
      monnaie: monnaie,
      description: '',
      createdAt: DateTime.now(),
      updatedAt: DateTime.now(),
    );

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 10),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        border: isLast
            ? null
            : const Border(
          bottom: BorderSide(color: TAPAColors.border, width: 0.5),
        ),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          // Icône
          Container(
            width: 36,
            height: 36,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: tx.isRevenu ? TAPAColors.greenLight : TAPAColors.redLight,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11),
            ),
            child: Center(
              child: Text(
                tx.categorieEmoji,
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 15),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),

          // Informations
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  tx.categorieLabel,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    color: TAPAColors.navy,
                  ),
                ),
                Text(
                  '${wallet.emoji} ${wallet.nom} · ${Fmt.dateRelative(tx.dateTransaction)}',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 10,
                    color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                  ),
                ),
                if (tx.note != null && tx.note!.isNotEmpty)
                  Text(
                    tx.note!,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 9,
                      color: TAPAColors.textSecond.withOpacity(0.7),
                      fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                    ),
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),

          // Montant
          Text(
            '${tx.isRevenu ? "+" : "-"}${Fmt.montant(tx.montant, monnaie: monnaie)}',
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 12,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
              color: tx.isRevenu ? TAPAColors.green : TAPAColors.red,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

// lib/presentation/screens/home/widgets/balance_card.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import 'package:tapa_budget/presentation/providers/providers.dart';
import '../../../../core/utils/formatters.dart';

/// Carte affichant le solde total avec indicateurs de revenus/dépenses
class BalanceCard extends ConsumerWidget {
  final double totalBalance;
  final double totalRevenus;
  final double totalDepenses;
  final bool isSoldeVisible;
  final VoidCallback onToggleVisibility;

  const BalanceCard({
    super.key,
    required this.totalBalance,
    required this.totalRevenus,
    required this.totalDepenses,
    required this.isSoldeVisible,
    required this.onToggleVisibility,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final monnaie = ref.watch(userMonnaieProvider);
    final prenom = ref.watch(userPrenomProvider);
    final isSmall = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width < 360;
    final fontSize = isSmall ? 12.5 : 14.0;

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 16, 20, 16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: const LinearGradient(
          colors: [Color(0xFF1A2B4A), TAPAColors.navy],
          begin: Alignment.topLeft,
          end: Alignment.bottomRight,
        ),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          // Salutation
          Text(
            'Bonjour${prenom.isNotEmpty ? ', $prenom' : ''} !',
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: fontSize,
              color: Colors.white60,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),

          // Solde total
          Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  isSoldeVisible
                      ? Fmt.montant(totalBalance, monnaie: monnaie)
                      : '••••••••',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: isSmall ? 26 : 30,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                    color: TAPAColors.white,
                    letterSpacing: -0.5,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              GestureDetector(
                onTap: onToggleVisibility,
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.08),
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  ),
                  child: Icon(
                    isSoldeVisible
                        ? Icons.visibility_outlined
                        : Icons.visibility_off_outlined,
                    color: Colors.white54,
                    size: 18,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 2),

          // Monnaie
          Text(
            'Solde total · $monnaie',
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 12,
              color: TAPAColors.gold.withOpacity(0.9),
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),

          // Mini cartes Revenus / Dépenses
          Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: _miniCard(
                  'Revenus',
                  Fmt.montant(totalRevenus, monnaie: monnaie),
                  TAPAColors.green,
                  Icons.trending_up_rounded,
                  isSmall,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(
                child: _miniCard(
                  'Dépenses',
                  Fmt.montant(totalDepenses, monnaie: monnaie),
                  TAPAColors.red,
                  Icons.trending_down_rounded,
                  isSmall,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _miniCard(
      String label,
      String valeur,
      Color color,
      IconData icone,
      bool isSmall,
      ) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 8),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: color.withOpacity(0.14),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: color.withOpacity(0.28)),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            width: 22,
            height: 22,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: color.withOpacity(0.2),
              shape: BoxShape.circle,
            ),
            child: Icon(icone, size: 12, color: color),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 6),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                Text(
                  label,
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 9.5, color: Colors.white60),
                ),
                Text(
                  valeur,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                    color: color,
                  ),
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

// lib/presentation/screens/splash/splash_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import 'package:tapa_budget/presentation/providers/providers.dart';
import '../../../../core/utils/logger.dart';

/// Écran de chargement / Splash Screen
/// Vérifie l'état d'authentification avant de rediriger
class SplashScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const SplashScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<SplashScreen> createState() => _SplashScreenState();
}

class _SplashScreenState extends ConsumerState<SplashScreen> {
  // ============================================
  // VARIABLES D'ÉTAT
  // ============================================

  bool _isInitialized = false;
  String _statusMessage = 'Chargement...';

  // ============================================
  // CYCLE DE VIE
  // ============================================

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _initializeApp();
  }

  // ============================================
  // INITIALISATION
  // ============================================

  /// Initialise l'application et vérifie l'authentification
  Future<void> _initializeApp() async {
    try {
      _updateStatus('Vérification de l\'authentification...');

      // Attendre que l'état d'authentification soit résolu
      await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 500));

      // Récupérer l'état d'authentification
      final isAuthenticated = ref.read(isAuthenticatedProvider);
      final user = ref.read(currentUserProvider);

      if (!mounted) return;

      _updateStatus(
        isAuthenticated
            ? 'Bienvenue ${user?.prenom ?? ''} !'
            : 'Prêt pour la connexion...',
      );

      // Petit délai pour l'effet visuel
      await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 500));

      if (!mounted) return;

      // Rediriger vers la page appropriée
      _navigateToAppropriateScreen();

    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur lors de l\'initialisation: $e');
      if (mounted) {
        _updateStatus('Erreur de chargement');
        await Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));
        if (mounted) {
          // En cas d'erreur, aller vers l'écran de connexion
          context.go('/inscription');
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /// Met à jour le message de statut
  void _updateStatus(String message) {
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _statusMessage = message;
        _isInitialized = true;
      });
    }
  }

  /// Redirige vers l'écran approprié selon l'état de l'utilisateur
  void _navigateToAppropriateScreen() {
    final isAuthenticated = ref.read(isAuthenticatedProvider);
    final user = ref.read(currentUserProvider);

    if (!mounted) return;

    if (!isAuthenticated) {
      Logger.info('👤 Utilisateur non authentifié → /inscription');
      context.go('/inscription');
      return;
    }

    // Utilisateur authentifié
    Logger.info('👤 Utilisateur authentifié: ${user?.prenom}');

    // Vérifier l'onboarding
    if (user?.onboardingVu == false) {
      Logger.info('🔄 Onboarding nécessaire → /onboarding');
      context.go('/onboarding');
      return;
    }

    // Vérifier le PIN
    final hasPin = ref.read(hasPinProvider);
    if (!hasPin) {
      Logger.info('🔐 PIN nécessaire → /pin-setup');
      context.go('/pin-setup');
      return;
    }

    // Vérifier l'accès (essai ou premium)
    final canAccess = ref.read(canAccessAppProvider);
    if (!canAccess) {
      Logger.info('🔒 Activation nécessaire → /activation');
      context.go('/activation');
      return;
    }

    // Tout est ok → Accueil
    Logger.info('🏠 Accès validé → /home');
    context.go('/home');
  }

  // ============================================
  // BUILD
  // ============================================

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
      body: Center(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            // ============================================
            // LOGO / ICÔNE
            // ============================================
            Container(
              width: 80,
              height: 80,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: TAPAColors.gold.withOpacity(0.15),
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                border: Border.all(
                  color: TAPAColors.gold,
                  width: 2,
                ),
              ),
              child: const Icon(
                Icons.account_balance_wallet,
                color: TAPAColors.gold,
                size: 36,
              ),
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 20),

            // ============================================
            // TITRE DE L'APPLICATION
            // ============================================
             RichText(
              text: const TextSpan(
                children: [
                  TextSpan(
                    text: 'TAPA',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 32,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      color: TAPAColors.gold,
                    ),
                  ),
                  TextSpan(
                    text: ' Invest',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 32,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                      color: TAPAColors.white,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 8),

            // ============================================
            // SOUS-TITRE
            // ============================================
            const Text(
              'Le budget simple pour tous.',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 13,
                color: Colors.white54,
                fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
              ),
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 48),

            // ============================================
            // STATUT DE CHARGEMENT
            // ============================================
            if (_isInitialized) ...[
              Text(
                _statusMessage,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 12,
                  color: Colors.white38,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
            ],

            // ============================================
            // INDICATEUR DE PROGRÈS
            // ============================================
            const CircularProgressIndicator(
              color: TAPAColors.gold,
              strokeWidth: 2,
            ),

            // ============================================
            // VERSION DE L'APPLICATION
            // ============================================
            const SizedBox(height: 48),
            const Text(
              'v1.0.0',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 10,
                color: Colors.white24,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class EcheancesScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const EcheancesScreen({super.key});
  @override
  ConsumerState<EcheancesScreen> createState() => _EcheancesScreenState();
}

class _EcheancesScreenState extends ConsumerState<EcheancesScreen> {
  List<EcheanceModel> get _echeances =>
      ref.watch(echeancesStateProvider).echeances;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      _charger();
    });
  }

  Future<void> _charger() async {
    final uid = ref.read(currentUserProvider)?.id ?? '';
    if (uid.isEmpty) return;
    await ref.read(echeancesStateProvider.notifier).loadEcheances(uid);
  }

  Future<void> _supprimer(EcheanceModel e) async {
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
        context: context,
        builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
            title: const Text('Supprimer ?'),
            content: Text('Supprimer l echeance "${e.titre}" ?'),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
                  child: const Text('Annuler')),
              TextButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
                  child: const Text('Supprimer',
                      style: TextStyle(color: TAPAColors.red))),
            ]));
    if (ok == true) {
      await ref.read(deleteEcheanceProvider(e.id).future);
      await NotificationService.annulerEcheance(e.id);
    }
  }

  Color _couleurType(String type) {
    switch (type) {
      case 'mensuelle': return TAPAColors.navy;
      case 'hebdomadaire': return TAPAColors.green;
      default: return TAPAColors.purple;
    }
  }

  String _labelType(String type) {
    switch (type) {
      case 'mensuelle': return 'Mensuelle';
      case 'hebdomadaire': return 'Hebdomadaire';
      default: return 'Date unique';
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final user = ref.read(currentUserProvider);
    final monnaie = user?.monnaie ?? 'FCFA';

    return Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
        appBar: AppBar(
            title: const Text('Mes echeances'),
            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
            foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
            leading: IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios),
                onPressed: () => context.pop()),
            actions: [
              IconButton(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.add, color: TAPAColors.gold),
                  onPressed: () async {
                    await context.push('/echeances/ajouter');
                    _charger();
                  }),
            ]),
        body: _echeances.isEmpty
            ? Center(child: Column(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              const Icon(Icons.alarm_outlined,
                  size: 60, color: TAPAColors.textHint),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              const Text('Aucune echeance',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      color: TAPAColors.navy)),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              const Text(
                  'Ajoutez vos echeances pour recevoir\ndes rappels automatiques.',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: TextStyle(color: TAPAColors.textSecond)),
              const SizedBox(height: 24),
              ElevatedButton.icon(
                  onPressed: () async {
                    await context.push('/echeances/ajouter');
                    _charger();
                  },
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.add),
                  label: const Text('Ajouter une echeance'),
                  style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy)),
            ]))
            : ListView.builder(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            itemCount: _echeances.length,
            itemBuilder: (ctx, i) {
              final e = _echeances[i];
              final couleur = _couleurType(e.type);
              return Container(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: TAPAColors.surface,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                      border: Border.all(
                          color: TAPAColors.border, width: 0.5)),
                  child: Row(children: [
                    Container(
                        width: 48, height: 48,
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: couleur.withOpacity(0.12),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
                        child: Icon(Icons.alarm,
                            color: couleur, size: 24)),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    Expanded(child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Text(e.titre,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 14,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                  color: TAPAColors.navy)),
                          const SizedBox(height: 3),
                          Text(
                              Fmt.montant(e.montant, monnaie: monnaie),
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 13,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                  color: couleur)),
                          const SizedBox(height: 3),
                          Row(children: [
                            Container(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                    horizontal: 7, vertical: 2),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: couleur.withOpacity(0.1),
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6)),
                                child: Text(_labelType(e.type),
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                        fontSize: 10,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                        color: couleur))),
                            const SizedBox(width: 6),
                            Text(e.descriptionRecurrence,
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 11,
                                    color: TAPAColors.textSecond)),
                          ]),
                          const SizedBox(height: 3),
                          Row(children: [
                            const Icon(Icons.notifications_outlined,
                                size: 12, color: TAPAColors.gold),
                            const SizedBox(width: 4),
                            Text('Rappel ${e.descriptionRappel}',

                                    color: TAPAColors.gold)),

                        ])),
                    IconButton(
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline,
                            color: TAPAColors.textHint, size: 20),
                        onPressed: () => _supprimer(e)),
                  ]));
            }));
  }
}

FICHIER : lib/presentation/screens/echeances/ajouter_echeance_screen.dart
