import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../../../data/models/models.dart';  // ✅ CORRIGÉ
import '../../../services/db_service_mysql.dart';
import '../../../services/notification_service.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/formatters.dart';

class AjouterEcheanceScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const AjouterEcheanceScreen({super.key});
  @override
  State<AjouterEcheanceScreen> createState() =>
      _AjouterEcheanceScreenState();
}

class _AjouterEcheanceScreenState extends State<AjouterEcheanceScreen> {
  final _titreCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final _montantCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final _db = DBService();

  DateTime _dateChoisie = DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 7));
  String _frequence = 'unique';
  int _rappelAvant = 120;
  bool _dateSelectionnee = false;

  static const List<Map<String, dynamic>> _rappelOptions = [
    {'label': '1 heure avant', 'valeur': 1},
    {'label': '3 heures avant', 'valeur': 3},
    {'label': '6 heures avant', 'valeur': 6},
    {'label': '10 heures avant', 'valeur': 10},
    {'label': '1 jour avant', 'valeur': 24},
    {'label': '2 jours avant', 'valeur': 48},
    {'label': '3 jours avant', 'valeur': 72},
    {'label': '5 jours avant', 'valeur': 120},
    {'label': '1 semaine avant', 'valeur': 168},
  ];

  String _getDescriptionRecurrence(String type, DateTime date) {
    switch (type) {
      case 'mensuelle':
        return 'Le ${date.day} de chaque mois';
      case 'hebdomadaire':
        const jours = ['', 'Lundi', 'Mardi', 'Mercredi', 'Jeudi', 'Vendredi', 'Samedi', 'Dimanche'];
        return 'Chaque ${jours[date.weekday]}';
      default:
        return 'Le ${date.day}/${date.month}/${date.year}';
    }
  }

  String _getDescriptionRappel(int heures) {
    if (heures >= 168) return '1 semaine avant';
    if (heures >= 72) return '3 jours avant';
    if (heures >= 48) return '2 jours avant';
    if (heures >= 24) return '1 jour avant';
    if (heures >= 10) return '$heures heures avant';
    if (heures >= 6) return '6 heures avant';
    if (heures >= 3) return '3 heures avant';
    return '1 heure avant';
  }

  Future<void> _choisirDate() async {
    final d = await showDatePicker(
        context: context,
        initialDate: _dateChoisie,
        firstDate: DateTime.now(),
        lastDate: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 365 * 5)),
        builder: (context, child) => Theme(
            data: Theme.of(context).copyWith(
                colorScheme: const ColorScheme.light(
                    primary: TAPAColors.navy,
                    onPrimary: TAPAColors.white,
                    onSurface: TAPAColors.navy)),
            child: child!));
    if (d != null) {
      setState(() {
        _dateChoisie = d;
        _dateSelectionnee = true;
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _enregistrer() async {
    final titre = _titreCtrl.text.trim();
    final montant = double.tryParse(_montantCtrl.text);

    if (titre.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Entrez un titre'),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red));
      return;
    }
    if (montant == null || montant <= 0) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Entrez un montant valide'),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red));
      return;
    }
    if (!_dateSelectionnee) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Choisissez une date'),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red));
      return;
    }

    String type;
    int? jourDuMois;
    int? jourDeLaSemaine;
    DateTime? datePrecise;

    switch (_frequence) {
      case 'mensuelle':
        type = 'mensuelle';
        jourDuMois = _dateChoisie.day;
        break;
      case 'hebdomadaire':
        type = 'hebdomadaire';
        jourDeLaSemaine = _dateChoisie.weekday;
        break;
      default:
        type = 'unique';
        datePrecise = _dateChoisie;
    }

    // ✅ CORRECTION : Utiliser le constructeur correct d'EcheanceModel
    final echeance = EcheanceModel(
      id: Fmt.genId(),
      uid: _db.getUser()?['uid'] ?? '',
      titre: titre,
      description: '',
      montant: montant,
      dateEcheance: _dateChoisie,
      type: type,
      statut: 'en_attente',
      descriptionRecurrence: _getDescriptionRecurrence(type, _dateChoisie),
      descriptionRappel: _getDescriptionRappel(_rappelAvant),
      createdAt: DateTime.now(),
      updatedAt: DateTime.now(),
    );

    await _db.saveEcheance(echeance);
    await NotificationService.programmerEcheance(echeance);

    if (mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Echeance ajoutee !'),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.green));
      context.pop();
    }
  }

  String _nomJour(int weekday) {
    const jours = ['', 'Lundi', 'Mardi', 'Mercredi',
      'Jeudi', 'Vendredi', 'Samedi', 'Dimanche'];
    return jours[weekday];
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final monnaie = _db.getUser()?['monnaie'] ?? 'FCFA';

    return Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
        appBar: AppBar(
            title: const Text('Nouvelle echeance'),
            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
            foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
            leading: IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios),
                onPressed: () => context.pop())),
        body: ListView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
            children: [
              // Titre
              TextField(
                  controller: _titreCtrl,
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Titre de l echeance',
                      hintText: 'Ex: Scolarite enfants, Loyer, CIE...',
                      prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.label_outline),
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)))),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),

              // Montant
              TextField(
                  controller: _montantCtrl,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Montant',
                      suffixText: monnaie,
                      hintText: 'Ex: 100000',
                      prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.attach_money_outlined),
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)))),
              const SizedBox(height: 24),

              // Calendrier
              const Text('Date de l echeance',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      color: TAPAColors.navy)),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              GestureDetector(
                onTap: _choisirDate,
                child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: _dateSelectionnee
                            ? TAPAColors.navy
                            : TAPAColors.surface,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                        border: Border.all(
                            color: _dateSelectionnee
                                ? TAPAColors.navy
                                : TAPAColors.border,
                            width: _dateSelectionnee ? 0 : 1)),
                    child: Row(children: [
                      Container(
                          width: 50, height: 50,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: _dateSelectionnee
                                  ? TAPAColors.gold.withOpacity(0.2)
                                  : TAPAColors.goldLight,
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                          child: const Icon(Icons.calendar_month,
                              color: TAPAColors.gold, size: 26)),
                      const SizedBox(width: 16),
                      Expanded(child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                                _dateSelectionnee
                                    ? '${_dateChoisie.day}/${_dateChoisie.month}/${_dateChoisie.year}'
                                    : 'Choisir la date',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 16,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                    color: _dateSelectionnee
                                        ? TAPAColors.white
                                        : TAPAColors.navy)),
                            if (_dateSelectionnee)
                              Text(
                                  _nomJour(_dateChoisie.weekday),
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 12,
                                      color: Colors.white60)),
                          ])),
                      Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_ios,
                          size: 16,
                          color: _dateSelectionnee
                              ? Colors.white54
                              : TAPAColors.textHint),
                    ])),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 24),

              // Frequence
              if (_dateSelectionnee) ...[
                const Text('Frequence',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        color: TAPAColors.navy)),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                _freqCard(
                    'unique',
                    'Une seule fois',
                    'Le ${_dateChoisie.day}/${_dateChoisie.month}/${_dateChoisie.year} uniquement',
                    Icons.looks_one_outlined),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                _freqCard(
                    'mensuelle',
                    'Tous les mois',
                    'Le ${_dateChoisie.day} de chaque mois',
                    Icons.repeat_outlined),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                _freqCard(
                    'hebdomadaire',
                    'Chaque semaine',
                    'Chaque ${_nomJour(_dateChoisie.weekday)}',
                    Icons.view_week_outlined),
                const SizedBox(height: 24),
              ],

              // Rappel
              const Text('Me rappeler',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      color: TAPAColors.navy)),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              DropdownButtonFormField<int>(
                  value: _rappelAvant,
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                      prefixIcon: const Icon(
                          Icons.notifications_outlined,
                          color: TAPAColors.gold),
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12))),
                  items: _rappelOptions.map((o) => DropdownMenuItem<int>(
                      value: o['valeur'] as int,
                      child: Text(o['label'] as String))).toList(),
                  onChanged: (v) =>
                      setState(() => _rappelAvant = v ?? 120)),
              const SizedBox(height: 32),

              ElevatedButton(
                  onPressed: _enregistrer,
                  style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16)),
                  child: const Text('Enregistrer l echeance',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: TAPAColors.gold,
                          fontSize: 15,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700))),
              const SizedBox(height: 20),
            ]));
  }

  Widget _freqCard(String val, String titre,
      String sous, IconData icon) {
    final isActive = _frequence == val;
    return GestureDetector(
        onTap: () => setState(() => _frequence = val),
        child: Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: isActive
                    ? TAPAColors.navy.withOpacity(0.06)
                    : TAPAColors.surface,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                border: Border.all(
                    color: isActive ? TAPAColors.navy : TAPAColors.border,
                    width: isActive ? 2 : 0.5)),
            child: Row(children: [
              Container(
                  width: 40, height: 40,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: isActive
                          ? TAPAColors.navy
                          : TAPAColors.navy.withOpacity(0.08),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
                  child: Icon(icon, size: 20,
                      color: isActive
                          ? TAPAColors.gold
                          : TAPAColors.navy)),
              const SizedBox(width: 14),
              Expanded(child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(titre,
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 14,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                            color: isActive
                                ? TAPAColors.navy
                                : TAPAColors.navy)),
                    Text(sous,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 11.5,
                            color: TAPAColors.textSecond)),
                  ])),
              if (isActive)
                const Icon(Icons.check_circle,
                    color: TAPAColors.navy, size: 22),
            ])));
  }
}

// lib/screens/savings/add_goal_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../../../data/models/models.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/formatters.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/logger.dart';
import 'package:tapa_budget/presentation/providers/providers.dart';

class AddGoalScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const AddGoalScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<AddGoalScreen> createState() => _AddGoalScreenState();
}

class _AddGoalScreenState extends ConsumerState<AddGoalScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _nameController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _targetController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _currentController = TextEditingController();

  DateTime _targetDate = DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 30));
  bool _isLoading = false;
  String _selectedCurrency = 'FCFA';

  // Raccourcis de date (jours)
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> _quickDates = [
    {'label': '1 mois', 'days': 30},
    {'label': '3 mois', 'days': 90},
    {'label': '6 mois', 'days': 180},
    {'label': '1 an', 'days': 365},
  ];

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nameController.dispose();
    _targetController.dispose();
    _currentController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Logique (inchangée) ─────────────────────────

  Future<void> _saveGoal() async {
    final name = _nameController.text.trim();
    final targetAmount = double.tryParse(_targetController.text);
    final currentAmount = double.tryParse(_currentController.text) ?? 0;

    if (name.isEmpty) {
      _showSnackBar('Veuillez entrer un nom pour votre objectif',
          isError: true);
      return;
    }

    if (targetAmount == null || targetAmount <= 0) {
      _showSnackBar('Veuillez entrer un montant cible valide', isError: true);
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _isLoading = true);

    try {
      final user = ref.read(currentUserProvider);
      final userId = user?.id ?? '';

      if (userId.isEmpty) {
        _showSnackBar('Utilisateur non trouvé', isError: true);
        setState(() => _isLoading = false);
        return;
      }

      final goal = SavingsGoalModel(
        id: '',
        uid: userId,
        nom: name,
        montantCible: targetAmount,
        montantActuel: currentAmount,
        dateLimite: _targetDate,
        walletId: '',
        estAtteint: false,
        createdAt: DateTime.now(),
        updatedAt: DateTime.now(),
      );

      await ref.read(addSavingsGoalProvider(goal).future);

      if (mounted) {
        _showSnackBar('Objectif d\'épargne créé avec succès !');
        context.pop(true);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur création objectif: $e');
      if (mounted) {
        _showSnackBar(
          'Erreur: ${e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '')}',
          isError: true,
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isLoading = false);
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _selectDate(BuildContext context) async {
    final picked = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: _targetDate,
      firstDate: DateTime.now(),
      lastDate: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 365 * 10)),
      builder: (context, child) {
        return Theme(
          data: ThemeData.light().copyWith(
            colorScheme: const ColorScheme.light(
              primary: TAPAColors.navy,
              onPrimary: TAPAColors.white,
            ),
          ),
          child: child!,
        );
      },
    );
    if (picked != null) {
      setState(() => _targetDate = picked);
    }
  }

  void _showSnackBar(String message, {bool isError = false}) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(message, maxLines: 3, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
        backgroundColor: isError ? TAPAColors.red : TAPAColors.navy,
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Aides de style ─────────────────────────

  InputDecoration _dec({
    required String label,
    String? hint,
    required IconData icon,
    String? suffix,
  }) {
    OutlineInputBorder border(Color c, [double w = 1]) => OutlineInputBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
      borderSide: BorderSide(color: c, width: w),
    );
    return InputDecoration(
      labelText: label,
      hintText: hint,
      suffixText: suffix,
      prefixIcon: Icon(icon, color: TAPAColors.navy, size: 22),
      filled: true,
      fillColor: TAPAColors.background,
      contentPadding:
      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 16),
      border: border(TAPAColors.border),
      enabledBorder: border(TAPAColors.border),
      focusedBorder: border(TAPAColors.gold, 1.6),
      labelStyle: const TextStyle(color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
      floatingLabelStyle: const TextStyle(
        color: TAPAColors.navy,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _card({required String title, required Widget child}) {
    return Container(
      width: double.infinity,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: TAPAColors.surface,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(color: TAPAColors.border, width: 0.8),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: TAPAColors.navy.withOpacity(0.05),
            blurRadius: 14,
            offset: const Offset(0, 5),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Container(
                width: 4,
                height: 16,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: TAPAColors.gold,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  title,
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 15,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    color: TAPAColors.navy,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          child,
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Aperçu ─────────────────────────

  Widget _previewCard() {
    final name = _nameController.text.trim();
    final target = double.tryParse(_targetController.text) ?? 0;
    final current = double.tryParse(_currentController.text) ?? 0;
    final progress = target > 0 ? (current / target).clamp(0.0, 1.0) : 0.0;

    return ClipRRect(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
      child: Container(
        width: double.infinity,
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            colors: [Color(0xFF1A237E), Color(0xFF0D1444)],
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
          ),
        ),
        child: Stack(
          children: [
            Positioned(
              right: -36,
              top: -36,
              child: Container(
                width: 130,
                height: 130,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  color: TAPAColors.gold.withOpacity(0.10),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: TAPAColors.gold.withOpacity(0.18),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        ),
                        child: const Icon(Icons.flag_outlined,
                            size: 20, color: TAPAColors.gold),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 10),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                          name.isEmpty ? 'Votre nouvel objectif' : name,
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 14,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            color: Colors.white70,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Text(
                        '${(progress * 100).round()}%',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 14,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                          color: TAPAColors.gold,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  FittedBox(
                    fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                    alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                    child: Text(
                      Fmt.montant(target, monnaie: _selectedCurrency),
                      maxLines: 1,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 32,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                        color: TAPAColors.white,
                        letterSpacing: -0.5,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  ClipRRect(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                    child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                      value: progress,
                      minHeight: 8,
                      backgroundColor: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.15),
                      valueColor: const AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(
                          TAPAColors.gold),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Date ─────────────────────────

  bool _isQuickSelected(int days) {
    final target = DateTime.now().add(Duration(days: days));
    return _targetDate.year == target.year &&
        _targetDate.month == target.month &&
        _targetDate.day == target.day;
  }

  Widget _dateSection() {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        // Wrap : les raccourcis passent à la ligne au lieu de déborder
        Wrap(
          spacing: 8,
          runSpacing: 8,
          children: _quickDates.map((q) {
            final days = q['days'] as int;
            final selected = _isQuickSelected(days);
            return GestureDetector(
              onTap: () => setState(() =>
              _targetDate = DateTime.now().add(Duration(days: days))),
              child: AnimatedContainer(
                duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
                padding:
                const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 9),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: selected ? TAPAColors.navy : TAPAColors.background,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                  border: Border.all(
                    color: selected ? TAPAColors.navy : TAPAColors.border,
                  ),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  q['label'] as String,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    color: selected ? TAPAColors.white : TAPAColors.navy,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            );
          }).toList(),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        InkWell(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          onTap: () => _selectDate(context),
          child: Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: TAPAColors.background,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
              border: Border.all(color: TAPAColors.border),
            ),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.calendar_today_outlined,
                    color: TAPAColors.navy, size: 20),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    Fmt.dateFuture(_targetDate),
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 14,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      color: TAPAColors.navy,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                const Text(
                  'Modifier',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    color: TAPAColors.gold,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Build ─────────────────────────

  @override

// lib/screens/savings/savings_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import 'package:tapa_budget/presentation/providers/providers.dart';
import '../../../data/models/models.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/formatters.dart';
import '../../../domain/usecases/savings/transfer_to_goal_usecase.dart';

class SavingsScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const SavingsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<SavingsScreen> createState() => _SavingsScreenState();
}

class _SavingsScreenState extends ConsumerState<SavingsScreen> {
  int _selectedIndex = 2;

  void _navigateTo(String route, int index) {
    setState(() => _selectedIndex = index);
    context.go(route);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final monnaie = ref.watch(userMonnaieProvider);
    final user = ref.watch(currentUserProvider);
    final userId = user?.id ?? '';

    final goalsAsync = ref.watch(userSavingsGoalsProvider(userId));
    final epargnesAsync = ref.watch(userEpargneProgrammeeProvider(userId));

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text(
          'Enveloppe',
          maxLines: 1,
          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
        ),
        elevation: 0,
        centerTitle: true,
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
        foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_new, size: 20),
          onPressed: () => context.go('/home'),
        ),
        actions: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
            child: IconButton(
              tooltip: 'Ajouter',
              style: IconButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: TAPAColors.gold.withOpacity(0.18),
              ),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.add, color: TAPAColors.gold),
              onPressed: () async {
                await context.push('/savings/add');
              },
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: goalsAsync.when(
        loading: () => const Center(
          child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: TAPAColors.gold),
        ),
        error: (err, stack) => Center(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.error_outline,
                    size: 40, color: TAPAColors.red),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                Text(
                  'Impossible de charger vos enveloppes.\n$err',
                  maxLines: 5,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: const TextStyle(color: TAPAColors.red),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextButton(
                  onPressed: () =>
                      ref.invalidate(userSavingsGoalsProvider(userId)),
                  child: const Text('Réessayer'),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
        data: (goals) {
          final epargnes = epargnesAsync.valueOrNull ?? [];
          final totalEpargne = goals.fold<double>(
            0.0,
                (sum, g) => sum + g.montantActuel,
          );

          return RefreshIndicator(
            color: TAPAColors.gold,
            onRefresh: () async {
              ref.invalidate(userSavingsGoalsProvider(userId));
              ref.invalidate(userEpargneProgrammeeProvider(userId));
            },
            child: ListView(
              physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 24),
              children: [
                _heroCard(
                  total: totalEpargne,
                  nbGoals: goals.length,
                  nbEpargnes: epargnes.length,
                  monnaie: monnaie,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 24),
                if (goals.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  _sectionHeader('Objectifs d\'enveloppe', goals.length),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  ...goals.map((g) => _goalCard(g, monnaie)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                ],
                if (epargnes.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  _sectionHeader('Enveloppe programmée', epargnes.length),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  ...epargnes.map((e) => _epargneCard(e, monnaie)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                ],
                if (goals.isEmpty && epargnes.isEmpty) _emptyState(),
              ],
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
      bottomNavigationBar: _buildBottomNavigationBar(),
    );
  }


  Future<void> _ajouterFonds(SavingsGoalModel goal, String monnaie) async {
    final user = ref.read(currentUserProvider);
    if (user == null) return;

    // ✅ CHARGER les portefeuilles AVANT d'ouvrir le modal
    try {
      await ref.read(walletStateProvider.notifier).loadWallets(user.id);
    } catch (e) {
      print('Erreur chargement wallets: $e');
    }

    if (!mounted) return;

    final wallets = ref.read(walletStateProvider).wallets;
    if (wallets.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Créez d\'abord un portefeuille pour y prendre de l\'argent.'),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    WalletModel? selectedWallet = wallets.first;
    final montantController = TextEditingController();

    final result = await showModalBottomSheet<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setModalState) => Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom),
          child: Container(
            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
              color: TAPAColors.surface,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
            ),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 12, 24, 24),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Center(
                  child: Container(
                    margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
                    width: 40,
                    height: 4,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: TAPAColors.border,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const Text(
                  'Ajouter des fonds',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, color: TAPAColors.navy),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Text(
                  'Objectif : ${goal.nom}',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 20),
                const Text(
                  'Prendre l\'argent depuis :',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: TAPAColors.navy),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                DropdownButtonFormField<WalletModel>(
                  value: selectedWallet,
                  isExpanded: true,
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    filled: true,
                    fillColor: TAPAColors.background,
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      borderSide: BorderSide.none,
                    ),
                  ),
                  items: wallets.map((w) {
                    return DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: w,
                      child: Text('${w.emoji} ${w.nom} (${Fmt.montant(w.solde, monnaie: monnaie)})'),
                    );
                  }).toList(),
                  onChanged: (w) => setModalState(() => selectedWallet = w),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                TextField(
                  controller: montantController,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Montant à épargner',
                    hintText: 'Ex: 5000',
                    suffixText: monnaie,
                    filled: true,
                    fillColor: TAPAColors.background,
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      borderSide: BorderSide.none,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 24),
                SizedBox(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  height: 52,
                  child: ElevatedButton(
                    onPressed: () {
                      final montant = double.tryParse(montantController.text) ?? 0;
                      if (montant <= 0) {
                        ScaffoldMessenger.of(ctx).showSnackBar(
                          const SnackBar(content: Text('Saisissez un montant valide'), backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red),
                        );
                        return;
                      }
                      if (montant > selectedWallet!.solde) {
                        ScaffoldMessenger.of(ctx).showSnackBar(
                          const SnackBar(content: Text('Solde insuffisant dans ce portefeuille'), backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red),
                        );
                        return;
                      }
                      Navigator.pop(ctx, {
                        'montant': montant,
                        'walletId': selectedWallet!.id,
                      });
                    },
                    style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.gold,
                      foregroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                    ),
                    child: const Text('Confirmer le virement', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );

    if (result == null) return;

    try {
      final montant = result['montant'] as double;
      final walletId = result['walletId'] as String;
      final userId = ref.read(currentUserProvider)?.id ?? '';
      
      final virementResult = await ref.read(transferToGoalProvider({
        'walletId': walletId,
        'goalId': goal.id,
        'userId': userId,
        'montant': montant,
      }).future);

      if (virementResult.success && mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('✅ ${Fmt.montant(montant, monnaie: monnaie)} virés vers "${goal.nom}"'),
            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.green,
          ),
        );
        ref.invalidate(userSavingsGoalsProvider(userId));
        ref.invalidate(walletListProvider(userId));
      } else if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('❌ ${virementResult.message ?? "Erreur lors du virement"}'),
            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('❌ Erreur: $e'),
            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Objectif d'épargne ─────────────────────────

  Widget _goalCard(SavingsGoalModel goal, String monnaie) {
    final progress = goal.montantCible > 0
        ? (goal.montantActuel / goal.montantCible).clamp(0.0, 1.0)
        : 0.0;
    final reste = (goal.montantCible - goal.montantActuel);
    final atteint = progress >= 1.0;

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      decoration: _cardDecoration(
        borderColor: atteint ? TAPAColors.green : null,
        borderWidth: atteint ? 1.5 : 0.8,
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          // Anneau de progression
          SizedBox(
            width: 56,
            height: 56,
            child: Stack(
              alignment: Alignment.center,
              children: [
                SizedBox(
                  width: 56,
                  height: 56,
                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                    value: progress,
                    strokeWidth: 6,
                    strokeCap: StrokeCap.round,
                    backgroundColor: TAPAColors.border,
                    valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(
                      atteint ? TAPAColors.green : TAPAColors.gold,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                Text(
                  '${(progress * 100).round()}%',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                    color: TAPAColors.navy,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 14),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Flexible(
                      child: Text(
                        goal.nom,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 15,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                          color: TAPAColors.navy,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (atteint) ...[
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      const Icon(Icons.check_circle,
                          size: 16, color: TAPAColors.green),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                FittedBox(
                  fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                  alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                  child: Text(
                    Fmt.montant(goal.montantActuel, monnaie: monnaie),
                    maxLines: 1,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 16,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      color: TAPAColors.gold,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                Text(
                  atteint
                      ? 'Objectif atteint : ${Fmt.montant(goal.montantCible, monnaie: monnaie)}'
                      : 'Reste ${Fmt.montant(reste, monnaie: monnaie)} sur ${Fmt.montant(goal.montantCible, monnaie: monnaie)}',
                  maxLines: 2,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11,
                    color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.add_circle, color: TAPAColors.gold, size: 26),
            onPressed: () => _ajouterFonds(goal, monnaie),
            padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Épargne programmée ─────────────────────────

  Widget _epargneCard(EpargneProgrammeeModel epargne, String monnaie) {
    final progress = epargne.montantObjectif > 0
        ? (epargne.montantEpargne / epargne.montantObjectif).clamp(0.0, 1.0)
        : 0.0;
    final accent = epargne.termine ? TAPAColors.green : TAPAColors.gold;

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      decoration: _cardDecoration(
        borderColor: epargne.termine ? TAPAColors.green : null,
        borderWidth: epargne.termine ? 1.5 : 0.8,
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Container(
                width: 40,
                height: 40,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: accent.withOpacity(0.15),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                ),
                child: Icon(
                  epargne.termine ? Icons.check : Icons.autorenew,
                  size: 20,
                  color: accent,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Flexible(
                          child: Text(
                            epargne.titre,
                            maxLines: 1,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,

                  alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,

  // ───────────────────────── Navigation basse ─────────────────────────

  Widget _buildBottomNavigationBar() {
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.08),
            blurRadius: 16,
            offset: const Offset(0, -4),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(4, 8, 4, 6),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.home_outlined,
                activeIcon: Icons.home,
                label: 'Accueil',
                index: 0,
                route: '/home',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.shield_outlined,
                activeIcon: Icons.shield,
                label: 'Assurance',
                index: 1,
                route: '/investir/assurance',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.account_balance_wallet_outlined,
                activeIcon: Icons.account_balance_wallet,
                label: 'Enveloppe',
                index: 2,
                route: '/savings',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.pie_chart_outline,
                activeIcon: Icons.pie_chart,
                label: 'Budget',
                index: 3,
                route: '/budget',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.credit_card_outlined,
                activeIcon: Icons.credit_card,
                label: 'Dettes',
                index: 4,
                route: '/dettes',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.person_outline,
                activeIcon: Icons.person,
                label: 'Profil',
                index: 5,
                route: '/profile',
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildNavItem({
    required IconData icon,
    required IconData activeIcon,
    required String label,
    required int index,
    required String route,
  }) {
    final isActive = _selectedIndex == index;
    return Expanded(
      child: GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTap: () => _navigateTo(route, index),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            AnimatedContainer(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 260),
              curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
              width: isActive ? 46 : 38,
              height: 32,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: isActive
                    ? const LinearGradient(
                  colors: [Color(0xFF1A237E), Color(0xFF0D1444)],
                  begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                  end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                )
                    : null,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                boxShadow: isActive
                    ? [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: const Color(0xFF1A237E).withOpacity(0.35),
                    blurRadius: 10,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 4),
                  ),
                ]
                    : null,
              ),
              child: Icon(
                isActive ? activeIcon : icon,
                size: 20,
                color: isActive ? Colors.amber : Colors.grey.shade500,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            // FittedBox : le libellé rétrécit au lieu de déborder
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 2),
              child: FittedBox(
                fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                child: Text(
                  label,
                  maxLines: 1,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 10,
                    fontWeight: isActive ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
                    color: isActive
                        ? const Color(0xFF1A237E)
                        : Colors.grey.shade500,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// lib/screens/savings/epargne_programmee_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../../../data/models/models.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/formatters.dart';
import '../../../services/link_service.dart';
import 'package:tapa_budget/presentation/providers/providers.dart';  // ✅ IMPORT AJOUTÉ

class EpargneProgrammeeScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const EpargneProgrammeeScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<EpargneProgrammeeScreen> createState() => _EpargneProgrammeeScreenState();
}

class _EpargneProgrammeeScreenState extends ConsumerState<EpargneProgrammeeScreen> {
  int _selectedIndex = 2;
  final List<EpargneProgrammeeModel> _epargnes = [];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _charger();
  }

  Future<void> _charger() async {
    // TODO: Remplacer par un provider
    setState(() {});
  }

  void _navigateTo(String route, int index) {
    setState(() => _selectedIndex = index);
    context.go(route);
  }

  Future<void> _effectuerDepot(EpargneProgrammeeModel ep) async {
    if (ep.verrouille) {
      _afficherDialogDeverrouillage(ep);
      return;
    }
    if (ep.termine) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Objectif atteint ! Épargne terminée.'),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.green,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    // ✅ CORRECTION: Utiliser userMonnaieProvider
    final monnaie = ref.watch(userMonnaieProvider);

    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Confirmer le dépôt'),
        content: Text(
          'Effectuer un dépôt de '
              '${Fmt.montant(ep.montantParDepot, monnaie: monnaie)} '
              'pour "${ep.titre}" ?',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Annuler'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: TAPAColors.green,
            ),
            child: const Text(
              'Confirmer',
              style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (ok == true) {
      try {
        // TODO: Utiliser un provider
        _charger();
        if (mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(
              content: Text(
                'Dépôt effectué ! +${Fmt.montant(ep.montantParDepot, monnaie: monnaie)}',
              ),
              backgroundColor: TAPAColors.green,
            ),
          );
        }
      } catch (e) {
        if (mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(
              content: Text(e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '')),
              backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
            ),
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }

  void _afficherDialogDeverrouillage(EpargneProgrammeeModel ep) {
    final ctrl = TextEditingController();
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Compte verrouillé'),
        content: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            const Text(
              'Ce compte est verrouillé. Envoyez un WhatsApp à TAPA Invest '
                  'pour recevoir votre code de déverrouillage.',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            ElevatedButton.icon(

                Navigator.pop(ctx);

                        content: Text('Compte déverrouillé !'),

              ),

  }

  Future<void> _supprimer(EpargneProgrammeeModel ep) async {
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Supprimer ?'),
        content: Text('Supprimer l\'épargne "${ep.titre}" ?'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Annuler'),

          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text(
              'Supprimer',
              style: TextStyle(color: TAPAColors.red),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (ok == true) {
      // TODO: Utiliser un provider
      _charger();
    }
  }

  Widget _carteEpargne(EpargneProgrammeeModel ep, String monnaie) {
    final couleur = ep.termine
        ? TAPAColors.green
        : ep.verrouille
        ? TAPAColors.red
        : TAPAColors.navy;

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: TAPAColors.surface,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        border: Border.all(
          color: ep.verrouille
              ? TAPAColors.red.withOpacity(0.3)
              : TAPAColors.border,
          width: ep.verrouille ? 1.5 : 0.5,
        ),
      ),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            ep.titre,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 15,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                              color: TAPAColors.navy,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          if (ep.verrouille)
                            const Icon(Icons.lock, size: 16, color: TAPAColors.red),
                          if (ep.termine)
                            const Icon(Icons.check_circle, size: 16, color: TAPAColors.green),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      Text(
                        ep.descriptionFrequence,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12,
                          color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                IconButton(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline, color: TAPAColors.textHint, size: 20),
                  onPressed: () => _supprimer(ep),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            Fmt.montant(ep.montantEpargne, monnaie: monnaie),
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 18,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                              color: couleur,
                            ),
                          ),
                          Text(
                            '/ ${Fmt.montant(ep.montantObjectif, monnaie: monnaie)}',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 13,
                              color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 6),
                      ClipRRect(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                        child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                          value: ep.pourcentageAtteint / 100,
                          minHeight: 10,
                          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.border,
                          valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(couleur),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      Row(
                        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            '${ep.pourcentageAtteint.toStringAsFixed(0)}%',
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 11,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                              color: couleur,
                            ),
                          ),
                          Text(
                            '${ep.joursRestants} jours restants',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 11,
                              color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Row(
              children: [
                _statChip(
                  '${ep.nombreDepotsEffectues}/${ep.nombreDepotsTotal}',
                  'dépôts',
                  Icons.savings_outlined,
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                _statChip(
                  Fmt.montant(ep.montantParDepot, monnaie: monnaie),
                  'par dépôt',
                  Icons.payments_outlined,
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            if (!ep.termine)
              Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                      onPressed: () => _effectuerDepot(ep),
                      icon: Icon(
                        ep.verrouille ? Icons.lock_open : Icons.add,
                        size: 18,
                      ),
                      label: Text(
                        ep.verrouille ? 'Déverrouiller' : 'Faire un dépôt',
                      ),
                      style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: ep.verrouille ? TAPAColors.red : TAPAColors.navy,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              )
            else
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: TAPAColors.green.withOpacity(0.1),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                ),
                child: const Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                  children: [
                    Icon(Icons.check_circle, color: TAPAColors.green, size: 18),
                    SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Text(
                      'Objectif atteint !',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: TAPAColors.green,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _statChip(String valeur, String label, IconData icon) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 6),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: TAPAColors.background,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),

          Text(
            '$valeur ',
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 12,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
              color: TAPAColors.navy,
            ),
          ),
          Text(
            label,
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 11,
              color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // BARRE DE NAVIGATION INFÉRIEURE
  // ==========================================================
  Widget _buildBottomNavigationBar() {
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.06),
            blurRadius: 12,
            offset: const Offset(0, -3),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: 6),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceAround,
            children: [
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.home_outlined,
                activeIcon: Icons.home,
                label: 'Accueil',
                index: 0,
                route: '/home',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.shield_outlined,
                activeIcon: Icons.shield,
                label: 'Assurance',
                index: 1,
                route: '/investir/assurance',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.account_balance_wallet_outlined,
                activeIcon: Icons.account_balance_wallet,
                label: 'Enveloppe',
                index: 2,
                route: '/savings',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.pie_chart_outline,
                activeIcon: Icons.pie_chart,
                label: 'Budget',
                index: 3,
                route: '/budget',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.credit_card_outlined,
                activeIcon: Icons.credit_card,
                label: 'Dettes',
                index: 4,
                route: '/dettes',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.person_outline,
                activeIcon: Icons.person,
                label: 'Profil',
                index: 5,
                route: '/profile',
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildNavItem({
    required IconData icon,
    required IconData activeIcon,
    required String label,
    required int index,
    required String route,
  }) {
    final isActive = _selectedIndex == index;
    return Expanded(
      child: GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTap: () => _navigateTo(route, index),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            AnimatedContainer(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 260),
              curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: isActive ? 12 : 0,
                vertical: 6,
              ),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: isActive
                    ? const LinearGradient(
                  colors: [Color(0xFF1A237E), Color(0xFF0D1444)],
                  begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                  end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                )
                    : null,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                boxShadow: isActive
                    ? [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: const Color(0xFF1A237E).withOpacity(0.35),
                    blurRadius: 10,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 4),
                  ),
                ]
                    : null,
              ),
              child: Icon(
                isActive ? activeIcon : icon,
                size: isActive ? 22 : 20,
                color: isActive ? Colors.amber : Colors.grey.shade500,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(
              label,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: isActive ? 10 : 9,
                fontWeight: isActive ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
                color: isActive ? const Color(0xFF1A237E) : Colors.grey.shade500,
                letterSpacing: 0.1,
              ),
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// lib/screens/savings/creer_epargne_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../../../data/models/models.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/formatters.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/logger.dart';
import 'package:tapa_budget/presentation/providers/providers.dart';

class CreerEpargneScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const CreerEpargneScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<CreerEpargneScreen> createState() => _CreerEpargneScreenState();
}

class _CreerEpargneScreenState extends ConsumerState<CreerEpargneScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _nameController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _amountController = TextEditingController();

  String _selectedFrequency = 'mois';
  String _selectedWalletId = '';
  bool _isLoading = false;

  // Valeurs attendues par le modèle
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> _frequencies = [
    {
      'value': 'jour',
      'label': 'Quotidien',
      'short': 'par jour',
      'icon': Icons.today_outlined
    },
    {
      'value': 'semaine',
      'label': 'Hebdo',
      'short': 'par semaine',
      'icon': Icons.date_range_outlined
    },
    {
      'value': 'mois',
      'label': 'Mensuel',
      'short': 'par mois',
      'icon': Icons.calendar_month_outlined
    },
  ];

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nameController.dispose();
    _amountController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Logique (inchangée) ─────────────────────────

  Future<void> _saveEpargne() async {
    final name = _nameController.text.trim();
    final amount = double.tryParse(_amountController.text);

    if (name.isEmpty) {
      _showSnackBar('Veuillez entrer un nom', isError: true);
      return;
    }

    if (amount == null || amount <= 0) {
      _showSnackBar('Veuillez entrer un montant valide', isError: true);
      return;
    }

    if (_selectedWalletId.isEmpty) {
      _showSnackBar('Veuillez sélectionner un portefeuille', isError: true);
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _isLoading = true);

    try {
      final user = ref.read(currentUserProvider);
      final userId = user?.id ?? '';

      if (userId.isEmpty) {
        _showSnackBar('Utilisateur non trouvé', isError: true);
        setState(() => _isLoading = false);
        return;
      }

      final utilisateurIdInt = userId.hashCode.abs() % 1000000;
      final portefeuilleIdInt = _selectedWalletId.hashCode.abs() % 1000000;

      final epargne = EpargneProgrammeeModel(
        id: '',
        uuid: DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
        utilisateurId: utilisateurIdInt,
        titre: name,
        montantObjectif: amount * 10,
        frequence: _selectedFrequency,
        duree: 12,
        montantParDepot: amount,
        portefeuilleId: portefeuilleIdInt,
        dateCreation: DateTime.now(),
        dateFinPrevue: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 365)),
        montantEpargne: 0,
        verrouille: false,
        codeDeverrouillage: null,
        termine: false,
      );

      await ref.read(savingsRepositoryProvider).addEpargne(epargne);

      if (mounted) {
        _showSnackBar('Épargne programmée créée avec succès !');
        context.go('/savings');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur création épargne: $e');
      if (mounted) {
        _showSnackBar(
          'Erreur: ${e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '')}',
          isError: true,
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isLoading = false);
      }
    }
  }

  void _showSnackBar(String message, {bool isError = false}) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(message, maxLines: 3, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
        backgroundColor: isError ? TAPAColors.red : TAPAColors.navy,
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Aides de style ─────────────────────────

  InputDecoration _dec({
    required String label,
    String? hint,
    required IconData icon,
    String? suffix,
  }) {
    OutlineInputBorder border(Color c, [double w = 1]) => OutlineInputBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
      borderSide: BorderSide(color: c, width: w),
    );
    return InputDecoration(
      labelText: label,
      hintText: hint,
      suffixText: suffix,
      prefixIcon: Icon(icon, color: TAPAColors.navy, size: 22),
      filled: true,
      fillColor: TAPAColors.background,
      contentPadding:
      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 16),
      border: border(TAPAColors.border),
      enabledBorder: border(TAPAColors.border),
      focusedBorder: border(TAPAColors.gold, 1.6),
      labelStyle: const TextStyle(color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
      floatingLabelStyle: const TextStyle(
        color: TAPAColors.navy,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _card({required String title, required Widget child}) {
    return Container(

                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
