                            ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                              const SnackBar(
                                content: Text('📋 Clé copiée !'),
                                backgroundColor: TAPAColors.gold,
                              ),
                            );
                          },
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.copy, size: 16),
                          label: const Text('Copier'),
                          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
                            foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Expanded(
                        child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                          onPressed: () {
                            Navigator.pop(ctx);
                            _cleCtrl.text = cle;
                            _activerAvecCle(cle);
                          },
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.check, size: 16),
                          label: const Text('Activer'),
                          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: Colors.green,
                            foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
                label: const Text('Fermer'),
                style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================
  // ACTIVER AVEC UNE CLÉ - AVEC SUPPORT ROOT
  // ============================================

  Future<void> _activerAvecCle(String cle) async {
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
    });

    try {
      final firebaseService = FirebaseService();

      // ✅ VÉRIFICATION UNIQUE - ROOT KEY DEPUIS .env
      final isRoot = cle == _rootDevKey && _rootDevKey.isNotEmpty;

      // ✅ VÉRIFIER LA CLÉ (ROOT OU STANDARD)
      final cleValide = firebaseService.verifierCle(cle) || isRoot;

      if (!cleValide) {
        setState(() {
          _error = 'Clé invalide. Format : TB-2026-XXXXXXXX';
          _loading = false;
        });
        return;
      }

      if (isRoot) {
        Logger.info('👑 Accès Root activé avec la clé: $cle');
      } else {
        Logger.info('✅ Accès premium activé avec la clé: $cle');
      }

      // ✅ ACTIVER L'ACCÈS
      await firebaseService.activerAccesVie(cle);

      // ✅ METTRE À JOUR L'ÉTAT
      final authNotifier = ref.read(authStateProvider.notifier);
      final currentUser = ref.read(currentUserProvider);

      if (currentUser != null) {
        final updatedUser = AppUser(
          id: currentUser.id,
          phoneNumber: currentUser.phoneNumber,
          prenom: currentUser.prenom,
          monnaie: currentUser.monnaie,
          codePays: currentUser.codePays,
          hasAccessVie: true,
          onboardingVu: currentUser.onboardingVu,
          notificationsActivees: currentUser.notificationsActivees,
          createdAt: currentUser.createdAt,
          dernierActive: DateTime.now(),
        );
        await authNotifier.updateUser(updatedUser);
      }

      setState(() {
        _accesActive = true;
        _loading = false;
      });

      if (mounted) {
        final message = isRoot
            ? '👑 Accès Root activé avec succès !'
            : '✅ Accès activé avec succès !';

        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text(message),
            backgroundColor: isRoot ? TAPAColors.purple : Colors.green,
            duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
          ),
        );
        context.go('/home');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setState(() {
        _error = 'Erreur: ${e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '')}';
        _loading = false;
      });
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur activation: $e');
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // ACTIVER AVEC LE CHAMP DE SAISIE
  // ============================================

  Future<void> _activer() async {
    final cle = _cleCtrl.text.trim().toUpperCase();
    await _activerAvecCle(cle);
  }

    final hasRootKey = _rootDevKey.isNotEmpty;

    return Padding(

          }

          icon: Icon(

              fontSize: 13,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            ),
          ),
          style: TextButton.styleFrom(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

                  children: [
                    _ligne('Produit', produitNom),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    _ligne('Montant', '${montantPaye.toString().replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r"(\d)(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))"), (m) => "${m[1]} ")} FCFA'),

                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    _ligne('Statut', 'En cours de traitement'),
                  ],

              ),

class SonamSubscriptionScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {

    super.key,

      _SonamSubscriptionScreenState();

class _Benef {
  final nom = TextEditingController();
  final naissance = TextEditingController();
  final lieu = TextEditingController();
  final adresse = TextEditingController();
  final cni = TextEditingController();
  final tel = TextEditingController();

  void dispose() {
    nom.dispose();
    naissance.dispose();
    lieu.dispose();
    adresse.dispose();
    cni.dispose();
    tel.dispose();
  }

  Map<String, String> toMap() => {
        'nom_prenoms': nom.text.trim(),
        'date_naissance': naissance.text.trim(),
        'lieu_naissance': lieu.text.trim(),
        'adresse': adresse.text.trim(),
        'cni': cni.text.trim(),
        'telephone': tel.text.trim(),
      };
}

class _SonamSubscriptionScreenState extends ConsumerState<SonamSubscriptionScreen> {
  static const _titres = [
    'Votre contrat',
    'Souscripteur',
    'Assuré',
    'Bénéficiaires',
    'Validation',
  ];

  final _scroll = ScrollController();
  final _formKeys = List.generate(5, (_) => GlobalKey<FormState>());

  int _step = 0;
  bool _submitting = false;
  String? _policeCode;
  bool _done = false;
  bool _showConsentError = false;

  // Contrat
  final _dateEffet = TextEditingController();

  // Souscripteur
  final _sNom = TextEditingController();
  final _sNaissance = TextEditingController();
  final _sProfession = TextEditingController();
  final _sAdresse = TextEditingController();
  final _sTel = TextEditingController();
  final _sEmail = TextEditingController();
  String? _sCivilite;

  // Assuré
  bool _assureEstSouscripteur = true;
  final _aNom = TextEditingController();
  final _aNaissance = TextEditingController();
  final _aProfession = TextEditingController();
  final _aAdresse = TextEditingController();
  final _aTel = TextEditingController();
  final _aEmail = TextEditingController();
  final _aAdressePro = TextEditingController();
  final _aTelPro = TextEditingController();
  final _aEmailPro = TextEditingController();
  String? _aCivilite;

  // Bénéficiaires
  final List<_Benef> _benefs = [_Benef()];

  // Personne à contacter
  final _cNom = TextEditingController();
  final _cNaissance = TextEditingController();
  final _cAdresse = TextEditingController();
  final _cTel = TextEditingController();
  final _cEmail = TextEditingController();

  // Déclarations
  bool _okCG = false;
  bool _okDecl = false;
  bool _okNote = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final now = DateTime.now();
    _dateEffet.text = _fmtDate(DateTime(now.year, now.month + 1, 1));
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _scroll.dispose();
    for (final c in [
      _dateEffet, _sNom, _sNaissance, _sProfession, _sAdresse, _sTel, _sEmail,
      _aNom, _aNaissance, _aProfession, _aAdresse, _aTel, _aEmail,
      _aAdressePro, _aTelPro, _aEmailPro,
      _cNom, _cNaissance, _cAdresse, _cTel, _cEmail,
    ]) {
      c.dispose();
    }
    for (final b in _benefs) {
      b.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Helpers ─────────────────────────

  String _fmtDate(DateTime d) =>
      '${d.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${d.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${d.year}';

  DateTime? _parse(String s) {
    final p = s.split('/');
    if (p.length != 3) return null;
    final d = int.tryParse(p[0]);
    final m = int.tryParse(p[1]);
    final y = int.tryParse(p[2]);
    if (d == null || m == null || y == null) return null;
    return DateTime(y, m, d);
  }

  int _age(DateTime dob) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    var a = now.year - dob.year;
    if (now.month < dob.month ||
        (now.month == dob.month && now.day < dob.day)) {
      a--;
    }
    return a;
  }

  DateTime? get _effet => _parse(_dateEffet.text);
  DateTime? get _terme {
    final e = _effet;
    if (e == null) return null;
    return DateTime(e.year + widget.dureeAns, e.month, e.day);
  }

  double get _totalVerse => widget.cotisation * widget.dureeAns * 12;

  String? _vTel(String t) {
    final d = t.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\D'), '');
    return d.length >= 8 ? null : 'Numéro invalide';
  }

  String? _vEmail(String t) =>
      RegExp(r'^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$').hasMatch(t)
          ? null
          : 'Email invalide';

  InputDecoration _deco(String label, bool required) {
    return InputDecoration(
      labelText: required ? '$label *' : label,
      labelStyle:
          const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
      filled: true,
      fillColor: TAPAColors.surface,
      isDense: true,
      contentPadding:
          const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 14),
      border: OutlineInputBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        borderSide: const BorderSide(color: TAPAColors.border),
      ),
      enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        borderSide: const BorderSide(color: TAPAColors.border),
      ),
      focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        borderSide: const BorderSide(color: TAPAColors.gold, width: 1.6),
      ),
      errorBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        borderSide: const BorderSide(color: TAPAColors.red),
      ),
      focusedErrorBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        borderSide: const BorderSide(color: TAPAColors.red, width: 1.6),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _field(
    TextEditingController c,
    String label, {
    bool required = true,
    TextInputType? keyboard,
    String? Function(String)? extra,
    TextCapitalization cap = TextCapitalization.none,
  }) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      child: TextFormField(
        controller: c,
        keyboardType: keyboard,
        textCapitalization: cap,
        decoration: _deco(label, required),
        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: TAPAColors.navy),
        validator: (v) {
          final t = (v ?? '').trim();
          if (t.isEmpty) return required ? 'Champ obligatoire' : null;
          return extra?.call(t);
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _dateField(
    TextEditingController c,
    String label, {
    required DateTime first,
    required DateTime last,
    DateTime? initial,
    bool required = true,
    String? Function(DateTime)? check,
  }) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      child: TextFormField(
        controller: c,
        readOnly: true,
        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: TAPAColors.navy),
        decoration: _deco(label, required).copyWith(
          suffixIcon: const Icon(Icons.calendar_today_outlined, size: 18),
        ),
        onTap: () async {
          var start = _parse(c.text) ?? initial ?? last;
          if (start.isBefore(first)) start = first;
          if (start.isAfter(last)) start = last;
          final d = await showDatePicker(
            context: context,
            initialDate: start,
            firstDate: first,
            lastDate: last,
          );
          if (d != null) setState(() => c.text = _fmtDate(d));
        },
        validator: (v) {
          final t = (v ?? '').trim();
          if (t.isEmpty) return required ? 'Champ obligatoire' : null;
          final d = _parse(t);
          if (d == null) return 'Date invalide';
          return check?.call(d);
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _civiliteField(String? value, ValueChanged<String> onChanged) {
    return FormField<String>(
      initialValue: value,
      validator: (v) => v == null ? 'Choisissez Homme ou Femme' : null,
      builder: (state) {
        Widget chip(String code, String label) {
          final selected = state.value == code;
          return ChoiceChip(
            label: Text(label),
            selected: selected,
            selectedColor: TAPAColors.navy,
            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.surface,
            labelStyle: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 13,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: selected ? TAPAColors.white : TAPAColors.textSecond,
            ),
            side: BorderSide(
              color: selected ? TAPAColors.navy : TAPAColors.border,
            ),
            showCheckmark: false,
            onSelected: (_) {
              onChanged(code);
              state.didChange(code);
            },
          );
        }

        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Wrap(
                spacing: 8,
                runSpacing: 4,
                crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  const Text(
                    'Civilité *',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 13, color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
                  ),
                  chip('H', 'Homme'),
                  chip('F', 'Femme'),
                ],
              ),
              if (state.hasError)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 6, left: 4),
                  child: Text(
                    state.errorText!,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12, color: TAPAColors.red),
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  BoxDecoration _cardDecoration() => BoxDecoration(

  Widget _row(String label, String value, {bool bold = false}) {

  Widget _infoBox(IconData icon, String text) {
    return Container(
      width: double.infinity,
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(

  // ───────────────────────── Navigation ─────────────────────────

  void _goTo(int step) {
    setState(() => _step = step);
    if (_scroll.hasClients) _scroll.jumpTo(0);
  }

  void _back() {
    if (_step > 0) {
      _goTo(_step - 1);
    } else {
      Navigator.pop(context);
    }
  }

  void _next() {
    final ok = _formKeys[_step].currentState?.validate() ?? false;
    if (!ok) return;
    if (_step < 4) {
      // Assuré = souscripteur : on saute la saisie
      _goTo(_step + 1);
    } else {
      _submit();
    }
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Envoi ─────────────────────────

  Map<String, dynamic> _buildPayload() {
    final souscripteur = {
      'nom_prenoms': _sNom.text.trim(),
      'civilite': _sCivilite,
      'date_naissance': _sNaissance.text.trim(),
      'profession': _sProfession.text.trim(),
      'adresse': _sAdresse.text.trim(),
      'telephone': _sTel.text.trim(),
      'email': _sEmail.text.trim(),
    };
    final assure = _assureEstSouscripteur
        ? souscripteur
        : {
            'nom_prenoms': _aNom.text.trim(),
            'civilite': _aCivilite,
            'date_naissance': _aNaissance.text.trim(),
            'profession': _aProfession.text.trim(),
            'adresse': _aAdresse.text.trim(),
            'telephone': _aTel.text.trim(),
            'email': _aEmail.text.trim(),
            'adresse_professionnelle': _aAdressePro.text.trim(),
            'telephone_professionnel': _aTelPro.text.trim(),
            'email_professionnel': _aEmailPro.text.trim(),
          };

    return {
      'produit': 'EPARGNE',
      'contrat': {
        'cotisation_periodique': widget.cotisation.round(),
        'periodicite': 'mensuelle',
        'cotisation_annuelle': (widget.cotisation * 12).round(),
        'duree_paiement_ans': widget.dureeAns,
        'date_effet': _dateEffet.text.trim(),
        'terme': _terme == null ? null : _fmtDate(_terme!),
        'capital_garanti_terme': widget.capitalGaranti.round(),
        'taux_garanti': SonamCalc.tauxAnnuel,
        'chargement': SonamCalc.tauxFrais,
      },
      'souscripteur': souscripteur,
      'assure': assure,
      'assure_est_souscripteur': _assureEstSouscripteur,
      'beneficiaires_deces': _benefs.map((b) => b.toMap()).toList(),
      'personne_a_contacter': {
        'nom_prenoms': _cNom.text.trim(),
        'date_naissance': _cNaissance.text.trim(),
        'adresse': _cAdresse.text.trim(),
        'telephone': _cTel.text.trim(),
        'email': _cEmail.text.trim(),
      },
      'declarations': {
        'conditions_generales_recues': _okCG,
        'declarations_sinceres': _okDecl,
        'note_information_lue': _okNote,
      },
    };
  }

  /// ✅ Enregistre le contrat et débite le Wallet


  Future<void> _envoyer(Map<String, dynamic> payload) async {
    final user = ref.read(currentUserProvider);
    if (user == null) throw Exception('Utilisateur non connecté');

    // ✅ Générer un code de police unique (ex: POL-2026-X8Y2Z)
    final random = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString();
    final code = 'POL-${DateTime.now().year}-${random.substring(random.length - 5)}';

    // Créer le contrat en attente de paiement
    final contractRef = FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('sonam_contracts').doc();
    
    await contractRef.set({
      ...payload,
      'userId': user.id,
      'contractId': contractRef.id,
      'policeCode': code, // ✅ Code unique sauvegardé
      'dateSouscription': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      'statut': 'En attente de paiement',
      'totalVerse': 0,
      'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });

    // ✅ Sauvegarder le code pour l'afficher sur l'écran de succès
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _policeCode = code;
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    setState(() => _showConsentError = true);
    if (!(_okCG && _okDecl && _okNote)) return;

    setState(() => _submitting = true);
    try {
      await _envoyer(_buildPayload());
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _done = true);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '')),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _submitting = false);
    }
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Build ─────────────────────────

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_done) return _buildSuccess();

    return PopScope(
      canPop: _step == 0,
      onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, _) {
        if (!didPop) _back();
      },
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: const Text(
            'Souscription SONAM',
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
          ),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
          foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
          elevation: 0,
          leading: IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_new, size: 20),
            onPressed: _back,
          ),
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          child: Column(
            children: [
              _buildProgress(),
              Expanded(
                child: GestureDetector(
                  behavior: HitTestBehavior.translucent,
                  onTap: () => FocusScope.of(context).unfocus(),
                  child: SingleChildScrollView(
                    controller: _scroll,
                    keyboardDismissBehavior:
                        ScrollViewKeyboardDismissBehavior.onDrag,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 24),
                    child: _buildStep(),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        bottomNavigationBar: _buildBottomBar(),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildProgress() {
    return Container(
      color: TAPAColors.navy,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, 14),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: List.generate(_titres.length, (i) {
              return Expanded(
                child: Container(
                  height: 4,
                  margin: EdgeInsets.only(
                      right: i == _titres.length - 1 ? 0 : 6),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: i <= _step
                        ? TAPAColors.gold
                        : const Color(0x33FFFFFF),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                  ),
                ),
              );
            }),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
            'Étape ${_step + 1}/${_titres.length} · ${_titres[_step]}',
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: const TextStyle(
              color: Color(0xCCFFFFFF),
              fontSize: 12,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBottomBar() {
    final last = _step == 4;
    return Container(
      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
        color: TAPAColors.surface,
        border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: TAPAColors.border)),
      ),
      child: SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 12),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              if (_step > 0) ...[
                SizedBox(
                  height: 52,
                  child: OutlinedButton(
                    onPressed: _submitting ? null : _back,
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                      foregroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
                      side: const BorderSide(color: TAPAColors.border),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                      ),
                    ),
                    child: const Text('Retour'),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
              ],
              Expanded(
                child: SizedBox(
                  height: 52,
                  child: ElevatedButton(
                    onPressed: _submitting ? null : _next,
                    style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.gold,
                      foregroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
                      elevation: 0,
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                      ),
                    ),
                    child: _submitting
                        ? const SizedBox(
                            width: 22,
                            height: 22,
                            child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                              strokeWidth: 2.5,
                              color: TAPAColors.navy,
                            ),
                          )
                        : Text(
                            last ? 'Confirmer la souscription' : 'Continuer',
                            maxLines: 1,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 15,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                            ),
                          ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildStep() {
    switch (_step) {
      case 0:
        return _stepContrat();
      case 1:
        return _stepSouscripteur();
      case 2:
        return _stepAssure();
      case 3:
        return _stepBeneficiaires();
      default:
        return _stepValidation();
    }
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Étape 1 : contrat ─────────────────────────

            'faite du coût de police, sous 15 jours.',
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

  // ───────────────────────── Étape 3 : assuré ─────────────────────────

      child: Column(

                    cap: TextCapitalization.words),

          if (_benefs.length < 3)
            SizedBox(

  // ───────────────────────── Étape 5 : validation ─────────────────────────

  Widget _consent(String text, bool value, ValueChanged<bool> onChanged) {
    return CheckboxListTile(
      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
      controlAffinity: ListTileControlAffinity.leading,
      activeColor: TAPAColors.gold,
      checkColor: TAPAColors.navy,
      dense: true,
      value: value,
      onChanged: (v) => setState(() => onChanged(v ?? false)),
      title: Text(
        text,
        style: const TextStyle(
          fontSize: 12,
          height: 1.4,
          color: TAPAColors.navy,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _stepValidation() {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final consentManquant =
        _showConsentError && !(_okCG && _okDecl && _okNote);
    return Form(
      key: _formKeys[4],
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          _sectionCard(
            icon: Icons.contact_phone_outlined,
            title: 'Personne à contacter en cas de nécessité',
            children: [
              _field(_cNom, 'Nom et prénoms',
                  cap: TextCapitalization.words),
              _dateField(
                _cNaissance,
                'Date de naissance',
                required: false,
                first: DateTime(now.year - 120),
                last: now,
                initial: DateTime(now.year - 30, 1, 1),
              ),
              _field(_cAdresse, 'Adresse',
                  required: false, cap: TextCapitalization.sentences),
              _field(_cTel, 'Téléphone',
                  keyboard: TextInputType.phone, extra: _vTel),
              _field(_cEmail, 'Email',
                  required: false,
                  keyboard: TextInputType.emailAddress,
                  extra: _vEmail),
            ],
          ),
          _sectionCard(
            icon: Icons.fact_check_outlined,
            title: 'Récapitulatif',
            children: [
              _row('Souscripteur',
                  _sNom.text.trim().isEmpty ? '—' : _sNom.text.trim()),
              _row(
                  'Assuré',
                  _assureEstSouscripteur
                      ? 'Identique au souscripteur'
                      : (_aNom.text.trim().isEmpty
                          ? '—'
                          : _aNom.text.trim())),
              _row('Bénéficiaires', '${_benefs.length}'),
              _row('Cotisation mensuelle',
                  SonamCalc.formatMontant(widget.cotisation)),
              _row('Durée', '${widget.dureeAns} ans'),
              _row('Date d\'effet', _dateEffet.text),
              const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
                child: Divider(height: 1, color: TAPAColors.border),
              ),
              _row('Capital garanti',
                  SonamCalc.formatMontant(widget.capitalGaranti),
                  bold: true),
            ],
          ),
          Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: TAPAColors.surface,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
              border: Border.all(
                color: consentManquant
                    ? TAPAColors.red
                    : TAPAColors.border,
              ),
            ),
            child: Column(
              children: [
                _consent(
                  'Je reconnais avoir reçu un exemplaire des conditions '
                  'générales d\'assurance.',
                  _okCG,
                  (v) => _okCG = v,
                ),
                _consent(
                  'Je certifie que mes déclarations sont sincères et '
                  'véritables. Une déclaration fausse ou réticente entraîne '
                  'la nullité du contrat (art. 18 du Code CIMA).',
                  _okDecl,
                  (v) => _okDecl = v,
                ),
                _consent(
                  'J\'ai pris connaissance de la note d\'information '
                  '(rachat, renonciation, risques exclus).',
                  _okNote,
                  (v) => _okNote = v,
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          if (consentManquant)
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.only(left: 4, bottom: 8),
              child: Text(
                'Veuillez accepter les trois déclarations pour continuer.',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: TAPAColors.red),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Succès ─────────────────────────

  Widget _buildSuccess() {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Center(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                Container(
                  width: 88,
                  height: 88,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    color: TAPAColors.green.withAlpha(30),
                  ),
                  child: const Icon(Icons.check_rounded,
                      size: 48, color: TAPAColors.green),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 20),
                const Text(
                  'Demande enregistrée',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 22,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                    color: TAPAColors.navy,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Text(
                  'Votre demande a bien été enregistrée.\n\n'
                  'Voici votre code de police :',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 14,
                    height: 1.5,
                    color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                
                // ✅ Affichage du Code de Police
                if (_policeCode != null)
                  Container(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: TAPAColors.navy,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                    ),
                    child: Column(
                      children: [
                        const Text(
                          'CODE DE POLICE',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            color: Colors.white70,
                            fontSize: 12,
                            letterSpacing: 2,
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        SelectableText(
                          _policeCode!,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            color: TAPAColors.gold,
                            fontSize: 28,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                            letterSpacing: 2,
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        const Text(
                          'Conservez ce code. Il vous sera demandé pour '
                          'finaliser votre paiement.',
                          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                          style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white54, fontSize: 12),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),

                const SizedBox(height: 28),
                SizedBox(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  height: 52,
                  child: ElevatedButton(
                    onPressed: () => context.go('/home'),
                    style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.gold,
                      foregroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
                      elevation: 0,
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                      ),
                    ),
                    child: const Text(
                      'Retour à l\'accueil',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// lib/presentation/screens/investir/sonam_simulator_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import 'sonam_calc.dart';
import 'sonam_subscription_screen.dart';

class SonamSimulatorScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SonamSimulatorScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<SonamSimulatorScreen> createState() => _SonamSimulatorScreenState();
}

class _SonamSimulatorScreenState extends State<SonamSimulatorScreen> {
  static const double _tauxAnnuel = 0.04;
  static const double _tauxFrais = 0.04;
  static const List<int> _dureesRapides = [5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 40];

  double _cotisation = 10000;
  double _duree = 5;

  // ───────────────────────── Calculs ─────────────────────────

  double get _totalVerse => _cotisation * _duree * 12;
  double get _frais => _totalVerse * _tauxFrais;
  double get _capitalGaranti =>
      SonamCalc.capitalGaranti(_cotisation, _duree.toInt());

  double get _interets => _capitalGaranti - (_totalVerse - _frais);

  String _formatMontant(double montant) {
    final s = montant.round().toString().replaceAllMapped(
          RegExp(r'(\d{1,3})(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))'),
          (Match m) => '${m[1]} ',
        );
    return '$s FCFA';
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Build ─────────────────────────

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text(
          'Épargne SONAM',
          maxLines: 1,
          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
        ),
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
        foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
        elevation: 0,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_new, size: 20),
          onPressed: () => context.go('/investir'),
        ),
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 24),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              _buildHeroCard(),
              const SizedBox(height: 20),
              _buildCotisationSection(),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              _buildDureeSection(),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              _buildSummaryCard(),
              const SizedBox(height: 20),
              _buildSubscribeButton(),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              _buildInfoNote(),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Carte principale ─────────────────────────

  Widget _buildHeroCard() {
    return ClipRRect(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
      child: Container(
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            colors: [Color(0xFF1A237E), Color(0xFF0D1444)],
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
          ),
        ),
        child: Stack(
          children: [
            // Cercles décoratifs (clippés par le ClipRRect → pas de débordement)
            Positioned(
              top: -40,
              right: -30,
              child: Container(
                width: 130,
                height: 130,
                decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  color: Color(0x14FFFFFF),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            Positioned(
              bottom: -50,
              left: -40,
              child: Container(
                width: 120,
                height: 120,
                decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  color: Color(0x0DFFFFFF),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: TAPAColors.gold.withAlpha(40),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                        ),
                        child: const Icon(
                          Icons.savings_outlined,
                          color: TAPAColors.gold,
                          size: 20,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 10),
                      const Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                          'Capital garanti à terme',
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: TextStyle(
                            color: Color(0xB3FFFFFF),
                            fontSize: 13,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  SizedBox(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    child: FittedBox(
                      fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                      alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                      child: Text(
                        _formatMontant(_capitalGaranti),
                        maxLines: 1,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          color: TAPAColors.gold,
                          fontSize: 34,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                          letterSpacing: -0.5,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Expanded(
                        child: _buildHeroStat(
                          'Total versé',
                          _formatMontant(_totalVerse),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 10),
                      Expanded(
                        child: _buildHeroStat(
                          'Gain net',
                          '+ ${_formatMontant(_interets)}',
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  Wrap(
                    spacing: 8,
                    runSpacing: 8,
                    children: [
                      _buildChip(Icons.trending_up, 'Taux garanti 4 % / an'),
                      _buildChip(Icons.percent, 'Frais 4 %'),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildHeroStat(String label, String value) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 10),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: const Color(0x1AFFFFFF),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(
            label,
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0x99FFFFFF), fontSize: 11),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          SizedBox(
            width: double.infinity,
            child: FittedBox(
              fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
              alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
              child: Text(
                value,
                maxLines: 1,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  color: TAPAColors.white,
                  fontSize: 14,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildChip(IconData icon, String text) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 6),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: const Color(0x1AFFFFFF),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
      ),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          Icon(icon, size: 13, color: TAPAColors.gold),
          const SizedBox(width: 5),
          Text(
            text,
            style: const TextStyle(
              color: Color(0xCCFFFFFF),
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Sliders ─────────────────────────

  Widget _buildCotisationSection() {
    return _buildSliderCard(
      icon: Icons.payments_outlined,
      title: 'Cotisation mensuelle',
      value: _formatMontant(_cotisation),
      slider: Slider(
        value: _cotisation,
        min: 1000,
        max: 30000,
        divisions: 29,
        onChanged: (val) {
          setState(() {
            _cotisation = (val / 1000).round() * 1000.0;
          });
        },
      ),
      minLabel: '1 000 F',
      maxLabel: '30 000 F',
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDureeSection() {
    return _buildSliderCard(
      icon: Icons.calendar_month_outlined,
      title: 'Durée du contrat',
      value: '${_duree.toInt()} an${_duree > 1 ? 's' : ''}',
      slider: Slider(
        value: _duree,
        min: 1,
        max: 40,
        divisions: 39,
        onChanged: (val) {
          setState(() {
            _duree = val.roundToDouble();
          });
        },
      ),
      minLabel: '1 an',
      maxLabel: '40 ans',
      extra: Wrap(
        spacing: 8,
        runSpacing: 8,
        children: _dureesRapides.map((d) {
          final selected = _duree.toInt() == d;
          return GestureDetector(
            onTap: () => setState(() => _duree = d.toDouble()),
            child: AnimatedContainer(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 7),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: selected ? TAPAColors.navy : TAPAColors.background,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: selected ? TAPAColors.navy : TAPAColors.border,
                ),
              ),
              child: Text(
                '$d ans',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 12,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  color: selected ? TAPAColors.white : TAPAColors.textSecond,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        }).toList(),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSliderCard({
    required IconData icon,
    required String title,
    required String value,
    required Widget slider,
    required String minLabel,
    required String maxLabel,
    Widget? extra,
  }) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 12),
      decoration: _cardDecoration(),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Icon(icon, size: 18, color: TAPAColors.navy),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  title,
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 14,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    color: TAPAColors.navy,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Flexible(
                child: Container(
                  padding:
                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 5),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: TAPAColors.gold.withAlpha(30),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                  ),
                  child: FittedBox(
                    fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                    child: Text(
                      value,
                      maxLines: 1,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 14,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                        color: TAPAColors.gold,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          SliderTheme(
            data: SliderTheme.of(context).copyWith(
              trackHeight: 6,
              activeTrackColor: TAPAColors.gold,
              inactiveTrackColor: TAPAColors.border,
              thumbColor: TAPAColors.gold,
              overlayColor: TAPAColors.gold.withAlpha(35),
              activeTickMarkColor: Colors.transparent,
              inactiveTickMarkColor: Colors.transparent,
              thumbShape: const RoundSliderThumbShape(enabledThumbRadius: 11),
            ),
            child: slider,
          ),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
            child: Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                Text(
                  minLabel,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 11, color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
                ),
                Text(
                  maxLabel,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 11, color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          if (extra != null) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            extra,
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Récapitulatif ─────────────────────────

  Widget _buildSummaryCard() {
    final net = _totalVerse - _frais;
    final total = net + (_interets > 0 ? _interets : 0);
    final ratioNet = total <= 0 ? 0.5 : net / total;
    final flexNet = (ratioNet * 1000).round().clamp(1, 999);
    final flexInt = 1000 - flexNet;

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: _cardDecoration(),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          const Row(
            children: [
              Icon(Icons.receipt_long_outlined,
                  size: 18, color: TAPAColors.navy),
              SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  'Détail de votre épargne',
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 14,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    color: TAPAColors.navy,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),

          // Barre de répartition capital net / intérêts
          ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
            child: SizedBox(
              height: 10,
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    flex: flexNet,
                    child: Container(color: TAPAColors.navy),
                  ),
                  Expanded(
                    flex: flexInt,
                    child: Container(color: TAPAColors.gold),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          const Wrap(
            spacing: 14,
            runSpacing: 4,
            children: [
              _LegendDot(color: TAPAColors.navy, label: 'Capital net'),
              _LegendDot(color: TAPAColors.gold, label: 'Intérêts'),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),

          _buildDetailRow('Total versé', _formatMontant(_totalVerse)),
          _buildDetailRow(
            'Frais (4 %)',
            '- ${_formatMontant(_frais)}',
            isNegative: true,
          ),
          _buildDetailRow(
            'Intérêts générés',
            '+ ${_formatMontant(_interets)}',
            isPositive: true,
          ),
          const Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
            child: Divider(height: 1, color: TAPAColors.border),
          ),
          _buildDetailRow(
            'Capital garanti',
            _formatMontant(_capitalGaranti),
            isBold: true,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDetailRow(
    String label,
    String value, {
    bool isNegative = false,
    bool isPositive = false,
    bool isBold = false,
  }) {
    Color valueColor = TAPAColors.navy;
    if (isNegative) valueColor = TAPAColors.red;
    if (isPositive) valueColor = TAPAColors.green;
    if (isBold) valueColor = TAPAColors.gold;

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 5),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
        children: [
          Expanded(
            flex: 4,
            child: Text(
              label,
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 13,
                color: isBold ? TAPAColors.navy : TAPAColors.textSecond,
                fontWeight: isBold ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.normal,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          Expanded(
            flex: 6,
            child: Align(
              alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
              child: FittedBox(
                fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                child: Text(
                  value,
                  maxLines: 1,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: isBold ? 16 : 13,
                    fontWeight: isBold ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w600,
                    color: valueColor,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Bouton & note ─────────────────────────

  Widget _buildSubscribeButton() {
    return SizedBox(
      height: 56,
      child: ElevatedButton.icon(
        onPressed: () {
          Navigator.push(
            context,
            MaterialPageRoute(
              builder: (_) => SonamSubscriptionScreen(
                cotisation: _cotisation,
                dureeAns: _duree.toInt(),
                capitalGaranti: _capitalGaranti,
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
        icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_rounded, size: 20),
        label: const Text(
          'Souscrire maintenant',
          maxLines: 1,
          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
        ),
        style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.gold,
          foregroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
          elevation: 0,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildInfoNote() {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: TAPAColors.surface,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: TAPAColors.border),
      ),
      child: const Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 1),
            child: Icon(Icons.info_outline,
                size: 16, color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
          ),
          SizedBox(width: 8),
          Expanded(
            child: Text(
              'Sortie avant 12 mois : pénalité d\'un mois de cotisation. '
              'Après 12 mois : 0 frais de sortie.',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 11,
                height: 1.4,
                color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ───────────────────────── Helpers ─────────────────────────

  BoxDecoration _cardDecoration() {
    return BoxDecoration(
      color: TAPAColors.surface,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
      border: Border.all(color: TAPAColors.border),
      boxShadow: const [
        BoxShadow(
          color: Color(0x0A000000),
          blurRadius: 10,
          offset: Offset(0, 4),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _LegendDot extends StatelessWidget {
  final Color color;
  final String label;

  const _LegendDot({required this.color, required this.label});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Row(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        Container(
          width: 8,
          height: 8,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(color: color, shape: BoxShape.circle),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 5),
        Text(
          label,
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';

class ProduitDetailScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final Map<String, dynamic> produit;
  const ProduitDetailScreen({super.key, required this.produit});
  @override
  State<ProduitDetailScreen> createState() => _ProduitDetailScreenState();
}

class _ProduitDetailScreenState extends State<ProduitDetailScreen> {
  final _montantCtrl = TextEditingController();

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _montantCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _confirmerSouscription() {
    final montant = double.tryParse(_montantCtrl.text);
    final montantMin = widget.produit['montantMin'] as int;
    if (montant == null || montant < montantMin) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('Montant minimum: $montantMin FCFA'),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red));
      return;
    }
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Demande envoyee'),
        content: Text(
          'Ta demande de souscription de '
          '${montant.toStringAsFixed(0)} FCFA sur '
          '${widget.produit['nom']} a ete enregistree. '
          'Notre partenaire te contactera pour finaliser '
          'l operation.'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              Navigator.pop(ctx);
              context.pop();
            },
            child: const Text('OK')),
        ]));
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final p = widget.produit;
    final couleur = Color(p['couleurValue'] as int);

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(p['nom'] as String),
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
        foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        children: [
          Center(child: Container(
            width: 70, height: 70,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: couleur.withOpacity(0.12),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18)),
            child: Center(child: Text(p['icone'] as String,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 32))))),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Center(child: Text(p['nom'] as String,
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 20,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
              color: TAPAColors.navy))),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          Center(child: Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
              horizontal: 12, vertical: 5),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: couleur.withOpacity(0.12),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
            child: Text('Profil ${p['profil']}',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 12.5,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                color: couleur)))),
          const SizedBox(height: 24),

          Row(children: [
            Expanded(child: _statCard(
              'Rendement vise', p['rendement'] as String,
              Icons.trending_up, TAPAColors.green)),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            Expanded(child: _statCard(
              'Duree conseillee', p['duree'] as String,
              Icons.calendar_today_outlined, TAPAColors.navy)),
          ]),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),

          const Text('A propos de ce fonds',
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 15,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
              color: TAPAColors.navy)),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(p['description'] as String,
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 13.5,
              color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
              height: 1.6)),
          const SizedBox(height: 24),

          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: TAPAColors.surface,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
              border: Border.all(color: TAPAColors.border)),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                const Text('Montant a investir',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 13,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    color: TAPAColors.navy)),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(
                  'Minimum: ${p['montantMin']} FCFA',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11.5,
                    color: TAPAColors.textSecond)),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextField(
                  controller: _montantCtrl,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    hintText: 'Ex: ${p['montantMin']}',
                    suffixText: 'FCFA',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)))),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                SizedBox(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  child: ElevatedButton(
                    onPressed: _confirmerSouscription,
                    style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        vertical: 14)),
                    child: const Text('Souscrire maintenant',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: TAPAColors.gold,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)))),
              ])),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          const Row(children: [
            Icon(Icons.shield_outlined,
              size: 16, color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
            SizedBox(width: 6),
            Expanded(child: Text(
              'Fonds gere par notre partenaire agree. '
              'Capital soumis a fluctuation du marche.',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 11, color: TAPAColors.textSecond))),
          ]),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
        ]));
  }

  Widget _statCard(String label, String value, IconData icon, Color c) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: TAPAColors.surface,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        border: Border.all(color: TAPAColors.border, width: 0.5)),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Icon(icon, size: 18, color: c),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(label, style: const TextStyle(
            fontSize: 10.5, color: TAPAColors.textSecond)),
          const SizedBox(height: 2),
          Text(value, style: const TextStyle(
            fontSize: 13.5,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
            color: TAPAColors.navy)),
        ]));
  }
}

// lib/presentation/screens/investir/sonam_calc.dart
// Calcul aligné sur la grille officielle SONAM (taux 4 %, chargement 4 %).

import 'dart:math' as math;

class SonamCalc {
  SonamCalc._();

  static const double tauxAnnuel = 0.04;
  static const double tauxFrais = 0.04;

  /// Capital garanti au terme : annuité payable d'avance,
  /// taux mensuel équivalent, sur 96 % de la cotisation.
  static double capitalGaranti(double cotisationMensuelle, int dureeAns) {
    final im = math.pow(1 + tauxAnnuel, 1 / 12) - 1;
    final n = dureeAns * 12;
    final facteur = ((math.pow(1 + im, n) - 1) / im) * (1 + im);
    return (cotisationMensuelle * (1 - tauxFrais) * facteur).roundToDouble();
  }

  static String formatMontant(double montant) {
    final s = montant.round().toString().replaceAllMapped(
          RegExp(r'(\d{1,3})(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))'),
          (Match m) => '${m[1]} ',
        );
    return '$s FCFA';
  }
}

// lib/screens/investir/devis_auto_screen.dart

    _nomCtrl.dispose();
    _prenomCtrl.dispose();
    _telephoneCtrl.dispose();
    _emailCtrl.dispose();
    _immatriculationCtrl.dispose();

  void _calculerTarif() {
    final marque = _marqueCtrl.text.trim();
    final annee = int.tryParse(_anneeCtrl.text.trim()) ?? 0;
    final puissance = int.tryParse(_puissanceCtrl.text.trim()) ?? 0;
    final nbMois = int.tryParse(_nbMoisCtrl.text.trim()) ?? 0;

    if (marque.isEmpty || annee == 0 || puissance == 0 || nbMois == 0) {
      if (_afficherTarif) {
        setState(() {
          _afficherTarif = false;
          _tarifCalcule = 0;
          _montantTotal = 0;
        });
      }
      return;
    }

    final prime = TarifAssuranceAuto.calculerPrimeMensuelle(
      marque: marque,
      modele: _modeleCtrl.text.trim(),
      annee: annee,
      puissance: puissance,
      config: _tarifConfig,
    );

    final total = TarifAssuranceAuto.calculerMontantTotal(
      primeMensuelle: prime,
      nbMois: nbMois,
    );

    setState(() {
      _tarifCalcule = prime;
      _montantTotal = total;
      _afficherTarif = true;
    });
  }


  Future<void> _payerMaintenant() async {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;

    if (!_afficherTarif || _montantTotal <= 0) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Veuillez completer les informations du vehicule'),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _isLoading = true);

    try {
      final currentUser = ref.read(currentUserProvider);
      if (currentUser == null) {
        throw Exception('Aucun utilisateur connecte');
      }

      final reference =
          'ASSUR-${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}';

      Logger.info('Paiement assurance initie:');
      Logger.info('   - Produit: ${widget.produitNom}');
      Logger.info('   - Montant: $_montantTotal FCFA');
      Logger.info('   - Reference: $reference');

      final paiementPro = PaiementProService();
      final success = await paiementPro.payerAvecPaiementPro(
        amount: _montantTotal,
        description: 'Assurance ${widget.produitNom} - ${_nbMoisCtrl.text} mois',
        referenceNumber: reference,
        customerEmail: currentUser.email.isNotEmpty
            ? currentUser.email
            : 'client@tapa.com',
        customerFirstName: currentUser.prenom,
        customerLastname: currentUser.prenom,
        customerPhoneNumber: _telephoneCtrl.text.trim().isNotEmpty
            ? _telephoneCtrl.text.trim()
            : currentUser.phoneNumber,
        channel: '',
        notificationURL:
            'https://wallet-notify.tapa-invest.workers.dev',
        returnURL: 'tapa-budget://assurance/success',
        returnContext:
            '{"userId":"${currentUser.id}","type":"assurance","produitNom":"${widget.produitNom}","reference":"$reference"}',
      );

      if (success && mounted) {
        context.push(
          '/assurance/success',
          extra: {
            'produitNom': widget.produitNom,
            'montantPaye': _montantTotal,
            'reference': reference,
          },
        );
      } else {
        if (mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(
              content: Text('Le paiement a ete annule'),
              backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
            ),
          );
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('Erreur paiement assurance: $e');
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Erreur: ${e.toString()}'),
            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
          ),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _chargerConfigTarifs() async {
    try {
      final config = await ref.read(tarifsConfigProvider.future);
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _tarifConfig = config);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('Erreur chargement config tarifs: $e');
    }
  }

  String _construireMessage() {
    final nom = _nomCtrl.text.trim();
    final prenom = _prenomCtrl.text.trim();
    final telephone = _telephoneCtrl.text.trim();
    final email = _emailCtrl.text.trim();
    final immatriculation = _immatriculationCtrl.text.trim().toUpperCase();
    final marque = _marqueCtrl.text.trim();
    final modele = _modeleCtrl.text.trim();
    final annee = _anneeCtrl.text.trim();
    final puissance = _puissanceCtrl.text.trim();
    final nbMois = _nbMoisCtrl.text.trim();
    final notes = _notesCtrl.text.trim();

    final parts = <String>[];

    parts.add('NOUVELLE DEMANDE DE DEVIS AUTO');
    parts.add('');
    parts.add('Produit: ${widget.produitNom}');
    parts.add('');

    parts.add('--- CLIENT ---');
    parts.add('Nom: $nom');
    parts.add('Prenom: $prenom');
    parts.add('Tel: $telephone');
    if (email.isNotEmpty) parts.add('Email: $email');
    parts.add('');

    parts.add('--- VEHICULE ---');
    if (_modeSaisie == 1) {
      parts.add('Carte grise scannée (image jointe)');
    } else {
      parts.add('Immatriculation: $immatriculation');
      parts.add('Marque: $marque');
      parts.add('Modèle: $modele');
      parts.add('Année: $annee');
      if (puissance.isNotEmpty) parts.add('Puissance: $puissance CV');
    }
    parts.add('');

    parts.add('--- DEMANDE ---');
    parts.add('Durée: $nbMois mois');
    parts.add('');

    if (notes.isNotEmpty) {
      parts.add('--- NOTES ---');
      parts.add(notes);
      parts.add('');
    }

    parts.add('---');
    parts.add('Envoyé depuis TAPA Invest');
    parts.add('Contact: +225 07 18 14 87 79');

    return parts.join('\n');
  }

  Future<void> _envoyerDevis() async {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;

    setState(() => _isLoading = true);

    final message = _construireMessage();
    final encoded = Uri.encodeComponent(message);

    final whatsappUri = Uri.parse(
      'whatsapp://send?phone=2250718148779&text=$encoded',
    );

    final webUri = Uri.parse(
      'https://wa.me/2250718148779?text=$encoded',
    );

    try {
      bool launched = await launchUrl(
        whatsappUri,
        mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
      );

      if (!launched) {
        launched = await launchUrl(
          webUri,
          mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
        );
      }

      if (launched) {
        _showSuccess(
          "WhatsApp ouvert. Vous pouvez envoyer votre devis.",
        );

        Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 2), () {
          if (mounted) context.pop();
        });
      } else {
        setState(() => _isLoading = false);
        _showCopyDialog(message);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint("Erreur WhatsApp : $e");
      setState(() => _isLoading = false);
      _showCopyDialog(message);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isLoading = false);
      }
    }
  }

  void _navigateTo(String route, int index) {
    setState(() => _selectedIndex = index);
    context.go(route);
  }

  Widget _buildNavItem({
    required IconData icon,
    required IconData activeIcon,
    required String label,
    required int index,
    required String route,
  }) {
    final isActive = _selectedIndex == index;
    return Expanded(
      child: GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTap: () => _navigateTo(route, index),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            AnimatedContainer(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 260),
              curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: isActive ? 12 : 0,
                vertical: 6,
              ),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: isActive
                    ? const LinearGradient(
                  colors: [Color(0xFF1A237E), Color(0xFF0D1444)],
                  begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                  end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                )
                    : null,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                boxShadow: isActive
                    ? [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: const Color(0xFF1A237E).withOpacity(0.35),
                    blurRadius: 10,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 4),
                  ),
                ]
                    : null,
              ),
              child: Icon(
                isActive ? activeIcon : icon,
                size: isActive ? 22 : 20,
                color: isActive ? Colors.amber : Colors.grey.shade500,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(
              label,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: isActive ? 10 : 9,
                fontWeight: isActive ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
                color: isActive ? const Color(0xFF1A237E) : Colors.grey.shade500,
                letterSpacing: 0.1,
              ),
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _sectionTitle(String title, bool isSmall) {

          height: isSmall ? 14 : 18,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(

        Text(

          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: isSmall ? 13 : 15,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
            color: TAPAColors.navy,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _textField({
    required TextEditingController controller,
    required String label,
    required String hint,
    required IconData icon,
    TextInputType? keyboardType,
    TextCapitalization textCapitalization = TextCapitalization.none,
    int maxLines = 1,
    String? suffix,
    required bool isSmall,
    VoidCallback? onChanged,
  }) {
    return TextFormField(
      controller: controller,
      keyboardType: keyboardType ?? TextInputType.text,
      textCapitalization: textCapitalization,
      maxLines: maxLines,
      onChanged: onChanged != null ? (_) => onChanged() : null,
      validator: (value) {
        if (label.contains('*') && (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty)) {
          return 'Ce champ est requis';
        }
        return null;
      },
      decoration: InputDecoration(
        labelText: label,
        hintText: hint,
        prefixIcon: Icon(
          icon,
          color: TAPAColors.gold,
          size: isSmall ? 16 : 20,
        ),
        suffixText: suffix,
        border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(isSmall ? 8 : 12),
        ),
        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(isSmall ? 8 : 12),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: TAPAColors.gold, width: 2),
        ),
        filled: true,
        fillColor: TAPAColors.surface,
        contentPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          horizontal: isSmall ? 12 : 16,
          vertical: isSmall ? 10 : 14,
        ),
        labelStyle: TextStyle(fontSize: isSmall ? 12 : 14),
        hintStyle: TextStyle(fontSize: isSmall ? 12 : 14),
      ),
    );
  }
}

                ]),

                  child: CustomPaint(

            final couleur = Color(pos['couleurValue'] as int);
            return Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),

                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: couleur.withOpacity(0.12),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),

                      style: const TextStyle(

                        color: TAPAColors.green)),
                  ]),
              ]));
          }),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
        ]));
  }
}

class _EvolutionPainter extends CustomPainter {
  final List<double> points;
  _EvolutionPainter(this.points);

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    if (points.isEmpty) return;
    final minV = points.reduce((a, b) => a < b ? a : b);
    final maxV = points.reduce((a, b) => a > b ? a : b);
    final range = (maxV - minV) == 0 ? 1 : (maxV - minV);

    final path = Path();
    final stepX = size.width / (points.length - 1);

    for (int i = 0; i < points.length; i++) {
      final x = i * stepX;
      final normalized = (points[i] - minV) / range;
      final y = size.height - (normalized * size.height);
      if (i == 0) {
        path.moveTo(x, y);
      } else {
        path.lineTo(x, y);
      }
    }

    final fillPath = Path.from(path)
      ..lineTo(size.width, size.height)
      ..lineTo(0, size.height)
      ..close();

    canvas.drawPath(fillPath,
      Paint()..color = const Color(0xFFC9A227).withOpacity(0.15));

    canvas.drawPath(path,
      Paint()
        ..color = const Color(0xFFC9A227)
        ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
        ..strokeWidth = 2.5
        ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round);
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant CustomPainter oldDelegate) => false;
}
