  Widget _buildNavItem({
    required IconData icon,
    required IconData activeIcon,
    required String label,
    required int index,
    required String route,
  }) {
    final isActive = _selectedIndex == index;
    return Expanded(
      child: GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTap: () => _navigateTo(route, index),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            AnimatedContainer(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 260),
              curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: isActive ? 12 : 0,
                vertical: 6,
              ),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: isActive
                    ? const LinearGradient(
                  colors: [Color(0xFF1A237E), Color(0xFF0D1444)],
                  begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                  end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                )
                    : null,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                boxShadow: isActive
                    ? [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: const Color(0xFF1A237E).withOpacity(0.35),
                    blurRadius: 10,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 4),
                  ),
                ]
                    : null,
              ),
              child: Icon(
                isActive ? activeIcon : icon,
                size: isActive ? 22 : 20,
                color: isActive ? Colors.amber : Colors.grey.shade500,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(
              label,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: isActive ? 10 : 9,
                fontWeight: isActive ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
                color: isActive ? const Color(0xFF1A237E) : Colors.grey.shade500,
                letterSpacing: 0.1,
              ),
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

  Widget _grandBouton({
    required BuildContext context,
    required String titre,
    required String sousTitre,
    required String emoji,
    required Color couleur,
    required Color couleurBg,
    required String badge,
    required Color badgeCouleur,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
  }) {
    final isSmall = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width < 360;
    final isTablet = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width >= 600;
    final fontSize = isSmall ? 13.0 : (isTablet ? 17.0 : 15.0);
    final subFontSize = isSmall ? 11.0 : (isTablet ? 14.0 : 12.0);
    final iconSize = isSmall ? 50.0 : (isTablet ? 70.0 : 60.0);
    final paddingSize = isSmall ? 14.0 : (isTablet ? 24.0 : 20.0);

    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: onTap,
      child: Container(
        padding: EdgeInsets.all(paddingSize),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: couleurBg,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
          border: Border.all(
            color: couleur.withOpacity(0.2),
            width: 1.5,
          ),
        ),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Container(
              width: iconSize,
              height: iconSize,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: couleur.withOpacity(0.12),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
              ),
              child: Center(
                child: Text(
                  emoji,
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: iconSize * 0.45),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            SizedBox(width: isSmall ? 12 : 16),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                      horizontal: 8,
                      vertical: 3,
                    ),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: badgeCouleur.withOpacity(0.12),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      badge,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: isSmall ? 9 : 10,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        color: badgeCouleur,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  Text(
                    titre,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: fontSize,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      color: couleur,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(
                    sousTitre,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: subFontSize,
                      color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                      height: 1.4,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            Icon(
              Icons.arrow_forward_ios,
              size: isSmall ? 14 : 16,
              color: couleur.withOpacity(0.5),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBottomNavigationBar() {
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.06),
            blurRadius: 12,
            offset: const Offset(0, -3),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: 6),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceAround,
            children: [
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.home_outlined,
                activeIcon: Icons.home,
                label: 'Accueil',
                index: 0,
                route: '/home',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.shield_outlined,
                activeIcon: Icons.shield,
                label: 'Assurance',
                index: 1,
                route: '/investir/assurance',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.account_balance_wallet_outlined,
                activeIcon: Icons.account_balance_wallet,
                label: 'Enveloppe',
                index: 2,
                route: '/savings',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.pie_chart_outline,
                activeIcon: Icons.pie_chart,
                label: 'Budget',
                index: 3,
                route: '/budget',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.credit_card_outlined,
                activeIcon: Icons.credit_card,
                label: 'Dettes',
                index: 4,
                route: '/dettes',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.person_outline,
                activeIcon: Icons.person,
                label: 'Profil',
                index: 5,
                route: '/profile',
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildNavItem({
    required IconData icon,
    required IconData activeIcon,
    required String label,
    required int index,
    required String route,
  }) {
    final isActive = _selectedIndex == index;
    return Expanded(
      child: GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTap: () => _navigateTo(route, index),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            AnimatedContainer(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 260),
              curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: isActive ? 12 : 0,
                vertical: 6,
              ),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: isActive
                    ? const LinearGradient(
                  colors: [Color(0xFF1A237E), Color(0xFF0D1444)],
                  begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                  end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                )
                    : null,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                boxShadow: isActive
                    ? [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: const Color(0xFF1A237E).withOpacity(0.35),
                    blurRadius: 10,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 4),
                  ),
                ]
                    : null,
              ),
              child: Icon(
                isActive ? activeIcon : icon,
                size: isActive ? 22 : 20,
                color: isActive ? Colors.amber : Colors.grey.shade500,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(
              label,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: isActive ? 10 : 9,
                fontWeight: isActive ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
                color: isActive ? const Color(0xFF1A237E) : Colors.grey.shade500,
                letterSpacing: 0.1,
              ),
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// lib/presentation/screens/investir/my_sonam_contracts_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import 'package:tapa_budget/presentation/providers/providers.dart';
import 'sonam_calc.dart';

class MySonamContractsScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const MySonamContractsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<MySonamContractsScreen> createState() => _MySonamContractsScreenState();
}

class _MySonamContractsScreenState extends ConsumerState<MySonamContractsScreen> {
  
  // ✅ MÉTHODE DE PAIEMENT
  Future<void> _payerCotisation(BuildContext context, String contractId, double montant, List<dynamic> historiqueActuel) async {
    final user = ref.read(currentUserProvider);
    if (user == null) return;

    // ✅ Calculer le prochain mois à payer
    DateTime prochainMoisDate;
    if (historiqueActuel.isEmpty) {
      // Si aucun paiement, on commence au mois suivant la date d'effet (ou le mois actuel)
      prochainMoisDate = DateTime.now(); 
    } else {
      // Prendre le dernier mois payé et ajouter 1 mois
      final dernierPaiement = historiqueActuel.last;
      final parts = dernierPaiement['mois'].split('/');
      final mois = int.parse(parts[0]);
      final annee = int.parse(parts[1]);
      prochainMoisDate = DateTime(annee, mois + 1);
    }
    
    final moisAPayer = '${prochainMoisDate.month}/${prochainMoisDate.year}';

    // Afficher un loader
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (ctx) => const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
    );

    try {
      final walletRef = FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('user_wallet').doc(user.id);
      final walletDoc = await walletRef.get();
      final solde = (walletDoc.data()?['solde'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;

      if (solde < montant) {
        if (!context.mounted) return;
        Navigator.pop(context);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('Solde insuffisant. Veuillez recharger votre Wallet.'),
            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
          ),
        );
        return;
      }

      await FirebaseFirestore.instance.runTransaction((transaction) async {
        final currentWallet = await transaction.get(walletRef);
        final currentSolde = (currentWallet.data()?['solde'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;

        if (currentSolde < montant) throw Exception('Solde insuffisant');

        // 1. Déduire du Wallet
        transaction.update(walletRef, {
          'solde': currentSolde - montant,
          'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        });

        // 2. Mettre à jour le contrat ET ajouter l'historique
        transaction.update(
          FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('sonam_contracts').doc(contractId),
          {
            'totalVerse': FieldValue.increment(montant),
            'dernierPaiement': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
            'historiquePaiements': FieldValue.arrayUnion([
              {
                'mois': moisAPayer,
                'montant': montant,
                'date': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
              }
            ]),
          }
        );

        // 3. Créer la transaction
        final txRef = FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('transactions').doc();
        transaction.set(txRef, {
          'userId': user.id,
          'montant': montant,
          'type': 'depense',
          'categorieLabel': 'Cotisation SONAM ($moisAPayer)',
          'categorieEmoji': '💰',
          'dateTransaction': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
          'description': 'Paiement anticipé cotisation SONAM - $moisAPayer',
        });
      });

      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pop(context);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('✅ Cotisation pour $moisAPayer payée avec succès !'),
            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.green,
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pop(context);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Erreur: $e'),
            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final user = ref.watch(currentUserProvider);
    if (user == null) return const Scaffold(body: Center(child: Text('Non connecté')));

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Mes Contrats SONAM'),
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
        foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios),
          onPressed: () => context.go('/investir'),
        ),
      ),
      body: StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot>(
        stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
            .collection('sonam_contracts')
            .where('userId', isEqualTo: user.id)
            .snapshots(),
        builder: (context, snapshot) {
          if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
            return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
          }
          if (!snapshot.hasData || snapshot.data!.docs.isEmpty) {
            return const Center(
              child: Text('Aucun contrat SONAM pour le moment.'),
            );
          }

          final contracts = snapshot.data!.docs;

          return ListView.builder(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            itemCount: contracts.length,
            itemBuilder: (context, index) {
              final data = contracts[index].data() as Map<String, dynamic>;
              final statut = data['statut'] ?? 'Inconnu';
              final policeCode = data['policeCode'] ?? 'N/A';
              final cotisation = (data['contrat']?['cotisation_periodique'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0;
              final capital = (data['contrat']?['capital_garanti_terme'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0;

              Color statutColor = TAPAColors.gold;
              if (statut == 'Actif') statutColor = TAPAColors.green;

              return Card(
                margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            'Code: $policeCode',
                            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 16),
                          ),
                          Container(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: statutColor.withAlpha(30),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            ),
                            child: Text(
                              statut,
                              style: TextStyle(color: statutColor, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 12),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      Text('Cotisation: ${SonamCalc.formatMontant(cotisation)} / mois'),
                      Text('Capital garanti: ${SonamCalc.formatMontant(capital)}'),
                      
                      // ✅ AFFICHAGE DE L'HISTORIQUE
                      if (data['historiquePaiements'] != null && (data['historiquePaiements'] as List).isNotEmpty) ...[
                        const Divider(height: 24),
                        const Text(
                          'Historique des paiements :', 
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: TAPAColors.navy)
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 4),
                        ...(data['historiquePaiements'] as List).map((p) {
                          return Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 4),
                            child: Row(
                              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                              children: [
                                Text('Mois: ${p['mois']}', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: TAPAColors.textSecond)),
                                Text(SonamCalc.formatMontant((p['montant'] as num).toDouble()), style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: TAPAColors.navy)),
                              ],
                            ),
                          );
                        }).toList(),
                      ],

                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      
                      // ✅ BOUTON DE PAIEMENT (toujours visible)
                      SizedBox(
                        width: double.infinity,
                        height: 48,
                        child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                          onPressed: () => _payerCotisation(context, contracts[index].id, cotisation),
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.payment),
                          label: Text(
                            statut == 'En attente de paiement' 
                              ? 'Payer ma 1ère cotisation' 
                              : 'Payer ma cotisation mensuelle'
                          ),
                          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.gold,
                            foregroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              );
            },
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

  // ==========================================================
  // GÉNÉRATION DU CODE D'ACTIVATION
  // ==========================================================
  String _genererCodeActivation() {
    const chars = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789';
    final random = Random.secure();
    final code = List.generate(8, (_) => chars[random.nextInt(chars.length)]).join();
    return 'TB-2026-$code';
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // SAUVEGARDE DU CODE D'ACTIVATION
  // ==========================================================
  Future<void> _sauvegarderCodeActivation(String code) async {
    try {
      final firebaseService = FirebaseService();
      final userId = firebaseService.getCurrentUserId();

      if (userId != null) {
        // Sauvegarder dans Firestore
        await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users').doc(userId).set({
          'activationCode': code,
          'codeGeneratedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
          'codeUsed': false,
          'hasAccesVie': true,
          'licenseKey': code,
          'licenseType': 'premium',
          'licenseActivatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        }, SetOptions(merge: true));

        // Sauvegarder aussi en local
        final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
        await prefs.setString('activation_code', code);
        await prefs.setBool('acces_vie', true);
        await prefs.setString('cle_activee', code);

        Logger.info('✅ Code d\'activation sauvegardé: $code');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur sauvegarde code: $e');
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // LOGIQUE DE PAIEMENT AVEC GÉNÉRATION DE CODE
  // ==========================================================

  Future<void> _processPayment() async {
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);

    try {
      final selectedProvider = _providers.firstWhere(
            (p) => p.id == _selectedProvider,
      );

      Logger.info('💳 Paiement initié:');
      Logger.info('   - Opérateur: ${selectedProvider.name}');
      Logger.info('   - Téléphone: $_phoneNumber');
      Logger.info('   - Montant: 5000 FCFA');

      // Simuler l'appel API
      await Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 2));

      // ✅ Générer le code d'activation
      final activationCode = _genererCodeActivation();
      setState(() => _generatedCode = activationCode);

      // ✅ Sauvegarder le code
      await _sauvegarderCodeActivation(activationCode);

      Logger.info('🎫 Code d\'activation généré: $activationCode');

      // ✅ Paiement réussi
      if (mounted) {
        final monnaie = ref.read(userMonnaieProvider);
        _showSuccessDialog(selectedProvider, activationCode, 5000, monnaie);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur paiement: $e');
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('❌ Erreur lors du paiement: ${e.toString()}'),
            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
          ),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

// ==========================================================
// MODÈLE
// ==========================================================

class PaymentProvider {
  final String id;
  final String name;
  final String logoAsset;
  final Color color;
  final Color bgColor;
  final int minAmount;
  final int maxAmount;

  const PaymentProvider({
    required this.id,
    required this.name,
    required this.logoAsset,
    required this.color,
    required this.bgColor,
    required this.minAmount,
    required this.maxAmount,
  });

  String get initials {
    final words = name.split(' ');
    if (words.length >= 2) {
      return '${words[0][0]}${words[1][0]}'.toUpperCase();
    }
    return name.substring(0, name.length >= 2 ? 2 : 1).toUpperCase();
  }
}

  }

  Future<void> _loadConfig() async {
    try {
      final config = await ref.read(tarifsConfigProvider.future);
      if (mounted) {
        _initControllers(config);
        setState(() => _initialized = true);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('Erreur chargement config: $e');
      if (mounted) setState(() => _initialized = true);
    }
  }

  TarifConfigModel _buildConfigFromControllers() {
    return TarifConfigModel(
      basePremium: double.tryParse(_basePremiumCtrl.text) ?? 15000,
      baseHautGamme: double.tryParse(_baseHautGammeCtrl.text) ?? 10000,
      basePopulaire: double.tryParse(_basePopulaireCtrl.text) ?? 8000,
      baseChinoise: double.tryParse(_baseChinoiseCtrl.text) ?? 7000,
      baseDefaut: double.tryParse(_baseDefautCtrl.text) ?? 8000,
      coefAge0a1: double.tryParse(_coefAge0a1Ctrl.text) ?? 1.30,
      coefAge1a3: double.tryParse(_coefAge1a3Ctrl.text) ?? 1.20,
      coefAge3a5: double.tryParse(_coefAge3a5Ctrl.text) ?? 1.10,
      coefAge5a10: double.tryParse(_coefAge5a10Ctrl.text) ?? 1.00,
      coefAge10a15: double.tryParse(_coefAge10a15Ctrl.text) ?? 0.90,
      coefAge15Plus: double.tryParse(_coefAge15PlusCtrl.text) ?? 0.80,
      coefCv0a4: double.tryParse(_coefCv0a4Ctrl.text) ?? 0.85,
      coefCv4a6: double.tryParse(_coefCv4a6Ctrl.text) ?? 1.00,
      coefCv6a8: double.tryParse(_coefCv6a8Ctrl.text) ?? 1.15,
      coefCv8a10: double.tryParse(_coefCv8a10Ctrl.text) ?? 1.30,
      coefCv10a13: double.tryParse(_coefCv10a13Ctrl.text) ?? 1.50,
      coefCv13Plus: double.tryParse(_coefCv13PlusCtrl.text) ?? 1.80,
      primeMinimum: double.tryParse(_primeMinCtrl.text) ?? 5000,
      updatedAt: DateTime.now(),
      updatedBy: ref.read(currentUserProvider)?.email ?? 'admin',
    );
  }

  Future<void> _sauvegarder() async {
    final user = ref.read(currentUserProvider);
    if (user == null) return;

    final config = _buildConfigFromControllers();
    final success = await ref
        .read(tarifsStateProvider.notifier)
        .saveConfig(config, user.email);

    if (mounted) {
      if (success) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('Tarifs sauvegardes'),
            backgroundColor: Color(0xFF27AE60),
          ),
        );
      } else {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('Erreur sauvegarde'),
            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  int _calculerApercu() {
    final config = _buildConfigFromControllers();
    return TarifAssuranceAuto.calculerPrimeMensuelle(
      marque: 'Toyota',
      modele: 'Yaris',
      annee: 2020,
      puissance: 5,
      config: config,
    );
  }

  Widget _champ(TextEditingController ctrl, String label, String hint,
      {bool decimal = false}) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
      child: TextField(
        controller: ctrl,
        keyboardType: TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: decimal),
        inputFormatters: decimal
            ? [FilteringTextInputFormatter.allow(RegExp(r'[0-9.]'))]
            : [FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly],
        onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          labelText: label,
          hintText: hint,
          filled: true,
          fillColor: TAPAColors.surface,
          suffixText: decimal ? '' : 'FCFA',
          border: OutlineInputBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
          ),
          focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
            borderSide: const BorderSide(color: TAPAColors.gold, width: 2),
          ),
          prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.edit, size: 18, color: TAPAColors.gold),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _apercu() {
    final prime = _calculerApercu();
    final total = prime * 12;

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: const LinearGradient(
          colors: [Color(0xFF27AE60), Color(0xFF1E8449)],
        ),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          const Row(
            children: [
              Icon(Icons.calculate, color: Colors.white, size: 20),
              SizedBox(width: 8),
              Text(
                'Apercu du calcul',
                style: TextStyle(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  fontSize: 14,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          const Text(
            'Exemple : Toyota Yaris 2020, 5 CV, 12 mois',
            style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 12),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              const Text('Prime mensuelle', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 13)),
              Text(
                '${_format(prime)} FCFA',
                style: const TextStyle(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  fontSize: 15,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              const Text('Total 12 mois', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 13)),
              Text(
                '${_format(total)} FCFA',
                style: const TextStyle(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  fontSize: 18,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  String _format(int n) {
    final s = n.toString();
    final buf = StringBuffer();
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
      if (i > 0 && (s.length - i) % 3 == 0) buf.write(' ');
      buf.write(s[i]);
    }
    return buf.toString();
  }
}

// lib/presentation/screens/admin/admin_souscriptions_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../../../data/models/models.dart';
import '../../../domain/usecases/souscriptions/admin_souscriptions_usecase.dart';
import '../../providers/providers.dart';

class AdminSouscriptionsScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const AdminSouscriptionsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<AdminSouscriptionsScreen> createState() =>
      _AdminSouscriptionsScreenState();
}

class _AdminSouscriptionsScreenState
    extends ConsumerState<AdminSouscriptionsScreen> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      ref.read(adminSouscriptionsStateProvider.notifier).loadAllSouscriptions();
    });
  }

  Future<void> _valider(SouscriptionModel s) async {
    final confirme = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Valider la souscription ?'),
        content: Text('Valider "${s.produitNom}" pour ${_format(s.montant)} FCFA ?'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Annuler'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF27AE60),
            ),
            child: const Text('Valider'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirme == true) {
      await ref
          .read(adminSouscriptionsStateProvider.notifier)
          .updateStatut(s.reference, 'payee');
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('Souscription validee'),
            backgroundColor: Color(0xFF27AE60),
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _annuler(SouscriptionModel s) async {
    final confirme = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Annuler la souscription ?'),
        content: Text('Annuler "${s.produitNom}" ?'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Retour'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
            ),
            child: const Text('Annuler'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirme == true) {
      await ref
          .read(adminSouscriptionsStateProvider.notifier)
          .updateStatut(s.reference, 'annulee');
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('Souscription annulee'),
            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = ref.watch(adminSouscriptionsStateProvider);

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Administration des souscriptions'),
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
        foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios),
          onPressed: () => context.pop(),
        ),
      ),
      body: RefreshIndicator(
        onRefresh: () async {
          await ref
              .read(adminSouscriptionsStateProvider.notifier)
              .loadAllSouscriptions();
        },
        child: _buildBody(state),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBody(AdminSouscriptionsState state) {
    if (state.isLoading && state.souscriptions.isEmpty) {
      return const Center(
        child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: TAPAColors.gold),
      );
    }

    return ListView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      children: [
        _carteStatistiques(state),
        const SizedBox(height: 20),
        _filtres(state),
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        if (state.souscriptionsFiltrees.isEmpty)
          _emptyState(state.filtre)
        else
          ...state.souscriptionsFiltrees.map((s) => _carteSouscription(s)),
        const SizedBox(height: 20),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _carteStatistiques(AdminSouscriptionsState state) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: const LinearGradient(
          colors: [TAPAColors.navy, Color(0xFF14274E)],
          begin: Alignment.topLeft,
          end: Alignment.bottomRight,
        ),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          const Text(
            'Total des souscriptions',
            style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 12),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
            '${_format(state.montantTotal)} FCFA',
            style: const TextStyle(
              color: Colors.white,
              fontSize: 26,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Row(
            children: [
              _badge('${state.totalEnCours} en cours', TAPAColors.gold),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              _badge('${state.totalPayees} payees', const Color(0xFF27AE60)),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              _badge('${state.totalAnnulees} annulees', TAPAColors.red),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _badge(String texte, Color couleur) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: couleur.withOpacity(0.2),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
      ),
      child: Text(
        texte,
        style: TextStyle(
          fontSize: 11,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
          color: couleur,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _filtres(AdminSouscriptionsState state) {
    final filtres = [
      ('toutes', 'Toutes'),
      ('en_cours', 'En cours'),
      ('payee', 'Payees'),
      ('annulee', 'Annulees'),
    ];

    return SizedBox(
      height: 40,
      child: ListView.separated(
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        itemCount: filtres.length,
        separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const SizedBox(width: 8),
        itemBuilder: (context, i) {
          final f = filtres[i];
          final actif = state.filtre == f.$1;
          return GestureDetector(
            onTap: () => ref
                .read(adminSouscriptionsStateProvider.notifier)
                .setFiltre(f.$1),
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: actif ? TAPAColors.navy : TAPAColors.surface,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: actif ? TAPAColors.navy : TAPAColors.border,
                ),
              ),
              child: Text(
                f.$2,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 13,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                  color: actif ? TAPAColors.white : TAPAColors.navy,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _emptyState(String filtre) {
    return Center(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(40),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            const Icon(
              Icons.receipt_long_outlined,
              size: 60,
              color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Text(
              'Aucune souscription "$filtre"',
              style: const TextStyle(
                fontSize: 14,
                color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _carteSouscription(SouscriptionModel s) {
    final couleur = s.estEnCours
        ? TAPAColors.gold
        : (s.estPayee ? const Color(0xFF27AE60) : TAPAColors.red);

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: TAPAColors.surface,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        border: Border.all(color: couleur.withOpacity(0.3), width: 1.5),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Container(
                width: 40,
                height: 40,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: couleur.withOpacity(0.15),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                ),
                child: Icon(
                  s.estEnCours
                      ? Icons.hourglass_empty
                      : (s.estPayee ? Icons.check_circle : Icons.cancel),
                  color: couleur,
                  size: 20,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      s.produitNom,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 14,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        color: TAPAColors.navy,
                      ),
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                    Text(
                      s.reference,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 10,
                        color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                      ),
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              Text(
                '${_format(s.montant)} F',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 15,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                  color: couleur,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Row(
            children: [
              const Icon(Icons.person_outline, size: 14, color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
              const SizedBox(width: 4),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  s.clientNom.isNotEmpty
                      ? '${s.clientNom} ${s.clientPrenom}'
                      : s.userId,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11,
                    color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                  ),
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                ),
              ),
              Text(
                '${s.dateCreation.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${s.dateCreation.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${s.dateCreation.year}',
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 11,
                  color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          if (s.estEnCours) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                    onPressed: () => _valider(s),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.check, size: 16),
                    label: const Text('Valider'),
                    style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF27AE60),
                      foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Expanded(
                  child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                    onPressed: () => _annuler(s),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.close, size: 16),
                    label: const Text('Annuler'),
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                      foregroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
                      side: const BorderSide(color: TAPAColors.red),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  String _format(double n) {
    final s = n.toInt().toString();
    final buf = StringBuffer();
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
      if (i > 0 && (s.length - i) % 3 == 0) buf.write(' ');
      buf.write(s[i]);
    }
    return buf.toString();
  }
}

// lib/presentation/screens/admin/admin_withdraw_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'dart:convert';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';

class AdminWithdrawScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const AdminWithdrawScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<AdminWithdrawScreen> createState() => _AdminWithdrawScreenState();
}

class _AdminWithdrawScreenState extends State<AdminWithdrawScreen> {
  // ⚠️ Ce token doit correspondre à celui du serveur
  static const String _adminToken = 'TAPA_ADMIN_SECRET_2026';
  static const String _serverUrl = 'https://tapa-budget-server.onrender.com/api';

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _requests = [];
  bool _isLoading = true;
  String? _error;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadRequests();
  }

  Future<void> _loadRequests() async {
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
      _error = null;
    });

    try {
      final response = await http.get(
        Uri.parse('$_serverUrl/admin/withdraws'),
        headers: {'x-admin-token': _adminToken},
      );

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final data = jsonDecode(response.body);
        setState(() {
          _requests = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(data['requests']);
        });
      } else {
        setState(() => _error = 'Erreur ${response.statusCode}: ${response.body}');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setState(() => _error = 'Erreur réseau: $e');
    } finally {
      setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _valider(String requestId, String status) async {
    try {
      final response = await http.post(
        Uri.parse('$_serverUrl/admin/withdraw/$requestId/complete'),
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'x-admin-token': _adminToken,
        },
        body: jsonEncode({'status': status}),
      );

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text(status == 'success' ? '✅ Retrait validé' : '❌ Retrait marqué comme échoué'),
            backgroundColor: status == 'success' ? Colors.green : Colors.red,
          ),
        );
        _loadRequests(); // Recharger la liste
      } else {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('Erreur: ${response.body}'), backgroundColor: Colors.red),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Erreur réseau: $e'), backgroundColor: Colors.red),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Admin - Demandes de retrait'),
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
        foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
            onPressed: _loadRequests,
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: _isLoading
          ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
          : _error != null
              ? Center(
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                    child: Text(_error!, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red)),
                  ),
                )
              : _requests.isEmpty
                  ? const Center(
                      child: Text(
                        'Aucune demande en attente',
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
                      ),
                    )
                  : ListView.builder(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                      itemCount: _requests.length,
                      itemBuilder: (ctx, i) {
                        final r = _requests[i];
                        return Card(
                          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                          child: Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                            child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: [
                                Row(
                                  children: [
                                    const Icon(Icons.payments, color: TAPAColors.gold),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                    Text(
                                      '${r['amount']} FCFA',
                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                        fontSize: 18,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                        color: TAPAColors.navy,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                                Text('Opérateur : ${r['operator']}'),
                                Text('Numéro : ${r['phone']}'),
                                Text('Date : ${r['requestedAt'] ?? 'N/A'}'),
                                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                                Row(
                                  children: [
                                    Expanded(
                                      child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                                        onPressed: () => _valider(r['id'], 'success'),
                                        icon: const Icon(Icons.check, color: Colors.white),
                                        label: const Text('Valider'),
                                        style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                                          backgroundColor: Colors.green,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                    Expanded(
                                      child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                                        onPressed: () => _valider(r['id'], 'failed'),
                                        icon: const Icon(Icons.close, color: Colors.white),
                                        label: const Text('Échec'),
                                        style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                                          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                        );
                      },
                    ),
    );
  }
}

FICHIER : lib/presentation/screens/transfer/transfer_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../../../services/db_service_mysql.dart';
import '../../../data/models/models.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/formatters.dart';

class TransferScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const TransferScreen({super.key});
  @override
  State<TransferScreen> createState() => _TransferScreenState();
}

class _TransferScreenState extends State<TransferScreen> {
  final DBService _db = DBService();
  final TextEditingController _montantCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _noteCtrl = TextEditingController();
  String? _walletSourceId;
  String? _walletDestId;

  // ✅ État pour les portefeuilles
  List<WalletModel> _wallets = [];
  bool _isLoading = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _initWallets();
  }

  // ✅ CORRIGÉ : ajout de async
  Future<void> _initWallets() async {
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    try {
      final wallets = await _db.getWallets();
      setState(() {
        _wallets = wallets.where((w) => w != null).cast<WalletModel>().toList();
        if (_wallets.length >= 2) {
          _walletSourceId = _wallets[0].id;
          _walletDestId = _wallets[1].id;
        }
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _montantCtrl.dispose();
    _noteCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _transfer() async {
    final montant = double.tryParse(_montantCtrl.text);
    if (montant == null || montant <= 0) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Entrez un montant valide'),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    if (_walletSourceId == null || _walletDestId == null) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Sélectionnez les portefeuilles'),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    if (_walletSourceId == _walletDestId) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Source et destination doivent être différents'),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    // ✅ Utiliser _wallets déjà chargé
    final source = _wallets.firstWhere(
          (w) => w.id == _walletSourceId,
      orElse: () => throw Exception('Portefeuille source non trouvé'),
    );
    final user = _db.getUser();
    final monnaie = user?['monnaie'] ?? 'FCFA';

    if (source.solde < montant) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('Solde insuffisant: ${Fmt.montant(source.solde, monnaie: monnaie)}'),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final dest = _wallets.firstWhere(
          (w) => w.id == _walletDestId,
      orElse: () => throw Exception('Portefeuille destination non trouvé'),
    );

    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Confirmer le transfert'),
        content: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text('De: ${source.emoji} ${source.nom}'),
            Text('Vers: ${dest.emoji} ${dest.nom}'),
            Text('Montant: ${Fmt.montant(montant, monnaie: monnaie)}'),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Annuler'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text('Transférer'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (ok == true) {
      final userId = _db.getCurrentUserId();
      final int utilisateurId = userId != null ? int.tryParse(userId) ?? 1 : 1;

      // Mettre à jour la source
      final updatedSource = WalletModel(
        id: source.id,
        uid: source.uid,
        nom: source.nom,
        emoji: source.emoji,
        type: source.type,
        solde: source.solde - montant,
        monnaie: source.monnaie,
        description: source.description,
        createdAt: source.createdAt,
        updatedAt: DateTime.now(),
      );
      await _db.saveWallet(updatedSource);

      // Mettre à jour la destination
      final updatedDest = WalletModel(
        id: dest.id,
        uid: dest.uid,
        nom: dest.nom,
        emoji: dest.emoji,
        type: dest.type,
        solde: dest.solde + montant,
        monnaie: dest.monnaie,
        description: dest.description,
        createdAt: dest.createdAt,
        updatedAt: DateTime.now(),
      );
      await _db.saveWallet(updatedDest);

      // Créer la transaction
      final tx = TransactionModel(
        id: Fmt.genId(),
        uid: userId ?? '',
        walletId: _walletSourceId!,
        montant: montant,
        type: TransactionType.transfert,
        categorieId: 'transfert',
        categorieLabel: 'Transfert',
        categorieEmoji: '🔄',
        note: _noteCtrl.text.trim().isEmpty ? null : _noteCtrl.text.trim(),
        dateTransaction: DateTime.now(),
        createdAt: DateTime.now(),
      );
      await _db.addTransaction(tx);

      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('Transfert effectué avec succès !'),
            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.green,
          ),
        );
        context.pop(true);
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final user = _db.getUser();
    final monnaie = user?['monnaie'] ?? 'FCFA';

    // ✅ Utiliser _wallets au lieu de await
    final wallets = _wallets;

    if (_isLoading) {
      return Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: const Text('Transfert'),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
          foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
          leading: IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
            onPressed: () => context.pop(),
          ),
        ),
        body: const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
      );
    }

    if (wallets.length < 2) {
      return Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: const Text('Transfert'),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
          foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
          leading: IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
            onPressed: () => context.pop(),
          ),
        ),
        body: const Center(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              Icon(Icons.info_outline, size: 48, color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
              SizedBox(height: 16),
              Text(
                'Vous avez besoin d\'au moins 2 portefeuilles',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 16,
                  color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Transfert'),
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
        foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
          onPressed: () => context.pop(),
        ),
      ),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        children: [
          const Text(
            'Transférer de l\'argent',
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 20,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
              color: TAPAColors.navy,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          const Text(
            'D\'un portefeuille à un autre',
            style: TextStyle(
              color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 24),
          DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
            value: _walletSourceId,
            decoration: const InputDecoration(
              labelText: 'Portefeuille source *',
            ),
            items: wallets.map((wallet) {
              return DropdownMenuItem<String>(
                value: wallet.id,
                child: Text('${wallet.emoji ?? '💳'} ${wallet.nom ?? 'Portefeuille'} (${Fmt.montant(wallet.solde, monnaie: monnaie)})'),
              );
            }).toList(),
            onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _walletSourceId = v),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
            value: _walletDestId,
            decoration: const InputDecoration(
              labelText: 'Portefeuille destination *',
            ),
            items: wallets.where((w) => w.id != _walletSourceId).map((wallet) {
              return DropdownMenuItem<String>(
                value: wallet.id,
                child: Text('${wallet.emoji ?? '💳'} ${wallet.nom ?? 'Portefeuille'} (${Fmt.montant(wallet.solde, monnaie: monnaie)})'),
              );
            }).toList(),
            onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _walletDestId = v),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          TextField(
            controller: _montantCtrl,
            keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
            inputFormatters: [
              FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly,
            ],
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              labelText: 'Montant *',
              suffixText: monnaie,
              hintText: '0',
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          TextField(
            controller: _noteCtrl,
            decoration: const InputDecoration(
              labelText: 'Note (optionnelle)',
              hintText: 'ex : Virement Wave',
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 32),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: _transfer,
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
            ),
            child: const Text(
              'Transférer',
              style: TextStyle(color: TAPAColors.white),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

// lib/screens/coach/coach_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

class CoachScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const CoachScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<CoachScreen> createState() => _CoachScreenState();
}

class _CoachScreenState extends ConsumerState<CoachScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _msgCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final ScrollController _scrollCtrl = ScrollController();
  final DBService _db = DBService();
  final List<Map<String, String>> _messages = [];
  bool _loading = false;

  // ✅ UTILISER LA CLÉ DEPUIS .env
  static String get _apiKey => dotenv.env['ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'] ?? '';
  static const String _model = 'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ajouterMessageBienvenue();
    _verifierCleApi();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _msgCtrl.dispose();
    _scrollCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  // ✅ VÉRIFIER QUE LA CLÉ API EXISTE
  void _verifierCleApi() {
    if (_apiKey.isEmpty) {
      Logger.warning('⚠️ ANTHROPIC_API_KEY non définie dans .env');
      // ✅ CORRIGÉ : Pas de EnvService, on utilise directement _apiKey
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('⚠️ Mode simulation activé (Clé API manquante)'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
            duration: Duration(seconds: 3),
          ),
        );
      }
    } else {
      Logger.info('✅ ANTHROPIC_API_KEY chargée avec succès');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _ajouterMessageBienvenue() async {
    final user = _db.getUser();
    final prenom = user?['prenom'] ?? 'ami(e)';
    final monnaie = user?['monnaie'] ?? 'FCFA';
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final depMois = await _db.getTotalDepensesReelles(now.month, now.year);
    final revMois = await _db.getTotalRevenusReels(now.month, now.year);
    final soldeTotal = revMois - depMois;

    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _messages.add({
        'role': 'assistant',
        'content':
        'Bonjour $prenom ! 👋\n\n'
            'Je suis TAPA Coach, votre assistant financier personnel. '
            'Je suis là pour vous aider à mieux gérer votre argent, '
            'épargner intelligemment et construire votre avenir.\n\n'
            'Comment vous sentez-vous aujourd\'hui sur le plan financier ? '
            'Dites-moi ce qui vous préoccupe ou ce sur quoi vous voulez '
            'progresser. 💪'
      });
    });
  }

  Future<String> _construireContexte() async {
    final user = _db.getUser();
    final monnaie = user?['monnaie'] ?? 'FCFA';
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final depMois = await _db.getTotalDepensesReelles(now.month, now.year);
    final revMois = await _db.getTotalRevenusReels(now.month, now.year);
    final soldeTotal = revMois - depMois;
    final wallets = await _db.getWallets();
    final goals = _db.getSavingsGoals();

    String walletsStr = '';
    if (wallets.isNotEmpty) {
      final walletStrings = <String>[];
      for (final w in wallets) {
        walletStrings.add('${w.nom ?? 'Inconnu'}: ${(w.solde ?? 0).toStringAsFixed(0)} $monnaie');
            }
      walletsStr = walletStrings.join(', ');
    } else {
      walletsStr = 'Aucun portefeuille';
    }

    return '''Tu es TAPA Coach, un assistant financier personnel bienveillant et expert, 
intégré dans l'application TAPA Invest pour l'Afrique de l'Ouest.

TON RÔLE :
- Coach financier personnel chaleureux et accessible
- Éduquer sur la gestion financière, l'épargne, l'investissement
- Soutenir l'état d'esprit financier (mindset)
- Conseiller sur l'assurance vie, les FCP, le budget
- Parler en français simple et accessible
- Adapter tes conseils au contexte africain (Wave, Orange Money, BRVM, FCFA)
- Être encourageant et positif, jamais condescendant

CONTEXTE UTILISATEUR :
- Prénom : ${user?['prenom'] ?? 'Utilisateur'}
- Monnaie : $monnaie
- Solde total : ${soldeTotal.toStringAsFixed(0)} $monnaie
- Dépenses ce mois : ${depMois.toStringAsFixed(0)} $monnaie
- Revenus ce mois : ${revMois.toStringAsFixed(0)} $monnaie
- Portefeuilles : $walletsStr
- Objectifs épargne : ${goals.length} en cours

RÈGLES :
- Réponds toujours en français
- Sois chaleureux et empathique
- Donne des conseils concrets et applicables
- Utilise des exemples en FCFA et contexte africain
- Maximum 3-4 paragraphes par réponse
- Pose une question de suivi pour engager la conversation
- Ne jamais donner de conseils médicaux ou juridiques
- Si l'utilisateur semble stressé, rassure-le d'abord avant les conseils''';
  }

  // ✅ MÉTHODE _envoyer (CORRIGÉE)
  Future<void> _envoyer() async {
    final msg = _msgCtrl.text.trim();
    if (msg.isEmpty || _loading) return;

    setState(() {
      _messages.add({'role': 'user', 'content': msg});
      _loading = true;
    });
    _msgCtrl.clear();
    _scrollToBottom();

    try {
      final contexte = await _construireContexte();
      final messages = [
        {'role': 'user', 'content': contexte},
        {'role': 'assistant', 'content': 'Compris ! Je suis prêt à aider.'},
        ..._messages.map((m) => {'role': m['role']!, 'content': m['content']!}),
      ];

      // ✅ VÉRIFIER SI LA CLÉ API EXISTE
      if (_apiKey.isEmpty) {
        Logger.warning('⚠️ ANTHROPIC_API_KEY manquante - Utilisation du mode simulation');
        _reponseSimulee(msg);
        return;
      }

      // ✅ APPEL API AVEC LA CLÉ DEPUIS .env
      final response = await http.post(
        Uri.parse('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages'),
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01',
          'x-api-key': _apiKey, // ✅ UTILISATION DE LA CLÉ .env
        },
        body: jsonEncode({
          'model': _model,
          'max_tokens': 1000,
          'messages': messages,
        }),
      );

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final data = jsonDecode(response.body);
        final reponse = data['content'][0]['text'] as String;

        setState(() {
          _messages.add({'role': 'assistant', 'content': reponse});
          _loading = false;
        });
        _scrollToBottom();
      } else {
        final errorData = jsonDecode(response.body);
        final errorMessage = errorData['error']['message'] ?? 'Erreur inconnue';
        Logger.error('❌ API Erreur: ${response.statusCode} - $errorMessage');

        // ✅ GESTION D'ERREUR : Si erreur API, on utilise la simulation
        if (response.statusCode == 401) {
          Logger.error('❌ Clé API invalide ou expirée');
          _showApiKeyError();
        }
        _reponseSimulee(msg);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur connexion: $e');
      _reponseSimulee(msg);
    }
  }

  // ✅ AFFICHER UNE ERREUR SI LA CLÉ API EST INVALIDE
  void _showApiKeyError() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      const SnackBar(
        content: Text('❌ Clé API Anthropic invalide. Vérifiez votre fichier .env'),
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
        duration: Duration(seconds: 4),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ✅ RÉPONSE SIMULÉE (AMÉLIORÉE)
  void _reponseSimulee(String msg) {
    final user = _db.getUser();
    final prenom = user?['prenom'] ?? 'Utilisateur';

  void _scrollToBottom() {
    Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 300), () {
      if (_scrollCtrl.hasClients) {
        _scrollCtrl.animateTo(
            _scrollCtrl.position.maxScrollExtent,
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
            curve: Curves.easeOut);
      }
    });
  }

            ]));
  }

// lib/screens/transactions/scanner_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:google_mlkit_text_recognition/google_mlkit_text_recognition.dart';
import 'package:image_picker/image_picker.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../../../services/db_service_mysql.dart';
import '../../../data/models/models.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/formatters.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/logger.dart';

class ScannerScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ScannerScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<ScannerScreen> createState() => _ScannerScreenState();
}

class _ScannerScreenState extends State<ScannerScreen> {
  final DBService _db = DBService();
  final ImagePicker _picker = ImagePicker();
  final TextRecognizer _textRecognizer = TextRecognizer();
  bool _isProcessing = false;
  String _result = '';
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _detectedItems = [];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    // Initialiser le TextRecognizer
    _textRecognizer;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _textRecognizer.close();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _pickImage() async {
    final XFile? image = await _picker.pickImage(source: ImageSource.gallery);
    if (image == null) return;
    await _processImage(image);
  }

  Future<void> _takePhoto() async {
    final XFile? image = await _picker.pickImage(source: ImageSource.camera);
    if (image == null) return;
    await _processImage(image);
  }

  Future<void> _processImage(XFile image) async {
    // ✅ CORRECTION: Vérifier mounted avant setState
    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() {
      _isProcessing = true;
      _result = 'Analyse en cours...';
      _detectedItems = [];
    });

    try {
      final inputImage = InputImage.fromFilePath(image.path);
      final recognizedText = await _textRecognizer.processImage(inputImage);
      final text = recognizedText.text;

      // ✅ CORRECTION: Vérifier mounted après await
      if (!mounted) return;

      setState(() {
        _result = text;
        _detectedItems = _parseText(text);
        _isProcessing = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur analyse image: $e');

      // ✅ CORRECTION: Vérifier mounted après await
      if (!mounted) return;

      setState(() {
        _result = 'Erreur: $e';
        _isProcessing = false;
      });
    }
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _parseText(String text) {
    final items = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    final lines = text.split('\n');
    for (final line in lines) {
      final regExp = RegExp(r'(\d[\d\s]*\d|\d+)');
      final match = regExp.firstMatch(line);
      if (match != null) {
        final numStr = match.group(1)!.replaceAll(' ', '');
        final montant = double.tryParse(numStr);
        if (montant != null && montant > 0) {
          items.add({
            'montant': montant,
            'description': line.replaceAll(regExp, '').trim(),
          });
        }
      }
    }
    return items;
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // ✅ MÉTHODE CREATE TRANSACTION - COMPLÈTEMENT CORRIGÉE
  // ==========================================================
  Future<void> _createTransaction(Map<String, dynamic> item) async {
    final wallets = await _db.getWallets();

    // ✅ CORRECTION: Vérifier mounted avant d'utiliser context
    if (!mounted) return;

    if (wallets.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Créez d\'abord un portefeuille'),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final montant = item['montant'] as double;
    final description = item['description'] as String? ?? '';
    final userId = _db.getCurrentUserId() ?? '';

    final tx = TransactionModel(
      id: Fmt.genId(),
      uid: userId,
      walletId: wallets.first.id,
      montant: montant,
      type: TransactionType.depense,
      categorieId: 'autre',
      categorieLabel: 'Autre',
      categorieEmoji: '📌',
      note: description.isNotEmpty ? description : null,
      dateTransaction: DateTime.now(),
      createdAt: DateTime.now(),
    );

    await _db.addTransaction(tx);

    // ✅ CORRECTION: Vérifier mounted après await
    if (!mounted) return;

    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      const SnackBar(
        content: Text('Transaction enregistrée !'),
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.green,
      ),
    );
    context.pop(true);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final user = _db.getUser();
    final monnaie = user?['monnaie'] ?? 'FCFA';

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Scanner'),
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
        foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
      ),
      body: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                    onPressed: _isProcessing ? null : _pickImage,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.photo_library),
                    label: const Text('Galerie'),
                    style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                    onPressed: _isProcessing ? null : _takePhoto,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.camera_alt),
                    label: const Text('Appareil'),
                    style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.gold,
                      foregroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            if (_isProcessing) ...[
              const CircularProgressIndicator(),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              const Text('Analyse en cours...'),
            ],
            if (_result.isNotEmpty) ...[
              Expanded(
                child: SingleChildScrollView(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      const Text(
                        'Texte reconnu :',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                          color: TAPAColors.navy,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: TAPAColors.surface,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        ),
                        child: Text(
                          _result,
                          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      if (_detectedItems.isNotEmpty) ...[
                        const Text(
                          'Montants détectés :',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                            color: TAPAColors.navy,
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        ..._detectedItems.map((item) => Container(
                          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: TAPAColors.surface,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            border: Border.all(
                              color: TAPAColors.border,
                              width: 0.5,
                            ),
                          ),
                          child: Row(
                            children: [
                              Expanded(
                                child: Column(
                                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                  children: [
                                    Text(
                                      Fmt.montant(item['montant'], monnaie: monnaie),
                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                        fontSize: 16,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                        color: TAPAColors.red,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                    if (item['description'] != null &&
                                        item['description'].toString().isNotEmpty)
                                      Text(
                                        item['description'],
                                        style: const TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 12,
                                          color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                              IconButton(
                                icon: const Icon(
                                  Icons.add_circle_outline,
                                  color: TAPAColors.green,
                                ),
                                onPressed: () => _createTransaction(item),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        )),
                      ],
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
