// lib/screens/transactions/history_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:tapa_budget/presentation/providers/providers.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';

import '../../../data/models/models.dart';  // ✅ CORRIGÉ
import '../../../core/utils/constants.dart';

class HistoryScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const HistoryScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<HistoryScreen> createState() => _HistoryScreenState();
}

class _HistoryScreenState extends ConsumerState<HistoryScreen> {
  DateTime? _dateDebut;
  DateTime? _dateFin;
  String _filtre = 'tout';
  String _periode = 'tout';
  String? _filtreCategorie;
  int _refreshKey = 0;

  List<TransactionModel> get _transactions {
    final uid = ref.read(currentUserProvider)?.id ?? '';
    if (uid.isEmpty) return [];
    return ref.watch(transactionListProvider(uid)).value ?? [];
  }

  List<WalletModel> get _wallets {
    final uid = ref.read(currentUserProvider)?.id ?? '';
    if (uid.isEmpty) return [];
    return ref.watch(walletListProvider(uid)).value ?? [];
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get _categories =>
      ref.watch(allCategoriesProvider);

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadData();
  }

  Future<void> _loadData() async {
    // Les providers gerent le chargement automatiquement
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  List<TransactionModel> get _filteredTransactions {
    var txs = _transactions;
    if (_dateDebut != null) {
      txs = txs.where((t) => t.dateTransaction.isAfter(
          _dateDebut!.subtract(const Duration(days: 1)))).toList();
    }
    if (_dateFin != null) {
      txs = txs.where((t) => t.dateTransaction.isBefore(
          _dateFin!.add(const Duration(days: 1)))).toList();
    }
    if (_filtre == 'depenses') {
      txs = txs.where((t) => t.isDepense).toList();
    } else if (_filtre == 'revenus') {
      txs = txs.where((t) => t.isRevenu).toList();
    }
    if (_filtreCategorie != null) {
      txs = txs.where((t) => t.categorieId == _filtreCategorie).toList();
    }
    final now = DateTime.now();
    if (_periode == 'jour') {
      txs = txs.where((t) =>
      t.dateTransaction.year == now.year &&
          t.dateTransaction.month == now.month &&
          t.dateTransaction.day == now.day).toList();
    } else if (_periode == 'semaine') {
      final debut = now.subtract(const Duration(days: 7));
      txs = txs.where((t) => t.dateTransaction.isAfter(debut)).toList();
    } else if (_periode == 'mois') {
      txs = txs.where((t) =>
      t.dateTransaction.month == now.month &&
          t.dateTransaction.year == now.year).toList();
    }
    txs.sort((a, b) => b.dateTransaction.compareTo(a.dateTransaction));
    return txs;
  }

  void _modifier(TransactionModel tx) {
    final ctrl = TextEditingController(text: tx.montant.round().toString());
    DateTime selectedDate = tx.dateTransaction;
    final monnaie = ref.watch(userMonnaieProvider);
    final userCats = _categories;
    final catsRevenu = userCats.where((c) => c['type'] == 'revenu').toList();
    final catsDepense = userCats.where((c) => c['type'] == 'depense' || c['type'] == 'dépense').toList();
    final catsRevenuFinal = catsRevenu.isNotEmpty ? catsRevenu
        : AppConstants.categoriesRevenu.map((c) => {
      'id': c['id'] as String,
      'label': c['label'] as String,
      'emoji': c['emoji'] as String,
      'type': 'revenu'}).toList();
    final catsDepenseFinal = catsDepense.isNotEmpty ? catsDepense
        : AppConstants.categoriesDepense.map((c) => {
      'id': c['id'] as String,
      'label': c['label'] as String,
      'emoji': c['emoji'] as String,
      'type': 'depense'}).toList();
    final cats = tx.isRevenu ? catsRevenuFinal : catsDepenseFinal;
    var selCat = tx.categorieId;
    var selLabel = tx.categorieLabel;
    var selEmoji = tx.categorieEmoji;

    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setModal) => Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom),
          child: Container(
            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
              color: Colors.white,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
            ),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                Row(children: [
                  Text(selEmoji, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 24)),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  const Text('Modifier la transaction',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: Colors.black)),
                ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                TextField(
                  controller: ctrl,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                  inputFormatters: [FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly],
                  autofocus: true,
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Montant',
                    suffixText: monnaie,
                    border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  value: cats.any((c) => c['id'] == selCat) ? selCat : cats.first['id'] as String,
                  isExpanded: true,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Catégorie', border: OutlineInputBorder()),
                  items: cats.map((c) => DropdownMenuItem(
                    value: c['id'] as String,
                    child: Text('${c['emoji']} ${c['label']}'),
                  )).toList(),
                  onChanged: (v) {
                    if (v == null) return;
                    final cat = cats.firstWhere((c) => c['id'] == v);
                    setModal(() {
                      selCat = cat['id'] as String? ?? selCat;
                      selLabel = cat['label'] as String? ?? selLabel;
                      selEmoji = cat['emoji'] as String? ?? selEmoji;
                    });
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                GestureDetector(
                  onTap: () async {
                    final d = await showDatePicker(
                      context: ctx,
                      initialDate: selectedDate,
                      firstDate: DateTime(2020),
                      lastDate: DateTime.now(),
                    );
                    if (d != null) setModal(() => selectedDate = d);
                  },
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 14),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    ),
                    child: Row(children: [
                      const Icon(Icons.calendar_today_outlined, color: Colors.black, size: 18),
                      const SizedBox(width: 10),
                      Text(
                        '${selectedDate.day}/${selectedDate.month}/${selectedDate.year}',
                        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 15, color: Colors.black),
                      ),
                    ]),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                SizedBox(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  child: ElevatedButton(
                    onPressed: () async {
                      final montant = double.tryParse(ctrl.text) ?? tx.montant;
                      // ✅ CORRECTION : Utiliser le bon constructeur
                      final nouvelle = TransactionModel(
                        id: tx.id,
                        uid: tx.uid,
                        walletId: tx.walletId,
                        montant: montant,
                        type: tx.type,
                        categorieId: selCat,
                        categorieLabel: selLabel,
                        categorieEmoji: selEmoji,
                        note: tx.note,
                        dateTransaction: selectedDate,
                        createdAt: tx.createdAt,
                      );
                      try {
                        // TODO: Utiliser un provider
                        // await ref.read(transactionRepositoryProvider).updateTransaction(tx, nouvelle);
                        if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                        if (mounted) {
                          _loadData();
                          setState(() => _refreshKey++);
                          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                            const SnackBar(
                              content: Text('✅ Transaction modifiée !'),
                              backgroundColor: Colors.green,
                              duration: Duration(seconds: 2),
                            ),
                          );
                        }
                      } catch (e) {
                        if (ctx.mounted) {
                          ScaffoldMessenger.of(ctx).showSnackBar(
                            SnackBar(
                              content: Text(e.toString()),
                              backgroundColor: Colors.red,
                              duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
                            ),
                          );
                        }
                      }
                    },
                    style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: Colors.blue),
                    child: const Text('Enregistrer', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _supprimer(TransactionModel tx) async {
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Supprimer ?'),
        content: const Text('La transaction sera supprimée et le solde corrigé.'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Annuler'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text('Supprimer',
              style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (ok == true) {
      try {
        // TODO: Utiliser un provider
        // await ref.read(transactionRepositoryProvider).deleteTransaction(tx);
        if (mounted) {
          _loadData();
          setState(() => _refreshKey++);
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(
              content: Text('✅ Transaction supprimée !'),
              backgroundColor: Colors.green,
              duration: Duration(seconds: 2),
            ),
          );
        }
      } catch (e) {
        if (mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(content: Text(e.toString()), backgroundColor: Colors.red),
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }

  @override

    final txs = _filteredTransactions;

  Widget _filtreBtn(String label, String val, {bool isPeriode = false}) {
    final current = isPeriode ? _periode : _filtre;
    final isActive = current == val;
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () => setState(() {
        if (isPeriode) {
          _periode = val;
        } else {
          _filtre = val;
        }
      }),
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 150),
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 6),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isActive ? TAPAColors.gold : Colors.transparent,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          border: Border.all(color: isActive ? TAPAColors.gold : Colors.white30),
        ),
        child: Text(label,
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 12,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            color: isActive ? TAPAColors.navy : Colors.white70,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// lib/screens/transactions/add_transaction_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import 'package:tapa_budget/presentation/providers/providers.dart';
import '../../../data/models/models.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/formatters.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/logger.dart';
import '../../../domain/usecases/transaction/add_transaction_usecase.dart';

class AddTransactionScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const AddTransactionScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<AddTransactionScreen> createState() =>
      _AddTransactionScreenState();
}

class _AddTransactionScreenState extends ConsumerState<AddTransactionScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _montantCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _noteCtrl = TextEditingController();
  TransactionType _type = TransactionType.depense;
  String _categorieId = '';
  String _categorieLabel = '';
  String _categorieEmoji = '📌';
  String? _walletId;
  DateTime _date = DateTime.now();
  bool _saving = false;

  List<WalletModel> _wallets = [];
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _categories = [];
  bool _isLoading = true;
  bool _transitionReady = false;
  bool _listenerAttached = false;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  // Constantes de design
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  static const double _radius = 20;
  static const Duration _anim = Duration(milliseconds: 220);

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (mounted) _chargerDonnees();
    });
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    if (_listenerAttached) return;
    _listenerAttached = true;

    // Marquer la transition comme prete immediatement + timer de securite
    _transitionReady = true;
    Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 400), () {
      if (mounted && !_transitionReady) {
        setState(() => _transitionReady = true);
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _montantCtrl.dispose();
    _noteCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _chargerDonnees() async {
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    final uid = ref.read(currentUserProvider)?.id ?? '';
    try {
      // Charger depuis le stream Firestore
      if (uid.isNotEmpty) {
        _wallets = await ref.read(walletListProvider(uid).future);
      } else {
        _wallets = [];
      }



      Logger.info('DEBUG uid=$uid wallets=${_wallets.length} '
          'cats=${_categories.length} '
          'walletsIds=${_wallets.map((w) => w.id).toList()}');

      if (_wallets.isNotEmpty && _walletId == null) {
        _walletId = _wallets.first.id;
      }
      _syncCategorySelection();
    } catch (e, st) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur chargement données: $e\n$st');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get _filteredCats {
    return _type == TransactionType.revenu
        ? _categories.where((c) => c['type'] == 'revenu').toList()
        : _categories.where((c) => c['type'] == 'depense').toList();
  }

  void _syncCategorySelection() {
    final cats = _filteredCats;
    if (cats.isEmpty) {
      _categorieId = '';
      _categorieLabel = '';
      _categorieEmoji = '📌';
      return;
    }
    final stillValid = cats.any((c) => c['id'] == _categorieId);
    if (!stillValid) {
      final first = cats.first;
      _categorieId = first['id'] as String? ?? '';
      _categorieLabel = first['label'] as String? ?? 'Autre';
      _categorieEmoji = first['emoji'] as String? ?? '📌';
    }
  }

  void _selectType(TransactionType type) {
    if (_type == type) return;
    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
    setState(() {
      _type = type;
      _syncCategorySelection();
    });
  }

  void _selectCategory(Map<String, dynamic> cat) {
    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
    setState(() {
      _categorieId = cat['id'] as String? ?? '';
      _categorieLabel = cat['label'] as String? ?? 'Autre';
      _categorieEmoji = cat['emoji'] as String? ?? '📌';
    });
  }

  void _snack(String message, Color color) {
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
      ..hideCurrentSnackBar()
      ..showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            message,
            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
          ),
          backgroundColor: color,
          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
          margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 0, 20, 16),
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          ),
        ),
      );
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    final montant = double.tryParse(_montantCtrl.text);
    if (montant == null || montant <= 0) {
      _snack('Entrez un montant valide', TAPAColors.red);
      return;
    }
    if (_walletId == null || _walletId!.isEmpty) {
      _snack('Sélectionnez un portefeuille', TAPAColors.red);
      return;
    }
    if (_categorieId.isEmpty) {
      _snack('Sélectionnez une catégorie', TAPAColors.red);
      return;
    }

    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
    setState(() => _saving = true);

    try {
      final userId = ref.read(currentUserProvider)?.id ?? '';

      if (userId.isEmpty) {
        throw Exception('Utilisateur non connecté');
      }

      // Convertir TransactionType (modele) en TransactionTypeParam (usecase)
      TransactionTypeParam typeParam;
      switch (_type) {
        case TransactionType.revenu:
          typeParam = TransactionTypeParam.revenu;
          break;
        case TransactionType.transfert:
          typeParam = TransactionTypeParam.transfert;
          break;
        default:
          typeParam = TransactionTypeParam.depense;
      }

      final params = AddTransactionParams(
        uid: userId,
        walletId: _walletId!,
        montant: montant,
        type: typeParam,
        categorieId: _categorieId,
        categorieLabel: _categorieLabel,
        categorieEmoji: _categorieEmoji,
        note: _noteCtrl.text.trim().isEmpty ? null : _noteCtrl.text.trim(),
        dateTransaction: _date,
      );

      final result = await ref.read(addTransactionProvider(params).future);

      if (!result.success) {
        throw Exception(result.message ?? 'Erreur enregistrement');
      }

      Logger.info('Transaction enregistree + solde mis a jour: $montant');

      if (!mounted) return;
      HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
      _snack('Transaction enregistrée !', TAPAColors.green);
      context.pop(true);
    } catch (e, st) {
      Logger.error('❌ ECHEC ajout transaction: $e');
      Logger.error('Stack: $st');
      if (!mounted) return;
      _snack('Erreur lors de l\'enregistrement : $e', TAPAColors.red);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _saving = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _pickDate() async {
    final date = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: _date,
      firstDate: DateTime.now().subtract(const Duration(days: 365)),
      lastDate: DateTime.now(),
      builder: (context, child) => Theme(
        data: Theme.of(context).copyWith(
          colorScheme: const ColorScheme.light(
            primary: TAPAColors.navy,
            onPrimary: Colors.white,
            onSurface: TAPAColors.navy,
          ),
        ),
        child: child!,
      ),
    );
    if (date != null) setState(() => _date = date);
  }

  bool _sameDay(DateTime a, DateTime b) =>
      a.year == b.year && a.month == b.month && a.day == b.day;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  // Briques UI réutilisables
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------

  BoxDecoration _cardDecoration() => BoxDecoration(
    color: TAPAColors.surface,
    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(_radius),
    boxShadow: [
      BoxShadow(
        color: TAPAColors.navy.withOpacity(0.06),
        blurRadius: 16,
        offset: const Offset(0, 4),
      ),
    ],
  );

  Widget _typeTab({
    required String label,
    required IconData icon,
    required TransactionType type,
    required Color color,
    required bool blocked,

          ),
          child: Row(

            children: [

                icon,

                color: selected ? Colors.white : Colors.white60,

  Widget _buildCategoryChip(Map<String, dynamic> cat, Color accent) {
    final id = cat['id'] as String? ?? '';
    final label = cat['label'] as String? ?? 'Autre';
    final emoji = cat['emoji'] as String? ?? '📌';
    final selected = id == _categorieId;

    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () => _selectCategory(cat),
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: _anim,
        curve: Curves.easeOut,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: selected ? accent.withOpacity(0.12) : TAPAColors.background,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30),
          border: Border.all(
            color: selected ? accent : Colors.transparent,
            width: 1.5,
          ),
        ),
        child: Row(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Text(emoji, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 17, height: 1.0)),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Flexible(
              child: Text(
                label,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 13.5,
                  fontWeight: selected ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
                  color: selected ? accent : TAPAColors.navy,
                ),
              ),

          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCategories(List<Map<String, dynamic>> cats, Color accent) {
    if (!_transitionReady) return _skeleton(height: 120);
    if (cats.isEmpty) {
      return Container(
        width: double.infinity,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        decoration: _cardDecoration(),
        child: const Text(
          'Aucune catégorie disponible',
          style: TextStyle(color: TAPAColors.textSecond, fontSize: 14),
        ),
      );
    }
    return Container(
      width: double.infinity,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      decoration: _cardDecoration(),
      child: Wrap(
        spacing: 8,
        runSpacing: 8,
        children: cats.map((c) => _buildCategoryChip(c, accent)).toList(),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildWalletCard(WalletModel wallet, String monnaie, bool blocked) {
    final selected = wallet.id == _walletId;
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: blocked
          ? null
          : () {
        HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
        setState(() => _walletId = wallet.id);
      },
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: _anim,
        curve: Curves.easeOut,
        width: 168,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: selected ? TAPAColors.navy : TAPAColors.surface,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(_radius),
          border: Border.all(
            color: selected ? TAPAColors.gold : Colors.transparent,
            width: 1.5,
          ),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: TAPAColors.navy.withOpacity(selected ? 0.22 : 0.06),
              blurRadius: selected ? 18 : 12,
              offset: const Offset(0, 4),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Container(
                  width: 34,
                  height: 34,
                  alignment: Alignment.center,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: selected
                        ? Colors.white.withOpacity(0.12)
                        : TAPAColors.goldLight,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    wallet.emoji ?? '💳',
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 17, height: 1.0),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    wallet.nom ?? 'Portefeuille',
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 13.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      color: selected ? Colors.white : TAPAColors.navy,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                if (selected)
                  const Icon(Icons.check_circle,
                      size: 18, color: TAPAColors.gold),
              ],
            ),
            Text(
              Fmt.montant(wallet.solde, monnaie: monnaie),
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 15,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                color: selected ? TAPAColors.gold : TAPAColors.textSecond,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildWallets(String monnaie, bool blocked) {
    if (!_transitionReady) return _skeleton(height: 92);
    if (_wallets.isEmpty) {
      return Container(
        width: double.infinity,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        decoration: _cardDecoration(),
        child: const Text(
          'Aucun portefeuille',
          style: TextStyle(color: TAPAColors.textSecond, fontSize: 14),
        ),
      );
    }
    return SizedBox(
      height: 96,
      child: ListView.separated(
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        clipBehavior: Clip.none,
        itemCount: _wallets.length,
        separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const SizedBox(width: 12),
        itemBuilder: (_, i) => _buildWalletCard(_wallets[i], monnaie, blocked),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDate(bool blocked) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final isToday = _sameDay(_date, now);
    final isYesterday =
    _sameDay(_date, now.subtract(const Duration(days: 1)));
    final isCustom = !isToday && !isYesterday;

    return Container(
      width: double.infinity,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      decoration: _cardDecoration(),
      child: Wrap(
        spacing: 8,
        runSpacing: 8,
        children: [
          _dateChip(
            label: 'Aujourd\'hui',
            selected: isToday,
            onTap: blocked ? null : () => setState(() => _date = now),
          ),
          _dateChip(
            label: 'Hier',
            selected: isYesterday,
            onTap: blocked
                ? null
                : () => setState(
                    () => _date = now.subtract(const Duration(days: 1))),
          ),
          _dateChip(
            label: isCustom ? Fmt.dateComplete(_date) : 'Autre date',
            icon: Icons.calendar_today_outlined,
            selected: isCustom,
            onTap: blocked ? null : _pickDate,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBottomBar(bool blocked, Color accent) {
    final isRevenu = _type == TransactionType.revenu;
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 14, 20, 14),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: TAPAColors.surface,
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: TAPAColors.navy.withOpacity(0.08),
            blurRadius: 20,
            offset: const Offset(0, -4),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: SafeArea(

        child: SizedBox(
          width: double.infinity,
          height: 56,
          child: ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: (blocked || _saving) ? null : _save,
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: accent,
              foregroundColor: Colors.white,
              disabledBackgroundColor: accent.withOpacity(0.4),
              disabledForegroundColor: Colors.white70,
              elevation: 0,
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
              ),
            ),
            child: AnimatedSwitcher(
              duration: _anim,
              child: _saving
                  ? const SizedBox(
                key: ValueKey('loading'),
                width: 24,
                height: 24,
                child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                  strokeWidth: 2.5,
                  color: Colors.white,
                ),
              )
                  : Row(
                key: ValueKey(isRevenu),
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    isRevenu
                        ? Icons.add_circle_outline_rounded
                        : Icons.remove_circle_outline_rounded,
                    size: 22,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Text(
                    isRevenu
                        ? 'Enregistrer le revenu'
                        : 'Enregistrer la dépense',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 16,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  // BUILD
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // ✅ On écoute les catégories en temps réel
    // ✅ Utiliser le StreamProvider temps réel
    final dynamicCatsAsync = ref.watch(dynamicCategoriesProvider);
    final allCats = dynamicCatsAsync.valueOrNull ?? [];
    // Filtrer selon le type (depense ou revenu)
    final typeFilter = _type == TransactionType.revenu ? 'revenu' : 'depense';
    _categories = allCats.where((c) => c['type'] == typeFilter).toList();

    final monnaie = ref.watch(userMonnaieProvider);
    final filteredCats = _filteredCats;
    final noWallets = _wallets.isEmpty;
    final noCats = filteredCats.isEmpty;
    final blocked = noWallets || noCats;
    final accent =
    _type == TransactionType.revenu ? TAPAColors.green : TAPAColors.red;

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text(
          'Nouvelle transaction',
          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 17),
        ),
        centerTitle: true,
        elevation: 0,
        scrolledUnderElevation: 0,
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
        foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded),
          onPressed: () => context.pop(false),
        ),
      ),
      bottomNavigationBar: _buildBottomBar(blocked, accent),
      body: Stack(
        children: [
          GestureDetector(
            behavior: HitTestBehavior.translucent,
            onTap: () => FocusScope.of(context).unfocus(),
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              keyboardDismissBehavior:
              ScrollViewKeyboardDismissBehavior.onDrag,
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  _buildHeader(monnaie, blocked),
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 24, 20, 24),
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        if (blocked) _buildBlockedBanner(noWallets),

                        _sectionTitle('Catégorie'),
                        _buildCategories(filteredCats, accent),

                        const SizedBox(height: 24),

                        _sectionTitle('Portefeuille'),
                        _buildWallets(monnaie, blocked),

                        const SizedBox(height: 24),

                        _sectionTitle('Date'),
                        _buildDate(blocked),

                        const SizedBox(height: 24),

                        _sectionTitle('Note', trailing: const Text(
                          'Optionnelle',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 12,
                            color: TAPAColors.textHint,
                          ),
                        )),
                        _buildNote(blocked),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          if (_isLoading || !_transitionReady)
            Positioned.fill(
              child: Container(
                color: TAPAColors.background.withOpacity(0.85),
                child: const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class ScoreScreen extends StatefulWidget {

  State<ScoreScreen> createState() => _ScoreScreenState();

class _ScoreScreenState extends State<ScoreScreen> {
  late Future<ScoreTAPA> _scoreFuture;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final db = DBService();
    _scoreFuture = ScoreService.calculer(db);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Score TAPA'),
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
        foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios),
          onPressed: () => context.pop(),
        ),
      ),
      body: FutureBuilder<ScoreTAPA>(
        future: _scoreFuture,
        builder: (context, snapshot) {
          if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
            return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
          }
          if (snapshot.hasError) {
            return Center(
              child: Column(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  const Icon(Icons.error_outline, size: 48, color: TAPAColors.red),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  Text('Erreur: ${snapshot.error}'),
                ],
              ),
            );
          }
          if (!snapshot.hasData) {
            return const Center(child: Text('Aucune donnée'));
          }

          final score = snapshot.data!;
          return _buildScoreContent(score);
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildScoreContent(ScoreTAPA score) {
    Color scoreColor;
    if (score.scoreTotal >= 80) {
      scoreColor = TAPAColors.green;

    else if (score.scoreTotal >= 40) scoreColor = TAPAColors.amber;
    else if (score.scoreTotal >= 20) scoreColor = Colors.orange;
    else scoreColor = TAPAColors.red;

      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      children: [
        // Score principal

                alignment: Alignment.center,
                children: [
                  SizedBox(
                    width: 140,
                    height: 140,
                    child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                      value: score.scoreTotal / 100,
                      strokeWidth: 12,
                      backgroundColor: Colors.white12,
                      valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(scoreColor),
                    ),
                  ),
                  Column(

                      Text(
                        '${score.scoreTotal}',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 42,

                      const Text(
                        '/100',
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Colors.white54),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 8),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: scoreColor.withOpacity(0.2),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                  border: Border.all(color: scoreColor),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  score.niveau,
                  style: TextStyle(

  Widget _criterCard(String label, int score, int max, IconData icon, Color color) {
    final pct = score / max;
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: TAPAColors.surface,

      ),

              Container(
                width: 36,
                height: 36,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: color.withOpacity(0.1),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                ),
                child: Icon(icon, color: color, size: 18),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  label,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 14,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    color: TAPAColors.navy,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              Text(
                '$score/$max',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 14,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                  color: color,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
            child: LinearProgressIndicator(
              value: pct,
              minHeight: 6,
              backgroundColor: TAPAColors.border,
              valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(color),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

  // ==========================================================
  // ✅ MÉTHODE AJOUTER CATÉGORIE - COMPLÈTEMENT CORRIGÉE
  // ==========================================================
  Future<void> _ajouterCategorie(BuildContext context) async {
    final nom = _nomCtrl.text.trim();

    // ✅ CORRECTION: Vérifier mounted avant d'utiliser context
    if (!mounted) return;

    if (nom.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Veuillez entrer un nom'),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final emoji = _emojiCtrl.text.trim().isEmpty ? '📌' : _emojiCtrl.text.trim();
    final type = _tabController.index == 0 ? 'depense' : 'revenu';

    // ✅ CORRECTION: Vérifier mounted avant d'utiliser context
    if (!mounted) return;

    final existe = _categories.any((c) =>
    c['label']?.toLowerCase() == nom.toLowerCase() && c['type'] == type
    );

    if (existe) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('La catégorie "$nom" existe déjà'),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    try {
      final userId = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.uid;
      if (userId == null) throw Exception('Utilisateur non connecté');

      final nouvelleCategorie = {
        'uid': userId,
        'label': nom,
        'emoji': emoji,
        'type': type,
        'isDefault': false,
        'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      };

      Logger.info('📝 Ajout catégorie: $nouvelleCategorie');
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('categories').add(nouvelleCategorie);

      // ✅ CORRECTION: Vérifier mounted après chaque await
      if (!mounted) return;
      Navigator.pop(context);

      // ✅ CORRECTION: Vérifier mounted avant d'utiliser context
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('✅ Catégorie "$nom" ajoutée !'),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.green,
        ),
      );
    } catch (e) {
      // ✅ CORRECTION: Vérifier mounted avant d'utiliser context
      if (!mounted) return;
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur ajout catégorie: $e');
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('❌ Erreur: ${e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '')}'),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // SUPPRIMER CATÉGORIE - AVEC VÉRIFICATION mounted
  // ==========================================================
  Future<void> _supprimerCategorie(String id) async {
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Supprimer ?'),
        content: const Text('Cette catégorie sera supprimée.'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Annuler'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text(
              'Supprimer',
              style: TextStyle(color: TAPAColors.red),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirm == true) {
      try {
        await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('categories').doc(id).delete();
  
        // ✅ CORRECTION: Vérifier mounted avant d'utiliser context
        if (!mounted) return;

        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('✅ Catégorie supprimée'),
            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.green,
          ),
        );
      } catch (e) {
        // ✅ CORRECTION: Vérifier mounted avant d'utiliser context
        if (!mounted) return;
        Logger.error('❌ Erreur suppression catégorie: $e');
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Erreur: ${e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '')}'),
            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // ✅ Lire les catégories en temps réel
    final dynamicCatsAsync = ref.watch(dynamicCategoriesProvider);

    // ✅ Gérer le chargement avec un fallback : si le stream met trop de temps
    // ou est en erreur, on affiche les catégories par défaut.
    final allCats = dynamicCatsAsync.valueOrNull ?? [];
    _categories = allCats;

    // On ne bloque plus sur isLoading : on affiche toujours l'UI
    // avec les données disponibles (par défaut ou Firestore).

    final cats = _filteredCategories;

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Mes catégories'),
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
        foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios),
          onPressed: () => context.pop(),
        ),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.add, color: TAPAColors.gold),
            onPressed: _showAjoutDialog,
          ),
        ],
        bottom: TabBar(
          controller: _tabController,
          tabs: const [
            Tab(text: 'Dépenses'),
            Tab(text: 'Revenus'),
          ],
          indicatorColor: TAPAColors.gold,
          labelColor: TAPAColors.gold,
          unselectedLabelColor: Colors.white54,
          onTap: (_) => setState(() {}),
        ),
      ),
      body: cats.isEmpty
          ? _buildEmptyState()
          : _buildCategoryList(cats),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildEmptyState() {
    return Center(
      child: Column(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        children: [
          const Icon(
            Icons.category_outlined,
            size: 60,
            color: TAPAColors.textHint,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          const Text(
            'Aucune catégorie',
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 16,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: TAPAColors.navy,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
            _tabController.index == 0
                ? 'Ajoutez des catégories de dépenses'
                : 'Ajoutez des catégories de revenus',
            style: const TextStyle(color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 24),
          ElevatedButton.icon(
            onPressed: _showAjoutDialog,
            icon: const Icon(Icons.add, color: TAPAColors.gold),
            label: const Text('Ajouter une catégorie'),
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCategoryList(List<Map<String, dynamic>> cats) {
    return ListView.builder(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      itemCount: cats.length,
      itemBuilder: (ctx, i) {
        final c = cats[i];
        final isDefault = c['isDefault'] == true;

        return Container(
          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: TAPAColors.surface,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            border: Border.all(
              color: isDefault ? TAPAColors.gold.withOpacity(0.3) : TAPAColors.border,
              width: isDefault ? 1.5 : 0.5,
            ),
          ),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              Text(
                c['emoji'] ?? '📌',
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 24),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      c['label'] ?? '',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 14,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        color: TAPAColors.navy,
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (isDefault)
                      const Text(
                        'Défaut',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 10,
                          color: TAPAColors.gold,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              if (!isDefault)
                IconButton(
                  icon: const Icon(
                    Icons.delete_outline,
                    color: TAPAColors.textHint,
                    size: 20,
                  ),
                  onPressed: () => _supprimerCategorie(c['id'] as String),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

// lib/presentation/screens/profile/historique_paiements_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/formatters.dart';
import '../../../data/models/models.dart';
import '../../providers/providers.dart';

class HistoriquePaiementsScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const HistoriquePaiementsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<HistoriquePaiementsScreen> createState() =>
      _HistoriquePaiementsScreenState();
}

class _HistoriquePaiementsScreenState
    extends ConsumerState<HistoriquePaiementsScreen> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      final user = ref.read(currentUserProvider);
      if (user != null) {
        ref
            .read(souscriptionsStateProvider.notifier)
            .loadSouscriptions(user.id);
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = ref.watch(souscriptionsStateProvider);
    final user = ref.watch(currentUserProvider);
    final monnaie = user?.monnaie ?? 'FCFA';

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Historique des paiements'),
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
        foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios),
          onPressed: () => context.pop(),
        ),
      ),
      body: RefreshIndicator(
        onRefresh: () async {
          if (user != null) {
            await ref
                .read(souscriptionsStateProvider.notifier)
                .loadSouscriptions(user.id);
          }
        },
        child: _buildBody(state, monnaie),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBody(SouscriptionsState state, String monnaie) {
    if (state.isLoading && state.souscriptions.isEmpty) {
      return const Center(
        child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: TAPAColors.gold),
      );
    }

    if (state.error != null && state.souscriptions.isEmpty) {
      return Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              const Icon(Icons.error_outline,
                  size: 60, color: TAPAColors.red),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              Text(
                state.error!,
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: const TextStyle(color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  final user = ref.read(currentUserProvider);
                  if (user != null) {
                    ref
                        .read(souscriptionsStateProvider.notifier)
                        .loadSouscriptions(user.id);
                  }
                },
                child: const Text('Reessayer'),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    if (state.souscriptions.isEmpty) {
      return Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              Container(
                width: 100,
                height: 100,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: TAPAColors.gold.withOpacity(0.15),
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                ),
                child: const Icon(
                  Icons.receipt_long_outlined,
                  size: 50,
                  color: TAPAColors.gold,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 20),
              const Text(
                'Aucun paiement',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 18,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                  color: TAPAColors.navy,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              const Text(
                'Vos souscriptions et paiements apparaitront ici.',
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 13,
                  color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return ListView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      children: [
        _carteTotaux(state, monnaie),
        const SizedBox(height: 20),
        const Text(
          'Historique',
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 15,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
            color: TAPAColors.navy,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        ...state.souscriptions.map((s) => _carteSouscription(s, monnaie)),
        const SizedBox(height: 20),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _carteTotaux(SouscriptionsState state, String monnaie) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: const LinearGradient(
          colors: [TAPAColors.navy, Color(0xFF14274E)],
          begin: Alignment.topLeft,
          end: Alignment.bottomRight,
        ),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          const Text(
            'Total paye',
            style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 12),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
            Fmt.montant(state.montantTotal, monnaie: monnaie),
            style: const TextStyle(
              color: TAPAColors.white,
              fontSize: 26,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Row(
            children: [
              _badge('${state.totalEnCours} en cours', TAPAColors.gold),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              _badge('${state.totalPayees} payees', TAPAColors.green),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _badge(String texte, Color couleur) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: couleur.withOpacity(0.2),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
      ),
      child: Text(
        texte,
        style: TextStyle(
          fontSize: 11,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
          color: couleur,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _carteSouscription(SouscriptionModel s, String monnaie) {
    final couleur = s.estEnCours
        ? TAPAColors.gold
        : (s.estPayee ? TAPAColors.green : TAPAColors.red);

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: TAPAColors.surface,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        border: Border.all(color: TAPAColors.border, width: 0.5),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Container(
                width: 40,
                height: 40,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: couleur.withOpacity(0.15),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                ),
                child: Icon(
                  s.estEnCours ? Icons.hourglass_empty : Icons.check_circle,
                  color: couleur,
                  size: 20,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      s.produitNom,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 14,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        color: TAPAColors.navy,
                      ),
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                    Text(
                      s.reference,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 11,
                        color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                      ),
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    Fmt.montant(s.montant, monnaie: monnaie),
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 14,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      color: TAPAColors.navy,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 8, vertical: 2),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: couleur.withOpacity(0.15),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      s.estEnCours ? 'En cours' : (s.estPayee ? 'Payee' : 'Annulee'),
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 10,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        color: couleur,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
            '${s.dateCreation.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${s.dateCreation.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${s.dateCreation.year}',
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 11,
              color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class ProfileScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const ProfileScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<ProfileScreen> createState() => _ProfileScreenState();
}

class _ProfileScreenState extends ConsumerState<ProfileScreen> {
  int _selectedIndex = 5;

  // ============================================
  // ACTIONS (inchangées)
  // ============================================
  Future<void> _reinitialiser() async {
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text(
          'Réinitialiser ?',
          style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
        ),
        content: const SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Text(
            'Toutes tes données seront effacées :\n'
                '- Portefeuilles et soldes\n'
                '- Transactions\n'
                '- Objectifs épargne\n'
                '- Ton profil\n\n'
                'Cette action est irréversible.',
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Annuler'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text(
              'Réinitialiser',
              style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (confirm != true) return;
    await ref.read(authStateProvider.notifier).deleteAccount();
    if (mounted) context.go('/inscription');
  }

  Future<void> _deconnecter() async {
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text(
          'Se déconnecter ?',
          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
        ),
        content: const Text(
          'Tes données restent sauvegardées.\n'
              'Tu pourras te reconnecter avec ton PIN.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Annuler'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text(
              'Se déconnecter',
              style: TextStyle(
                  color: TAPAColors.navy, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (confirm != true) return;
    await ref.read(authStateProvider.notifier).logout();
    if (mounted) context.go('/inscription');
  }

  void _navigateTo(String route, int index) {
    setState(() => _selectedIndex = index);
    context.go(route);
  }

  // ============================================
  // BUILD
  // ============================================
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final user = ref.watch(currentUserProvider);
    Logger.info('DEBUG User: id=${user?.id}, email="${user?.email}", phone="${user?.phoneNumber}"');
    Logger.info('DEBUG EstAdmin? ${user?.id == 'YkqBGtNLqWVYR3GuVDYqvmmqY1I2'}');
    final prenom = ref.watch(userPrenomProvider);
    final monnaie = ref.watch(userMonnaieProvider);

    Logger.info('👤 ProfileScreen - user: ${user?.prenom ?? "null"}');

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
      body: SingleChildScrollView(
        physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            _buildHeader(
              prenom: prenom,
              phone: user?.phoneNumber ?? '',
              monnaie: monnaie,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),

            // ---- Section Découvrir ----
            _sectionTitle('DÉCOUVRIR'),
            _group([
              _menuItem(
                icon: Icons.alarm_outlined,
                iconColor: const Color(0xFFE67E22),
                bgColor: const Color(0xFFFEF9E7),
                title: 'Mes échéances',
                subtitle: 'Rappels automatiques pour tes échéances',
                onTap: () => context.push('/echeances'),
              ),
            ]),

            // ---- Section Admin ----
            _sectionTitle('ADMINISTRATION'),
            _group([
              _menuItem(
                icon: Icons.admin_panel_settings,
                iconColor: TAPAColors.red,
                bgColor: Colors.red.shade50,
                title: 'Demandes de retrait',
                subtitle: 'Gérer les retraits en attente',
                onTap: () => context.push('/admin/withdraws'),
              ),
            ]),

            // ---- Section Mon compte ----
            _sectionTitle('MON COMPTE'),
            _group([
              _menuItem(
                icon: Icons.account_balance_wallet,
                iconColor: TAPAColors.gold,
                bgColor: Colors.amber.shade50,
                title: 'Mon Wallet',
                subtitle: 'Ajouter des fonds pour investir',
                onTap: () => context.push('/wallet'),
              ),
              _menuItem(
                icon: Icons.account_balance_wallet_outlined,
                title: 'Mes portefeuilles',
                subtitle: 'Ajouter, modifier, supprimer',

  // ============================================
  // TITRE DE SECTION
  // ============================================
  Widget _sectionTitle(String title, {Color color = Colors.grey}) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 18, 24, 8),
      child: Text(
        title,
        maxLines: 1,
        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
        style: TextStyle(
          fontSize: 11,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
          color: color == Colors.grey ? Colors.grey.shade600 : color,
          letterSpacing: 1.2,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================
  // GROUPE DE MENUS (une carte, séparateurs fins)
  // ============================================
  Widget _group(List<Widget> items, {Color? borderColor}) {
    final children = <Widget>[];
    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
      children.add(items[i]);
      if (i < items.length - 1) {
        children.add(Divider(
          height: 1,
          thickness: 0.8,
          indent: 66,
          endIndent: 14,
          color: Colors.grey.shade200,
        ));
      }
    }

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: TAPAColors.surface,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        border: Border.all(
          color: borderColor ?? Colors.grey.shade200,
          width: 0.8,
        ),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.04),
            blurRadius: 10,
            offset: const Offset(0, 3),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: ClipRRect(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        child: Material(
          color: Colors.transparent,
          child: Column(children: children),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================
  // ÉLÉMENT DE MENU
  // ============================================
  Widget _menuItem({
    required IconData icon,
    required String title,
    String? subtitle,
    Color iconColor = TAPAColors.navy,
    Color bgColor = const Color(0xFFF0F2F8),
    required VoidCallback onTap,
    Widget? trailing,
  }) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: onTap,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Container(
              width: 40,
              height: 40,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: bgColor,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              ),
              child: Icon(icon, color: iconColor, size: 20),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    title,
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 14,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      color: TAPAColors.navy,
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (subtitle != null && subtitle.isNotEmpty) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(
                      subtitle,
                      maxLines: 2,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 11.5,
                        color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                        height: 1.25,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            trailing ??
                Icon(
                  Icons.chevron_right_rounded,
                  size: 22,
                  color: Colors.grey.shade400,
                ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================
  // BARRE DE NAVIGATION INFÉRIEURE
  // ============================================
  Widget _buildBottomNavigationBar() {
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.06),
            blurRadius: 12,
            offset: const Offset(0, -3),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: 6),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.home_outlined,
                activeIcon: Icons.home,
                label: 'Accueil',
                index: 0,
                route: '/home',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.shield_outlined,
                activeIcon: Icons.shield,
                label: 'Assurance',
                index: 1,
                route: '/investir/assurance',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.account_balance_wallet_outlined,
                activeIcon: Icons.account_balance_wallet,
                label: 'Enveloppe',
                index: 2,
                route: '/savings',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.pie_chart_outline,
                activeIcon: Icons.pie_chart,
                label: 'Budget',
                index: 3,
                route: '/budget',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.credit_card_outlined,
                activeIcon: Icons.credit_card,
                label: 'Dettes',
                index: 4,
                route: '/dettes',
              ),
              _buildNavItem(
                icon: Icons.person_outline,
                activeIcon: Icons.person,
                label: 'Profil',
                index: 5,
                route: '/profile',
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildNavItem({
    required IconData icon,
    required IconData activeIcon,
    required String label,
    required int index,
    required String route,
  }) {
    final isActive = _selectedIndex == index;
    return Expanded(
      child: GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTap: () => _navigateTo(route, index),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            AnimatedContainer(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 260),
              curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
              width: isActive ? 46 : 36,
              height: 30,
              alignment: Alignment.center,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: isActive
                    ? const LinearGradient(
                  colors: [Color(0xFF1A237E), Color(0xFF0D1444)],
                  begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                  end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                )
                    : null,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),
                boxShadow: isActive
                    ? [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: const Color(0xFF1A237E).withOpacity(0.35),
                    blurRadius: 10,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 4),
                  ),
                ]
                    : null,
              ),
              child: Icon(
                isActive ? activeIcon : icon,
                size: isActive ? 20 : 20,
                color: isActive ? Colors.amber : Colors.grey.shade500,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(
              label,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 10,
                fontWeight: isActive ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
                color: isActive
                    ? const Color(0xFF1A237E)
                    : Colors.grey.shade500,
              ),
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
