// lib/screens/profile/edit_profile_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/constants.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/logger.dart';
import 'package:tapa_budget/presentation/providers/providers.dart';

class EditProfileScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const EditProfileScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<EditProfileScreen> createState() => _EditProfileScreenState();
}

class _EditProfileScreenState extends ConsumerState<EditProfileScreen> {
  late TextEditingController _prenomCtrl;
  late String _monnaie;
  late String _codePays;
  bool _isLoading = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final user = ref.read(currentUserProvider);
    _prenomCtrl = TextEditingController(text: user?.prenom ?? '');
    _monnaie = user?.monnaie ?? 'FCFA';
    _codePays = user?.codePays ?? 'CI';
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _prenomCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    final user = ref.read(currentUserProvider);
    if (user == null) {
      _showSnackBar('Utilisateur non trouvé', isError: true);
      return;
    }

    final newPrenom = _prenomCtrl.text.trim();
    if (newPrenom.isEmpty) {
      _showSnackBar('Le prénom ne peut pas être vide', isError: true);
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _isLoading = true);

    try {
      // ✅ CORRECTION: Appeler avec des paramètres nommés
      final authNotifier = ref.read(authStateProvider.notifier);
      await authNotifier.updateUserProfile(
        prenom: newPrenom,
        monnaie: _monnaie,
        codePays: _codePays,
      );

      if (mounted) {
        _showSnackBar('✅ Profil mis à jour avec succès');
        context.pop();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        _showSnackBar('Erreur: ${e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '')}', isError: true);
      }
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur mise à jour profil: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  void _showSnackBar(String message, {bool isError = false}) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(message),
        backgroundColor: isError ? TAPAColors.red : TAPAColors.green,
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final user = ref.watch(currentUserProvider);
    final isSmall = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width < 360;
    final isTablet = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width >= 600;
    final paddingSize = isSmall ? 12.0 : (isTablet ? 24.0 : 16.0);

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Modifier mon profil'),
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
        foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios),
          onPressed: () => context.pop(),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: _isLoading ? null : _save,
            child: _isLoading
                ? const SizedBox(
              width: 20,
              height: 20,
              child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                strokeWidth: 2,
                color: TAPAColors.gold,
              ),
            )
                : const Text(
              'Sauver',
              style: TextStyle(
                color: TAPAColors.gold,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: ListView(
        padding: EdgeInsets.all(paddingSize),
        children: [
          // Prénom
          const Text(
            'Mon prénom',
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 12,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          TextField(
            controller: _prenomCtrl,
            textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,
            decoration: const InputDecoration(
              hintText: 'ex : Kouassi',
              prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.person_outline),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),

          // Monnaie
          const Text(
            'Ma monnaie',
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 12,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          GridView.builder(
            shrinkWrap: true,
            physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
            gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
              crossAxisCount: 2,
              childAspectRatio: 2.5,
              crossAxisSpacing: 10,
              mainAxisSpacing: 10,
            ),
            itemCount: AppConstants.monnaies.length,
            itemBuilder: (ctx, i) {
              final m = AppConstants.monnaies[i];
              final sel = _monnaie == m['symbole'];
              return GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => setState(() => _monnaie = m['symbole']!),
                child: AnimatedContainer(
                  duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 150),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: sel ? TAPAColors.navy : TAPAColors.surface,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: sel ? TAPAColors.gold : TAPAColors.border,
                      width: sel ? 2 : 0.5,
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        m['symbole']!,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 14,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                          color: sel ? TAPAColors.gold : TAPAColors.navy,
                        ),
                      ),
                      Text(
                        m['nom']!,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 10,
                          color: sel ? Colors.white60 : TAPAColors.textSecond,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),

          // Pays
          DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
            value: _codePays,
            decoration: const InputDecoration(
              labelText: 'Mon pays',
            ),
            items: AppConstants.pays.map((p) =>
                DropdownMenuItem<String>(
                  value: p['code'] as String,
                  child: Text('${p['flag']} ${p['nom']}'),
                ),
            ).toList(),
            onChanged: (v) {
              if (v == null) return;
              final p = AppConstants.pays.firstWhere((p) => p['code'] == v);
              setState(() {
                _codePays = v;
                _monnaie = p['monnaie']!;
              });
            },
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),

          // Téléphone (lecture seule)
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: TAPAColors.surface,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              border: Border.all(color: TAPAColors.border),
            ),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.phone_outlined, color: TAPAColors.textHint),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      const Text(
                        'Téléphone',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11,
                          color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                        ),
                      ),
                      Text(
                        user?.phoneNumber ?? '',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 14,
                          color: TAPAColors.navy,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),

          const SizedBox(height: 32),

          // Bouton Enregistrer
          SizedBox(
            width: double.infinity,
            child: ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: _isLoading ? null : _save,
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
              ),
              child: _isLoading
                  ? const SizedBox(
                width: 20,
                height: 20,
                child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                  strokeWidth: 2,
                  color: TAPAColors.gold,
                ),
              )
                  : const Text(
                'Enregistrer les modifications',
                style: TextStyle(color: TAPAColors.white),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

FICHIER : lib/presentation/screens/profile/change_pin_screen.dart

// lib/screens/profile/change_pin_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../../../services/db_service_mysql.dart';

class ChangePinScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ChangePinScreen({super.key});
  @override
  State<ChangePinScreen> createState() => _ChangePinScreenState();
}

class _ChangePinScreenState extends State<ChangePinScreen> {
  final DBService _db = DBService();
  String _ancien = '';
  String _nouveau = '';
  String _confirm = '';
  int _step = 0;
  bool _error = false;
  String _errorMsg = '';
  bool _isLoading = false;

  void _press(String d) {
    if (_isLoading) return;
    setState(() => _error = false);
    if (_step == 0 && _ancien.length < 4) {
      setState(() => _ancien += d);
      if (_ancien.length == 4) {
        Future.delayed(
            const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
            _validateAncien);
      }
    } else if (_step == 1 && _nouveau.length < 4) {
      setState(() => _nouveau += d);
      if (_nouveau.length == 4) {
        Future.delayed(
            const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
                () => setState(() => _step = 2));
      }
    } else if (_step == 2 && _confirm.length < 4) {
      setState(() => _confirm += d);
      if (_confirm.length == 4) {
        Future.delayed(
            const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
            _validerNouveau);
      }
    }
  }

  void _delete() {
    if (_isLoading) return;
    if (_step == 0 && _ancien.isNotEmpty) {
      setState(() => _ancien =
          _ancien.substring(0, _ancien.length - 1));
    } else if (_step == 1 && _nouveau.isNotEmpty) {
      setState(() => _nouveau =
          _nouveau.substring(0, _nouveau.length - 1));
    } else if (_step == 2 && _confirm.isNotEmpty) {
      setState(() => _confirm =
          _confirm.substring(0, _confirm.length - 1));
    }
  }

  // ✅ CORRIGÉ : utilise async/await
  Future<void> _validateAncien() async {
    if (_isLoading) return;
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);

    try {
      final isValid = await _db.verifyPin(_ancien);

      if (isValid) {
        setState(() {
          _step = 1;
          _isLoading = false;
          _error = false;
        });
      } else {
        setState(() {
          _ancien = '';
          _error = true;
          _errorMsg = 'Code incorrect. Réessaie.';
          _isLoading = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setState(() {
        _ancien = '';
        _error = true;
        _errorMsg = 'Erreur: ${e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '')}';
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _validerNouveau() async {
    if (_isLoading) return;
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);

    if (_nouveau != _confirm) {
      setState(() {
        _nouveau = '';
        _confirm = '';
        _step = 1;
        _error = true;
        _errorMsg = 'Les codes ne correspondent pas.';
        _isLoading = false;
      });
      return;
    }

    try {
      await _db.savePin(_nouveau);

      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('PIN modifié avec succès !'),
            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.green,
          ),
        );
        context.pop();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setState(() {
        _error = true;
        _errorMsg = 'Erreur: ${e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '')}';
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  String get _currentPin {
    if (_step == 0) return _ancien;
    if (_step == 1) return _nouveau;
    return _confirm;
  }

  String get _title {
    if (_step == 0) return 'Entre ton ancien code';
    if (_step == 1) return 'Choisis ton nouveau code';
    return 'Confirme ton nouveau code';
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
      appBar: AppBar(
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
          foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
          title: const Text('Changer mon PIN')),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Column(children: [
          const SizedBox(height: 30),
          Text(_title,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 20,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                  color: TAPAColors.white)),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets
                .symmetric(horizontal: 40),
            child: ClipRRect(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                    value: (_step + 1) / 3,
                    backgroundColor: Colors.white12,
                    valueColor:
                    const AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(
                        TAPAColors.gold))),
          ),
          if (_error) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(_errorMsg,
                style: const TextStyle(
                    color: TAPAColors.red,
                    fontSize: 12)),
          ],
          if (_isLoading) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            const CircularProgressIndicator(
              color: TAPAColors.gold,
              strokeWidth: 2,
            ),
          ],
          const SizedBox(height: 32),
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment:
            MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: List.generate(4, (i) =>
                Container(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets
                      .symmetric(horizontal: 10),
                  width: 18, height: 18,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      color: i < _currentPin.length
                          ? TAPAColors.gold
                          : Colors.transparent,
                      border: Border.all(
                          color: i < _currentPin.length
                              ? TAPAColors.gold
                              : Colors.white38,
                          width: 2)),
                )),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 40),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets
                .symmetric(horizontal: 40),
            child: GridView.builder(
                shrinkWrap: true,
                physics:
                const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                gridDelegate:
                const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
                    crossAxisCount: 3,
                    childAspectRatio: 1.8,
                    crossAxisSpacing: 12,
                    mainAxisSpacing: 12),
                itemCount: 12,
                itemBuilder: (ctx, i) {
                  if (i == 9) return const SizedBox();
                  if (i == 11) {
                    return GestureDetector(
                      onTap: _delete,
                      child: Container(
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: Colors.white10,
                              borderRadius:
                              BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                          child: const Icon(
                              Icons.backspace_outlined,
                              color: Colors.white60,
                              size: 22)));
                  }
                  final d = i == 10 ? '0' : '${i+1}';
                  return GestureDetector(
                      onTap: () => _press(d),
                      child: Container(
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: Colors.white10,
                              borderRadius:
                              BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                          child: Center(child: Text(d,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 24,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                                  color: TAPAColors.white)))));
                }),
          ),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// lib/screens/analyse/analyse_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';  // ✅ CHEMIN CORRIGÉ
import '../../../services/db_service_mysql.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/formatters.dart';
import '../../../data/models/models.dart';
import 'dart:math' as math;

class AnalyseScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const AnalyseScreen({super.key});
  @override
  State<AnalyseScreen> createState() => _AnalyseScreenState();
}

class _AnalyseScreenState extends State<AnalyseScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late TabController _tabController;
  final DBService _db = DBService();

  // ✅ Cache pour les transactions
  List<TransactionModel> _allTransactions = [];
  bool _isLoading = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _tabController = TabController(length: 3, vsync: this);
    _loadData();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _tabController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  // ✅ Charger toutes les transactions une fois
  Future<void> _loadData() async {
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    try {
      _allTransactions = await _db.getTransactions();
    } catch (e) {
      print('Erreur chargement transactions: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  // ✅ CORRIGÉ : Obtenir transactions du mois
  List<TransactionModel> _txDuMois(int mois, int annee) {
    return _allTransactions.where((t) =>
        t.dateTransaction.month == mois &&
        t.dateTransaction.year == annee &&
        t.isDepense).toList();
  }

  // ✅ CORRIGÉ : Obtenir transactions de l'année
  List<TransactionModel> _txAnnee(int annee) {
    return _allTransactions.where((t) =>
        t.dateTransaction.year == annee && t.isDepense).toList();
  }

  // Grouper par categorie
  Map<String, double> _parCategorie(List<TransactionModel> txs) {
    final map = <String, double>{};
    for (final tx in txs) {
      map[tx.categorieLabel] =
          (map[tx.categorieLabel] ?? 0) + tx.montant;
    }
    return Map.fromEntries(
        map.entries.toList()
          ..sort((a, b) => b.value.compareTo(a.value)));
  }

  // Grouper par mois
  Map<int, double> _parMois(int annee) {
    final map = <int, double>{};
    for (int m = 1; m <= 12; m++) {
      map[m] = 0;
    }
    final transactions = _txAnnee(annee);
    for (final tx in transactions) {
      map[tx.dateTransaction.month] = (map[tx.dateTransaction.month] ?? 0) + tx.montant;
    }
    return map;
  }

  // Calcul regle 50/30/20
  Map<String, double> _calcul5030(List<TransactionModel> txs) {
    final cats = _db.getCategories();
    double essentielle = 0, loisir = 0, epargne = 0, nonclasse = 0;
    for (final tx in txs) {
      final catList = cats.where((c) => c['label'] == tx.categorieLabel).toList();
      final cat = catList.isNotEmpty ? catList.first : <String, dynamic>{};
      final type = cat['typeBudget'] as String? ?? '';
      switch (type) {
        case 'essentielle': essentielle += tx.montant; break;
        case 'loisir': loisir += tx.montant; break;
        case 'epargne': epargne += tx.montant; break;
        default: nonclasse += tx.montant;
      }
    }
    return {
      'essentielle': essentielle,
      'loisir': loisir,
      'epargne': epargne,
      'nonclasse': nonclasse,
    };
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final user = _db.getUser();
    final monnaie = user?['monnaie'] ?? 'FCFA';

    if (_isLoading) {
      return const Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
        body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
      );
    }

    return Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
        appBar: AppBar(
            title: const Text('Analyse financiere'),
            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
            foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
            leading: IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios),
                onPressed: () => context.pop()),
            bottom: TabBar(
                controller: _tabController,
                indicatorColor: TAPAColors.gold,
                labelColor: TAPAColors.gold,
                unselectedLabelColor: Colors.white54,
                tabs: const [
                  Tab(text: 'Mensuel'),
                  Tab(text: 'Annuel'),
                  Tab(text: '50/30/20'),
                ])),
        body: TabBarView(
            controller: _tabController,
            children: [
              _vueMensuelle(now, monnaie),
              _vueAnnuelle(now, monnaie),
              _vue503020(now, monnaie),
            ]));
  }

  // VUE MENSUELLE
  Widget _vueMensuelle(DateTime now, String monnaie) {
    final txMoisCourant = _txDuMois(now.month, now.year);
    final txMoisPrecedent = _txDuMois(
        now.month == 1 ? 12 : now.month - 1,
        now.month == 1 ? now.year - 1 : now.year);

    final totalCourant = txMoisCourant.fold(0.0, (s, t) => s + t.montant);
    final totalPrecedent = txMoisPrecedent.fold(0.0, (s, t) => s + t.montant);
    final evolution = totalPrecedent > 0
        ? ((totalCourant - totalPrecedent) / totalPrecedent * 100)
        : 0.0;

    final parCat = _parCategorie(txMoisCourant);
    final parCatPrec = _parCategorie(txMoisPrecedent);
    final total = totalCourant > 0 ? totalCourant : 1;

    final colors = [
      TAPAColors.red,
      TAPAColors.gold,
      TAPAColors.purple,
      TAPAColors.green,
      TAPAColors.navy,
      const Color(0xFFE67E22),
    ];

    return ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        children: [
          // Resume mois
          Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  gradient: const LinearGradient(
                      colors: [TAPAColors.navy, Color(0xFF14274E)],
                      begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                      end: Alignment.bottomRight),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18)),
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text('Depenses ${_nomMois(now.month)} ${now.year}',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 12)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Text(Fmt.montant(totalCourant, monnaie: monnaie),
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            color: TAPAColors.white, fontSize: 26,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Row(children: [
                      Icon(
                          evolution <= 0
                              ? Icons.trending_down
                              : Icons.trending_up,
                          size: 16,
                          color: evolution <= 0
                              ? TAPAColors.green : TAPAColors.red),
                      const SizedBox(width: 4),
                      Text(
                          '${evolution >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${evolution.toStringAsFixed(1)}% vs mois precedent',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 12,
                              color: evolution <= 0
                                  ? TAPAColors.green : TAPAColors.red,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                    ]),
                  ])),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),

          // Camembert
          if (parCat.isNotEmpty) ...[
            const Text('Repartition par categorie',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 15,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    color: TAPAColors.navy)),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Row(children: [
              SizedBox(
                  width: 130, height: 130,
                  child: CustomPaint(
                      painter: _PiePainter(
                          parCat.values.toList(), colors))),
              const SizedBox(width: 16),
              Expanded(child: Column(
                  children: parCat.entries.take(5)
                      .toList().asMap().entries.map((e) {
                    final pct = e.value.value / total * 100;
                    final color = colors[e.key % colors.length];
                    return Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
                        child: Row(children: [
                          Container(width: 10, height: 10,
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: color, shape: BoxShape.circle)),
                          const SizedBox(width: 6),
                          Expanded(child: Text(e.value.key,
                              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11,
                                  color: TAPAColors.navy),
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis)),
                          Text('${pct.toStringAsFixed(1)}%',
                              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                  color: color)),
                        ]));
                  }).toList())),
            ]),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
          ],

          // Comparaison avec mois precedent
          const Text('Comparaison avec le mois precedent',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 15,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                  color: TAPAColors.navy)),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          ...parCat.entries.take(6).toList().asMap().entries.map((e) {
            final catLabel = e.value.key;
            final montantCourant = e.value.value;
            final montantPrec = parCatPrec[catLabel] ?? 0;
            final diff = montantPrec > 0
                ? ((montantCourant - montantPrec) / montantPrec * 100)
                : 0.0;
            final color = colors[e.key % colors.length];
            return Container(
                margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: TAPAColors.surface,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    border: Border.all(color: TAPAColors.border, width: 0.5)),
                child: Row(children: [
                  Container(width: 10, height: 10,

                  Expanded(child: Text(catLabel,
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13,

                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                color: TAPAColors.navy)),
                        if (montantPrec > 0)
                          Row(children: [
                            Icon(
                                diff <= 0
                                    ? Icons.arrow_downward
                                    : Icons.arrow_upward,
                                size: 11,
                                color: diff <= 0
                                    ? TAPAColors.green : TAPAColors.red),
                            Text('${diff.abs().toStringAsFixed(1)}%',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 10.5,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                    color: diff <= 0
                                        ? TAPAColors.green : TAPAColors.red)),
                          ]),
                      ]),
                ]));
          }),
        ]);
  }

                    ]));
          }),
        ]);
  }

  // VUE 50/30/20
  Widget _vue503020(DateTime now, String monnaie) {
    final txMois = _txDuMois(now.month, now.year);
    final totalMois = txMois.fold(0.0, (s, t) => s + t.montant);
    final repartition = _calcul5030(txMois);

    final essentielle = repartition['essentielle'] ?? 0;
    final loisir = repartition['loisir'] ?? 0;
    final epargne = repartition['epargne'] ?? 0;
    final nonclasse = repartition['nonclasse'] ?? 0;

    final pctEss = totalMois > 0 ? essentielle / totalMois * 100 : 0.0;
    final pctLoi = totalMois > 0 ? loisir / totalMois * 100 : 0.0;
    final pctEpa = totalMois > 0 ? epargne / totalMois * 100 : 0.0;

    // Alertes depassement
    final alerteEss = pctEss > 50;
    final alerteLoi = pctLoi > 30;
    final alerteEpa = pctEpa < 20 && epargne > 0;

    return ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        children: [
          // Explication regle
          Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: TAPAColors.navy,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    const Text('Regle 50 / 30 / 20',
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                            color: TAPAColors.gold)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    _regleItem('50%', 'Essentielles',
                        'Loyer, nourriture, factures, sante'),
                    _regleItem('30%', 'Loisirs',
                        'Sorties, habits, divertissement'),
                    _regleItem('20%', 'Epargne',
                        'Investissement, objectifs, avenir'),
                  ])),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),

          // Alertes
          if (alerteEss || alerteLoi || alerteEpa) ...[
            Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: TAPAColors.red.withOpacity(0.1),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    border: Border.all(color: TAPAColors.red.withOpacity(0.3))),
                child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      const Row(children: [
                        Icon(Icons.warning_amber_rounded,
                            color: TAPAColors.red, size: 18),
                        SizedBox(width: 8),
                        Text('Alertes budget',
                            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                color: TAPAColors.red)),
                      ]),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      if (alerteEss)
                        Text(
                            'Depenses essentielles: ${pctEss.toStringAsFixed(1)}% (max 50%)',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12, color: TAPAColors.red)),
                      if (alerteLoi)
                        Text(
                            'Loisirs: ${pctLoi.toStringAsFixed(1)}% (max 30%)',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12, color: TAPAColors.red)),
                      if (alerteEpa)
                        Text(
                            'Epargne insuffisante: ${pctEpa.toStringAsFixed(1)}% (min 20%)',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12, color: TAPAColors.red)),
                    ])),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
          ],

          // Jauges 50/30/20
          _jaugeBudget('Essentielles', essentielle, pctEss, 50,
              TAPAColors.navy, monnaie),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          _jaugeBudget('Loisirs', loisir, pctLoi, 30,
              TAPAColors.gold, monnaie),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          _jaugeBudget('Epargne', epargne, pctEpa, 20,
              TAPAColors.green, monnaie),
          if (nonclasse > 0) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: TAPAColors.surface,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    border: Border.all(color: TAPAColors.border)),
                child: Row(children: [
                  const Icon(Icons.help_outline,
                      size: 16, color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Expanded(child: Text(
                      'Non classe: ${Fmt.montant(nonclasse, monnaie: monnaie)} - Classez vos categories pour une meilleure analyse',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11.5, color: TAPAColors.textSecond))),
                ])),
          ],
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
        ]);
  }

  Widget _regleItem(String pct, String label, String desc) {
    return Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 6),

          Container(
              width: 40,

  }

  Widget _jaugeBudget(String label, double montant,
      double pct, double cible, Color color, String monnaie) {
    final depasse = pct > cible;
    return Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: TAPAColors.surface,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
            border: Border.all(
                color: depasse ? TAPAColors.red : TAPAColors.border,
                width: depasse ? 1.5 : 0.5)),
        child: Column(children: [
          Row(children: [
            Text(label, style: const TextStyle(
                fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                color: TAPAColors.navy)),
            const Spacer(),
            Text(Fmt.montant(montant, monnaie: monnaie),
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: color)),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 8, vertical: 2),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: (depasse ? TAPAColors.red : color)
                        .withOpacity(0.12),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
                child: Text('${pct.toStringAsFixed(1)}%',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 11,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        color: depasse ? TAPAColors.red : color))),
          ]),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Stack(children: [
            ClipRRect(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                    value: (pct / 100).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                    minHeight: 10,
                    backgroundColor: TAPAColors.border,
                    valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(
                        depasse ? TAPAColors.red : color))),
            Positioned(
                left: cible / 100 *
                    (MediaQuery.of(context).size.width - 76),
                child: Container(
                    width: 2, height: 10,
                    color: TAPAColors.navy.withOpacity(0.4))),
          ]),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          Row(children: [
            Text('Objectif: $cible%',
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 10, color: TAPAColors.textSecond)),
            const Spacer(),
            if (depasse)
              Text('Depasse de ${(pct - cible).toStringAsFixed(1)}%',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 10, color: TAPAColors.red,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
          ]),
        ]));
  }

  String _nomMois(int m) {
    const mois = ['', 'Janvier', 'Fevrier', 'Mars', 'Avril',
      'Mai', 'Juin', 'Juillet', 'Aout', 'Septembre',
      'Octobre', 'Novembre', 'Decembre'];
    return mois[m];
  }

  String _nomMoisCourt(int m) {
    const mois = ['', 'J', 'F', 'M', 'A', 'M', 'J',
      'J', 'A', 'S', 'O', 'N', 'D'];
    return mois[m];
  }
}

class _PiePainter extends CustomPainter {
  final List<double> data;
  final List<Color> colors;
  _PiePainter(this.data, this.colors);

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final total = data.fold(0.0, (s, v) => s + v);
    if (total == 0) return;
    final center = Offset(size.width / 2, size.height / 2);
    final radius = size.width / 2;
    double startAngle = -math.pi / 2;
    for (int i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
      final sweep = data[i] / total * 2 * math.pi;
      canvas.drawArc(
          Rect.fromCircle(center: center, radius: radius),
          startAngle, sweep, true,
          Paint()..color = colors[i % colors.length]);
      startAngle += sweep;
    }
    canvas.drawCircle(center, radius * 0.5,
        Paint()..color = Colors.white);
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant CustomPainter old) => true;
}

class WalletScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const WalletScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<WalletScreen> createState() => _WalletScreenState();
}

class _WalletScreenState extends ConsumerState<WalletScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _montantController = TextEditingController();
  WalletModel? _selectedWallet; // ✅ Portefeuille sélectionné
  bool _isLoading = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      final user = ref.read(currentUserProvider);
      if (user != null) {
        ref.read(walletStateProvider.notifier).loadWallets(user.id);
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _montantController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _ajouterFonds() async {
    // ✅ 1. Vérifier que l'utilisateur et son téléphone sont présents
    final currentUser = ref.read(currentUserProvider);
    if (currentUser == null) {
      _showSnackBar('Utilisateur non connecté');
      return;
    }

    // ✅ 2. Vérifier le portefeuille sélectionné
    if (_selectedWallet == null) {
      _showSnackBar('Sélectionnez un portefeuille');
      return;
    }

    // ✅ 3. Vérifier le montant
    final montantText = _montantController.text.trim();
    if (montantText.isEmpty) {
      _showSnackBar('Saisissez un montant');
      return;
    }

    final montant = int.tryParse(montantText);
    if (montant == null || montant < 500) {
      _showSnackBar('Montant minimum: 500 FCFA');
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _isLoading = true);

    try {
      final paiementPro = PaiementProService();
      final success = await paiementPro.payerAvecPaiementPro(
        amount: montant,
        description: 'Rechargement wallet ${_selectedWallet!.nom}',
        referenceNumber: 'WALLET-${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}',
        customerEmail: currentUser.email.isNotEmpty
            ? currentUser.email
            : 'client@tapa.com',
        customerFirstName: currentUser.prenom,
        customerLastname: currentUser.prenom,
        // ✅ Si le profil n'a pas de numéro, on met un placeholder.
        // L'utilisateur saisira son vrai numéro sur la page PaiementPro.
        customerPhoneNumber: currentUser.phoneNumber.trim().isNotEmpty
            ? currentUser.phoneNumber
            : '+2250700000000',
        channel: 'WAVE',
        notificationURL: 'https://wallet-notify.tapa-invest.workers.dev',
        returnURL: 'tapa://wallet/success',
        // ✅ On passe l'ID du portefeuille ET le montant pour que le webhook sache quoi créditer
        returnContext:
        '{"userId":"${currentUser.id}", "walletId":"${_selectedWallet!.id}", "amount":$montant}',
      );

      if (success && mounted) {
        // ✅ OPTIMISTE : On met à jour le solde immédiatement pour l'utilisateur
        // (Le webhook fera la vraie mise à jour Firestore en arrière-plan)
        // ✅ On invalide le provider pour forcer le rechargement depuis Firestore
        final currentUser = ref.read(currentUserProvider);
        if (currentUser != null) {
          ref.invalidate(walletListProvider(currentUser.id));
        }
        _showSnackBar(
          '✅ Paiement initié. Votre wallet sera crédité.',
          isSuccess: true,
        );
        _montantController.clear();

        // ✅ Redirection vers l'accueil après un court délai
        Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 2), () {
          if (mounted) context.go('/home');
        });
      } else if (mounted) {
        // ✅ Gestion d'erreur : le paiement n'a pas pu être lancé
        _showSnackBar(
          '❌ Impossible d\'ouvrir la page de paiement. Vérifiez votre connexion.',
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Afficher le message exact (ex: "Erreur ouverture navigateur: ...")
      _showSnackBar('❌ ${e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '')}');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }


  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // MÉTHODE RETIRER DES FONDS
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  Future<void> _retirerFonds() async {
    final currentUser = ref.read(currentUserProvider);
    if (currentUser == null) {
      _showSnackBar('Utilisateur non connecté');
      return;
    }

    final montantCtrl = TextEditingController();
    final phoneCtrl = TextEditingController(text: currentUser.phoneNumber);
    String operator = 'WAVE';
    bool isLoading = false;

    final result = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setDialogState) => AlertDialog(
          title: const Text('Retirer des fonds'),
          content: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                TextField(
                  controller: montantCtrl,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Montant (FCFA)',
                    hintText: 'Ex: 5000',
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextField(
                  controller: phoneCtrl,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.phone,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Numéro (+225XXXXXXXXXX)',
                    hintText: '+2250700000000',
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  value: operator,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Opérateur'),
                  items: const [
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: 'WAVE', child: Text('Wave')),
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: 'ORANGE', child: Text('Orange Money')),
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: 'MTN', child: Text('MTN MoMo')),
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: 'MOOV', child: Text('Moov Flooz')),
                  ],
                  onChanged: (v) => setDialogState(() => operator = v!),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                const Text(
                  'Frais de retrait : 1,5% + 100 FCFA (Wave) ou 250 FCFA (Orange/MTN/Moov)',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
              child: const Text('Annuler'),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: isLoading ? null : () async {
                final montant = int.tryParse(montantCtrl.text) ?? 0;
                if (montant < 500) {
                  _showSnackBar('Montant minimum : 500 FCFA');
                  return;
                }
                if (!phoneCtrl.text.startsWith('+225')) {
                  _showSnackBar('Format : +225XXXXXXXXXX');
                  return;
                }

                setDialogState(() => isLoading = true);

                try {
                  final response = await http.post(
                    Uri.parse('https://tapa-budget-server.onrender.com/api/withdraw'),
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: jsonEncode({
                      'userId': currentUser.id,
                      'amount': montant,
                      'phone': phoneCtrl.text,
                      'operator': operator,
                    }),
                  ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 90));

                  if (response.statusCode == 200) {
                    final data = jsonDecode(response.body);
                    Navigator.pop(ctx, data);
                  } else {
                    final data = jsonDecode(response.body);
                    _showSnackBar(data['error'] ?? 'Erreur serveur');
                  }
                } on TimeoutException {
                  _showSnackBar('Le serveur met du temps à répondre. Veuillez patienter et réessayer.');
                } catch (e) {
                  _showSnackBar('Erreur réseau: $e');
                } finally {
                  setDialogState(() => isLoading = false);
                }
              },
              child: isLoading
                  ? const SizedBox(width: 20, height: 20, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2))
                  : const Text('Confirmer'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );

    if (result != null && result['success'] == true) {
      _showSnackBar(
        '✅ Demande enregistrée. Traitement sous 48h maximum.',
        isSuccess: true,
      );
    }
  }

  void _showSnackBar(String message, {bool isSuccess = false}) {
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(message),
        backgroundColor: isSuccess ? Colors.green : TAPAColors.red,
      ),
    );
  }

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import 'package:tapa_budget/presentation/providers/providers.dart';
import '../../../data/models/models.dart';
import '../../../domain/usecases/wallet/create_wallet_usecase.dart';

class AddWalletScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const AddWalletScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<AddWalletScreen> createState() => _AddWalletScreenState();
}

class _AddWalletScreenState extends ConsumerState<AddWalletScreen> {
  final _nomController = TextEditingController();
  final _soldeController = TextEditingController();
  final _descriptionController = TextEditingController();

  // Types disponibles
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> _types = [
    {'id': 'bank', 'label': 'Banque', 'emoji': '🏦', 'color': Colors.blue},
    {'id': 'wave', 'label': 'Wave', 'emoji': '🌊', 'color': const Color(0xFF1DC8F2)},
    {'id': 'orange', 'label': 'Orange Money', 'emoji': '🟠', 'color': const Color(0xFFFF7900)},
    {'id': 'mtn', 'label': 'MTN MoMo', 'emoji': '🟡', 'color': const Color(0xFFFFCC00)},
    {'id': 'cash', 'label': 'Cash', 'emoji': '💵', 'color': Colors.green},
  ];

  String _selectedType = 'cash';
  bool _isLoading = false;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nomController.dispose();
    _soldeController.dispose();
    _descriptionController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _creerPortefeuille() async {
    final nom = _nomController.text.trim();
    final soldeStr = _soldeController.text.trim();

    if (nom.isEmpty) {
      _showError('Veuillez donner un nom à ce compte (ex: Wave Perso)');
      return;
    }

    if (soldeStr.isEmpty) {
      _showError('Veuillez indiquer le solde actuel');
      return;
    }

    final solde = double.tryParse(soldeStr) ?? 0;
    if (solde < 0) {
      _showError('Le solde ne peut pas être négatif');
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _isLoading = true);

    try {
      final userId = ref.read(currentUserProvider)?.id ?? '';
      if (userId.isEmpty) throw Exception('Utilisateur non connecté');

      // Trouver les infos du type sélectionné
      final typeInfo = _types.firstWhere((t) => t['id'] == _selectedType);

      // ✅ Créer les paramètres avec la structure exacte de CreateWalletParams
      final params = CreateWalletParams(
        uid: userId,
        nom: nom,
        type: typeInfo['id'],
        emoji: typeInfo['emoji'],
        solde: solde,
        monnaie: ref.read(userMonnaieProvider),
        description: _descriptionController.text.trim(),
      );

      // ✅ Appeler le provider de création
      final result = await ref.read(createWalletProvider(params).future);

      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('✅ Portefeuille créé avec succès'),
            backgroundColor: TAPAColors.green,
          ),
        );
        context.pop(); // Retour à l'écran précédent
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        _showError('Erreur : ${e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '')}');
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  void _showError(String msg) {
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(msg),
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final monnaie = ref.watch(userMonnaieProvider);

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Nouveau compte'),
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
        foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_new_rounded),
          onPressed: () => context.pop(),
        ),
      ),
      body: SingleChildScrollView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            // 1. SECTION : TYPE DE COMPTE
            const Text(
              'Type de compte',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: TAPAColors.navy),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            SizedBox(
              height: 90,
              child: ListView.separated(
                scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                itemCount: _types.length,
                separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const SizedBox(width: 10),
                itemBuilder: (ctx, i) {
                  final type = _types[i];
                  final isSelected = _selectedType == type['id'];
                  return GestureDetector(
                    onTap: () => setState(() => _selectedType = type['id']),
                    child: AnimatedContainer(
                      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
                      width: 90,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: isSelected ? TAPAColors.navy : TAPAColors.surface,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                        border: Border.all(
                          color: isSelected ? TAPAColors.gold : TAPAColors.border,
                          width: isSelected ? 2 : 1,
                        ),
                        boxShadow: isSelected ? [
                          BoxShadow(
                            color: TAPAColors.navy.withOpacity(0.2),
                            blurRadius: 10,
                            offset: const Offset(0, 4),
                          )
                        ] : null,
                      ),
                      child: Column(
                        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                        children: [
                          Text(type['emoji'], style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 28)),
                          const SizedBox(height: 6),
                          Text(
                            type['label'],
                            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 11,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                              color: isSelected ? TAPAColors.gold : TAPAColors.textSecond,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                },
              ),
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 24),

            // 2. SECTION : INFORMATIONS
            const Text(
              'Informations du compte',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: TAPAColors.navy),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),

            // Champ Nom (dynamique selon le type)
            _buildTextField(
              controller: _nomController,
              label: _selectedType == 'bank' ? 'Nom de la banque' : 'Nom du compte',
              hint: _selectedType == 'bank'
                  ? 'Ex: NSIA Banque, SGCI...'
                  : 'Ex: Wave Perso, Orange Pro...',
              icon: Icons.account_balance_outlined,
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            // Champ Solde Initial
            _buildTextField(
              controller: _soldeController,
              label: 'Solde actuel',
              hint: '0',
              icon: Icons.payments_outlined,
              keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
              inputFormatters: [FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly],
              suffix: monnaie,
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            // Champ Description (optionnel)
            _buildTextField(
              controller: _descriptionController,
              label: 'Description (optionnel)',
              hint: 'Ex: Compte pour les dépenses quotidiennes...',
              icon: Icons.notes_rounded,
              maxLines: 3,
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 32),

            // 3. BOUTON DE VALIDATION
            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              height: 56,
              child: ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: _isLoading ? null : _creerPortefeuille,
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: TAPAColors.gold,
                  foregroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                  ),
                  elevation: 0,
                ),
                child: _isLoading
                    ? const SizedBox(
                  width: 24,
                  height: 24,
                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                    color: TAPAColors.navy,
                    strokeWidth: 2.5,
                  ),
                )
                    : const Text(
                  'Créer le compte',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 16,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // Widget réutilisable pour les champs de texte
  Widget _buildTextField({
    required TextEditingController controller,
    required String label,
    required String hint,
    required IconData icon,
    TextInputType? keyboardType,
    List<TextInputFormatter>? inputFormatters,
    String? suffix,
    int maxLines = 1,
  }) {
    return TextField(
      controller: controller,
      keyboardType: keyboardType,
      inputFormatters: inputFormatters,
      maxLines: maxLines,
      decoration: InputDecoration(
        labelText: label,
        hintText: hint,
        suffixText: suffix,
        prefixIcon: Icon(icon, color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
        filled: true,
        fillColor: TAPAColors.surface,
        border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          borderSide: BorderSide.none,
        ),
        enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: TAPAColors.border),
        ),
        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: TAPAColors.navy, width: 1.5),
        ),
        contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 16),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// lib/screens/wallets/wallets_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class WalletsScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const WalletsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<WalletsScreen> createState() => _WalletsScreenState();
}

class _WalletsScreenState extends ConsumerState<WalletsScreen> {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final user = ref.watch(currentUserProvider);
    final monnaie = ref.watch(userMonnaieProvider);
    final userId = user?.id ?? '';

    if (userId.isEmpty) {
      return const Scaffold(
        body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
      );
    }

    final walletsAsync = ref.watch(walletListProvider(userId));

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: TAPAColors.background,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Mes portefeuilles'),
        backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
        foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios),
          onPressed: () => context.go('/home'),
        ),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.add_circle_outline,
                color: TAPAColors.gold),
            onPressed: () async {
              final result = await context.push('/wallets/add');
              if (result == true) {
                ref.invalidate(walletListProvider(userId));
              }
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: walletsAsync.when(
        loading: () => const Center(
          child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: TAPAColors.gold),
        ),
        error: (err, stack) => Center(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            child: Text(
              'Erreur: $err',
              style: const TextStyle(color: TAPAColors.red),
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            ),
          ),
        ),
        data: (wallets) {
          final total = wallets.fold(0.0, (sum, w) => sum + w.solde);

          return ListView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            children: [
              // Carte total
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: TAPAColors.navy,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                ),
                child: Column(
                  children: [
                    const Text(
                      'TOTAL DISPONIBLE',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 11,
                        color: Colors.white54,
                        letterSpacing: 0.8,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    Text(
                      Fmt.montant(total, monnaie: monnaie),
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 26,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                        color: TAPAColors.white,
                      ),
                    ),
                    Text(
                      '${wallets.length} portefeuille${wallets.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: Colors.white38,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),

              // Liste des wallets
              if (wallets.isEmpty)
                const Center(
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 40),
                    child: Column(
                      children: [
                        Icon(Icons.account_balance_wallet_outlined,
                            size: 48, color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
                        SizedBox(height: 12),
                        Text(
                          'Aucun portefeuille',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 16,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                            color: TAPAColors.navy,
                          ),
                        ),
                        SizedBox(height: 8),
                        Text(
                          'Ajoutez votre premier portefeuille',
                          style: TextStyle(color: TAPAColors.textSecond),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                )
              else
                ...wallets.map((w) => Container(
                      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: TAPAColors.surface,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                        border: Border.all(
                            color: TAPAColors.border, width: 0.5),

                      child: Row(

                            height: 44,
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: TAPAColors.background,
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            ),
                            child: Center(
                              child: Text(w.emoji,
                                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 22)),
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 14),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: [
                                Text(
                                  w.nom,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 15,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                    color: TAPAColors.navy,

FICHIER : lib/presentation/screens/migration/migration_page.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show rootBundle;
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'dart:convert';

class MigrationPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const MigrationPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<MigrationPage> createState() => _MigrationPageState();
}

class _MigrationPageState extends State<MigrationPage> {
  String _status = 'Prêt pour la migration...';
  bool _isMigrating = false;
  int _progress = 0;
  int _total = 0;

  Future<void> _migrate() async {
    setState(() {
      _isMigrating = true;
      _status = 'Début de la migration...';
      _progress = 0;
      _total = 0;
    });

    try {
      // Lire le fichier JSON depuis assets
      final String jsonString = await rootBundle.loadString('assets/data/utilisateurs.json');
      final List<dynamic> users = jsonDecode(jsonString);
      
      _total = users.length;
      setState(() => _status = 'Migration de $_total utilisateurs...');

      int count = 0;
      for (final user in users) {
        try {
          final telephone = user['telephone']?.toString() ?? '';
          if (telephone.isEmpty) {
            print('⚠️ Utilisateur sans téléphone: ${user['prenom']}');
            continue;
          }

          final cleanTelephone = telephone.replaceAll(' ', '').trim();

          await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users').doc(cleanTelephone).set({
            'uuid': user['uuid'] ?? '',
            'prenom': user['prenom'] ?? '',
            'telephone': cleanTelephone,
            'indicatif': user['indicatif'] ?? '+225',
            'codePays': user['code_pays'] ?? 'CI',
            'monnaie': user['monnaie'] ?? 'FCFA',
            'pinCode': user['pin_code'] ?? '1234',
            'hasAccesVie': user['has_acces_vie'] == 1,
            'cleActivee': user['cle_activee'],
            'dateInscription': user['date_inscription'],
            'derniereActivite': user['derniere_activite'] ?? DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
            'onboardingVu': user['onboarding_vu'] == 1,
            'notificationsActivees': user['notifications_activees'] == 1,
            'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
            'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
          });

          count++;
          setState(() {
            _progress = count;
            _status = 'Importé ${user['prenom']} ($count/$_total)';
          });
          
          print('✅ ${user['prenom']} - $cleanTelephone');
          
        } catch (e) {
          print('❌ Erreur pour ${user['prenom']}: $e');
        }
      }

      setState(() {
        _status = '✅ Migration terminée ! $count utilisateurs importés sur $_total.';
        _isMigrating = false;
      });

    } catch (e) {
      setState(() {
        _status = '❌ Erreur: $e. Vérifiez que le fichier assets/data/utilisateurs.json existe.';
        _isMigrating = false;
      });
      print('❌ Erreur: $e');
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Migration Firebase'),
        backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF1A237E),
        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
      ),
      body: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            const Icon(Icons.cloud_upload, size: 64, color: Color(0xFF1A237E)),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            Text(
              _status,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            if (_total > 0) ...[
              LinearProgressIndicator(
                value: _progress / _total,
                minHeight: 10,
                backgroundColor: Colors.grey[300],
                valueColor: const AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(Color(0xFF1A237E)),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              Text('$_progress / $_total'),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: 30),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: _isMigrating ? null : _migrate,
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 40, vertical: 15),
                backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF1A237E),
                foregroundColor: Colors.white,
              ),
              child: Text(
                _isMigrating ? 'Migration en cours...' : 'Lancer la migration',
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            if (_isMigrating)
              const CircularProgressIndicator(
                valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(Color(0xFF1A237E)),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class OnboardingScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const OnboardingScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<OnboardingScreen> createState() => _OnboardingScreenState();
}

/// Métriques responsives
class _Metrics {
  final double width;
  final double height;
  final bool isCompact;
  final bool isTablet;
  final double contentMaxWidth;
  final double horizontalPadding;
  final double iconSize;
  final double emojiFontSize;
  final double titleFontSize;
  final double subtitleFontSize;
  final double descriptionFontSize;
  final double itemFontSize;
  final double buttonHeight;
  final double cardPadding;
  final double cardRadius;
  final double gapLarge;
  final double gapMedium;

  _Metrics(BuildContext context, BoxConstraints constraints)
      : width = constraints.maxWidth,
        height = constraints.maxHeight,
        isCompact = constraints.maxHeight < 700 || constraints.maxWidth < 340,
        isTablet = constraints.maxWidth >= 600,
        contentMaxWidth = constraints.maxWidth >= 600 ? 480 : double.infinity,
        horizontalPadding = constraints.maxWidth >= 600 ? 0 : 24,
        iconSize = constraints.maxWidth >= 600
            ? 108
            : (constraints.maxHeight < 700 ? 72 : 92),
        emojiFontSize = constraints.maxWidth >= 600
            ? 46
            : (constraints.maxHeight < 700 ? 32 : 40),
        titleFontSize = constraints.maxWidth >= 600
            ? 28
            : (constraints.maxHeight < 700 ? 20 : 24),
        subtitleFontSize = constraints.maxWidth >= 600 ? 13 : 11.5,
        descriptionFontSize = constraints.maxWidth >= 600 ? 15 : 13.5,
        itemFontSize = constraints.maxWidth >= 600 ? 14 : 13,
        buttonHeight = constraints.maxHeight < 700 ? 52 : 58,
        cardPadding = constraints.maxWidth >= 600 ? 28 : 20,
        cardRadius = 28,
        gapLarge = constraints.maxHeight < 700 ? 14 : 24,
        gapMedium = constraints.maxHeight < 700 ? 8 : 12;
}

class _OnboardingScreenState extends ConsumerState<OnboardingScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  final PageController _pageCtrl = PageController();
  late final AnimationController _contentCtrl;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _contentCtrl = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 500),
    )..forward();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _pageCtrl.dispose();
    _contentCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  bool get _isLastPage => _page == _slides.length - 1;

  // ============================================
  // SUIVANT - Change de page ou termine
  // ============================================

  void _suivant() {
    if (!_isLastPage) {
      _pageCtrl.nextPage(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 450),
          curve: Curves.easeOutCubic);
    } else {
      _terminer();
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // TERMINER - Marque l'onboarding comme vu
  // ============================================

  Future<void> _terminer() async {
    if (_isCompleting) return;
    setState(() => _isCompleting = true);

    try {
      Logger.info('✅ Fin de l\'onboarding...');

      // ✅ 1. Marquer l'onboarding comme vu
      await ref.read(authStateProvider.notifier).markOnboardingAsSeen();
      Logger.info('✅ Onboarding marqué comme vu');

      // ✅ 2. Récupérer l'utilisateur mis à jour
      final user = ref.read(currentUserProvider);

      if (user != null) {
        // ✅ 3. Mettre à jour l'état global
        ref.read(appStateProvider.notifier).setAuthenticatedUser(user);
        Logger.info('✅ État utilisateur mis à jour: ${user.prenom}');
      } else {
        Logger.warning('⚠️ Utilisateur non trouvé après onboarding');
      }

      // ✅ 4. Naviguer vers la configuration du PIN
      if (mounted) {
        context.go('/pin-setup');
        Logger.info('🚀 Navigation vers /pin-setup');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur lors de la fin de l\'onboarding: $e');
      if (mounted) {
        // En cas d'erreur, essayer de naviguer quand même
        context.go('/pin-setup');
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isCompleting = false);
    }
  }

  void _onPageChanged(int i) {
    setState(() => _page = i);
    _contentCtrl
      ..reset()
      ..forward();
  }

  // ============================================

  Widget _glowOrb(double diameter, Color color) {
    return IgnorePointer(
      child: Container(
        width: diameter,
        height: diameter,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(shape: BoxShape.circle, color: color),
        child: ClipOval(
          child: BackdropFilter(
            filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 60, sigmaY: 60),
            child: const SizedBox.shrink(),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================

  Widget _buildSlide(Map<String, dynamic> slide, _Metrics m) {

// ============================================
// BOUTON PRINCIPAL PERSONNALISÉ
// ============================================

class _PrimaryButton extends StatefulWidget {
  final double height;
  final bool isLastPage;
  final bool isLoading;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  const _PrimaryButton({
    required this.height,
    required this.isLastPage,
    required this.isLoading,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  @override
  State<_PrimaryButton> createState() => _PrimaryButtonState();
}

class _PrimaryButtonState extends State<_PrimaryButton> {
  bool _pressed = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final disabled = widget.isLoading;
    return GestureDetector(
      onTapDown: disabled ? null : (_) => setState(() => _pressed = true),
      onTapCancel: () => setState(() => _pressed = false),
      onTapUp: (_) => setState(() => _pressed = false),
      onTap: disabled ? null : widget.onTap,
      child: AnimatedScale(
        scale: _pressed ? 0.98 : 1.0,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 120),
        curve: Curves.easeOut,
        child: AnimatedContainer(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
          width: double.infinity,
          height: widget.height,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            gradient: LinearGradient(
              colors: [
                TAPAColors.gold,
                TAPAColors.gold.withOpacity(0.85),
              ],
              begin: Alignment.topLeft,
              end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            ),
            boxShadow: [
              BoxShadow(
                color: TAPAColors.gold.withOpacity(disabled ? 0.15 : 0.35),
                blurRadius: 20,
                offset: const Offset(0, 10),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          child: Center(
            child: widget.isLoading
                ? const SizedBox(
              width: 22,
              height: 22,
              child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                strokeWidth: 2.4,
                valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(TAPAColors.navy),
              ),
            )
                : AnimatedSwitcher(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
              child: Row(
                key: ValueKey(widget.isLastPage),
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    widget.isLastPage
                        ? 'Commencer maintenant'
                        : 'Suivant',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      color: TAPAColors.navy,
                      fontSize: 16,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Icon(
                    widget.isLastPage
                        ? Icons.check_circle_rounded
                        : Icons.arrow_forward_rounded,
                    color: TAPAColors.navy,
                    size: 20,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// lib/screens/dettes/dettes_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
