  List<Widget> _emptyChildren() {
    return [
      _heroShell(const <Widget>[]),
      Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(32, 56, 32, 0),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Container(
              width: 88,
              height: 88,
              decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                color: TAPAColors.goldLight,
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
              ),
              child: const Icon(Icons.donut_large_rounded,
                  size: 40, color: TAPAColors.navy),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 24),
            Text(
              'Pas encore de budget pour $_moisLabel',
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: const TextStyle(
                fontSize: 19,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                color: TAPAColors.navy,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            const Text(
              'Fixez un montant par catégorie et voyez ce qu\'il vous reste à dépenser.',
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: TextStyle(color: TAPAColors.textSecond, height: 1.45),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 28),
            ElevatedButton.icon(
              onPressed: () => _ouvrirEditeur(),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.add_rounded, size: 20),
              label: const Text('Créer le budget',
                  style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 15)),
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
                foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                elevation: 0,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 28, vertical: 16),
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ];
  }

  List<Widget> _budgetChildren(BudgetMensuel b, Map<String, num> reel) {
    double somme(Iterable<BudgetLigne> l) => l.fold<double>(
        0.0, (s, x) => s + (reel[x.categorieId] ?? 0).toDouble());

    return [
      _buildHero(
        prevuDep: b.totalDepensesPrevu,
        reelDep: somme(b.depenses),
        prevuRev: b.totalRevenusPrevu,
        reelRev: somme(b.revenus),
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 20),
      if (b.depenses.isNotEmpty)
        _buildGroup('Dépenses', b.depenses, reel, b.totalDepensesPrevu),
      if (b.revenus.isNotEmpty) ...[
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        _buildGroup('Revenus', b.revenus, reel, b.totalRevenusPrevu),
      ],
    ];
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // LISTE PAR CATÉGORIE
  // ==========================================================

  Widget _buildGroup(String title, List<BudgetLigne> lignes,
      Map<String, num> reel, double total) {
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: TAPAColors.surface,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(color: TAPAColors.border),
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 18, 4),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(title,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 16,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                          color: TAPAColors.navy)),
                ),
                Text('Prévu ${_fmt(total)}',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12.5,
                        color: TAPAColors.textSecond,
                        fontFeatures: _tabular)),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          for (int i = 0; i < lignes.length; i++) ...[
            if (i > 0)
              const Divider(
                  height: 1, indent: 18, endIndent: 18, color: TAPAColors.border),
            _buildLigne(lignes[i], reel),
          ],
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLigne(BudgetLigne l, Map<String, num> reelMap) {
    final reel = (reelMap[l.categorieId] ?? 0).toDouble();
    final prevu = l.montantPrevu;
    final ratio = prevu > 0 ? reel / prevu : 0.0;
    final depasse = !l.isRevenu && prevu > 0 && reel > prevu;
    final Color color = l.isRevenu
        ? TAPAColors.green
        : (depasse
        ? TAPAColors.red
        : (ratio >= 0.8 ? TAPAColors.gold : TAPAColors.navy));
    final String info = l.isRevenu
        ? (reel >= prevu ? 'Objectif atteint' : 'Reste ${_fmt(prevu - reel)} à recevoir')
        : (depasse ? 'Dépassé de ${_fmt(reel - prevu)}' : 'Reste ${_fmt(prevu - reel)}');

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 14, 18, 14),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Container(
                width: 42,
                height: 42,
                alignment: Alignment.center,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: color.withOpacity(0.10),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(13),
                ),
                child: Text(l.categorieEmoji, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 19)),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(l.categorieLabel,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                            fontSize: 14.5,
                            color: TAPAColors.navy)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(info,
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 12,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                            fontFeatures: _tabular,
                            color: depasse ? TAPAColors.red : TAPAColors.textSecond)),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Text(_fmt(reel),
                  style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 14.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      fontFeatures: _tabular,
                      color: depasse ? TAPAColors.red : TAPAColors.navy)),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
            child: LinearProgressIndicator(
              value: ratio.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble(),
              minHeight: 6,
              backgroundColor: color.withOpacity(0.12),
              color: color,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // BARRE DE NAVIGATION INFÉRIEURE
  // ==========================================================

  Widget _buildBottomNavigationBar() {
    return Container(
      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: TAPAColors.border)),
      ),
      child: SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: 8),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              for (int i = 0; i < _navItems.length; i++) _buildNavItem(i),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildNavItem(int index) {
    final item = _navItems[index];
    final active = _selectedIndex == index;
    return Expanded(
      child: GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTap: () => _navigateTo(item.route, index),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            AnimatedContainer(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
              curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: active ? 16 : 0, vertical: 6),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: active ? TAPAColors.navy : Colors.transparent,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
              ),
              child: Icon(
                active ? item.activeIcon : item.icon,
                size: 21,
                color: active ? TAPAColors.gold : TAPAColors.textHint,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(
              item.label,
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 10,
                fontWeight: active ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
                color: active ? TAPAColors.navy : TAPAColors.textHint,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// ==========================================================
// ÉDITEUR DE BUDGET
// ==========================================================

class _BudgetEditorSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final int mois;
  final int annee;
  final String monnaie;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> categories;
  final BudgetMensuel? existant;

  const _BudgetEditorSheet({
    required this.mois,
    required this.annee,
    required this.monnaie,
    required this.categories,
    required this.existant,
  });

  @override
  State<_BudgetEditorSheet> createState() => _BudgetEditorSheetState();
}

class _BudgetEditorSheetState extends State<_BudgetEditorSheet> {
  final Map<String, TextEditingController> _controllers = {};

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    for (final cat in widget.categories) {
      final id = cat['id'] as String? ?? '';
      double montant = 0;
      for (final l in widget.existant?.lignes ?? const <BudgetLigne>[]) {
        if (l.categorieId == id) montant = l.montantPrevu;
      }
      _controllers[id] = TextEditingController(
        text: montant > 0 ? montant.toStringAsFixed(0) : '',
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    for (final c in _controllers.values) {
      c.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  String _fmt(num v) => Fmt.montant(v.toDouble(), monnaie: widget.monnaie);

  double _total(String type) => widget.categories
      .where((c) => c['type'] == type)
      .fold<double>(
    0.0,
        (s, c) =>
    s +
        (double.tryParse(_controllers[c['id'] as String? ?? '']?.text ?? '') ?? 0),
  );

  void _enregistrer() {
    final lignes = <BudgetLigne>[];
    for (final cat in widget.categories) {
      final id = cat['id'] as String? ?? '';
      final montant = double.tryParse(_controllers[id]?.text ?? '') ?? 0;
      if (montant <= 0) continue;
      lignes.add(BudgetLigne(
        id: Fmt.genId(),
        categorieId: id,
        categorieLabel: cat['label'] as String? ?? 'Autre',
        categorieEmoji: cat['emoji'] as String? ?? '📌',
        montantPrevu: montant,
        isRevenu: cat['type'] == 'revenu',
      ));
    }

    if (lignes.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: const Text('Renseignez au moins un montant',
              style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.red,
          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    Navigator.of(context).pop(BudgetMensuel(
      id: widget.existant?.id ?? Fmt.genId(),
      mois: widget.mois,
      annee: widget.annee,
      lignes: lignes,
    ));
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final depenses = widget.categories.where((c) => c['type'] == 'depense').toList();
    final revenus = widget.categories.where((c) => c['type'] == 'revenu').toList();
    final moisLabel = BudgetMensuel(
        id: '', mois: widget.mois, annee: widget.annee, lignes: const [])
        .moisLabel;

    return DraggableScrollableSheet(
      initialChildSize: 0.88,
      minChildSize: 0.5,
      maxChildSize: 0.95,
      builder: (ctx, scrollController) => Container(
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
          color: TAPAColors.background,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(28)),
        ),
        padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
            20, 12, 20, 16 + MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Center(
              child: Container(
                width: 40,
                height: 4,
                margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: TAPAColors.border,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            Text(
              widget.existant == null ? 'Créer le budget' : 'Modifier le budget',
              style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, color: TAPAColors.navy),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 2),
            Text(moisLabel,
                style: const TextStyle(color: TAPAColors.textSecond, fontSize: 13.5)),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: TAPAColors.navy,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  _summaryItem('Dépenses prévues', _total('depense'), _alertOnNavy),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  _summaryItem('Revenus prévus', _total('revenu'), _okOnNavy),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            Expanded(
              child: ListView(
                controller: scrollController,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                children: [
                  if (depenses.isNotEmpty) _section('Dépenses', depenses),
                  if (revenus.isNotEmpty) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 18),
                    _section('Revenus', revenus),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              height: 54,
              child: ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: _enregistrer,
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
                  foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                  elevation: 0,
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
                ),
                child: const Text('Enregistrer',
                    style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 15.5)),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _summaryItem(String label, double value, Color dot) {
    return Expanded(
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Container(
                width: 8,
                height: 8,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(color: dot, shape: BoxShape.circle),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              Flexible(
                child: Text(label,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.62),
                        fontSize: 12.5,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500)),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 5),
          Text(_fmt(value),
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              style: const TextStyle(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  fontSize: 16,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                  fontFeatures: _tabular)),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _section(String title, List<Map<String, dynamic>> cats) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 4, bottom: 8),
          child: Text(title,
              style: const TextStyle(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                  fontSize: 14.5,
                  color: TAPAColors.navy)),
        ),
        Container(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: TAPAColors.surface,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
            border: Border.all(color: TAPAColors.border),
          ),
          child: Column(
            children: [
              for (int i = 0; i < cats.length; i++) ...[
                if (i > 0)
                  const Divider(
                      height: 1, indent: 14, endIndent: 14, color: TAPAColors.border),
                _buildCategoryField(cats[i]),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCategoryField(Map<String, dynamic> cat) {
    final id = cat['id'] as String? ?? '';
    final label = cat['label'] as String? ?? 'Autre';
    final emoji = cat['emoji'] as String? ?? '📌';

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            width: 36,
            height: 36,
            alignment: Alignment.center,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: TAPAColors.navy.withOpacity(0.06),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11),
            ),
            child: Text(emoji, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 17)),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            flex: 5,
            child: Text(label,
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: const TextStyle(
                    color: TAPAColors.navy,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    fontSize: 14)),
          ),
          Expanded(
            flex: 5,
            child: TextField(
              controller: _controllers[id],
              keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
              textAlign: TextAlign.right,
              inputFormatters: [FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly],
              onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
              style: const TextStyle(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                  fontSize: 15,
                  color: TAPAColors.navy,
                  fontFeatures: _tabular),
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                hintText: '0',
                suffixText: widget.monnaie,
                suffixStyle: const TextStyle(
                    color: TAPAColors.textHint,
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                isDense: true,
                filled: true,
                fillColor: TAPAColors.background,
                contentPadding:
                const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 11),
                border: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  borderSide: BorderSide.none,
                ),
                focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  borderSide: const BorderSide(color: TAPAColors.gold, width: 1.5),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class AppRouter {
  final GoRouter router;

  AppRouter(WidgetRef ref) : router = _buildRouter(ref);

  /// Fonction pour vérifier l'existence du PIN
  static Future<bool> _checkIfPinExists(WidgetRef ref) async {
    try {
      final db = DBService();
      final hasPin = await db.hasPin();
      Logger.info(hasPin ? '✅ PIN trouvé' : '❌ Aucun PIN trouvé');
      return hasPin;
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur vérification PIN: $e');
      return false;
    }
  }

  static GoRouter _buildRouter(WidgetRef ref) {
    return GoRouter(
      initialLocation: '/splash',
      redirect: (context, state) async {
        final isAuthenticated = ref.read(isAuthenticatedProvider);
        final user = ref.read(currentUserProvider);
        final location = state.matchedLocation;

        final isOnboardingScreen = location == '/onboarding';
        final isPinScreen = location == '/pin-setup' || location == '/pin-login';
        final isActivationScreen = location == '/activation';
        final isAuthScreen = location == '/inscription' ||
            location == '/pin-login' ||
            location == '/verify-phone' ||
            location == '/splash';

        // ---- Utilisateur NON connecté ----
        if (!isAuthenticated) {
          if (location == '/splash' || isAuthScreen) {
            return null;
          }
          return '/inscription';
        }

        // ---- Utilisateur connecté ----
        final needsOnboarding = !(user?.onboardingVu ?? false);
        final hasPin = await _checkIfPinExists(ref);
        final needsPin = !hasPin;

        // ÉTAPE 1 : ONBOARDING
        if (needsOnboarding) {
          Logger.info('🔄 Redirection: Onboarding nécessaire');
          return isOnboardingScreen ? null : '/onboarding';
        }

        // ÉTAPE 2 : PIN
        if (needsPin) {
          Logger.info('🔄 Redirection: PIN nécessaire (hasPin=$hasPin)');
          return isPinScreen ? null : '/pin-setup';
        }

        // ✅ ACCÈS GRATUIT POUR TOUS : plus de vérification d'essai/abonnement
        return null;
      },
      routes: [
        // ============================================
        // ROUTES PUBLIQUES
        // ============================================
        GoRoute(
          path: '/splash',
          builder: (context, state) => const SplashScreen(),
        ),
        GoRoute(
          path: '/inscription',
          builder: (context, state) => const InscriptionScreen(),
        ),
        GoRoute(
          path: '/verify-phone',
          builder: (context, state) {
            final args = state.extra as Map<String, String>? ?? {};
            return VerifyPhoneScreen(
              prenom: args['prenom'] ?? '',
              telephone: args['telephone'] ?? '',
              indicatif: args['indicatif'] ?? '+225',
              codePays: args['codePays'] ?? 'CI',
              monnaie: args['monnaie'] ?? 'FCFA',
            );
          },
        ),
        GoRoute(
          path: '/pin-login',
          builder: (context, state) => const PinScreen(isSetup: false),
        ),
        GoRoute(
          path: '/pin-setup',
          builder: (context, state) => const PinScreen(isSetup: true),
        ),
        GoRoute(
          path: '/activation',
          builder: (context, state) => const ActivationScreen(),
        ),

        // ============================================
        // ROUTES PROTÉGÉES
        // ============================================
        GoRoute(
          path: '/onboarding',
          builder: (context, state) => const OnboardingScreen(),
        ),
        GoRoute(
          path: '/setup-wallets',
          builder: (context, state) => const SetupWalletsScreen(),
        ),
        GoRoute(
          path: '/home',
          builder: (context, state) => const HomeScreen(),
        ),
        GoRoute(
          path: '/admin/withdraws',
          builder: (context, state) => const AdminWithdrawScreen(),
        ),
        // ✅ Route Admin (accès réservé)

// lib/services/link_service.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';
import '../../core/theme/app_theme.dart'; // ✅ AJOUTÉ pour TAPAColors

class LinkService {
  static Future<void> ouvrirWhatsApp({String message = ''}) async {
    try {
      String url = 'https://wa.me/2250160254102';
      if (message.isNotEmpty) {
        url = 'https://wa.me/2250160254102?text=${Uri.encodeComponent(message)}';
      }

      final uri = Uri.parse(url);

      if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
        await launchUrl(
          uri,
          mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
        );
      } else {
        final webUrl = Uri.parse('https://wa.me/2250160254102');
        if (await canLaunchUrl(webUrl)) {
          await launchUrl(webUrl, mode: LaunchMode.platformDefault);
        } else {
          throw Exception('Impossible d\'ouvrir WhatsApp');
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('Erreur WhatsApp: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  static Future<void> ouvrirBoutique() async {
    try {
      final urls = [
        'https://tapa-budget.com/boutique',
        'https://tapa-budget.com',
        'https://tapa-budget.com/shop',
      ];

      bool opened = false;

      for (final url in urls) {
        try {
          final uri = Uri.parse(url);
          if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
            await launchUrl(
              uri,
              mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
            );
            opened = true;
            break;
          }
        } catch (e) {
          // Continuer avec l'URL suivante
        }
      }

      if (!opened) {
        throw Exception('Aucune URL accessible');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('Erreur boutique: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  static Future<void> ouvrirSite() async {
    try {
      final uri = Uri.parse('https://tapa-budget.com');
      if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
        await launchUrl(
          uri,
          mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
        );
      } else {
        throw Exception('Impossible d\'ouvrir le site');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('Erreur site: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  static Future<void> ouvrirBoutiqueAvecFallback(BuildContext context) async {
    try {
      await ouvrirBoutique();
    } catch (e) {
      if (context.mounted) {
        _showUrlDialog(context, 'https://tapa-budget.com/boutique');
      }
    }
  }

  static void _showUrlDialog(BuildContext context, String url) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Row(
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.shopping_bag_outlined),
            SizedBox(width: 10),
            Text('Boutique TAPA'),
          ],
        ),
        content: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            const Text(
              'Impossible d\'ouvrir la boutique automatiquement.\n'
                  'Vous pouvez copier le lien ci-dessous et l\'ouvrir dans votre navigateur :',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: TAPAColors.background,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                border: Border.all(color: TAPAColors.border),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      url,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: Colors.blue,
                        decoration: TextDecoration.underline,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    onPressed: () {
                      // Copier l'URL
                      ScaffoldMessenger.of(ctx).showSnackBar(
                        const SnackBar(
                          content: Text('📋 Lien copié !'),
                          backgroundColor: TAPAColors.gold,
                          duration: Duration(seconds: 2),
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.copy, color: TAPAColors.gold),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
            child: const Text('Fermer'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton.icon(
            onPressed: () async {
              Navigator.pop(ctx);
              try {
                await ouvrirSite();
              } catch (_) {}
            },
            icon: const Icon(Icons.open_in_browser),
            label: const Text('Ouvrir le site'),
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: TAPAColors.navy,
              foregroundColor: TAPAColors.white,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';

class CryptoService {
  static const String _key = 'TAPA_BUDGET_2026_CI';

  static String genererHash(String walletId, double montant,
      String categorieId, String type, DateTime date) {
    final data = '$walletId|$montant|$categorieId|$type'
        '|${date.toIso8601String()}|$_key';
    return _hash(data);
  }

  static bool verifierHash(String hash, String walletId,
      double montant, String categorieId,
      String type, DateTime date) {
    return hash ==
        genererHash(walletId, montant, categorieId, type, date);
  }

  static String _hash(String input) {
    final bytes = utf8.encode(input);

    // Utiliser deux hash 32 bits pour la compatibilité JavaScript
    int h1 = 0x811c9dc5; // FNV-1a 32-bit offset basis
    int h2 = 0x811c9dc5;

    for (final b in bytes) {
      h1 ^= b;
      h1 = (h1 * 0x01000193) & 0xFFFFFFFF; // FNV-1a 32-bit prime

      h2 ^= b;
      h2 = (h2 * 0x01000193) & 0xFFFFFFFF;
    }

    // Combiner les deux parties
    final p1 = h1.toRadixString(16).padLeft(8, '0');
    final p2 = h2.toRadixString(16).padLeft(8, '0');
    final extra = bytes.fold(0, (a, b) => a + b);
    final p3 = extra.toRadixString(16).padLeft(8, '0');

    return '$p1$p2$p3';
  }

  static Map<String, dynamic> analyserCoherence(
      double totalRevenus,
      double totalDepenses,
      int nbTransactions,
      int nbMois) {
    int score = 100;
    final alertes = <String>[];

    if (totalRevenus <= 0 && totalDepenses <= 0) {
      return {
        'score': 50,
        'alertes': ['Aucune transaction enregistree.'],
        'fiable': false,
      };
    }

    if (totalRevenus > 0) {
      final ratio = totalDepenses / totalRevenus;
      if (ratio > 10) {
        score -= 40;
        alertes.add('Dépenses 10x supérieures aux revenus. Incohérence détectée.');
      } else if (ratio > 5) {
        score -= 20;
        alertes.add('Dépenses tres elevees par rapport aux revenus.');
      } else if (ratio > 2) {
        score -= 10;
        alertes.add('Dépenses supérieures au double des revenus.');
      }
    }

    final revMensuel =
    nbMois > 0 ? totalRevenus / nbMois : totalRevenus;
    if (revMensuel > 10000000) {
      score -= 25;
      alertes.add('Revenus mensuels tres eleves. Verification recommandee.');
    } else if (revMensuel > 5000000) {
      score -= 10;
      alertes.add('Revenus eleves. Justificatifs recommandes.');
    }

    if (totalRevenus == 0 && totalDepenses > 1000000) {
      score -= 30;
      alertes.add('Dépenses importantes sans revenus declares.');
    }

    score = score.clamp(0, 100);
    return {
      'score': score,
      'alertes': alertes,
      'fiable': score >= 60,
    };
  }
}

// lib/services/migration_service.dart

import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import '../core/utils/logger.dart';

/// Service de migration pour corriger les données existantes
class MigrationService {
  static final FirebaseFirestore _firestore = FirebaseFirestore.instance;

  /// ✅ Migrer les dates d'inscription manquantes
  static Future<void> migrerDatesInscription() async {
    Logger.info('🔍 Début de la migration des dates d\'inscription...');

    try {
      final snapshot = await _firestore.collection('users').get();
      int count = 0;
      int updated = 0;

      for (final doc in snapshot.docs) {
        count++;
        final data = doc.data();
        final userId = doc.id;

        // Vérifier si la date d'inscription existe
        if (!data.containsKey('dateInscription') || data['dateInscription'] == null) {
          String? dateStr;

          // Essayer d'utiliser la date de création
          if (data.containsKey('createdAt')) {
            final timestamp = data['createdAt'];
            if (timestamp is Timestamp) {
              dateStr = timestamp.toDate().toIso8601String();
            }
          }

          // Fallback : date actuelle
          dateStr ??= DateTime.now().toIso8601String();

          // Mettre à jour le document
          await doc.reference.update({
            'dateInscription': dateStr,
            'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
          });

          updated++;
          Logger.info('✅ Migration pour $userId: dateInscription = $dateStr');
        }
      }

      Logger.success('✅ Migration terminée ! $updated utilisateurs mis à jour sur $count.');
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur migration: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  /// ✅ Vérifier et corriger les données d'un utilisateur spécifique
  static Future<void> verifierUtilisateur(String userId) async {
    try {
      final doc = await _firestore.collection('users').doc(userId).get();

      if (!doc.exists) {
        Logger.warning('⚠️ Utilisateur $userId non trouvé');
        return;
      }

      final data = doc.data()!;
      Logger.info('📋 Données utilisateur $userId:');
      Logger.info('  - prenom: ${data['prenom']}');
      Logger.info('  - dateInscription: ${data['dateInscription'] ?? 'MANQUANTE'}');
      Logger.info('  - createdAt: ${data['createdAt']}');
      Logger.info('  - hasAccessVie: ${data['hasAccessVie']}');
      Logger.info('  - onboardingVu: ${data['onboardingVu']}');

      // Si la date d'inscription est manquante, la corriger
      if (!data.containsKey('dateInscription') || data['dateInscription'] == null) {
        String? dateStr;

        if (data.containsKey('createdAt')) {
          final timestamp = data['createdAt'];
          if (timestamp is Timestamp) {
            dateStr = timestamp.toDate().toIso8601String();
          }
        }

        dateStr ??= DateTime.now().toIso8601String();

        await doc.reference.update({
          'dateInscription': dateStr,
          'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        });

        Logger.success('✅ Date d\'inscription corrigée pour $userId: $dateStr');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur vérification utilisateur: $e');
    }
  }

  /// ✅ Afficher les statistiques des utilisateurs
  static Future<void> afficherStatistiques() async {
    try {
      final snapshot = await _firestore.collection('users').get();
      final total = snapshot.docs.length;
      int avecDate = 0;
      int sansDate = 0;

      for (final doc in snapshot.docs) {
        final data = doc.data();
        if (data.containsKey('dateInscription') && data['dateInscription'] != null) {
          avecDate++;
        } else {
          sansDate++;
        }
      }

      Logger.info('📊 STATISTIQUES UTILISATEURS:');
      Logger.info('  - Total: $total');
      Logger.info('  - Avec date d\'inscription: $avecDate');
      Logger.info('  - Sans date d\'inscription: $sansDate');
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur statistiques: $e');
    }
  }

  /// ✅ Corriger la date d'inscription d'un utilisateur spécifique
  static Future<bool> corrigerDateInscription(String userId) async {
    try {
      final doc = await _firestore.collection('users').doc(userId).get();

      if (!doc.exists) {
        Logger.warning('⚠️ Utilisateur $userId non trouvé');
        return false;
      }

      final data = doc.data()!;
      final dateStr = DateTime.now().toIso8601String();

      await doc.reference.update({
        'dateInscription': dateStr,
        'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });

      Logger.success('✅ Date d\'inscription mise à jour pour $userId: $dateStr');
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur correction date: $e');
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// ✅ Réinitialiser l'essai gratuit d'un utilisateur
  static Future<bool> reinitialiserEssai(String userId) async {
    try {
      final doc = await _firestore.collection('users').doc(userId).get();

      if (!doc.exists) {
        Logger.warning('⚠️ Utilisateur $userId non trouvé');
        return false;
      }

      final dateStr = DateTime.now().toIso8601String();

      await doc.reference.update({
        'dateInscription': dateStr,
        'hasAccessVie': false,
        'cleActivee': FieldValue.delete(),
        'accesType': FieldValue.delete(),
        'dateActivation': FieldValue.delete(),
        'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });

      Logger.success('✅ Essai réinitialisé pour $userId');
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur réinitialisation essai: $e');
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// ✅ Supprimer la date d'inscription d'un utilisateur (danger)
  static Future<bool> supprimerDateInscription(String userId) async {
    try {
      final doc = await _firestore.collection('users').doc(userId).get();

      if (!doc.exists) {
        Logger.warning('⚠️ Utilisateur $userId non trouvé');
        return false;
      }

      await doc.reference.update({
        'dateInscription': FieldValue.delete(),
        'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });

      Logger.warning('⚠️ Date d\'inscription supprimée pour $userId');
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur suppression date: $e');
      return false;
    }
  }
}

// lib/services/firebase_service.dart

import '../core/utils/date_parser.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:flutter_dotenv/flutter_dotenv.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../data/models/models.dart';
import '../core/utils/logger.dart';
import 'pin_security.dart';

/// Service principal d'interaction avec Firebase
/// Gère l'authentification, les données utilisateur et la sécurité
class FirebaseService {
  static final FirebaseService _instance = FirebaseService._internal();
  factory FirebaseService() => _instance;
  FirebaseService._internal();

  final FirebaseAuth _auth = FirebaseAuth.instance;
  final FirebaseFirestore _firestore = FirebaseFirestore.instance;

  SharedPreferences? _prefs;
  String? _currentUserId;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _categories = [];

  // ============================================
  // CONSTANTES
  // ============================================

  static const int DUREE_ESSAI_JOURS = 10;
  static const int PRIX_ACCES_VIE = 5000;
  static const String FORMAT_CLE = 'TB-2026-XXXXXXXX';

  // ✅ ROOT_DEV_KEY depuis .env
  static String get _rootDevKey => dotenv.env['ROOT_DEV_KEY'] ?? '';

  // ============================================
  // INITIALISATION
  // ============================================

  Future<void> init() async {
    _prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();

    final user = _auth.currentUser;
    if (user != null) {
      _currentUserId = user.uid;
      await _prefs?.setString('user_id', user.uid);
      Logger.info('✅ FirebaseService - Utilisateur déjà connecté: ${user.uid}');
    } else {
      _currentUserId = _prefs?.getString('user_id');
      if (_currentUserId != null) {
        Logger.info('✅ FirebaseService - Utilisateur restauré: $_currentUserId');
      } else {
        Logger.info('ℹ️ FirebaseService - Aucun utilisateur');
      }
    }

    if (_currentUserId != null) {
      await _loadCategories();
      Logger.info('📂 Catégories initiales: ${_categories.length}');
    }

    _verifierConfigurationRoot();
  }

  // ✅ VÉRIFIER LA CONFIGURATION ROOT
  void _verifierConfigurationRoot() {
    if (_rootDevKey.isEmpty) {
      Logger.warning('⚠️ ROOT_DEV_KEY non définie dans .env');
    } else {
      Logger.info('✅ ROOT_DEV_KEY chargée avec succès');
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // AUTH - GESTION DE L'UTILISATEUR
  // ============================================

  String? getCurrentUserId() {
    if (_currentUserId == null) {
      final user = _auth.currentUser;
      if (user != null) {
        _currentUserId = user.uid;
        _prefs?.setString('user_id', user.uid);
        Logger.info('🔍 getCurrentUserId - Récupéré depuis Firebase Auth: ${user.uid}');
      }
    }
    return _currentUserId;
  }

  bool get isLoggedIn {
    final user = _auth.currentUser;
    return user != null || _currentUserId != null;
  }

  Future<void> setCurrentUser(User? user) async {
    if (user != null) {
      _currentUserId = user.uid;
      await _prefs?.setString('user_id', user.uid);
      await _loadCategories();
      Logger.info('👤 FirebaseService - Utilisateur connecté: ${user.uid}');
    } else {
      _currentUserId = null;
      await _prefs?.remove('user_id');
      _categories = [];
      Logger.info('👤 FirebaseService - Utilisateur déconnecté');
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // GESTION DE L'ESSAI GRATUIT - ✅ CORRIGÉ
  // ============================================

  bool get essaiGratuitExpire {
    // ✅ 1. Lire depuis SharedPreferences d'abord
    String? dateInscription = _prefs?.getString('date_inscription');

    // ✅ 2. Si pas en local, essayer de lire depuis Firestore (synchrone)
    if (dateInscription == null) {
      final userId = getCurrentUserId();
      if (userId != null) {
        try {
          // ⚠️ Lecture synchrone impossible avec Firestore
          // On va utiliser la version asynchrone via isEssaiGratuitExpire()
          Logger.warning('⚠️ Date d\'inscription non trouvée localement, utilisez la version asynchrone');
          return false; // ✅ FALLBACK SÉCURISÉ
        } catch (e) {
          Logger.error('❌ Erreur récupération date: $e');
          return false;
        }
      }
      Logger.warning('⚠️ Date d\'inscription non trouvée');
      return false; // ✅ FALLBACK SÉCURISÉ
    }

    try {
      final date = DateTime.parse(dateInscription);
      final now = DateTime.now();
      final diff = now.difference(date);
      final isExpired = diff.inDays > DUREE_ESSAI_JOURS;
      Logger.info('📅 Date inscription: $date, Jours écoulés: ${diff.inDays}, Expiré: $isExpired');
      return isExpired;
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur lecture date inscription: $e');
      return false;
    }
  }

  int get joursRestantsEssai {
    final dateInscription = _prefs?.getString('date_inscription');
    if (dateInscription == null) return 0;

    try {
      final date = DateTime.parse(dateInscription);
      final now = DateTime.now();
      final diff = now.difference(date);
      return (DUREE_ESSAI_JOURS - diff.inDays).clamp(0, DUREE_ESSAI_JOURS);
    } catch (e) {
      return 0;
    }
  }

  Future<bool> isEssaiGratuitExpire() async {
    // ✅ 1. Lire depuis SharedPreferences
    String? dateInscription = _prefs?.getString('date_inscription');

    // ✅ 2. Si pas en local, lire depuis Firestore
    if (dateInscription == null) {
      final userId = getCurrentUserId();
      if (userId != null) {
        try {
          final doc = await _firestore.collection('users').doc(userId).get();
          if (doc.exists && doc.data() != null) {
            final data = doc.data()!;
            if (data.containsKey('dateInscription')) {
              dateInscription = data['dateInscription'] as String?;
              if (dateInscription != null) {
                await _prefs?.setString('date_inscription', dateInscription);
                Logger.info('📅 Date chargée depuis Firestore: $dateInscription');
              }
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {
          Logger.error('❌ Erreur récupération date Firestore: $e');
        }
      }
    }

    if (dateInscription == null) {
      Logger.warning('⚠️ Date d\'inscription non trouvée');
      // ✅ FALLBACK : Si pas de date, on considère que l'essai n'est PAS expiré
      // pour ne pas bloquer l'utilisateur
      return false;
    }

    try {
      final date = DateTime.parse(dateInscription);
      final now = DateTime.now();
      final diff = now.difference(date);
      final isExpired = diff.inDays > DUREE_ESSAI_JOURS;
      Logger.info('📅 Date inscription: $date, Jours écoulés: ${diff.inDays}, Expiré: $isExpired');
      return isExpired;
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur lecture date inscription: $e');
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> sauvegarderDateInscription(DateTime date) async {
    final dateStr = date.toIso8601String();

    // ✅ Sauvegarde locale
    await _prefs?.setString('date_inscription', dateStr);
    Logger.info('📅 Date d\'inscription sauvegardée localement: $dateStr');

    // ✅ Sauvegarde Firestore
    final userId = getCurrentUserId();
    if (userId != null) {
      try {
        await _firestore.collection('users').doc(userId).update({
          'dateInscription': dateStr,
          'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        });
        Logger.info('📅 Date d\'inscription sauvegardée dans Firestore: $dateStr');
      } catch (e) {
        Logger.error('❌ Erreur sauvegarde date dans Firestore: $e');
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // GESTION DE L'ACCÈS
  // ============================================

  bool get aAccesAVie => _prefs?.getBool('acces_vie') ?? false;

  bool get isRootUser {
    final cle = _prefs?.getString('cle_activee');
    if (cle == null) return false;
    final rootKey = _rootDevKey;
    return cle == rootKey && rootKey.isNotEmpty;
  }

  bool verifierCle(String cle) {
    if (cle.isEmpty) return false;

    // ✅ Vérifier la clé root
    final rootKey = _rootDevKey;
    if (cle == rootKey && rootKey.isNotEmpty) {
      Logger.info('👑 Clé root validée');
      return true;
    }

    // Vérifier les clés normales
    final regex = RegExp(r'^TB-2026-[A-Z0-9]{8}$');
    final isValid = regex.hasMatch(cle);
    if (isValid) {
      Logger.info('✅ Clé premium valide: $cle');
    } else {
      Logger.warning('⚠️ Clé invalide: $cle');
    }
    return isValid;
  }

  Future<void> activerAccesVie(String cle) async {
    final rootKey = _rootDevKey;
    final isRoot = cle == rootKey && rootKey.isNotEmpty;

    await _prefs?.setBool('acces_vie', true);
    await _prefs?.setString('cle_activee', cle);
    await _prefs?.setString('date_activation', DateTime.now().toIso8601String());

    if (isRoot) {
      await _prefs?.setString('acces_type', 'root');
      Logger.info('👑 Accès root activé avec la clé: $cle');
    } else {
      await _prefs?.setString('acces_type', 'premium');
      Logger.info('✅ Accès premium activé avec la clé: $cle');
    }

    final userId = getCurrentUserId();
    if (userId != null) {
      try {
        await _firestore.collection('users').doc(userId).update({
          'hasAccesVie': true,
          'cleActivee': cle,
          'accesType': isRoot ? 'root' : 'premium',
          'dateActivation': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
          'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        });
        Logger.info('✅ Accès sauvegardé dans Firestore pour $userId');
      } catch (e) {
        Logger.error('❌ Erreur sauvegarde accès dans Firestore: $e');
      }
    }
  }

  bool get peutAcceder => isRootUser || aAccesAVie || !essaiGratuitExpire;

  // ============================================
  // UTILISATEUR
  // ============================================

  Map<String, dynamic>? getUser() {
    final prenom = _prefs?.getString('user_prenom');
    final telephone = _prefs?.getString('user_telephone');
    final monnaie = _prefs?.getString('user_monnaie') ?? 'FCFA';
    final pinCode = _prefs?.getString('user_pin') ?? '';
    final hasAccesVie = _prefs?.getBool('acces_vie') ?? false;
    final isRoot = isRootUser;

    if (prenom == null) return null;
    return {
      'prenom': prenom,
      'telephone': telephone ?? '',
      'monnaie': monnaie,
      'pinCode': pinCode,
      'hasAccesVie': hasAccesVie,
      'isRoot': isRoot,
    };
  }

  Future<void> saveUser(UserModel user) async {
    try {
      final uid = _auth.currentUser?.uid ?? user.id;
      final now = DateTime.now();

      await _firestore.collection('users').doc(uid).set({
        'phoneNumber': user.phoneNumber,
        'prenom': user.prenom,
        'monnaie': user.monnaie,
        'codePays': user.codePays,
        'hasAccessVie': user.hasAccessVie,
        'onboardingVu': user.onboardingVu,
        'notificationsActivees': user.notificationsActivees,
        'dateInscription': now.toIso8601String(),  // ✅ SAUVEGARDE ICI
        'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });

      _currentUserId = uid;
      await _prefs?.setString('user_id', uid);
      await _prefs?.setString('user_telephone', user.phoneNumber);
      await _prefs?.setString('user_prenom', user.prenom);
      await _prefs?.setString('user_monnaie', user.monnaie);

      // ✅ SAUVEGARDER LA DATE D'INSCRIPTION
      await sauvegarderDateInscription(now);

      await _initDefaultWallets(uid);
      await _initDefaultCategories(uid);
      await _loadCategories();

      Logger.info('✅ Utilisateur sauvegardé: $uid');
      Logger.info('📅 Date d\'inscription: $now');
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur saveUser: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // PIN - SÉCURISÉ AVEC HASH ET ANTI-BRUTEFORCE
  // ============================================

  Future<void> savePin(String pin) async {
    try {
      final userId = getCurrentUserId();
      if (userId == null) {
        throw Exception('Utilisateur non authentifié');
      }

      await PinSecurity.savePin(userId, pin);

      final hashedPin = await PinSecurity.hashPinForStorage(pin);
      await _firestore.collection('users').doc(userId).set({
        'pinHash': hashedPin,
        'pinFailures': 0,
        'pinLockTime': 0,
        'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));

      await _prefs?.remove('user_pin');
      await _firestore.collection('users').doc(userId).update({
        'pinCode': FieldValue.delete(),
      });

      Logger.info('✅ PIN sauvegardé de manière sécurisée');
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur savePin: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<PinCheckResult> verifyPin(String pin) async {
    try {
      final userId = getCurrentUserId();
      if (userId == null) {
        return const PinCheckResult(
          success: false,
          message: 'Utilisateur non authentifié',
        );
      }

      final result = await PinSecurity.verifyPin(userId, pin);

      if (result.success) {
        await _firestore.collection('users').doc(userId).set({
          'pinFailures': 0,
          'pinLockTime': 0,
          'lastPinVerifiedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      } else if (result.isLocked) {
        await _firestore.collection('users').doc(userId).set({
          'pinLockTime': result.lockTime?.millisecondsSinceEpoch ?? 0,
          'pinFailures': 5,
        }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      } else {
        final doc = await _firestore.collection('users').doc(userId).get();
        final currentFailures = (doc.data()?['pinFailures'] as int?) ?? 0;
        await _firestore.collection('users').doc(userId).set({
          'pinFailures': currentFailures + 1,
        }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      }

      return result;
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur verifyPin: $e');
      return const PinCheckResult(
        success: false,
        message: 'Erreur lors de la vérification',
      );
    }
  }

  Future<bool> hasPin() async {
    try {
      final userId = getCurrentUserId();
      if (userId == null) return false;

      final hasLocalPin = await PinSecurity.hasPin(userId);
      if (hasLocalPin) return true;

      final doc = await _firestore.collection('users').doc(userId).get();
      if (doc.exists) {
        final data = doc.data();
        if (data != null) {
          final pinHash = data['pinHash'] as String?;
          if (pinHash != null && pinHash.isNotEmpty) {
            await PinSecurity.migrateFromFirestore(userId, pinHash);
            Logger.info('✅ PIN migré de Firestore vers stockage local');
            return true;
          }
        }
      }

      return false;
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur hasPin: $e');
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> clearPinData() async {
    try {
      final userId = getCurrentUserId();
      if (userId == null) return;

      await PinSecurity.clearPinData(userId);
      await _firestore.collection('users').doc(userId).set({
        'pinHash': FieldValue.delete(),
        'pinFailures': FieldValue.delete(),
        'pinLockTime': FieldValue.delete(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));

      Logger.info('✅ Données PIN supprimées');
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur clearPinData: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<List<WalletModel>> getWallets() async {

          .collection('wallets')

          .orderBy('createdAt', descending: false)
          .get();

      return snap.docs.map((doc) {
        final data = doc.data();
        return WalletModel(
          id: doc.id,
          uid: data['uid'] ?? '',
          nom: data['nom'] ?? '',
          emoji: data['emoji'] ?? '💵',
          type: data['type'] ?? 'autre',
          solde: (data['solde'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0,
          monnaie: data['monnaie'] ?? 'FCFA',
          description: data['description'] ?? '',
          createdAt: parseFirestoreDateOrNull(data['createdAt']),
          updatedAt: parseFirestoreDateOrNull(data['updatedAt']),
        );
      }).toList();
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur getWallets: $e');
      return [];
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // TRANSACTIONS
  // ============================================

  Future<List<TransactionModel>> getTransactions() async {
    final userId = getCurrentUserId();
    if (userId == null) return [];

    try {
      final snap = await _firestore
          .collection('transactions')
          .where('uid', isEqualTo: userId)
          .orderBy('dateTransaction', descending: true)
          .limit(100)
          .get();

      return snap.docs.map((doc) {
        final data = doc.data();
        return TransactionModel(
          id: doc.id,
          uid: data['uid'] ?? '',
          walletId: data['walletId'] ?? '',
          montant: (data['montant'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0,
          type: _parseTransactionType(data['type'] as String? ?? 'depense'),
          categorieId: data['categorieId'] ?? '',
          categorieLabel: data['categorieLabel'] ?? 'Autre',
          categorieEmoji: data['categorieEmoji'] ?? '📌',
          note: data['note'],
          dateTransaction: parseFirestoreDate(data['dateTransaction']),
          createdAt: parseFirestoreDate(data['createdAt']),
        );
      }).toList();
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur getTransactions: $e');
      return [];
    }
  }

  TransactionType _parseTransactionType(String type) {
    switch (type.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'revenu':
        return TransactionType.revenu;
      case 'transfert':
        return TransactionType.transfert;
      default:
        return TransactionType.depense;
    }
  }

  Future<void> addTransaction(TransactionModel transaction) async {
    final userId = getCurrentUserId();
    if (userId == null) return;

    await _firestore.collection('transactions').add({
      'uid': userId,
      'walletId': transaction.walletId,
      'montant': transaction.montant,
      'type': transaction.type.toString().split('.').last,
      'categorieId': transaction.categorieId,
      'categorieLabel': transaction.categorieLabel,
      'categorieEmoji': transaction.categorieEmoji,
      'note': transaction.note,
      'dateTransaction': transaction.dateTransaction,
      'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
  }

  Future<void> updateTransaction(TransactionModel oldTx, TransactionModel newTx) async {}
  Future<void> deleteTransaction(TransactionModel transaction) async {}

  Future<void> _loadCategories() async {
    final userId = getCurrentUserId();
    if (userId == null) {
      _categories = [];
      return;
    }

    try {
      final snap = await _firestore
          .collection('categories')
          .where('uid', isEqualTo: userId)
          .get();

      _categories = snap.docs.map((d) => {
        'id': d.id,
        ...d.data(),
      }).toList();
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur chargement catégories: $e');
      _categories = [];
    }
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> getCategories() => _categories;

  /// ✅ NOUVELLE MÉTHODE : Recharge depuis Firestore ET retourne la liste
  /// Utilise cette méthode au lieu de getCategories() pour forcer le refresh
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> reloadCategoriesFromFirestore() async {
    await _loadCategories();
    return List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(_categories);
  }

  Future<void> addCategory(Map<String, dynamic> category) async {
    final userId = getCurrentUserId();
    if (userId == null) {
      throw Exception('Utilisateur non authentifié');
    }

    final id = category['id'] as String? ?? DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString();
    final label = category['label'] as String? ?? 'Autre';
    final emoji = category['emoji'] as String? ?? '📌';
    final type = category['type'] as String? ?? 'depense';

    try {
      await _firestore.collection('categories').doc(id).set({
        'uid': userId,
        'categorieId': id,
        'label': label,
        'emoji': emoji,
        'type': type,
        'isDefault': category['isDefault'] ?? false,
        'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
      await _loadCategories();
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur addCategory: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<void> deleteCategory(String categoryId) async {
    final userId = getCurrentUserId();
    if (userId == null) {
      throw Exception('Utilisateur non authentifié');
    }

    try {
      await _firestore.collection('categories').doc(categoryId).delete();
      await _loadCategories();
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur deleteCategory: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  // BUDGET

  String _budgetDocId(int mois, int annee) => '$annee-$mois';

  Future<BudgetMensuel?> getBudget(int mois, int annee) async {
    final userId = getCurrentUserId();
    if (userId == null) return null;

    final doc = await _firestore
        .collection('users')
        .doc(userId)
        .collection('budgets')
        .doc(_budgetDocId(mois, annee))
        .get();

    if (!doc.exists || doc.data() == null) return null;
    return BudgetMensuel.fromMap(doc.data()!);
  }

  Future<void> saveBudget(BudgetMensuel budget) async {
    final userId = getCurrentUserId();
    if (userId == null) return;

    await _firestore
        .collection('users')
        .doc(userId)
        .collection('budgets')
        .doc(_budgetDocId(budget.mois, budget.annee))
        .set(budget.toMap());
  }

  Future<void> deleteBudget(int mois, int annee) async {
    final userId = getCurrentUserId();
    if (userId == null) return;

    await _firestore
        .collection('users')
        .doc(userId)
        .collection('budgets')
        .doc(_budgetDocId(mois, annee))
        .delete();
  }

  Future<double> _sommeTransactions(int mois, int annee, String type) async {
    final userId = getCurrentUserId();
    if (userId == null) return 0.0;

    final debut = DateTime(annee, mois, 1);
    final fin = DateTime(annee, mois + 1, 1);

    final snap = await _firestore
        .collection('transactions')
        .where('uid', isEqualTo: userId)
        .where('type', isEqualTo: type)
        .where('dateTransaction', isGreaterThanOrEqualTo: debut)
        .where('dateTransaction', isLessThan: fin)
        .get();

    double total = 0.0;
    for (final d in snap.docs) {
      total += (d.data()['montant'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
    }
    return total;
  }

  Future<double> getTotalDepensesReelles(int mois, int annee) =>
      _sommeTransactions(mois, annee, 'depense');

  Future<double> getTotalRevenusReels(int mois, int annee) =>
      _sommeTransactions(mois, annee, 'revenu');

  Future<double> getDepensesReellesByCategorie(String categorieId, int mois, int annee) async {
    final userId = getCurrentUserId();
    if (userId == null) return 0.0;

    final debut = DateTime(annee, mois, 1);
    final fin = DateTime(annee, mois + 1, 1);

    final snap = await _firestore
        .collection('transactions')
        .where('uid', isEqualTo: userId)
        .where('categorieId', isEqualTo: categorieId)
        .where('dateTransaction', isGreaterThanOrEqualTo: debut)
        .where('dateTransaction', isLessThan: fin)
        .get();

    double total = 0.0;
    for (final d in snap.docs) {
      total += (d.data()['montant'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
    }
    return total;
  }

  // ============================================
  // STATISTIQUES
  // ============================================

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> getStatistics() async {
    try {
      final userId = getCurrentUserId();
      if (userId == null) {
        return {
          'total_revenus': 0.0,
          'total_depenses': 0.0,
          'solde': 0.0,
          'nombre_transactions': 0,
          'revenus_prevus': 0.0,
          'depenses_prevues': 0.0,
          'solde_previsionnel': 0.0,
          'taux_depense': 0.0,
          'taux_revenu': 0.0,
        };
      }

      final transactions = await getTransactions();

      double totalRevenus = 0.0;
      double totalDepenses = 0.0;

      for (final tx in transactions) {
        if (tx.type == TransactionType.revenu) {
          totalRevenus += tx.montant;
        } else if (tx.type == TransactionType.depense) {
          totalDepenses += tx.montant;
        }
      }

      final now = DateTime.now();
      final budget = await getBudget(now.month, now.year);

      double revenusPrevus = 0.0;
      double depensesPrevues = 0.0;

      if (budget != null) {
        revenusPrevus = budget.totalRevenusPrevu;
        depensesPrevues = budget.totalDepensesPrevu;
      }

      return {
        'total_revenus': totalRevenus,
        'total_depenses': totalDepenses,
        'solde': totalRevenus - totalDepenses,
        'solde_previsionnel': revenusPrevus - depensesPrevues,
        'nombre_transactions': transactions.length,
        'revenus_prevus': revenusPrevus,
        'depenses_prevues': depensesPrevues,
        'taux_depense': depensesPrevues > 0 ? (totalDepenses / depensesPrevues) : 0.0,
        'taux_revenu': revenusPrevus > 0 ? (totalRevenus / revenusPrevus) : 0.0,
      };
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur getStatistics: $e');
      return {
        'total_revenus': 0.0,
        'total_depenses': 0.0,
        'solde': 0.0,
        'solde_previsionnel': 0.0,
        'nombre_transactions': 0,
        'revenus_prevus': 0.0,
        'depenses_prevues': 0.0,
        'taux_depense': 0.0,
        'taux_revenu': 0.0,
      };
    }
  }

  bool get onboardingVu => _prefs?.getBool('onboarding_vu') ?? false;

  Future<void> marquerOnboardingVu() async {
    await _prefs?.setBool('onboarding_vu', true);

    final userId = getCurrentUserId();
    if (userId != null) {
      try {
        await _firestore.collection('users').doc(userId).update({
          'onboardingVu': true,
          'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        });
        Logger.info('✅ onboardingVu=true synchronisé dans Firestore');
      } catch (e) {
        Logger.error('❌ Erreur mise à jour onboardingVu dans Firestore: $e');
        rethrow;
      }
    } else {
      Logger.warning('⚠️ marquerOnboardingVu: aucun userId, Firestore non mis à jour');
    }
  }

  Future<void> clearAll() async {
    await _prefs?.clear();
    _categories = [];
    _currentUserId = null;
  }

  Future<void> clear() async => await _prefs?.clear();
}
