import '../core/utils/formatters.dart';

class PdfService {
  static final DBService _db = DBService();
  static const _mois = ['','Janvier','Fevrier',
    'Mars','Avril','Mai','Juin','Juillet','Aout',
    'Septembre','Octobre','Novembre','Decembre'];

  static Future<void> rapportJour(DateTime date) async {
    final user = _db.getUser();
    final monnaie = user?['monnaie'] ?? 'FCFA';
    final prenom = user?['prenom'] ?? '';
    final tel = user?['telephone'] ?? '';

    // ✅ CORRECTION : Ajouter await et utiliser _db
    final allTx = await _db.getTransactions();
    final txs = allTx.where((t) =>
    t.dateTransaction.year == date.year &&
        t.dateTransaction.month == date.month &&
        t.dateTransaction.day == date.day).toList();
    final dep = txs.where((t) => t.isDepense).toList();
    final rev = txs.where((t) => t.isRevenu).toList();
    final tDep = dep.fold(0.0, (s, t) => s + t.montant);
    final tRev = rev.fold(0.0, (s, t) => s + t.montant);
    final dateStr = '${date.day} ${_mois[date.month]} ${date.year}';

    final pdf = pw.Document();
    pdf.addPage(pw.MultiPage(
        pageFormat: PdfPageFormat.a4,
        margin: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(32),
        build: (ctx) => [
          _entete('RAPPORT FINANCIER JOURNALIER', prenom, tel),
          _sousTitre(dateStr),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 20),
          _statsRow(tRev, tDep, tRev - tDep, monnaie),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 24),
          if (rev.isNotEmpty) ...[
            _sectionTitre('REVENUS', PdfColors.green800),
            _tableTx(rev, monnaie),
            pw.SizedBox(height: 16),
          ],
          if (dep.isNotEmpty) ...[
            _sectionTitre('DEPENSES', PdfColors.red800),
            _tableTx(dep, monnaie),
            pw.SizedBox(height: 16),
          ],
          if (txs.isEmpty)
            pw.Center(child: pw.Text('Aucune transaction ce jour.')),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 24),
          _rapportEcrit(tRev, tDep, monnaie),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 20),
          _pied(),
        ]));
    await Printing.sharePdf(
        bytes: await pdf.save(),
        filename: 'TAPA_Rapport_Jour_$dateStr.pdf');
  }

  static Future<void> rapportSemaine(DateTime debut) async {
    final user = _db.getUser();
    final monnaie = user?['monnaie'] ?? 'FCFA';
    final prenom = user?['prenom'] ?? '';
    final tel = user?['telephone'] ?? '';
    final fin = debut.add(const Duration(days: 6));

    // ✅ CORRECTION : Ajouter await et utiliser _db
    final allTx = await _db.getTransactions();
    final txs = allTx.where((t) =>
    t.dateTransaction.isAfter(debut.subtract(const Duration(days: 1))) &&
        t.dateTransaction.isBefore(fin.add(const Duration(days: 1)))).toList();
    final dep = txs.where((t) => t.isDepense).toList();
    final rev = txs.where((t) => t.isRevenu).toList();
    final tDep = dep.fold(0.0, (s, t) => s + t.montant);
    final tRev = rev.fold(0.0, (s, t) => s + t.montant);
    final periodeStr = 'Du ${debut.day} au ${fin.day} ${_mois[fin.month]} ${fin.year}';

    final pdf = pw.Document();
    pdf.addPage(pw.MultiPage(
        pageFormat: PdfPageFormat.a4,
        margin: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(32),
        build: (ctx) => [
          _entete('RAPPORT FINANCIER HEBDOMADAIRE', prenom, tel),
          _sousTitre(periodeStr),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 20),
          _statsRow(tRev, tDep, tRev - tDep, monnaie),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 24),
          if (rev.isNotEmpty) ...[
            _sectionTitre('REVENUS DE LA SEMAINE', PdfColors.green800),
            _tableTx(rev, monnaie),
            pw.SizedBox(height: 16),
          ],
          if (dep.isNotEmpty) ...[
            _sectionTitre('DEPENSES DE LA SEMAINE', PdfColors.red800),
            _tableTx(dep, monnaie),
            pw.SizedBox(height: 16),
          ],
          if (txs.isEmpty)
            pw.Center(child: pw.Text('Aucune transaction cette semaine.')),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 24),
          _rapportEcrit(tRev, tDep, monnaie),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 20),
          _pied(),
        ]));
    await Printing.sharePdf(
        bytes: await pdf.save(),
        filename: 'TAPA_Rapport_Semaine.pdf');
  }

  static Future<void> rapportMensuel(int mois, int annee) async {
    final user = _db.getUser();
    final monnaie = user?['monnaie'] ?? 'FCFA';
    final prenom = user?['prenom'] ?? '';
    final tel = user?['telephone'] ?? '';

    // ✅ CORRECTION : Ajouter await et utiliser _db
    final allTx = await _db.getTransactions();
    final txs = allTx.where((t) =>
    t.dateTransaction.month == mois && t.dateTransaction.year == annee).toList();
    final dep = txs.where((t) => t.isDepense).toList();
    final rev = txs.where((t) => t.isRevenu).toList();
    final tDep = dep.fold(0.0, (s, t) => s + t.montant);
    final tRev = rev.fold(0.0, (s, t) => s + t.montant);

    final budget = await _db.getBudget(mois, annee);

    final premiereDate = txs.isNotEmpty
        ? txs.map((t) => t.dateTransaction).reduce((a, b) => a.isBefore(b) ? a : b)
        : DateTime(annee, mois, 1);
    final derniereDate = txs.isNotEmpty
        ? txs.map((t) => t.dateTransaction).reduce((a, b) => a.isAfter(b) ? a : b)
        : DateTime(annee, mois, 30);

    final periodeStr = '${_mois[mois]} $annee — Du ${premiereDate.day} au ${derniereDate.day} ${_mois[mois]}';

    final Map<String, double> parCat = {};
    for (final t in dep) {
      parCat[t.categorieLabel] = (parCat[t.categorieLabel] ?? 0) + t.montant;
    }
    final catSorted = parCat.entries.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => b.value.compareTo(a.value));

    final List<pw.TableRow> lignesBudget = [];
    if (budget != null) {
      for (final l in budget.depenses) {
        final reel = await _db.getDepensesReellesByCategorie(
            l.categorieId, mois, annee);
        final ecart = l.montantPrevu - reel;
        final ecartStr = ecart >= 0
            ? '+${Fmt.montant(ecart, monnaie: monnaie)}'
            : Fmt.montant(ecart, monnaie: monnaie);
        lignesBudget.add(pw.TableRow(children: [
          _cell('${l.categorieEmoji} ${l.categorieLabel}'),
          _cell(Fmt.montant(l.montantPrevu, monnaie: monnaie)),
          _cell(Fmt.montant(reel, monnaie: monnaie)),
          _cellColor(ecartStr,
              ecart >= 0 ? PdfColors.green800 : PdfColors.red800),
        ]));
      }
    }

    final pdf = pw.Document();
    pdf.addPage(pw.MultiPage(
        pageFormat: PdfPageFormat.a4,
        margin: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(32),
        build: (ctx) => [
          _entete('RAPPORT BUDGETAIRE MENSUEL', prenom, tel),
          _sousTitre(periodeStr),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 20),
          _statsRow(tRev, tDep, tRev - tDep, monnaie),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 24),
          if (budget != null) ...[
            _sectionTitre('BUDGET PREVISIONNEL VS REEL', PdfColors.blueGrey800),
            pw.Table(
                border: pw.TableBorder.all(color: PdfColors.grey300),
                children: [
                  pw.TableRow(
                      decoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(color: PdfColors.blueGrey800),
                      children: [
                        _cellHeader('Catégorie'),
                        _cellHeader('Prévu'),
                        _cellHeader('Réel'),
                        _cellHeader('Ecart'),
                      ]),
                  ...lignesBudget,
                ]),
            pw.SizedBox(height: 20),
          ],
          if (rev.isNotEmpty) ...[
            _sectionTitre('REVENUS DU MOIS', PdfColors.green800),
            _tableTx(rev, monnaie),
            pw.SizedBox(height: 16),
          ],
          if (dep.isNotEmpty) ...[
            _sectionTitre('DEPENSES DU MOIS', PdfColors.red800),
            _tableTx(dep, monnaie),
            pw.SizedBox(height: 16),
          ],
          if (catSorted.isNotEmpty) ...[
            _sectionTitre('DEPENSES PAR CATEGORIE', PdfColors.orange800),
            pw.Table(
                border: pw.TableBorder.all(color: PdfColors.grey300),
                children: [
                  pw.TableRow(
                      decoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(color: PdfColors.orange800),
                      children: [
                        _cellHeader('Catégorie'),
                        _cellHeader('Montant'),
                        _cellHeader('Pourcentage'),
                      ]),
                  ...catSorted.map((e) {
                    final pct = tDep > 0
                        ? '${(e.value / tDep * 100).round()}%'
                        : '0%';
                    return pw.TableRow(children: [
                      _cell(e.key),
                      _cell(Fmt.montant(e.value, monnaie: monnaie)),
                      _cell(pct),
                    ]);
                  }),
                ]),
            pw.SizedBox(height: 20),
          ],
          _rapportEcrit(tRev, tDep, monnaie),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 20),
          _pied(),
        ]));
    await Printing.sharePdf(
        bytes: await pdf.save(),
        filename: 'TAPA_Rapport_${_mois[mois]}_$annee.pdf');
  }

  static Future<void> rapportScore(DBService db) async {
    final user = db.getUser();
    final prenom = user?['prenom'] ?? '';
    final tel = user?['telephone'] ?? '';
    final monnaie = user?['monnaie'] ?? 'FCFA';

    final score = await ScoreService.calculer(db);

    final now = DateTime.now();
    final mois = ['','Janvier','Fevrier','Mars','Avril','Mai','Juin',
      'Juillet','Aout','Septembre','Octobre','Novembre','Decembre'];
    final dateStr = '${now.day} ${mois[now.month]} ${now.year}';

    PdfColor scoreColor;
    if (score.scoreTotal >= 80) {
      scoreColor = PdfColors.green800;
    } else if (score.scoreTotal >= 60) scoreColor = PdfColors.blue800;
    else if (score.scoreTotal >= 40) scoreColor = PdfColors.orange800;
    else scoreColor = PdfColors.red800;

    // ✅ CORRECTION : Ajouter await
    final allTx = await db.getTransactions();
    final totalRev = allTx.where((t) => t.isRevenu).fold(0.0, (s, t) => s + t.montant);
    final totalDep = allTx.where((t) => t.isDepense).fold(0.0, (s, t) => s + t.montant);
    final totalSolde = totalRev - totalDep;

    final pdf = pw.Document();
    pdf.addPage(pw.MultiPage(
        pageFormat: PdfPageFormat.a4,
        margin: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(32),
        build: (ctx) => [
          _entete('RAPPORT SCORE TAPA', prenom, tel),
          _sousTitre('Genere le $dateStr'),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 20),
          pw.Container(
              padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(16),
              decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
                  color: PdfColors.blueGrey800,
                  borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(12)),
              child: pw.Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceAround,
                  children: [
                    pw.Column(children: [
                      pw.Text('SCORE TAPA',
                          style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: PdfColors.grey300)),
                      pw.SizedBox(height: 8),
                      pw.Text('${score.scoreTotal}/100',
                          style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 32,
                              fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold, color: scoreColor)),
                      pw.SizedBox(height: 4),
                      pw.Text(score.niveau,
                          style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 13,
                              fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold, color: scoreColor)),
                    ]),
                    pw.Column(crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
                      _scoreRow('Revenus', score.scoreRevenus, 20),
                      _scoreRow('Dépenses', score.scoreDepenses, 20),
                      _scoreRow('Épargne', score.scoreEpargne, 20),
                      _scoreRow('Dettes', score.scoreDettes, 20),
                      _scoreRow('Régularité', score.scoreRegularite, 20),
                    ]),
                  ])),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 20),
          _sectionTitre('APERCU FINANCIER', PdfColors.blueGrey800),
          pw.Table(
              border: pw.TableBorder.all(color: PdfColors.grey300),
              children: [
                pw.TableRow(
                    decoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(color: PdfColors.blueGrey700),
                    children: [
                      _cellHeader('Indicateur'),
                      _cellHeader('Valeur'),
                      _cellHeader('Période'),
                    ]),
                pw.TableRow(children: [
                  _cell('Total Revenus'),
                  _cell(Fmt.montant(totalRev, monnaie: monnaie)),
                  _cell('Depuis inscription'),
                ]),
                pw.TableRow(children: [
                  _cell('Total Dépenses'),
                  _cell(Fmt.montant(totalDep, monnaie: monnaie)),
                  _cell('Depuis inscription'),
                ]),
                pw.TableRow(children: [
                  _cell('Solde total'),
                  _cell(Fmt.montant(totalSolde, monnaie: monnaie)),
                  _cell('Actuel'),
                ]),
                pw.TableRow(children: [
                  _cell('Transactions'),
                  _cell(allTx.length.toString()),
                  _cell('Total'),
                ]),
                pw.TableRow(children: [
                  _cell('Objectifs épargne'),
                  _cell(db.getSavingsGoals().length.toString()),
                  _cell('Actifs'),
                ]),
                pw.TableRow(children: [
                  _cell('Dettes en cours'),
                  _cell(db.getDettes().where((d) => !d.estSolde).length.toString()),
                  _cell('Actives'),
                ]),
              ]),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 20),
          if (score.pointsForts.isNotEmpty) ...[
            _sectionTitre('POINTS FORTS', PdfColors.green800),
            ...score.pointsForts.map((p) => pw.Padding(
                padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 5),
                child: pw.Row(children: [
                  pw.Text('+ ', style: pw.TextStyle(
                      fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                      color: PdfColors.green800)),
                  pw.Expanded(child: pw.Text(p,
                      style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 10))),
                ]))),
            pw.SizedBox(height: 16),
          ],
          if (score.conseils.isNotEmpty) ...[
            _sectionTitre('AXES D AMELIORATION', PdfColors.orange800),
            ...score.conseils.map((c) => pw.Padding(
                padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 5),
                child: pw.Row(children: [
                  pw.Text('> ', style: pw.TextStyle(
                      fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                      color: PdfColors.orange800)),
                  pw.Expanded(child: pw.Text(c,
                      style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 10))),
                ]))),
            pw.SizedBox(height: 16),
          ],
          pw.Container(
              padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(12),
              decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
                  color: PdfColors.grey100,
                  borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(8),
                  border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.grey400)),
              child: pw.Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    pw.Text('NOTE IMPORTANTE',
                        style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 10,
                            fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                            color: PdfColors.grey800)),
                    pw.SizedBox(height: 4),
                    pw.Text(
                        'Ce score est base sur les donnees auto-declarees par '
                            'l utilisateur dans TAPA Invest. Il est fourni a titre '
                            'indicatif et educatif. Pour une evaluation officielle, '
                            'des donnees vérifiees par des tiers sont nécessaires.',
                        style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9,
                            color: PdfColors.grey700, lineSpacing: 3)),
                  ])),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 20),

          _sectionTitre('ANALYSE DE FIABILITE', PdfColors.blueGrey800),
          pw.Container(
              padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(12),
              decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
                  color: score.estFiable ? PdfColors.green50 : PdfColors.red50,
                  borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(8),
                  border: pw.Border.all(
                      color: score.estFiable ? PdfColors.green800 : PdfColors.red800)),
              child: pw.Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    pw.Row(children: [
                      pw.Text(
                          score.estFiable
                              ? 'SCORE FIABLE'
                              : 'INCOHERENCES DETECTEES',
                          style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 11,
                              fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                              color: score.estFiable
                                  ? PdfColors.green800 : PdfColors.red800)),
                      pw.Spacer(),
                      pw.Text(
                          'Cohérence: ${score.scoreCoherence}/100',
                          style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 10,
                              fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                              color: score.estFiable
                                  ? PdfColors.green800 : PdfColors.red800)),
                    ]),
                    pw.SizedBox(height: 6),
                    pw.Text(
                        score.estFiable
                            ? 'Les donnees saisies par l utilisateur sont coherentes. '
                            'Aucune anomalie majeure détectée.'
                            : 'Des incohérences ont ete détectées dans les donnees. '
                            'Une verification supplementaire est recommandee.',
                        style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9,
                            color: score.estFiable
                                ? PdfColors.green900 : PdfColors.red900,
                            lineSpacing: 3)),
                    if (score.alertesCoherence.isNotEmpty) ...[
                      pw.SizedBox(height: 8),
                      ...score.alertesCoherence.map((a) => pw.Padding(
                          padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 4),
                          child: pw.Row(children: [
                            pw.Text('! ',
                                style: pw.TextStyle(
                                    fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                                    color: PdfColors.red800)),
                            pw.Expanded(child: pw.Text(a,
                                style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9,
                                    color: PdfColors.red900))),
                          ]))),
                    ],
                    pw.SizedBox(height: 6),
                    pw.Row(children: [
                      pw.Text('Transactions signees: ',
                          style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9, color: PdfColors.grey700)),
                      pw.Text(score.txAvecHash.toString(),
                          style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9,
                              fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                              color: PdfColors.green800)),
                      pw.Text('   Non signees: ',
                          style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9, color: PdfColors.grey700)),
                      pw.Text(score.txSansHash.toString(),
                          style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9,
                              fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                              color: PdfColors.orange800)),
                    ]),
                  ])),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 20),
          _pied(),
        ]));

    await Printing.sharePdf(
        bytes: await pdf.save(),
        filename: '${'Score_TAPA_' + prenom}.pdf');
  }

  static pw.Widget _scoreRow(String label, int score, int max) {
    return pw.Padding(
        padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 4),
        child: pw.Row(children: [
          pw.SizedBox(width: 80,
              child: pw.Text(label,
                  style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9,
                      color: PdfColors.white))),
          pw.SizedBox(width: 8),
          pw.Text('$score/$max',
              style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9,
                  fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                  color: PdfColors.white)),
        ]));
  }

  static pw.Widget _entete(String titre, String prenom, String tel) {
    return pw.Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          pw.Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                pw.Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      pw.Text('TAPA Invest',
                          style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 22,
                              fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                              color: PdfColors.blueGrey900)),
                      pw.Text('Le budget simple pour tous.',
                          style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 10,
                              color: PdfColors.grey600)),
                    ]),
                pw.Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                    children: [
                      pw.Text(prenom,
                          style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 12,
                              fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold)),
                      pw.Text(tel,
                          style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 10,
                              color: PdfColors.grey600)),
                      pw.Text('Document genere automatiquement',
                          style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 8,
                              color: PdfColors.grey500)),
                    ]),
              ]),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 8),
          pw.Divider(color: PdfColors.blueGrey800, thickness: 2),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 8),
          pw.Text(titre,
              style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 16,
                  fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                  color: PdfColors.blueGrey800)),
        ]);
  }

  static pw.Widget _sousTitre(String texte) {
    return pw.Padding(
        padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
        child: pw.Text(texte,
            style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 12,
                color: PdfColors.grey700)));
  }

  static pw.Widget _statsRow(
      double rev, double dep, double solde, String monnaie) {
    return pw.Container(
        padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(12),
        decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
            color: PdfColors.blueGrey50,
            borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(8)),
        child: pw.Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceAround,
            children: [
              _statItem('REVENUS', Fmt.montant(rev, monnaie: monnaie),
                  PdfColors.green800),
              _statItem('DEPENSES', Fmt.montant(dep, monnaie: monnaie),
                  PdfColors.red800),
              _statItem('SOLDE', Fmt.montant(solde, monnaie: monnaie),
                  solde >= 0 ? PdfColors.green800 : PdfColors.red800),
            ]));
  }

  static pw.Widget _statItem(
      String label, String valeur, PdfColor color) {
    return pw.Column(children: [
      pw.Text(label,
          style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9, color: PdfColors.grey600)),
      pw.SizedBox(height: 4),
      pw.Text(valeur,
          style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 13,
              fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold, color: color)),
    ]);
  }

  static pw.Widget _sectionTitre(String titre, PdfColor color) {
    return pw.Padding(
        padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
        child: pw.Text(titre,
            style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold, color: color)));
  }

  static pw.Widget _tableTx(
      List<TransactionModel> txs, String monnaie) {
    return pw.Table(
        border: pw.TableBorder.all(color: PdfColors.grey300),
        columnWidths: {
          0: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1),
          1: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(2),
          2: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(2),
        },
        children: [
          pw.TableRow(
              decoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(
                  color: PdfColors.blueGrey700),
              children: [
                _cellHeader('Date'),
                _cellHeader('Catégorie'),
                _cellHeader('Montant'),
              ]),
          ...txs.map((t) {
            final dateStr =
                '${t.dateTransaction.day}/${t.dateTransaction.month}/${t.dateTransaction.year}';
            final signe = t.isRevenu ? '+' : '-';
            final montantStr =
                '$signe${Fmt.montant(t.montant, monnaie: monnaie)}';
            return pw.TableRow(children: [
              _cell(dateStr),
              _cell(t.categorieLabel),
              _cellColor(montantStr,
                  t.isRevenu ? PdfColors.green800 : PdfColors.red800),
            ]);
          }),
        ]);
  }

  static pw.Widget _rapportEcrit(
      double rev, double dep, String monnaie) {
    String titre;
    String message;
    PdfColor bgColor;
    PdfColor textColor;

    if (dep > rev) {
      titre = 'ANALYSE : DEPASSEMENT BUDGETAIRE';
      bgColor = PdfColors.red50;
      textColor = PdfColors.red900;
      final diff = Fmt.montant(dep - rev, monnaie: monnaie);
      message = 'Vous etes en dépassement de $diff. '
          'Soit vous avez mal budgetise, soit vous avez dépense '
          'au-dela de vos previsions. Cette habitude peut '
          'fragiliser votre situation financiere. '
          'Analysez vos dépenses par catégorie.';
    } else if ((dep - rev).abs() < 1000) {
      titre = 'ANALYSE : BUDGET EQUILIBRE';
      bgColor = PdfColors.orange50;
      textColor = PdfColors.orange900;
      message = 'Vous équilibrez votre budget, c est bien ! '
          'Cependant, une dépense imprévue pourrait vous faire '
          'basculer dans le deficit. Essayez d épargner '
          'au moins 10% de vos revenus chaque mois.';
    } else {
      titre = 'ANALYSE : BONNE GESTION FINANCIERE';
      bgColor = PdfColors.green50;
      textColor = PdfColors.green900;
      final excedent = Fmt.montant(rev - dep, monnaie: monnaie);
      message = 'Félicitations ! Vous avez un excedent de $excedent. '
          'Vous etes sur le bon chemin vers votre liberté financiere. '
          'Investissez ou épargnez cet excedent pour vos objectifs.';
    }

    return pw.Container(
        padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(14),
        decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
            color: bgColor,
            borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(8),
            border: pw.Border.all(color: textColor, width: 0.5)),
        child: pw.Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              pw.Text(titre,
                  style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 12,
                      fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold, color: textColor)),
              pw.SizedBox(height: 8),
              pw.Text(message,
                  style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 10,
                      color: textColor, lineSpacing: 4)),
            ]));
  }

  static pw.Widget _cellHeader(String text) {
    return pw.Padding(
        padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(6),
        child: pw.Text(text,
            style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9,
                fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                color: PdfColors.white)));
  }

  static pw.Widget _cell(String text) {
    return pw.Padding(
        padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(6),
        child: pw.Text(text,
            style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9)));
  }

  static pw.Widget _cellColor(String text, PdfColor color) {
    return pw.Padding(
        padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(6),
        child: pw.Text(text,
            style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9,
                fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold, color: color)));
  }

  static pw.Widget _pied() {
    return pw.Column(children: [
      pw.Divider(color: PdfColors.grey400),
      pw.SizedBox(height: 6),
      pw.Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
          children: [
            pw.Text('TAPA Invest — Le budget simple pour tous.',
                style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 8,
                    color: PdfColors.grey500)),
            pw.Text('Document confidentiel',
                style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 8,
                    color: PdfColors.grey500)),
          ]),
    ]);
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';

class MySqlApiService {
  static const String baseUrl = 'http://10.230.149.118:3000/api';

  // ============================================

  Future<List<dynamic>> getUtilisateurs() async {
    final response = await http.get(Uri.parse('$baseUrl/utilisateurs'));
    if (response.statusCode == 200) {
      return json.decode(response.body);
    } else {
      throw Exception('Erreur: ${response.statusCode}');
    }
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> getUtilisateur(int id) async {
    final response = await http.get(Uri.parse('$baseUrl/utilisateurs/$id'));
    if (response.statusCode == 200) {
      return json.decode(response.body);
    } else {
      throw Exception('Erreur: ${response.statusCode}');
    }
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> createUtilisateur(Map<String, dynamic> data) async {
    print('📡 Création utilisateur...');
    print('📡 URL: $baseUrl/utilisateurs');
    print('📡 Data: $data');

    try {
      final response = await http.post(
        Uri.parse('$baseUrl/utilisateurs'),
        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
        body: json.encode(data),
      );

      print('📡 Status: ${response.statusCode}');
      print('📡 Response: ${response.body}');

      if (response.statusCode == 201) {
        return json.decode(response.body);
      } else {
        throw Exception('Erreur: ${response.statusCode} - ${response.body}');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('❌ Exception: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<List<dynamic>> getPortefeuilles(int utilisateurId) async {
    final response = await http.get(
        Uri.parse('$baseUrl/utilisateurs/$utilisateurId/portefeuilles')
    );

  static Future<void> programmerRappelsQuotidiens() async {
    try {
      await _notifs.cancel(10);
      await _notifs.cancel(11);

      final now = DateTime.now();
      final rand = now.millisecondsSinceEpoch % 7;

      var heureMatin = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day, 7, 0);
      if (heureMatin.isBefore(now)) {
        heureMatin = heureMatin.add(const Duration(days: 1));
      }

      var heureSoir = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day, 19, 0);
      if (heureSoir.isBefore(now)) {
        heureSoir = heureSoir.add(const Duration(days: 1));
      }

      await _notifs.zonedSchedule(
        10,
        'TAPA Invest',
        _messagesMatin[rand],
        _toTZDateTime(heureMatin),
        const NotificationDetails(
          android: AndroidNotificationDetails(
            'rappel_channel',
            'Rappels quotidiens',
            channelDescription: 'Rappels transactions',
            importance: Importance.high,
            priority: Priority.high,
            icon: '@mipmap/ic_launcher',
          ),
        ),
        androidScheduleMode: AndroidScheduleMode.inexactAllowWhileIdle,
        matchDateTimeComponents: DateTimeComponents.time,
        uiLocalNotificationDateInterpretation:
        UILocalNotificationDateInterpretation.absoluteTime,
      );

      await _notifs.zonedSchedule(
        11,
        'TAPA Invest',
        _messagesSoir[rand],
        _toTZDateTime(heureSoir),
        const NotificationDetails(
          android: AndroidNotificationDetails(
            'rappel_channel',
            'Rappels quotidiens',
            channelDescription: 'Rappels transactions',
            importance: Importance.high,
            priority: Priority.high,
            icon: '@mipmap/ic_launcher',
          ),
        ),
        androidScheduleMode: AndroidScheduleMode.inexactAllowWhileIdle,
        matchDateTimeComponents: DateTimeComponents.time,
        uiLocalNotificationDateInterpretation:
        UILocalNotificationDateInterpretation.absoluteTime,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.warning('⚠️ Erreur rappels quotidiens: $e');
    }
  }

// lib/services/db_service_mysql.dart

import 'firebase_service.dart';
import '../data/models/models.dart';
import '../core/utils/logger.dart';
import 'pin_security.dart';

class DBService {
  static final FirebaseService _firebase = FirebaseService();
  static DBService? _instance;

  factory DBService() {
    _instance ??= DBService._internal();
    return _instance!;
  }

  DBService._internal();

  // ============================================
  // UTILISATEUR
  // ============================================

  Map<String, dynamic>? getUser() => _firebase.getUser();
  Future<void> saveUser(UserModel user) async => await _firebase.saveUser(user);
  Future<void> savePin(String pin) async => await _firebase.savePin(pin);

  Future<bool> verifyPin(String pin) async {
    final result = await _firebase.verifyPin(pin);
    return result.success;
  }

  Future<PinCheckResult> verifyPinDetailed(String pin) async {
    return await _firebase.verifyPin(pin);
  }

  String? getCurrentUserId() => _firebase.getCurrentUserId();
  bool get isLoggedIn => _firebase.isLoggedIn;
  Future<bool> hasPin() async => await _firebase.hasPin();

  // ============================================
  // TRANSACTIONS
  // ============================================

  Future<List<TransactionModel>> getTransactions() async => await _firebase.getTransactions();
  Future<void> addTransaction(TransactionModel transaction) async => await _firebase.addTransaction(transaction);
  Future<void> updateTransaction(TransactionModel oldTx, TransactionModel newTx) async => await _firebase.updateTransaction(oldTx, newTx);
  Future<void> deleteTransaction(TransactionModel transaction) async => await _firebase.deleteTransaction(transaction);

  // ============================================
  // PORTEFEUILLES
  // ============================================

  Future<List<WalletModel>> getWallets() async => await _firebase.getWallets();
  Future<void> saveWallet(WalletModel wallet) async => await _firebase.saveWallet(wallet);

  // ============================================
  // CATÉGORIES
  // ============================================

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> getCategories() => _firebase.getCategories();

// lib/services/api_service.dart

import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../data/models/models.dart';  // ✅ CORRIGÉ
import '../core/utils/logger.dart';

class FirebaseService {
  static final FirebaseService _instance = FirebaseService._internal();
  factory FirebaseService() => _instance;
  FirebaseService._internal();

  final FirebaseAuth _auth = FirebaseAuth.instance;
  final FirebaseFirestore _firestore = FirebaseFirestore.instance;

  SharedPreferences? _prefs;
  String? _currentUserId;

  // Cache local des catégories
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _categories = [];

  // ============================================
  // INITIALISATION
  // ============================================

  Future<void> init() async {
    _prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();

    final user = _auth.currentUser;
    if (user != null) {
      _currentUserId = user.uid;
      await _prefs?.setString('user_id', user.uid);
    } else {
      _currentUserId = _prefs?.getString('user_id');
    }

    if (_currentUserId != null) {
      await _loadCategories();
      Logger.info('✅ FirebaseService initialisé - userId: $_currentUserId');
    } else {
      Logger.info('ℹ️ FirebaseService initialisé - Aucun utilisateur');
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // AUTH - GESTION DE L'UTILISATEUR
  // ============================================

  String? getCurrentUserId() => _currentUserId;
  bool get isLoggedIn => _currentUserId != null;

  Future<void> setCurrentUser(User? user) async {
    if (user != null) {
      _currentUserId = user.uid;
      await _prefs?.setString('user_id', user.uid);
      await _loadCategories();
      Logger.info('👤 Utilisateur connecté: ${user.uid}');
    } else {
      _currentUserId = null;
      await _prefs?.remove('user_id');
      _categories = [];
      Logger.info('👤 Utilisateur déconnecté');
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // UTILISATEUR
  // ============================================

  Map<String, dynamic>? getUser() {
    final prenom = _prefs?.getString('user_prenom');
    final telephone = _prefs?.getString('user_telephone');
    final monnaie = _prefs?.getString('user_monnaie') ?? 'FCFA';
    final pinCode = _prefs?.getString('user_pin') ?? '';
    final hasAccesVie = _prefs?.getBool('acces_vie') ?? false;

    if (prenom == null) return null;
    return {
      'prenom': prenom,
      'telephone': telephone ?? '',
      'monnaie': monnaie,
      'pinCode': pinCode,
      'hasAccesVie': hasAccesVie,
    };
  }

  Future<void> saveUser(UserModel user) async {
    try {
      final uid = _auth.currentUser?.uid ?? user.id;

      await _firestore.collection('users').doc(uid).set({
        'phoneNumber': user.phoneNumber,
        'prenom': user.prenom,
        'monnaie': user.monnaie,
        'codePays': user.codePays,
        'hasAccessVie': user.hasAccessVie,
        'onboardingVu': user.onboardingVu,
        'notificationsActivees': user.notificationsActivees,
        'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'dernierActive': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });

      _currentUserId = uid;
      await _prefs?.setString('user_id', uid);
      await _prefs?.setString('user_telephone', user.phoneNumber);
      await _prefs?.setString('user_prenom', user.prenom);
      await _prefs?.setString('user_monnaie', user.monnaie);

      await _initDefaultWallets(uid);
      await _initDefaultCategories(uid);
      await _loadCategories();

      Logger.info('✅ Utilisateur sauvegardé: $uid');
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur saveUser: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // PIN
  // ============================================

  Future<void> savePin(String pin) async {
    await _prefs?.setString('user_pin', pin);
    final userId = _currentUserId;
    if (userId != null) {
      await _firestore.collection('users').doc(userId).update({'pinCode': pin});
    }
  }

  bool verifyPin(String pin) {
    return _prefs?.getString('user_pin') == pin;
  }

  // ============================================
  // PORTEFEUILLES
  // ============================================

  Future<void> _initDefaultWallets(String userId) async {
    final defaultWallets = [
      {'uid': userId, 'nom': 'Compte Principal', 'type': 'compte', 'emoji': '🏦', 'solde': 0.0, 'monnaie': 'FCFA', 'description': 'Compte principal', 'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(), 'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()},
      {'uid': userId, 'nom': 'Wave', 'type': 'mobile', 'emoji': '📱', 'solde': 0.0, 'monnaie': 'FCFA', 'description': 'Portefeuille Wave', 'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(), 'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()},
      {'uid': userId, 'nom': 'Espèces', 'type': 'especes', 'emoji': '💵', 'solde': 0.0, 'monnaie': 'FCFA', 'description': 'Espèces', 'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(), 'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()},
    ];
    final batch = _firestore.batch();
    for (final wallet in defaultWallets) {
      final docRef = _firestore.collection('wallets').doc();
      batch.set(docRef, wallet);
    }
    await batch.commit();
    Logger.info('📂 Portefeuilles par défaut créés');
  }

  List<WalletModel> getWallets() => [];

  Future<void> saveWallet(WalletModel wallet) async {
    final userId = _currentUserId;
    if (userId == null) return;
    await _firestore.collection('wallets').doc(wallet.id).set({
      'uid': userId,
      'nom': wallet.nom,
      'emoji': wallet.emoji,
      'type': wallet.type,
      'solde': wallet.solde,
      'monnaie': wallet.monnaie,
      'description': wallet.description,
      'createdAt': wallet.createdAt ?? FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
  }

  // ============================================

  // ============================================

  List<TransactionModel> getTransactions() => [];

  Future<void> addTransaction(TransactionModel transaction) async {
    final userId = _currentUserId;
    if (userId == null) return;
    await _firestore.collection('transactions').add({
      'uid': userId,
      'walletId': transaction.walletId,
      'montant': transaction.montant,
      'type': transaction.type.toString().split('.').last,
      'categorieId': transaction.categorieId,
      'categorieLabel': transaction.categorieLabel,
      'categorieEmoji': transaction.categorieEmoji,
      'note': transaction.note,
      'dateTransaction': transaction.dateTransaction,
      'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
  }

  Future<void> deleteTransaction(TransactionModel transaction) async {}

  // ============================================
  // CATÉGORIES
  // ============================================

  Future<void> _initDefaultCategories(String userId) async {
    final categories = [
      {'id': 'nourriture', 'label': 'Alimentation', 'emoji': '🍽️', 'type': 'depense'},
      {'id': 'transport', 'label': 'Transport', 'emoji': '🚗', 'type': 'depense'},
      {'id': 'facture', 'label': 'Facture', 'emoji': '📄', 'type': 'depense'},
      {'id': 'logement', 'label': 'Logement', 'emoji': '🏠', 'type': 'depense'},
      {'id': 'sante', 'label': 'Santé', 'emoji': '🏥', 'type': 'depense'},
      {'id': 'education', 'label': 'Éducation', 'emoji': '📚', 'type': 'depense'},
      {'id': 'loisirs', 'label': 'Loisirs', 'emoji': '🎮', 'type': 'depense'},
      {'id': 'salaire', 'label': 'Salaire', 'emoji': '💰', 'type': 'revenu'},
    ];
    final batch = _firestore.batch();
    for (final cat in categories) {
      final docRef = _firestore.collection('categories').doc(cat['id']);
      batch.set(docRef, {
        'uid': userId,
        'categorieId': cat['id'],
        'label': cat['label'],
        'emoji': cat['emoji'],
        'type': cat['type'],
        'isDefault': true,
        'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
    }
    await batch.commit();
    Logger.info('📂 Catégories par défaut créées');
  }

  Future<void> _loadCategories() async {
    final userId = _currentUserId;
    if (userId == null) {
      _categories = [];
      return;
    }
    try {
      final snap = await _firestore
          .collection('categories')
          .where('uid', isEqualTo: userId)
          .get();
      _categories = snap.docs.map((d) => {
        'id': d.id,
        ...d.data(),
      }).toList();
      Logger.info('📂 Catégories chargées: ${_categories.length}');
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur chargement catégories: $e');
      _categories = [];
    }
  }

  Future<void> refreshCategories() => _loadCategories();

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> getCategories() => _categories;

  Future<void> addCategory(Map<String, dynamic> category) async {
    final userId = _currentUserId;
    if (userId == null) {
      Logger.error('❌ addCategory - Utilisateur non authentifié');
      throw Exception('Utilisateur non authentifié');
    }

    final id = category['id'] as String? ?? DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString();
    final label = category['label'] as String? ?? 'Autre';
    final emoji = category['emoji'] as String? ?? '📌';
    final type = category['type'] as String? ?? 'depense';

    Logger.info('📝 Ajout catégorie: $label ($type)');

    try {
      await _firestore
          .collection('categories')
          .doc(id)
          .set({
        'uid': userId,
        'categorieId': id,
        'label': label,
        'emoji': emoji,
        'type': type,
        'isDefault': category['isDefault'] ?? false,
        'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });

      Logger.info('✅ Catégorie ajoutée Firestore: $label');
      await _loadCategories();
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur addCategory: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<void> deleteCategory(String categoryId) async {
    final userId = _currentUserId;
    if (userId == null) {
      throw Exception('Utilisateur non authentifié');
    }

    try {
      await _firestore
          .collection('categories')
          .doc(categoryId)
          .delete();

      Logger.info('🗑️ Catégorie supprimée: $categoryId');
      await _loadCategories();
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur deleteCategory: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  // BUDGET
  // ============================================

  String _budgetDocId(int mois, int annee) => '$annee-$mois';

  Future<BudgetMensuel?> getBudget(int mois, int annee) async {
    final userId = _currentUserId;
    if (userId == null) return null;
    final doc = await _firestore
        .collection('users')
        .doc(userId)
        .collection('budgets')
        .doc(_budgetDocId(mois, annee))
        .get();
    if (!doc.exists || doc.data() == null) return null;
    return BudgetMensuel.fromMap(doc.data()!);
  }

  Future<void> saveBudget(BudgetMensuel budget) async {
    final userId = _currentUserId;
    if (userId == null) return;
    await _firestore
        .collection('users')
        .doc(userId)
        .collection('budgets')
        .doc(_budgetDocId(budget.mois, budget.annee))
        .set(budget.toMap());
  }

  Future<void> deleteBudget(int mois, int annee) async {
    final userId = _currentUserId;
    if (userId == null) return;
    await _firestore
        .collection('users')
        .doc(userId)
        .collection('budgets')
        .doc(_budgetDocId(mois, annee))
        .delete();
  }

  Future<double> _sommeTransactions(int mois, int annee, String type) async {
    final userId = _currentUserId;
    if (userId == null) return 0.0;
    final debut = DateTime(annee, mois, 1);
    final fin = DateTime(annee, mois + 1, 1);
    final snap = await _firestore
        .collection('transactions')
        .where('uid', isEqualTo: userId)
        .where('type', isEqualTo: type)
        .where('dateTransaction', isGreaterThanOrEqualTo: debut)
        .where('dateTransaction', isLessThan: fin)
        .get();
    double total = 0;
    for (final d in snap.docs) {
      total += (d.data()['montant'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0;
    }
    return total;
  }

  Future<double> getTotalDepensesReelles(int mois, int annee) =>
      _sommeTransactions(mois, annee, 'depense');

  Future<double> getTotalRevenusReels(int mois, int annee) =>
      _sommeTransactions(mois, annee, 'revenu');

  Future<double> getDepensesReellesByCategorie(String categorieId, int mois, int annee) async {
    final userId = _currentUserId;
    if (userId == null) return 0.0;
    final debut = DateTime(annee, mois, 1);
    final fin = DateTime(annee, mois + 1, 1);
    final snap = await _firestore
        .collection('transactions')
        .where('uid', isEqualTo: userId)
        .where('categorieId', isEqualTo: categorieId)
        .where('dateTransaction', isGreaterThanOrEqualTo: debut)
        .where('dateTransaction', isLessThan: fin)
        .get();
    double total = 0;
    for (final d in snap.docs) {
      total += (d.data()['montant'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0;
    }
    return total;
  }

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;

class OTPService {
  static const String _username = 'sandbox';
  static const String _apiKey =
      'atsk_34c5c02504d1c3c5797634f6154f15f6214a236dc15839ce07c6109d1b122bbbbdbf4dc3';
  static const String _apiUrl =
      'https://api.sandbox.africastalking.com/version1/messaging';

  static String _otpEnCours = '';
  static String _telephoneEnCours = '';

  static String _genererCode() {
    final random = Random.secure();
    return (1000 + random.nextInt(9000)).toString();
  }

  static Future<bool> envoyerOTP(String telephone) async {
    final code = _genererCode();
    _otpEnCours = code;
    _telephoneEnCours = telephone;

    // Formatter le numero
    String tel = telephone.replaceAll(' ', '')
        .replaceAll('-', '').replaceAll('+', '');
    if (tel.startsWith('0') && tel.length == 10) {
      tel = '225${tel.substring(1)}';
    } else if (!tel.startsWith('225')) {
      tel = '225$tel';
    }
    tel = '+$tel';

    print('ENVOI SMS A: $tel');

    try {
      final response = await http.post(
          Uri.parse(_apiUrl),
          headers: {
            'apiKey': _apiKey,
            'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
            'Accept': 'application/json',
          },
          body: {
            'username': _username,
            'to': tel,
            'message': 'Votre code TAPA Invest : $code. '
                'Valable 10 minutes.',
          });

      print('AT STATUS: ${response.statusCode}');
      print('AT BODY: ${response.body}');

      final data = jsonDecode(response.body);
      final recipients = data['SMSMessageData']?['Recipients'];
      if (recipients != null && (recipients as List).isNotEmpty) {
        final status = recipients[0]['status'] as String? ?? '';
        if (status == 'Success') return true;
      }
      return false;
    } catch (e) {
      print('AT ERROR: $e');
      return false;
    }
  }

  static bool verifierOTP(String code) {
    return code == _otpEnCours && _otpEnCours.isNotEmpty;
  }

  static void reinitialiser() {
    _otpEnCours = '';
    _telephoneEnCours = '';
  }

  static String get telephoneVerifie => _telephoneEnCours;
}

import 'db_service_mysql.dart';
import 'crypto_service.dart';

class ScoreTAPA {
  final int scoreTotal;
  final int scoreRevenus;
  final int scoreDepenses;
  final int scoreEpargne;
  final int scoreDettes;

  final int scoreCoherence;
  final String niveau;
  final String emoji;
  final List<String> conseils;
  final List<String> pointsForts;
  final List<String> alertesCoherence;
  final bool estFiable;
  final int txAvecHash;
  final int txSansHash;

  ScoreTAPA({
    required this.scoreTotal,
    required this.scoreRevenus,
    required this.scoreDepenses,
    required this.scoreEpargne,
    required this.scoreDettes,
    required this.scoreRegularite,
    required this.scoreCoherence,
    required this.niveau,
    required this.emoji,
    required this.conseils,
    required this.pointsForts,
    required this.alertesCoherence,
    required this.estFiable,
    required this.txAvecHash,
    required this.txSansHash,
  });
}

class ScoreService {
  static Future<ScoreTAPA> calculer(DBService db) async {
    // ✅ CORRECTION: Ajouter await
    final txs = await db.getTransactions();
    final revenus = txs.where((t) => t.isRevenu).toList();
    final depenses = txs.where((t) => t.isDepense).toList();
    final epargnes = db.getSavingsGoals();
    final dettes = db.getDettes();
    final now = DateTime.now();

    final totalRev = revenus.fold(0.0, (s, t) => s + t.montant);
    final totalDep = depenses.fold(0.0, (s, t) => s + t.montant);

    // 1. SCORE REVENUS (20 pts)
    int scoreRevenus = 0;
    if (totalRev > 0) scoreRevenus += 8;
    final revMois = revenus.where((t) =>
    t.dateTransaction.month == now.month && t.dateTransaction.year == now.year).toList();
    if (revMois.isNotEmpty) scoreRevenus += 6;
    final moisDernier = now.month == 1 ? 12 : now.month - 1;
    final anneeDerniere = now.month == 1 ? now.year - 1 : now.year;
    final revDernier = revenus.where((t) =>
    t.dateTransaction.month == moisDernier && t.dateTransaction.year == anneeDerniere).toList();
    if (revDernier.isNotEmpty) scoreRevenus += 6;

    // 2. SCORE DEPENSES (20 pts)
    int scoreDepenses = 0;
    if (totalRev > 0 && totalDep < totalRev) {
      scoreDepenses += 10;
    } else if (totalDep == 0) scoreDepenses += 5;
    final budget = await db.getBudget(now.month, now.year);
    if (budget != null) scoreDepenses += 6;
    if (budget != null && totalDep <= budget.totalDepensesPrevu) {
      scoreDepenses += 4;
    }

    // 3. SCORE EPARGNE (20 pts)
    int scoreEpargne = 0;
    if (epargnes.isNotEmpty) scoreEpargne += 8;
    final epargnesActives = epargnes.where(
            (e) => e.montantActuel < e.montantCible).toList();
    if (epargnesActives.isNotEmpty) scoreEpargne += 6;
    final epargnesAtteintes = epargnes.where(
            (e) => e.montantActuel >= e.montantCible).toList();
    if (epargnesAtteintes.isNotEmpty) scoreEpargne += 6;

    // 4. SCORE DETTES (20 pts)
    int scoreDettes = 20;
    if (dettes.isNotEmpty) {
      scoreDettes = 10;
      final dettesSoldees = dettes.where((d) => d.montantRestant <= 0).toList();
      final dettesEnAttente = dettes.where((d) => d.montantRestant > 0 && d.remboursements.isEmpty).toList();
      if (dettesSoldees.isNotEmpty) scoreDettes += 6;
      if (dettesEnAttente.isEmpty) scoreDettes += 4;
      if (dettesEnAttente.isNotEmpty) scoreDettes -= 2;
    }
    scoreDettes = scoreDettes.clamp(0, 20);

    // 5. SCORE REGULARITE (20 pts)
    int scoreRegularite = 0;
    if (txs.length >= 5) scoreRegularite += 5;
    if (txs.length >= 15) scoreRegularite += 5;
    if (txs.length >= 30) scoreRegularite += 5;
    final txsMois = txs.where((t) =>
    t.dateTransaction.month == now.month && t.dateTransaction.year == now.year).toList();
    if (txsMois.length >= 3) scoreRegularite += 5;

    // COHERENCE
    final moisDebut = txs.isNotEmpty
        ? txs.map((t) => t.dateTransaction).reduce((a, b) => a.isBefore(b) ? a : b)
        : now;
    final nbMois = ((now.difference(moisDebut).inDays) / 30)
        .ceil().clamp(1, 120);
    final coherence = CryptoService.analyserCoherence(
        totalRev, totalDep, txs.length, nbMois);
    final scoreCoherence = coherence['score'] as int;
    final alertesCoherence = List<String>.from(
        coherence['alertes'] as List);
    final estFiable = coherence['fiable'] as bool;

    // HASH VERIFICATION
    int txAvecHash = 0;
    int txSansHash = 0;
    for (final tx in txs) {
      txSansHash++;
    }

    // PENALITE COHERENCE
    int penalite = 0;
    if (scoreCoherence < 60) {
      penalite = 20;
    } else if (scoreCoherence < 80) penalite = 10;

    final total = (scoreRevenus + scoreDepenses +
        scoreEpargne + scoreDettes + scoreRegularite - penalite)
        .clamp(0, 100);

    // NIVEAU
    String niveau;
    String emoji;
    if (total >= 80) { niveau = 'Excellent'; emoji = '🟢'; }
    else if (total >= 60) { niveau = 'Bon'; emoji = '🔵'; }
    else if (total >= 40) { niveau = 'Moyen'; emoji = '🟡'; }
    else if (total >= 20) { niveau = 'Faible'; emoji = '🟠'; }
    else { niveau = 'Insuffisant'; emoji = '🔴'; }

    // CONSEILS
    final conseils = <String>[];
    final pointsForts = <String>[];

    if (scoreRevenus >= 14) {
      pointsForts.add('Vous enregistrez vos revenus regulierement.');
    } else {
      conseils.add('Enregistrez vos revenus chaque mois.');
    }
    if (scoreDepenses >= 14) {
      pointsForts.add('Vos dépenses sont bien controlees.');
    } else {
      conseils.add('Essayez de dépenser moins que vos revenus.');
    }
    if (budget != null) {
      pointsForts.add('Vous utilisez le budget prévisionnel.');
    } else {
      conseils.add('Crééz un budget prévisionnel mensuel.');
    }
    if (scoreEpargne >= 14) {
      pointsForts.add('Vous épargnez regulierement.');
    } else {
      conseils.add('Crééz un objectif d épargne.');
    }
    if (dettes.isEmpty) {
      pointsForts.add('Aucune dette. Tres bien !');
    } else if (dettes.any((d) => d.montantRestant > 0 && d.remboursements.isEmpty)) {
      conseils.add('Remboursez vos dettes en attente rapidement.');
    } else {
      pointsForts.add('Vous gerez bien vos dettes.');
    }
    if (scoreRegularite >= 15) {
      pointsForts.add('Vous utilisez l app regulierement.');
    } else {
      conseils.add('Utilisez l app quotidiennement.');
    }

    return ScoreTAPA(
      scoreTotal: total,
      scoreRevenus: scoreRevenus,
      scoreDepenses: scoreDepenses,
      scoreEpargne: scoreEpargne,
      scoreDettes: scoreDettes,
      scoreRegularite: scoreRegularite,
      scoreCoherence: scoreCoherence,
      niveau: niveau,
      emoji: emoji,
      conseils: conseils,
      pointsForts: pointsForts,
      alertesCoherence: alertesCoherence,
      estFiable: estFiable,
      txAvecHash: txAvecHash,
      txSansHash: txSansHash,
    );
  }
}

// lib/services/secure_http_service.dart

import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:dio_smart_retry/dio_smart_retry.dart';
import '../core/utils/logger.dart';

class SecureHttpService {
  static final SecureHttpService _instance = SecureHttpService._internal();
  factory SecureHttpService() => _instance;
  SecureHttpService._internal();

  late Dio _dio;
  bool _isInitialized = false;

  // ============================================
  // CERTIFICATS SHA-256 À PINNER
  // ============================================
  // 🔧 GÉNÉREZ CES HASH AVEC LA COMMANDE CI-DESSOUS
  // echo | openssl s_client -servername api.anthropic.com -connect api.anthropic.com:443 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -pubkey -noout | openssl pkey -pubin -outform der | openssl dgst -sha256 -binary | base64

  static const Map<String, List<String>> _pinnedCertificates = {
    'api.anthropic.com': [
      'sha256/AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=',
    ],
    'api.wave.com': [
      'sha256/BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB=',
    ],
    'firestore.googleapis.com': [
      'sha256/CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC=',
    ],
    'tapa-budget-6ed7c.firebaseio.com': [
      'sha256/DDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDD=',
    ],
  };

  // ============================================
  // INITIALISATION
  // ============================================

  Future<void> init() async {
    if (_isInitialized) return;

    try {
      _dio = Dio(BaseOptions(
        connectTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 30),
        receiveTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 30),
        sendTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 30),
        headers: {
          'Accept': 'application/json',
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
      ));

      // ✅ Intercepteur de sécurité
      _dio.interceptors.add(InterceptorsWrapper(
        onRequest: (options, handler) {
          Logger.debug('🌐 ${options.method} ${options.uri}');
          return handler.next(options);
        },
        onResponse: (response, handler) {
          Logger.debug('✅ ${response.statusCode} ${response.requestOptions.uri}');
          return handler.next(response);
        },
        onError: (error, handler) {
          Logger.error('❌ ${error.response?.statusCode} ${error.requestOptions.uri}');
          return handler.next(error);
        },
      ));

      // ✅ Retry automatique
      _dio.interceptors.add(
        RetryInterceptor(
          dio: _dio,
          logPrint: (message) => Logger.debug('🔄 Retry: $message'),
          retries: 3,
          retryDelays: const [
            Duration(seconds: 1),
            Duration(seconds: 2),
            Duration(seconds: 3),
          ],
        ),
      );

      _isInitialized = true;
      Logger.info('✅ SecureHttpService initialisé');
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur init SecureHttpService: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // MÉTHODES HTTP
  // ============================================

  Future<Response> get(
      String url, {
        Map<String, String>? headers,
        Map<String, dynamic>? queryParameters,
      }) async {
    await _ensureInitialized();
    return _dio.get(
      url,
      options: Options(headers: headers),
      queryParameters: queryParameters,
    );
  }

  Future<Response> post(
      String url, {
        Map<String, String>? headers,
        dynamic data,
      }) async {
    await _ensureInitialized();
    return _dio.post(
      url,
      options: Options(headers: headers),
      data: data,
    );
  }

  Future<Response> put(
      String url, {
        Map<String, String>? headers,
        dynamic data,
      }) async {
    await _ensureInitialized();
    return _dio.put(
      url,
      options: Options(headers: headers),
      data: data,
    );
  }

  Future<Response> delete(
      String url, {
        Map<String, String>? headers,
      }) async {
    await _ensureInitialized();
    return _dio.delete(
      url,
      options: Options(headers: headers),
    );
  }

  // ============================================
  // UTILITAIRES
  // ============================================

  Future<void> _ensureInitialized() async {
    if (!_isInitialized) {
      await init();
    }
  }

  Dio get dio => _dio;

  /// Vérifie le statut du pinning pour un domaine
  bool isDomainPinned(String domain) {
    return _pinnedCertificates.containsKey(domain);
  }
}

// lib/services/pin_security.dart

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../core/utils/logger.dart';

class PinSecurity {
  static const int maxAttempts = 5;
  static const Duration lockoutDuration = Duration(minutes: 5);

  static const String _kSaltKey = 'pin_salt';
  static const String _kHashKey = 'pin_hash';
  static const String _kLegacyPlainKey = 'user_pin';
  static const String _kAttemptsKey = 'pin_attempts';
  static const String _kLockedUntilKey = 'pin_locked_until';

  /// Génère un sel aléatoire cryptographiquement sûr.
  static String _generateSalt() {
    final rand = Random.secure();
    final bytes = List<int>.generate(16, (_) => rand.nextInt(256));
    return base64Url.encode(bytes);
  }

  static String _hash(String pin, String salt) {
    return sha256.convert(utf8.encode('$salt:$pin')).toString();
  }

  /// Sauvegarde un nouveau PIN pour un utilisateur donné
  static Future<void> savePin(String userId, String pin) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final salt = _generateSalt();
    final hash = _hash(pin, salt);

    final prefix = '${userId}_';
    await prefs.setString('$prefix$_kSaltKey', salt);
    await prefs.setString('$prefix$_kHashKey', hash);
    await prefs.remove('$prefix$_kLegacyPlainKey');
    await _resetAttempts(prefs, userId);

    Logger.info('🔐 PIN haché et sauvegardé pour $userId');
  }

  /// Hash un PIN pour le stockage Firestore (sans salt, pour compatibilité)
  static Future<String> hashPinForStorage(String pin) async {
    // Utilise un salt fixe pour le stockage Firestore
    const fixedSalt = 'TAPA_BUDGET_FIXED_SALT_2026';
    return sha256.convert(utf8.encode('$fixedSalt:$pin')).toString();
  }

  /// Vérifie le PIN saisi pour un utilisateur donné
  static Future<PinCheckResult> verifyPin(String userId, String pin) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final prefix = '${userId}_';

    // Vérifier le verrouillage
    final lockedUntilMs = prefs.getInt('$prefix$_kLockedUntilKey');
    if (lockedUntilMs != null) {
      final lockedUntil = DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(lockedUntilMs);
      if (DateTime.now().isBefore(lockedUntil)) {
        final remaining = lockedUntil.difference(DateTime.now());
        return PinCheckResult(
          success: false,
          isLocked: true,
          lockTime: lockedUntil,
          remainingAttempts: 0,
          message: 'PIN verrouillé (${remaining.inMinutes} min restantes)',
        );
      }
      await _resetAttempts(prefs, userId);
    }

    // Récupérer le hash stocké
    final salt = prefs.getString('$prefix$_kSaltKey');
    final storedHash = prefs.getString('$prefix$_kHashKey');

    bool isValid = false;
    if (salt != null && storedHash != null) {
      isValid = _hash(pin, salt) == storedHash;
    } else {
      // Migration depuis l'ancien format
      final legacyPlain = prefs.getString('$prefix$_kLegacyPlainKey');
      if (legacyPlain != null && legacyPlain == pin) {
        isValid = true;
        Logger.info('🔁 Migration PIN legacy → hash pour $userId');
        await savePin(userId, pin);
      }
    }

    if (isValid) {
      await _resetAttempts(prefs, userId);
      return const PinCheckResult(
        success: true,
        isLocked: false,
        remainingAttempts: maxAttempts,
        message: 'PIN valide',
      );
    }

    // Incrémenter les échecs
    final attempts = (prefs.getInt('$prefix$_kAttemptsKey') ?? 0) + 1;
    await prefs.setInt('$prefix$_kAttemptsKey', attempts);

    if (attempts >= maxAttempts) {
      final lockedUntil = DateTime.now().add(lockoutDuration);
      await prefs.setInt('$prefix$_kLockedUntilKey', lockedUntil.millisecondsSinceEpoch);
      Logger.warning('🔒 PIN verrouillé après $attempts tentatives pour $userId');
      return PinCheckResult(
        success: false,
        isLocked: true,
        lockTime: lockedUntil,
        remainingAttempts: 0,
        message: 'Trop de tentatives, PIN verrouillé',
      );
    }

    return PinCheckResult(
      success: false,
      isLocked: false,
      remainingAttempts: maxAttempts - attempts,
      message: 'PIN incorrect, ${maxAttempts - attempts} essais restants',
    );
  }

  static Future<void> _resetAttempts(SharedPreferences prefs, String userId) async {
    final prefix = '${userId}_';
    await prefs.remove('$prefix$_kAttemptsKey');
    await prefs.remove('$prefix$_kLockedUntilKey');
  }

  /// Vérifie si un PIN existe pour l'utilisateur
  static Future<bool> hasPin(String userId) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final prefix = '${userId}_';
    return prefs.containsKey('$prefix$_kHashKey') ||
        prefs.containsKey('$prefix$_kLegacyPlainKey');
  }

  /// Migre un PIN depuis Firestore vers le stockage local
  static Future<void> migrateFromFirestore(String userId, String hashedPin) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final prefix = '${userId}_';

    // Stocker le hash tel quel (comme si c'était un hash avec salt)
    // Pour la migration, on stocke le hash sans salt
    await prefs.setString('$prefix$_kHashKey', hashedPin);
    await prefs.setString('$prefix$_kSaltKey', 'migrated_from_firestore');
    await _resetAttempts(prefs, userId);

    Logger.info('🔁 PIN migré depuis Firestore pour $userId');
  }

  /// Supprime toutes les données PIN de l'utilisateur
  static Future<void> clearPinData(String userId) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final prefix = '${userId}_';

    await prefs.remove('$prefix$_kSaltKey');
    await prefs.remove('$prefix$_kHashKey');
    await prefs.remove('$prefix$_kLegacyPlainKey');
    await prefs.remove('$prefix$_kAttemptsKey');
    await prefs.remove('$prefix$_kLockedUntilKey');

    Logger.info('🗑️ Données PIN supprimées pour $userId');
  }

  /// Vérifie si le PIN est verrouillé (pour compatibilité avec l'ancienne version)
  static Future<bool> isLocked(String userId, int lockTime) async {
    if (lockTime == 0) return false;
    final lockedUntil = DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(lockTime);
    return DateTime.now().isBefore(lockedUntil);
  }
}

/// Résultat de la vérification du PIN
class PinCheckResult {
  final bool success;
  final bool isLocked;
  final DateTime? lockTime;
  final int remainingAttempts;
  final String message;

  const PinCheckResult({
    required this.success,
    this.isLocked = false,
    this.lockTime,
    this.remainingAttempts = 0,
    this.message = '',
  });
}

// lib/services/paiement_pro_service.dart

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:flutter_custom_tabs/flutter_custom_tabs.dart';
import '../core/utils/logger.dart';

class PaiementProService {
  // ⚠️ Votre ID Marchand PaiementPro
  final String merchantId = 'PP-F914';

  // ✅ URL officielle de l'API d'initialisation
  static const String _apiUrl =
      'https://www.paiementpro.net/webservice/onlinepayment/init/curl-init.php';

  /// Initialise un paiement et retourne l'URL de la page de paiement.
  Future<String?> initierPaiement({
    required int amount,
    required String description,
    required String referenceNumber,
    required String customerEmail,
    required String customerFirstName,
    required String customerLastname,
    required String customerPhoneNumber,
    String channel = 'WAVE',
    String countryCurrencyCode = '952',
    String? notificationURL,
    String? returnURL,
    String? returnContext,
  }) async {
    try {
      final body = {
        'merchantId': merchantId,
        'amount': amount,
        'description': description,
        'channel': channel,
        'countryCurrencyCode': countryCurrencyCode,
        'referenceNumber': referenceNumber,
        'customerEmail': customerEmail,
        'customerFirstName': customerFirstName,
        'customerLastname': customerLastname,
        'customerPhoneNumber': customerPhoneNumber,
      };

      if (notificationURL != null) body['notificationURL'] = notificationURL;
      if (returnURL != null) body['returnURL'] = returnURL;
      if (returnContext != null) body['returnContext'] = returnContext;

      final response = await http.post(
        Uri.parse(_apiUrl),
        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8'},
        body: jsonEncode(body),
      );

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final data = jsonDecode(response.body);
        if (data['success'] == true && data['url'] != null) {
          Logger.success('✅ PaiementPro URL obtenue: ${data['url']}');
          return data['url'] as String;
        } else {
          Logger.error('❌ PaiementPro API Error: ${data['message'] ?? data.toString()}');
          return null;
        }
      } else {
        Logger.error('❌ PaiementPro HTTP Error ${response.statusCode}: ${response.body}');
        return null;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur initialisation paiement: $e');
      return null;
    }
  }

  /// Initialise le paiement ET ouvre la page de paiement dans un Custom Tab.
  Future<bool> payerAvecPaiementPro({
    required int amount,
    required String description,
    required String referenceNumber,
    required String customerEmail,
    required String customerFirstName,
    required String customerLastname,
    required String customerPhoneNumber,
    String channel = 'WAVE',
    String countryCurrencyCode = '952',
    String? notificationURL,
    String? returnURL,
    String? returnContext,
  }) async {
    final url = await initierPaiement(
      amount: amount,
      description: description,
      referenceNumber: referenceNumber,
      customerEmail: customerEmail,
      customerFirstName: customerFirstName,
      customerLastname: customerLastname,
      customerPhoneNumber: customerPhoneNumber,
      channel: channel,
      countryCurrencyCode: countryCurrencyCode,
      notificationURL: notificationURL,
      returnURL: returnURL,
      returnContext: returnContext,
    );

    if (url == null) {
      Logger.error('❌ Impossible d\'obtenir l\'URL de paiement');
      return false;
    }

    try {
      await launchUrl(
        Uri.parse(url),
        customTabsOptions: const CustomTabsOptions(
          urlBarHidingEnabled: true,
          showTitle: true,
        ),
      );
      Logger.success('✅ Page de paiement ouverte: $url');
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.error('❌ Erreur launchUrl: $e');
      // Propager l'erreur pour qu'elle soit visible dans le SnackBar
      throw Exception('Erreur ouverture navigateur: $e');
    }
  }
}
